001.title: Vocabulary list
001.transcriptNote: The words in the order they're read. The English introduction at the start isn't transcribed. Several words were misheard by one model but clear in the other, and the notes mark the one word both models agreed on that seems unusual.

lines: to search for, to look up
other parts of the country, out of town
to sketch or paint from life
to go on a business trip
to run into, to come across
blocks.note: 写生 looks odd in a list about phones and directions, but both models heard it, and part 006 uses it: 他到北京的胡同里写生 (he went sketching in Beijing's hutongs).

002.title: Ten sentences
002.sub: Phones, accents and being pleased with yourself
002.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences using the new words from part 001. The English instructions at the start aren't transcribed, and some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 那个中国人说法语说得真地道。
Nàge Zhōngguórén shuō Fǎyǔ shuō de zhēn dìdao.
That Chinese person speaks really authentic French.
那是一个相当漂亮的姑娘。
Nà shì yí ge xiāngdāng piàoliang de gūniang.
请问，我想往外地打电话，应该怎么办？
Qǐngwèn, wǒ xiǎng wǎng wàidì dǎ diànhuà, yīnggāi zěnme bàn?
Excuse me, I'd like to call another city. What should I do?
The phone! Quick, go and answer it.
我给你打电话，很长时间都不通，一直占线。
Wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà, hěn cháng shíjiān dōu bù tōng, yìzhí zhànxiàn.
I tried calling you for ages and couldn't get through. The line was busy the whole time.
你别太得意了，更难的还在后面呢。
Nǐ bié tài déyì le, gèng nán de hái zài hòumiàn ne.
Don't get too pleased with yourself. The harder part is still to come.
你要是不听我的话，我就再也不给你打电话了。
Nǐ yàoshi bù tīng wǒ de huà, wǒ jiù zài yě bù gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà le.
If you don't listen to me, I'll never call you again.
你好！这里是益达公司，请问您找哪位？
Nǐ hǎo! Zhèlǐ shì Yìdá Gōngsī, qǐngwèn nín zhǎo nǎ wèi?
Hello, this is Yida Company. Who would you like to speak to?
对不起，您打的电话正在通话中，请过一会儿再打。
Duìbuqǐ, nín dǎ de diànhuà zhèngzài tōnghuà zhōng, qǐng guò yíhuìr zài dǎ.
Sorry, the number you dialled is busy. Please try again later.
老林，你的手机怎么关机了？
Lǎo Lín, nǐ de shǒujī zěnme guānjī le?
Lao Lin, why was your phone switched off?

grammar: 往 + place + 打电话
to call (to) somewhere
往 marks the direction of the call: 往外地打电话 is a call to another city, and 往家里打电话 is a call home.
我想往外地打电话，应该怎么办？
Wǒ xiǎng wǎng wàidì dǎ diànhuà, yīnggāi zěnme bàn?
I'd like to call another city. What should I do?
我每个星期往家里打一次电话。
Wǒ měi ge xīngqī wǎng jiā li dǎ yí cì diànhuà.
I call home once a week.
快去 + V + 一下
quick, go and …
一下 after a verb makes the request short and casual. 快去 adds urgency.
电话！快去接一下。
Diànhuà! Kuài qù jiē yíxià.
The phone! Quick, go and answer it.
有人敲门，快去看一下。
Yǒu rén qiāo mén, kuài qù kàn yíxià.
Someone's knocking. Quick, go and have a look.
别太……了，更……还在后面呢
don't be too …, the … part is still to come
别太 + adjective + 了 is a warning. 还在后面呢 means “it's still ahead”.
你别太得意了，更难的还在后面呢。
Nǐ bié tài déyì le, gèng nán de hái zài hòumiàn ne.
Don't get too pleased with yourself. The harder part is still to come.
别太高兴了，更难的考试还在后面呢。
Bié tài gāoxìng le, gèng nán de kǎoshì hái zài hòumiàn ne.
Don't get too happy. The harder exams are still to come.
再也不 + V + 了
never … again
再也不 means “not any more, ever”. 了 at the end marks the change.
我就再也不给你打电话了。
Wǒ jiù zài yě bù gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà le.
I'll never call you again.
我再也不去那家饭馆了。
Wǒ zài yě bú qù nà jiā fànguǎn le.
I'm never going to that restaurant again.
正在……中
in the middle of … (formal)
This formal version of 正在 appears in announcements and recorded messages, like the phone network's message here.
您打的电话正在通话中，请过一会儿再打。
Nín dǎ de diànhuà zhèngzài tōnghuà zhōng, qǐng guò yíhuìr zài dǎ.
The number you dialled is busy. Please try again later.
会议正在进行中，请不要打扰。
Huìyì zhèngzài jìnxíng zhōng, qǐng bú yào dǎrǎo.
A meeting is in progress. Please don't disturb.
gaps: 那个中国人说法语说得真

I tried calling you for ages and couldn't get through. The line was busy the whole time.

003.title: Wrong number
003.sub: A short phone dialogue with three questions
003.transcriptNote: 甲 is Anda, the caller, and 乙 is the person who answers. Phone numbers are read digit by digit, with 1 said as 幺 (yāo).

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 喂，你好！请问是益达公司吗？
Wéi, nǐ hǎo! Qǐngwèn shì Yìdá Gōngsī ma?
对不起，这儿不是益达公司。
Duìbuqǐ, zhèr bú shì Yìdá Gōngsī.
您的电话是零幺零六二二五四五七八吗？
Nín de diànhuà shì líng yāo líng liù èr èr wǔ sì wǔ qī bā ma?
不是，这儿是零幺零六二五五四五七八。
Bú shì, zhèr shì líng yāo líng liù èr wǔ wǔ sì wǔ qī bā.
Nín dǎ de diànhuà hàomǎ cuò le.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 回答下面的问题 · Answer the questions

q: 安达要给谁打电话？
Āndá yào gěi shéi dǎ diànhuà?
Who is Anda trying to call?
ans: 他要给益达公司打电话。
Tā yào gěi Yìdá Gōngsī dǎ diànhuà.
He's trying to call Yida Company.

q: 益达公司的电话号码是多少？
Yìdá Gōngsī de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
What is Yida Company's phone number?
ans: 零幺零六二二五四五七八。
Líng yāo líng liù èr èr wǔ sì wǔ qī bā.

q: 安达打的电话号码是多少？
Āndá dǎ de diànhuà hàomǎ shì duōshao?
What number did Anda actually dial?
ans: 零幺零六二五五四五七八。
Líng yāo líng liù èr wǔ wǔ sì wǔ qī bā.

grammar: 读电话号码
reading out phone numbers
Read phone numbers one digit at a time. Say 1 as 幺 (yāo), so it can't be confused with 七 (qī), and say 0 as 零 (líng). To ask for a number, use 是多少, not 是什么.
您的电话是零幺零六二二五四五七八吗？
Nín de diànhuà shì líng yāo líng liù èr èr wǔ sì wǔ qī bā ma?
Is your number 010-6225 4578?
我的手机号码是一三九一一零八六五四二。
Wǒ de shǒujī hàomǎ shì yāo sān jiǔ yāo yāo líng bā liù wǔ sì èr.
My mobile number is 139-1108-6542.
V + 的 + noun
the noun that someone V-ed
A verb phrase + 的 describes the noun after it: 您打的电话号码 is “the number you dialled”.
您打的电话号码错了。
Nín dǎ de diànhuà hàomǎ cuò le.
You've dialled the wrong number.
我昨天买的书很有意思。
Wǒ zuótiān mǎi de shū hěn yǒu yìsi.
The book I bought yesterday is really interesting.
对不起 / 不好意思 / 没关系
apologising and replying
对不起 is a direct apology. 不好意思 is softer, more like “my bad”. People often say both together, and the usual reply is 没关系.
对不起，不好意思。
Duìbuqǐ, bù hǎoyìsi.
Sorry, my apologies.
不好意思，我来晚了。——没关系。
Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ lái wǎn le. — Méi guānxi.
Sorry I'm late. — No problem.
gaps: 喂，你好！请问是益达公司
零六二二五四五七八吗？
say: Hello! Is this Yida Company?
Sorry, this isn't Yida Company.
You've dialled the wrong number.
Sorry, my apologies.

004.title: Asking for Lao Lin
004.sub: A phone call to an office
004.transcriptNote: 甲 answers the phone at Yida Company, and 乙 is Anda. The English instructions at the start aren't transcribed.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: Wéi, nǐ hǎo! Qǐngwèn Lǎo Lín zài ma?
请问您是哪位？有什么事儿？
Qǐngwèn nín shì nǎ wèi? Yǒu shénme shìr?
May I ask who's calling? What's it about?
我是安达，请找一下老林。
Wǒ shì Āndá, qǐng zhǎo yíxià Lǎo Lín.
This is Anda. Could I speak to Lao Lin, please?
对不起，我们这儿有好几个老林，您找哪位？
Duìbuqǐ, wǒmen zhèr yǒu hǎo jǐ ge Lǎo Lín, nín zhǎo nǎ wèi?
Sorry, we have quite a few Lao Lins here. Which one do you want?
我找林大刚，林经理。他在吗？
Wǒ zhǎo Lín Dàgāng, Lín jīnglǐ. Tā zài ma?
I'm looking for Lin Dagang, Manager Lin. Is he in?
林经理不在。您有什么事儿？
Lín jīnglǐ bú zài. Nín yǒu shénme shìr?
Manager Lin isn't in. What's it about?
您可以告诉我，我帮您转告林经理。
Nín kěyǐ gàosu wǒ, wǒ bāng nín zhuǎngào Lín jīnglǐ.
You can tell me, and I'll pass it on to Manager Lin for you.
要是有着急的事儿，也可以打林经理的手机。
Yàoshi yǒu zháojí de shìr, yě kěyǐ dǎ Lín jīnglǐ de shǒujī.
If it's urgent, you can also call Manager Lin's mobile.
那好吧，我打他的手机。谢谢！
Nà hǎo ba, wǒ dǎ tā de shǒujī. Xièxie!
All right then, I'll call his mobile. Thanks!
blocks.note: Last line: both models heard 拨打他的手机 (bōdǎ, “dial”). 我打 is my reading because it fits the grammar, but the book may have 我拨打.

vocab: to look for; to ask for (sb on the phone)
to help, to do sth for sb
grammar: 请找一下 + person / 我找 + person
asking for someone on the phone
找 means “look for”. On the phone it's the normal way to ask for someone, and 一下 makes it softer.
我是安达，请找一下老林。
Wǒ shì Āndá, qǐng zhǎo yíxià Lǎo Lín.
This is Anda. Could I speak to Lao Lin, please?
你好，我找王老师。
Nǐ hǎo, wǒ zhǎo Wáng lǎoshī.
Hello, I'd like to speak to Teacher Wang.
好几 + measure word
quite a few
好 before 几 stresses that the number is bigger than expected.
我们这儿有好几个老林。
Wǒmen zhèr yǒu hǎo jǐ ge Lǎo Lín.
We have quite a few Lao Lins here.
我等了你好几个小时。
Wǒ děng le nǐ hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí.
I waited for you for hours.
帮 + person + V
to do something for someone
帮 means “help”, and it also marks who you're doing something for.
我帮您转告林经理。
Wǒ bāng nín zhuǎngào Lín jīnglǐ.
I'll pass it on to Manager Lin for you.
你能帮我买一杯咖啡吗？
Nǐ néng bāng wǒ mǎi yì bēi kāfēi ma?
Could you buy me a coffee?
要是……，也可以……
if …, you can also …
要是 sets a condition, and 也可以 offers another option.
要是有着急的事儿，也可以打林经理的手机。
Yàoshi yǒu zháojí de shìr, yě kěyǐ dǎ Lín jīnglǐ de shǒujī.
If it's urgent, you can also call Manager Lin's mobile.
要是你没有时间，也可以明天再来。
Yàoshi nǐ méiyǒu shíjiān, yě kěyǐ míngtiān zài lái.
If you don't have time, you can also come back tomorrow.
gaps: 的事儿，也可以打林经理的手机。
say: Hello! Is Lao Lin there?
May I ask who's calling? What's it about?
Sorry, we have quite a few Lao Lins here. Which one do you want?
You can tell me, and I'll pass it on to Manager Lin for you.

005.title: Accents, phone calls and asking the way
005.transcriptNote: Machine transcription, cleaned up by hand. Since 他 and 她 sound the same, I picked one from context. Notes mark the few spots the recognizer was unsure of.

lines: 安达来北京已经十多年了，
Āndá lái Běijīng yǐjīng shí duō nián le,
Anda has been in Beijing for more than ten years,
可是他说汉语还有一点外国口音。
kěshì tā shuō Hànyǔ hái yǒu yìdiǎn wàiguó kǒuyīn.
but he still has a slight foreign accent when he speaks Chinese.

q: 从这句话里，我们知道什么？
Cóng zhè jù huà li, wǒmen zhīdào shénme?
From this sentence, what do we know?
o: 安达的北京口音很地道。
Āndá de Běijīng kǒuyīn hěn dìdao.
Anda's Beijing accent is really authentic.
安达说话的样子不像外国人。
Āndá shuōhuà de yàngzi bú xiàng wàiguórén.
The way Anda talks isn't like a foreigner.
安达来北京的时间不长。
Āndá lái Běijīng de shíjiān bù cháng.
Anda hasn't been in Beijing long.

blocks.note: Option A: the 安 blends into the letter “A”, so it was heard as 答的. 安达的 is the likely wording.

lines: Shì nǐ zìjǐ de fāyīn bú duì,
It's your own pronunciation that's wrong,
为什么要怪别人不懂呢？
wèishénme yào guài biérén bù dǒng ne?
so why blame other people for not understanding?

q: 说话人的意思是什么？
Shuōhuàrén de yìsi shì shénme?
What does the speaker mean?
o: 你应该相信自己的发音是对的。
Nǐ yīnggāi xiāngxìn zìjǐ de fāyīn shì duì de.
You should trust that your pronunciation is right.
你的发音有问题，不应该怪别人。
Nǐ de fāyīn yǒu wèntí, bù yīnggāi guài biérén.
Your pronunciation has a problem; you shouldn't blame others.
Zhè bú shì nǐ yí ge rén de cuò.
别人不懂不是你的问题。
Biérén bù dǒng bú shì nǐ de wèntí.
Others not understanding isn't your problem.

lines: 老板到南方出差去了三个月，
Lǎobǎn dào nánfāng chūchāi qù le sān ge yuè,
The boss went on a three-month business trip to the south;
回来以后，说话像南方人一样。
huílai yǐhòu, shuōhuà xiàng nánfāngrén yíyàng.
since he came back, he talks like a southerner.

q: 听了这句话，我们可以知道什么？
Tīng le zhè jù huà, wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
From this sentence, what can we tell?
o: 老板说话一直有南方口音。
Lǎobǎn shuōhuà yìzhí yǒu nánfāng kǒuyīn.
The boss has always had a southern accent.
老板现在说话有南方口音了。
Lǎobǎn xiànzài shuōhuà yǒu nánfāng kǒuyīn le.
The boss has a southern accent now.
老板以前说话有南方口音。
Lǎobǎn yǐqián shuōhuà yǒu nánfāng kǒuyīn.
The boss used to have a southern accent.
老板说话有一点南方口音。
Lǎobǎn shuōhuà yǒu yìdiǎn nánfāng kǒuyīn.
The boss has a slight southern accent.

lines: 有人说，同时学几种外语肯定学得不好。
Yǒu rén shuō, tóngshí xué jǐ zhǒng wàiyǔ kěndìng xué de bù hǎo.
Some people say that if you study several foreign languages at once, you're bound to learn them badly.
我不这样看，安达就是一个很好的例子。
Wǒ bú zhèyàng kàn, Āndá jiù shì yí ge hěn hǎo de lìzi.
I don't see it that way. Anda is a good example.

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: Āndá shuō guo yí ge lìzi.
安达没有同时学几种外语。
Āndá méiyǒu tóngshí xué jǐ zhǒng wàiyǔ.
Anda didn't study several languages at the same time.

blocks.note: Option B was heard as 说过; the book may have 举过 (jǔguo, “gave”) instead.

lines: 您好！请问，张大海的妹妹张小红在吗？
Nín hǎo! Qǐngwèn, Zhāng Dàhǎi de mèimei Zhāng Xiǎohóng zài ma?
Hello! Is Zhang Dahai's younger sister, Zhang Xiaohong, there?
那您能不能转告她，请她给我回个电话？
Nà nín néng bu néng zhuǎngào tā, qǐng tā gěi wǒ huí ge diànhuà?
Then could you give her a message and ask her to call me back?

q: 听了这句话，我们可以知道什么？
Tīng le zhè jù huà, wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
From this, what can we tell?
o: Tā yào zhǎo de rén shì Zhāng Dàhǎi.
The person he wants is Zhang Dahai.
张大海应该给他打一个电话。
Zhāng Dàhǎi yīnggāi gěi tā dǎ yí ge diànhuà.
Zhāng Xiǎohóng shì tā yào zhǎo de rén.
Zhang Xiaohong is the person he wants.
张小红应该给张大海打一个电话。
Zhāng Xiǎohóng yīnggāi gěi Zhāng Dàhǎi dǎ yí ge diànhuà.
Zhang Xiaohong should call Zhang Dahai.

blocks.note: The other side of the phone call isn't heard. The pause after 在吗 is where they say she's out.

lines: 什么？你也不知道益达公司的电话号码？
Shénme? Nǐ yě bù zhīdào Yìdá Gōngsī de diànhuà hàomǎ?
What? You don't know Yida Company's number either?
那咱们打幺幺四吧，这是查电话号码的。
Nà zánmen dǎ yāo yāo sì ba, zhè shì chá diànhuà hàomǎ de.
Then let's call 114. It's the number for looking up phone numbers.

q: 幺幺四是什么？
Yāo yāo sì shì shénme?
What is 114?
o: A number for looking up addresses.
可以查找电话号码的一个号码。
Kěyǐ cházhǎo diànhuà hàomǎ de yí ge hàomǎ.
A number you can call to look up phone numbers.

blocks.note: The item number “六” isn't audible, so 什么 may be part of the line or a mishearing. The company name was heard as 益达 (Yìdá).

lines: 请问，您能告诉我们去火车站怎么走吗？
Qǐngwèn, nín néng gàosu wǒmen qù huǒchēzhàn zěnme zǒu ma?
Excuse me, could you tell us how to get to the train station?
我们不熟悉这里，走丢了。
Wǒmen bù shúxī zhèlǐ, zǒudiū le.
We don't know this area, and we're lost.

q: 他们怎么了？
Tāmen zěnme le?
What's happened to them?

blocks.note: Only 丢了 was picked up clearly at the end. 走丢了 fits best.

lines: 他手里拿着地址，怎么还走丢了呢？
Tā shǒu li ná zhe dìzhǐ, zěnme hái zǒudiū le ne?
He had the address in his hand, so how did he still get lost?

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: Tā yǒu dìzhǐ, bù yīnggāi zǒudiū.
He had the address, so he shouldn't have got lost.
他没有地址怎么能找到？
Tā méiyǒu dìzhǐ zěnme néng zhǎodào?
How could he find it without the address?
他要是有地址就能找到。
Tā yàoshi yǒu dìzhǐ jiù néng zhǎodào.
If he had the address, he could find it.
Bù zhīdào dìzhǐ yě néng zhǎodào.
You can find it even without the address.

blocks.note: The item number “八” isn't audible in the recording.

lines: Nǐ cóng zhèr yìzhí wǎng qián zǒu,
到十字路口那儿过马路，
dào shízì lùkǒu nàr guò mǎlù,
cross the road at the intersection,
zài wǎng nán zǒu dàyuē wǔshí mǐ,
then go south for about fifty metres.
过了地铁站就是公共汽车站了。
guò le dìtiězhàn jiù shì gōnggòng qìchēzhàn le.
The bus stop is just past the subway station.

q: 问路的人要找什么地方？
Wèn lù de rén yào zhǎo shénme dìfang?
Where does the person asking for directions want to go?

lines: 虽然他没在学校学过，可是他的脑子很聪明，
Suīrán tā méi zài xuéxiào xué guo, kěshì tā de nǎozi hěn cōngming,
He never studied it at school, but he's very bright.
在中餐馆打工才几个月，汉语就说得很不错了。
zài Zhōngcānguǎn dǎgōng cái jǐ ge yuè, Hànyǔ jiù shuō de hěn búcuò le.
After only a few months working in a Chinese restaurant, his Chinese is already quite good.

q: 说话人想说什么？
Shuōhuàrén xiǎng shuō shénme?
What is the speaker getting at?
o: He's helping out at a Chinese restaurant now.

lines: Xiǎo Xiè, shì shéi lái de diànhuà?
Xiao Xie, who was that on the phone?
Tā méiyǒu shuō tā de míngzi.
听口音不像北京人，好像是个外地人。
Tīng kǒuyīn bú xiàng Běijīngrén, hǎoxiàng shì ge wàidìrén.
From his accent he isn't from Beijing. He seems to be from out of town.

q: 小谢为什么说来电话的是个外地人？
Xiǎo Xiè wèishénme shuō lái diànhuà de shì ge wàidìrén?
Why does Xiao Xie say the caller is from out of town?
o: Tā zhīdào nàge rén de míngzi.
他觉得那个人没有北京口音。
Tā juéde nàge rén méiyǒu Běijīng kǒuyīn.
He thinks the person doesn't have a Beijing accent.
Tīng bù dǒng nàge rén de kǒuyīn.
He can't understand the person's accent.

blocks.note: Option D: only 不懂 was clear, so 听不懂 is my best guess.

lines: 老林，你的手机怎么一直不通？
Lǎo Lín, nǐ de shǒujī zěnme yìzhí bù tōng?
Lao Lin, why couldn't I get through to your phone?
我一直在跟一个客户通话，
Wǒ yìzhí zài gēn yí ge kèhù tōnghuà,
I was on the phone with a client the whole time.

q: 老林的手机为什么不通？
Lǎo Lín de shǒujī wèishénme bù tōng?
Why couldn't anyone get through to Lao Lin's phone?
o: 老林不想接小李的电话。
Lǎo Lín bù xiǎng jiē Xiǎo Lǐ de diànhuà.
Lao Lin didn't want to take Xiao Li's call.
Lǎo Lín zhèngzài gēn biérén tōnghuà.
Lao Lin was on a call with someone else.
Lǎo Lín de shǒujī guānjī le.
Lao Lin's phone was switched off.
Lǎo Lín de shǒujī méiyǒu diàn le.
Lao Lin's phone battery was dead.

vocab: to go on a business trip
to get lost, to go missing
don't ask / don't even mention it
grammar: 十多年
Number + 多 + measure word
多 after a round number means “more than”: 十多年 is 10+ years, 二十多个 is 20+. After a single digit, 多 goes after the measure word instead: 两年多.
安达来北京已经十多年了。
Āndá lái Běijīng yǐjīng shí duō nián le.
Anda has been in Beijing for over ten years.
我等了你二十多分钟。
Wǒ děng le nǐ èrshí duō fēnzhōng.
I waited for you for over twenty minutes.
虽然……可是……
although … (still) …
This sets up a contrast. 但是 can replace 可是, and 可是 can also stand alone, as in item 1.
虽然他没在学校学过，可是他的脑子很聪明。
Suīrán tā méi zài xuéxiào xué guo, kěshì tā de nǎozi hěn cōngming.
He never studied it at school, but he's very bright.
虽然今天很冷，可是他没穿外套。
Suīrán jīntiān hěn lěng, kěshì tā méi chuān wàitào.
It's cold today, but he didn't wear a coat.
为什么要……呢？ / 怎么还……呢？
rhetorical reproach
These look like questions but act as complaints. 呢 softens the line and adds a tone of disbelief. In items 2 and 8 the answer is the opposite of what the question seems to ask.
他手里拿着地址，怎么还走丢了呢？
Tā shǒu li ná zhe dìzhǐ, zěnme hái zǒudiū le ne?
He had the address, so how did he still get lost?
你已经吃饭了，怎么还饿呢？
Nǐ yǐjīng chī fàn le, zěnme hái è ne?
You've already eaten. How can you still be hungry?
像……一样
like …, the same as …
The comparison is A 像 B 一样 + (optional) adjective or verb.
回来以后，说话像南方人一样。
Huílai yǐhòu, shuōhuà xiàng nánfāngrén yíyàng.
Since coming back, he talks like a southerner.
她说话像老师一样。
Tā shuōhuà xiàng lǎoshī yíyàng.
She talks like a teacher.
V + 得 + comment
how well / how an action is done
得 links a verb to a comment on how it's done. When there's an object, repeat the verb or put the object first: 汉语说得很不错.
汉语就说得很不错了。
Hànyǔ jiù shuō de hěn búcuò le.
His Chinese is already quite good.
他跑得很快。
Tā pǎo de hěn kuài.
He runs very fast.
only … and already …
才 stresses how little time or effort it took, and 就 marks the result as early or easy.
在中餐馆打工才几个月，汉语就说得很不错了。
Zài Zhōngcānguǎn dǎgōng cái jǐ ge yuè, Hànyǔ jiù shuō de hěn búcuò le.
After only a few months at a Chinese restaurant, his Chinese is already good.
他才学了一年，就能看中文报纸了。
Tā cái xué le yì nián, jiù néng kàn Zhōngwén bàozhǐ le.
He's only studied for a year and he can already read Chinese newspapers.
一直在 / 正在 + V
ongoing action
正在 means right at that moment, and 一直在 means continuously for a whole stretch of time. 跟 + person + 通话 means talking with someone on the phone.
我一直在跟一个客户通话。
Wǒ yìzhí zài gēn yí ge kèhù tōnghuà.
I was on the phone with a client the whole time.
我正在跟妈妈打电话。
Wǒ zhèngzài gēn māma dǎ diànhuà.
I'm on the phone with my mum right now.
往 + direction + 走 / 过了 A 就是 B
giving directions
往 marks the direction of movement. 过了 A 就是 B means “once you pass A, you're at B”.
再往南走大约五十米，过了地铁站就是公共汽车站了。
Zài wǎng nán zǒu dàyuē wǔshí mǐ, guò le dìtiězhàn jiù shì gōnggòng qìchēzhàn le.
Then go south about fifty metres. Just past the subway station is the bus stop.
往左走，过了银行就是医院。
Wǎng zuǒ zǒu, guò le yínháng jiù shì yīyuàn.
Turn left. The hospital is just past the bank.
要是……就……
if … then …
This is a spoken condition, and 如果 is the more neutral form. 就 introduces the result.
他要是有地址就能找到。
Tā yàoshi yǒu dìzhǐ jiù néng zhǎodào.
If he had the address, he could find it.
要是明天下雨，我们就不去了。
Yàoshi míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
judging by … / it seems …
听口音 means “going by the accent”. Swap the noun to change what you're judging by: 听声音, 看样子.
听口音不像北京人，好像是个外地人。
Tīng kǒuyīn bú xiàng Běijīngrén, hǎoxiàng shì ge wàidìrén.
From his accent he isn't from Beijing. He seems to be from out of town.
听声音，好像是你哥哥。
Tīng shēngyīn, hǎoxiàng shì nǐ gēge.
From the voice, it sounds like your brother.
gaps: 他说汉语还有一点外国
是你自己的发音不对，为什么要
学几种外语肯定学得不好。
几个月，汉语就说得很不错了。
say: Hello, is Zhang Xiaohong there?
Could you give her a message and ask her to call me back?
Excuse me, could you tell us how to get to the train station?
Go straight ahead from here and cross the road at the intersection.
Then walk south about fifty metres.
Don't ask. I was on the phone with a client the whole time.

006.title: Anda's Beijing Chinese
006.sub: A short story, 7 true-or-false statements and 5 questions
006.transcriptNote: A story told by one narrator, followed by two exercises. The English instructions between sections aren't transcribed, and some statement numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 故事
lines: 安达是从美国来中国的。
Āndá shì cóng Měiguó lái Zhōngguó de.
Anda came to China from America.
他在北京生活了十多年了。
Tā zài Běijīng shēnghuó le shí duō nián le.
He has lived in Beijing for over ten years.
他喜欢画画，也喜欢学老北京人说话。
Tā xǐhuan huà huà, yě xǐhuan xué lǎo Běijīngrén shuōhuà.
He likes painting, and he also likes imitating the way old Beijingers talk.
有一次，他到北京的胡同里写生，
Yǒu yí cì, tā dào Běijīng de hútòng li xiěshēng,
Once he went sketching in the hutongs of Beijing.
因为太认真了，画得忘了时间，一直到天都黑了。
yīnwèi tài rènzhēn le, huà de wàng le shíjiān, yìzhí dào tiān dōu hēi le.
He was so absorbed that he lost track of time, and kept painting until it was dark.
他正收拾东西准备回家的时候，有两个外地人向他问路。
Tā zhèng shōushi dōngxi zhǔnbèi huí jiā de shíhou, yǒu liǎng ge wàidìrén xiàng tā wèn lù.
Just as he was packing up to go home, two people from out of town asked him the way.
他给他们指了路以后，外地人还夸他北京话说得好，像个地道的北京人。
Tā gěi tāmen zhǐ le lù yǐhòu, wàidìrén hái kuā tā Běijīnghuà shuō de hǎo, xiàng ge dìdao de Běijīngrén.
After he showed them the way, they even praised his Beijing dialect and said he sounded like a real Beijinger.
他得意得不得了，见到谁都要自夸一会儿。
Tā déyì de bùdéliǎo, jiàndào shéi dōu yào zìkuā yíhuìr.
He was extremely pleased with himself and bragged about it to everyone he met.
可是，有一次他去别的地方出差，打电话回来，
Kěshì, yǒu yí cì tā qù bié de dìfang chūchāi, dǎ diànhuà huílai,
But once, when he was on a business trip somewhere else, he called back,
接电话的人以为他是一个外地人。
jiē diànhuà de rén yǐwéi tā shì yí ge wàidìrén.
and the person who answered thought he was someone from out of town.
从那以后，他再也不得意了。
Cóng nà yǐhòu, tā zài yě bù déyì le.
After that, he never bragged again.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 听后判断正误 · True or false

q: 安达是美国人。
Āndá shì Měiguórén.
Anda is American.
他来北京十多天了。
Tā lái Běijīng shí duō tiān le.
He has been in Beijing for over ten days.
qs.why: 十多年, over ten years, not 十多天

q: 他喜欢画画，也喜欢听老北京人说话。
Tā xǐhuan huà huà, yě xǐhuan tīng lǎo Běijīngrén shuōhuà.
He likes painting, and he also likes listening to old Beijingers talk.
qs.why: the story says 学 (imitate), not 听 (listen)

q: 安达是在北京的胡同里遇到两个外地人的。
Āndá shì zài Běijīng de hútòng li yùdào liǎng ge wàidìrén de.
Anda met the two out-of-towners in a Beijing hutong.
外地人给安达指了路。
Wàidìrén gěi Āndá zhǐ le lù.
The out-of-towners showed Anda the way.
qs.why: it was the other way round

q: 外地人说安达的北京话说得好。
Wàidìrén shuō Āndá de Běijīnghuà shuō de hǎo.
The out-of-towners said Anda speaks good Beijing dialect.
听到外地人夸他，安达非常得意。
Tīngdào wàidìrén kuā tā, Āndá fēicháng déyì.
When he heard them praise him, Anda was very pleased with himself.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 听后回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 安达是什么时候来北京的？
Āndá shì shénme shíhou lái Běijīng de?
When did Anda come to Beijing?
ans: 他是十多年前来北京的。
Tā shì shí duō nián qián lái Běijīng de.
He came to Beijing more than ten years ago.

q: 安达的爱好是什么？
Āndá de àihào shì shénme?
What are Anda's hobbies?
ans: 他喜欢画画，也喜欢学老北京人说话。
Tā xǐhuan huà huà, yě xǐhuan xué lǎo Běijīngrén shuōhuà.
Painting and imitating the way old Beijingers talk.

q: 安达为什么能给外地人指路？
Āndá wèishénme néng gěi wàidìrén zhǐ lù?
Why could Anda give the out-of-towners directions?
ans: 因为他在北京生活了十多年了，对北京很熟悉。
Yīnwèi tā zài Běijīng shēnghuó le shí duō nián le, duì Běijīng hěn shúxī.
Because he's lived in Beijing for over ten years and knows it well.

q: 他给外地人指路以后，为什么非常得意？
Tā gěi wàidìrén zhǐ lù yǐhòu, wèishénme fēicháng déyì?
After giving them directions, why was he so pleased with himself?
ans: 因为外地人夸他北京话说得好，像个地道的北京人。
Yīnwèi wàidìrén kuā tā Běijīnghuà shuō de hǎo, xiàng ge dìdao de Běijīngrén.
Because they praised his Beijing dialect and said he sounded like a real Beijinger.

q: 最后，他为什么又不得意了？
Zuìhòu, tā wèishénme yòu bù déyì le?
In the end, why did he stop bragging?
ans: 因为他出差打电话回来，接电话的人以为他是外地人。
Yīnwèi tā chūchāi dǎ diànhuà huílai, jiē diànhuà de rén yǐwéi tā shì wàidìrén.
Because when he called back from a business trip, the person who answered thought he was from out of town.

blocks.note: The answers to these five questions are my own wording, based on the story.

vocab: to sketch or paint from life
to go on a business trip
to decide whether true or false
grammar: 是……的
stressing when, where or how
Use 是……的 for something that already happened, to highlight a detail such as where from, when or how. The detail goes right after 是.
安达是从美国来中国的。
Āndá shì cóng Měiguó lái Zhōngguó de.
Anda came to China from America.
我是坐飞机来的。
Wǒ shì zuò fēijī lái de.
I came by plane.
正……的时候
just as …
This marks an action in progress when something else happens.
他正收拾东西准备回家的时候，有两个外地人向他问路。
Tā zhèng shōushi dōngxi zhǔnbèi huí jiā de shíhou, yǒu liǎng ge wàidìrén xiàng tā wèn lù.
Just as he was packing up to go home, two out-of-towners asked him the way.
我正吃饭的时候，电话响了。
Wǒ zhèng chī fàn de shíhou, diànhuà xiǎng le.
The phone rang just as I was eating.
向 + person + 问路
to ask someone the way
向 marks who an action is aimed at. You'll also hear 跟 + person + 打听 for the same idea, as in part 007.
有两个外地人向他问路。
Yǒu liǎng ge wàidìrén xiàng tā wèn lù.
Two out-of-towners asked him the way.
我向一位老人问路。
Wǒ xiàng yí wèi lǎorén wèn lù.
I asked an old man the way.
adjective + 得不得了
extremely …
This degree complement is very common in speech. Also compare 画得忘了时间, “painted so much he forgot the time”.
他得意得不得了。
Tā déyì de bùdéliǎo.
He was extremely pleased with himself.
今天热得不得了。
Jīntiān rè de bùdéliǎo.
It's incredibly hot today.
谁都 / 什么都
everyone / everything
A question word + 都 means “every”: 见到谁都 is “whoever he meets”.
见到谁都要自夸一会儿。
Jiàndào shéi dōu yào zìkuā yíhuìr.
He bragged to everyone he met.
他什么都想吃。
Tā shénme dōu xiǎng chī.
He wants to eat everything.
以为
to think (wrongly)
以为 usually means the belief turned out to be wrong. For a neutral opinion, use 觉得 or 认为.
接电话的人以为他是一个外地人。
Jiē diànhuà de rén yǐwéi tā shì yí ge wàidìrén.
The person who answered thought he was from out of town.
我以为今天是星期六，原来是星期五。
Wǒ yǐwéi jīntiān shì xīngqīliù, yuánlái shì xīngqīwǔ.
I thought today was Saturday, but it's actually Friday.
say: Anda came to China from America.
He has lived in Beijing for over ten years.
Just as he was packing up to go home, two people from out of town asked him the way.
He was extremely pleased with himself and bragged about it to everyone he met.
The person who answered thought he was someone from out of town.

007.title: Asking the way
007.sub: A dialogue in a hutong, then 4 multiple-choice items
007.transcriptNote: 甲 is the pair from out of town, and 乙 is the man they ask. The English instructions aren't transcribed, and items 2 and 4 aren't numbered aloud.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 先生，您好！跟您打听一下路，行吗？
Xiānsheng, nín hǎo! Gēn nín dǎting yíxià lù, xíng ma?
Hello, sir! Could we ask you the way?
只要是我知道的，我一定会告诉你们。您就说要去哪儿吧。
Zhǐyào shì wǒ zhīdào de, wǒ yídìng huì gàosu nǐmen. Nín jiù shuō yào qù nǎr ba.
As long as it's somewhere I know, I'll certainly tell you. Just say where you want to go.
可是我们是从外地来的，不太熟悉北京，找了半天也没找到。
Kěshì wǒmen shì cóng wàidì lái de, bú tài shúxī Běijīng, zhǎo le bàntiān yě méi zhǎodào.
But we're from out of town and don't really know Beijing. We've been looking for ages and haven't found it.
您看，天快黑了，我们可真不知道怎么办了。
Nín kàn, tiān kuài hēi le, wǒmen kě zhēn bù zhīdào zěnme bàn le.
Look, it's almost dark, and we really don't know what to do.
这件事容易，我带你们去就行了。
Zhè jiàn shì róngyì, wǒ dài nǐmen qù jiù xíng le.
That's easy. I'll just take you there.
你们看，出了这个胡同口，往右拐，
Nǐmen kàn, chū le zhège hútòng kǒu, wǎng yòu guǎi,
Look, when you come out of this hutong, turn right,
guò mǎlù, zài wǎng zuǒ yìzhí zǒu,
cross the road, then go left and keep going straight.
过了两个红绿灯，右边第一个胡同就是百花胡同了。
guò le liǎng ge hónglǜdēng, yòubian dì yī ge hútòng jiù shì Bǎihuā Hútòng le.
After two sets of traffic lights, the first hutong on the right is Baihua Hutong.
太谢谢您了！您可帮了我们的大忙了。
Tài xièxie nín le! Nín kě bāng le wǒmen de dà máng le.
Thank you so much! You've been a huge help.
您的北京话说得真地道。
Nín de Běijīnghuà shuō de zhēn dìdao.
Your Beijing dialect is really authentic.
要不是看您的样子，还真以为您就是北京人呢。
Yàobúshì kàn nín de yàngzi, hái zhēn yǐwéi nín jiù shì Běijīngrén ne.
If it weren't for how you look, we'd really have thought you were from Beijing.
Nǎli nǎli, nín tài kèqi le.
Not at all, you're too kind.

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 听第二遍后选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 他们为什么向那位先生问路？
Tāmen wèishénme xiàng nà wèi xiānsheng wèn lù?
Why did they ask that man the way?
o: 他们想知道那位先生是不是北京人。
Tāmen xiǎng zhīdào nà wèi xiānsheng shì bu shì Běijīngrén.
They wanted to know whether he was from Beijing.
他们是外地人，不熟悉北京的街道。
Tāmen shì wàidìrén, bù shúxī Běijīng de jiēdào.
They're from out of town and don't know Beijing's streets.
他们熟悉北京，想知道那位先生熟悉不熟悉北京。
Tāmen shúxī Běijīng, xiǎng zhīdào nà wèi xiānsheng shúxī bu shúxī Běijīng.
They know Beijing and wanted to see whether he did.
他们不知道北京的街道在哪儿。
Tāmen bù zhīdào Běijīng de jiēdào zài nǎr.
They don't know where Beijing's streets are.

q: 他们什么时候跟那位先生问路？
Tāmen shénme shíhou gēn nà wèi xiānsheng wèn lù?
When did they ask him the way?
第二个人说：“要是我知道，我一定会告诉你们。”这句话是什么意思？
Dì èr ge rén shuō: “Yàoshi wǒ zhīdào, wǒ yídìng huì gàosu nǐmen.” Zhè jù huà shì shénme yìsi?
The second man says, “If I know, I'll certainly tell you.” What does he mean?
o: 我如果知道的话，一定会告诉你们。
Wǒ rúguǒ zhīdào de huà, yídìng huì gàosu nǐmen.
If I know it, I'll certainly tell you.
我知道，可是不告诉你们。
Wǒ zhīdào, kěshì bú gàosu nǐmen.
I know, but I won't tell you.
你们知道的话请告诉我。
Nǐmen zhīdào de huà qǐng gàosu wǒ.
If you know, please tell me.
Wǒ gàosu nǐmen wǒ bù zhīdào.
I'm telling you I don't know.

q: “您的北京话说得真地道。”这句话的意思是：
“Nín de Běijīnghuà shuō de zhēn dìdao.” Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì:
“Your Beijing dialect is really authentic.” This means:
o: 您的北京话说得跟北京人一样。
Nín de Běijīnghuà shuō de gēn Běijīngrén yíyàng.
You speak Beijing dialect just like a Beijinger.
您说的北京话有外地口音。
Nín shuō de Běijīnghuà yǒu wàidì kǒuyīn.
Your Beijing dialect has an out-of-town accent.
您说的北京话我们不懂。
Nín shuō de Běijīnghuà wǒmen bù dǒng.
We don't understand your Beijing dialect.
您说的北京话我们不容易听懂。
Nín shuō de Běijīnghuà wǒmen bù róngyì tīngdǒng.
Your Beijing dialect is hard for us to understand.

grammar: 跟 + person + 打听
to ask someone about something
打听 means asking for information, often directions or news. The person you ask comes after 跟 or 向.
跟您打听一下路，行吗？
Gēn nín dǎting yíxià lù, xíng ma?
Could we ask you the way?
我想跟你打听一个人。
Wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ dǎting yí ge rén.
I'd like to ask you about someone.
只要……，就/一定……
as long as …, then …
只要 gives the one condition that's enough for the result.
只要是我知道的，我一定会告诉你们。
Zhǐyào shì wǒ zhīdào de, wǒ yídìng huì gàosu nǐmen.
As long as it's somewhere I know, I'll certainly tell you.
只要你多练习，就能说好。
Zhǐyào nǐ duō liànxí, jiù néng shuō hǎo.
As long as you practise a lot, you'll speak well.
V了半天也没 + result
tried for ages without success
半天 here means “a long time”, not “half a day”. 也没 says the result never came.
找了半天也没找到。
Zhǎo le bàntiān yě méi zhǎodào.
We've been looking for ages and haven't found it.
我等了半天也没等到他。
Wǒ děng le bàntiān yě méi děngdào tā.
I waited ages, but he never came.
出了 A，往右拐
giving directions
出了 means “after leaving”. 往右拐 and 往左拐 mean turn right and turn left. Compare 过了A就是B from part 005.
出了这个胡同口，往右拐。
Chū le zhège hútòng kǒu, wǎng yòu guǎi.
When you come out of this hutong, turn right.
出了地铁站，往左拐就是银行。
Chū le dìtiězhàn, wǎng zuǒ guǎi jiù shì yínháng.
Turn left out of the subway station and the bank is right there.
可 (emphatic)
really, truly
可 before a verb or adjective adds strong feeling, much like “really” in speech.
您可帮了我们的大忙了。
Nín kě bāng le wǒmen de dà máng le.
You've been a huge help.
今天可冷了！
Jīntiān kě lěng le!
It's really cold today!
要不是……，还真以为……呢
if it weren't for …, I'd really have thought …
要不是 introduces the one thing that stopped a wrong conclusion, and 以为 is the conclusion you would have drawn.
要不是看您的样子，还真以为您就是北京人呢。
Yàobúshì kàn nín de yàngzi, hái zhēn yǐwéi nín jiù shì Běijīngrén ne.
If it weren't for how you look, we'd really have thought you were from Beijing.
要不是你告诉我，我还真以为今天不上课呢。
Yàobúshì nǐ gàosu wǒ, wǒ hái zhēn yǐwéi jīntiān bú shàngkè ne.
If you hadn't told me, I'd really have thought there was no class today.
gaps: 是我知道的，我一定会告诉你们。
我们是从外地来的，不太
，右边第一个胡同就是百花胡同了。
看您的样子，还真以为您就是北京人呢。

rp.title: Asking the way to Baihua Hutong

say: Hello, sir! Could we ask you the way?
We're from out of town and don't really know Beijing. We've been looking for ages and haven't found it.
When you come out of this hutong, turn right.
Thank you so much! You've been a huge help.
Not at all, you're too kind.

010.title: The American boss's Beijing accent
010.sub: The lesson text, told by Lin Dagang
010.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. It retells the story from part 006 from the point of view of Lin Dagang (老林), Anda's employee.

lines: 我叫林大刚，今年四十二岁，在北京一家外国公司工作。
Wǒ jiào Lín Dàgāng, jīnnián sìshí'èr suì, zài Běijīng yì jiā wàiguó gōngsī gōngzuò.
My name is Lin Dagang. I'm 42 and I work at a foreign company in Beijing.
下面我来给大家讲一个外国人说中国话的小故事。
Xiàmiàn wǒ lái gěi dàjiā jiǎng yí ge wàiguórén shuō Zhōngguóhuà de xiǎo gùshi.
Now let me tell you a little story about a foreigner speaking Chinese.
我的老板是个美国人，名字叫安达，在中国生活了十几年了。
Wǒ de lǎobǎn shì ge Měiguórén, míngzi jiào Āndá, zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó le shí jǐ nián le.
My boss is American. His name is Anda, and he's lived in China for more than ten years.
他中国话说得相当好，而且特别喜欢学老北京人的口音。
Tā Zhōngguóhuà shuō de xiāngdāng hǎo, érqiě tèbié xǐhuan xué lǎo Běijīngrén de kǒuyīn.
His Chinese is quite good, and he especially likes imitating the old Beijing accent.
他还爱画画，周末有空的时候，常常到小胡同里去写生。
Tā hái ài huà huà, zhōumò yǒu kòng de shíhou, chángcháng dào xiǎo hútòng li qù xiěshēng.
He also loves painting. When he's free at weekends, he often goes sketching in the little hutongs.
有一次，他画得忘了时间，
Yǒu yí cì, tā huà de wàng le shíjiān,
Once he was so absorbed in painting that he lost track of time.
天已经快黑了，胡同里的行人也越来越少了。
tiān yǐjīng kuài hēi le, hútòng li de xíngrén yě yuèláiyuè shǎo le.
It was almost dark, and there were fewer and fewer people in the hutong.
有两个提着旅行包的外地人迷了路，
Yǒu liǎng ge tí zhe lǚxíngbāo de wàidìrén mí le lù,
Two out-of-towners carrying travel bags had got lost,
最后是安达一直带着他们走到了大街上。
zuìhòu shì Āndá yìzhí dài zhe tāmen zǒudào le dàjiē shang.
and in the end it was Anda who walked them all the way out to the main street.
那两个人非常感谢他，还说他讲话就跟北京人一样。
Nà liǎng ge rén fēicháng gǎnxiè tā, hái shuō tā jiǎnghuà jiù gēn Běijīngrén yíyàng.
The two of them were very grateful, and they even said he talked just like a Beijinger.
Anda felt very pleased with himself.
星期一上班的时候，跟同事们说，连中国人都觉得他的北京话很地道。
Xīngqīyī shàngbān de shíhou, gēn tóngshìmen shuō, lián Zhōngguórén dōu juéde tā de Běijīnghuà hěn dìdao.
At work on Monday he told his colleagues that even Chinese people thought his Beijing dialect was authentic.
Dàjiā tīng le, zhǐshì xiào le xiào.
后来，安达去上海办事，往公司打电话找我，
Hòulái, Āndá qù Shànghǎi bànshì, wǎng gōngsī dǎ diànhuà zhǎo wǒ,
Later, Anda went to Shanghai on business and called the office asking for me.
是新来的谢云接的电话。
shì xīn lái de Xiè Yún jiē de diànhuà.
It was Xie Yun, who had just started, who answered.
小谢从来没见过这个老板，也没问对方是谁，
Xiǎo Xiè cónglái méi jiàn guo zhège lǎobǎn, yě méi wèn duìfāng shì shéi,
Xiao Xie had never met the boss, and didn't ask who was calling.
就大声地喊：“老林，电话！有个外地人找您！”
jiù dàshēng de hǎn: “Lǎo Lín, diànhuà! Yǒu ge wàidìrén zhǎo nín!”
She just shouted, “Lao Lin, phone! There's someone from out of town asking for you!”
从那以后，安达就再也不提自己的北京口音了。
Cóng nà yǐhòu, Āndá jiù zài yě bù tí zìjǐ de Běijīng kǒuyīn le.
After that, Anda never mentioned his Beijing accent again.
blocks.note: Both 他 and 她 fit Xiao Xie, since the recording can't tell them apart. I used “she” in the English.

vocab: to be free, to have time
to sketch or paint from life
grammar: 下面我来 + V
now let me …
来 before a verb means “I'll take this on”. It's common when you start talking to a group.
下面我来给大家讲一个外国人说中国话的小故事。
Xiàmiàn wǒ lái gěi dàjiā jiǎng yí ge wàiguórén shuō Zhōngguóhuà de xiǎo gùshi.
Now let me tell you a little story about a foreigner speaking Chinese.
下面我来介绍一下我的家。
Xiàmiàn wǒ lái jièshào yíxià wǒ de jiā.
Now let me tell you about my family.
十几年 / 十多年
ten-odd years
几 after 十 means an unknown number between 1 and 9, so it works like 多. Part 006 says 十多年 for the same idea.
在中国生活了十几年了。
Zài Zhōngguó shēnghuó le shí jǐ nián le.
He's lived in China for more than ten years.
我们班有二十几个学生。
Wǒmen bān yǒu èrshí jǐ ge xuésheng.
There are twenty-odd students in our class.
越来越 + adjective
more and more …
This describes a gradual change. Put 了 at the end when the change is happening now.
胡同里的行人也越来越少了。
Hútòng li de xíngrén yě yuèláiyuè shǎo le.
There were fewer and fewer people in the hutong.
天气越来越冷了。
Tiānqì yuèláiyuè lěng le.
The weather is getting colder and colder.
even …
Put the surprising example between 连 and 都 (or 也).
连中国人都觉得他的北京话很地道。
Lián Zhōngguórén dōu juéde tā de Běijīnghuà hěn dìdao.
Even Chinese people thought his Beijing dialect was authentic.
这个问题连老师都不知道。
Zhège wèntí lián lǎoshī dōu bù zhīdào.
Even the teacher doesn't know the answer to this question.
V了V
did briefly
Repeating a one-syllable verb with 了 in between means doing it briefly or lightly.
大家听了，只是笑了笑。
Dàjiā tīng le, zhǐshì xiào le xiào.
Everyone just smiled.
他想了想，说：“好吧。”
Tā xiǎng le xiǎng, shuō: “Hǎo ba.”
He thought for a moment and said, “All right.”
是……V的 (stressing who)
it was … who …
Here 是……的 highlights who did something. Compare 006, where it highlights where from.
是新来的谢云接的电话。
Shì xīn lái de Xiè Yún jiē de diànhuà.
It was Xie Yun, who had just started, who answered.
是我妈妈做的饭。
Shì wǒ māma zuò de fàn.
It was my mum who cooked.
从来没 + V过
have never …
从来 strengthens the negative, and 过 marks past experience.
小谢从来没见过这个老板。
Xiǎo Xiè cónglái méi jiàn guo zhège lǎobǎn.
Xiao Xie had never met the boss.
我从来没去过上海。
Wǒ cónglái méi qù guo Shànghǎi.
I've never been to Shanghai.
gaps: 的时候，常常到小胡同里去写生。
有两个提着旅行包的外地人
中国人都觉得他的北京话很地道。
say: Now let me tell you a little story about a foreigner speaking Chinese.
His Chinese is quite good, and he especially likes imitating the old Beijing accent.
It was almost dark, and there were fewer and fewer people in the hutong.
Even Chinese people thought his Beijing dialect was authentic.
After that, Anda never mentioned his Beijing accent again.

011.title: Taking a wrong turn
011.sub: Two out-of-towners meet Anda in a hutong
011.transcriptNote: 甲 and 乙 (老高) are the two visitors, and 丙 is Anda. I assigned the speakers from context, so the last line could belong to either visitor.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 哎，我说老高，咱们是不是走错路了？
Āi, wǒ shuō Lǎo Gāo, zánmen shì bu shì zǒucuò lù le?
Hey, Lao Gao, have we taken a wrong turn?
刚才来的时候，好像不是从这儿走的。
Gāngcái lái de shíhou, hǎoxiàng bú shì cóng zhèr zǒu de.
I don't think this is the way we came earlier.
Wǒ yě juéde yǒudiǎnr bú duì.
I have a feeling something's off too.
咱们身上连张地图也没有，最好打听打听。
Zánmen shēnshang lián zhāng dìtú yě méiyǒu, zuìhǎo dǎting dǎting.
We don't even have a map on us. We'd better ask someone.
Āi, nǐ kàn, nàbiān yǒu ge rén.
Hey, look, there's someone over there.
我早就看见了，是个黄头发的老外，
Wǒ zǎo jiù kànjiàn le, shì ge huáng tóufa de lǎowài,
I saw him a while ago. It's a blond foreigner,
zài nàr huà shítou shīzi ne.
painting the stone lions over there.
哦，你们说的是我吧？怎么了？是不是走丢了？
Ò, nǐmen shuō de shì wǒ ba? Zěnme le? Shì bu shì zǒudiū le?
Oh, are you talking about me? What's up? Are you lost?
天哪！你中国话说得这么好，就跟北京人一样。
Tiān na! Nǐ Zhōngguóhuà shuō de zhème hǎo, jiù gēn Běijīngrén yíyàng.
Good heavens! Your Chinese is so good, just like a Beijinger's.
哪里哪里。你们要去哪儿？
Nǎli nǎli. Nǐmen yào qù nǎr?
Not at all. Where are you heading?
我常来这一带，可以给你们指路。
Wǒ cháng lái zhè yídài, kěyǐ gěi nǐmen zhǐ lù.
I come round here a lot, so I can show you the way.
Tài hǎo le! Duō xiè duō xiè!
我们从外地来，不熟悉北京的街道，
Wǒmen cóng wàidì lái, bù shúxī Běijīng de jiēdào,
We're from out of town and don't know Beijing's streets.
一出来就不知道东南西北了。
yì chūlai jiù bù zhīdào dōng nán xī běi le.
As soon as we go out, we can't tell which way is which.
说老实话，还不如你这个外国人呢。
Shuō lǎoshi huà, hái bùrú nǐ zhège wàiguórén ne.
To be honest, we're worse at it than you, and you're a foreigner!

vocab: the four directions; which way is which
grammar: 是不是……？
isn't it that …? (checking a guess)
是不是 before the verb checks a suspicion. It's softer than a plain 吗 question.
咱们是不是走错路了？
Zánmen shì bu shì zǒucuò lù le?
Have we taken a wrong turn?
你是不是感冒了？
Nǐ shì bu shì gǎnmào le?
Have you caught a cold?
连……也/都 + 没有
not even …
Use 连 for an extreme case. With a negative, it means “not even one”.
咱们身上连张地图也没有。
Zánmen shēnshang lián zhāng dìtú yě méiyǒu.
We don't even have a map on us.
他连一块钱也没有。
Tā lián yí kuài qián yě méiyǒu.
He doesn't even have one yuan.
V V (verb repeated)
have a go at …
Repeating a two-syllable verb as ABAB, like 打听打听, makes it light and tentative: “ask around a bit”.
最好打听打听。
Zuìhǎo dǎting dǎting.
We'd better ask around.
你再考虑考虑吧。
Nǐ zài kǎolǜ kǎolǜ ba.
Think it over a bit more.
as soon as …
The second action follows straight after the first.
一出来就不知道东南西北了。
Yì chūlai jiù bù zhīdào dōng nán xī běi le.
As soon as we go out, we can't tell which way is which.
我一到家就给你打电话。
Wǒ yí dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
I'll call you as soon as I get home.
A 不如 B
A isn't as good as B
不如 compares and admits that A is worse. 还不如 adds surprise: “even worse than”.
说老实话，还不如你这个外国人呢。
Shuō lǎoshi huà, hái bùrú nǐ zhège wàiguórén ne.
To be honest, we're worse at it than you, and you're a foreigner!
坐出租车还不如坐地铁快。
Zuò chūzūchē hái bùrú zuò dìtiě kuài.
Taking a taxi is even slower than the subway.
say: Hey, Lao Gao, have we taken a wrong turn?
We don't even have a map on us. We'd better ask someone.
Not at all. Where are you heading?
As soon as we go out, we can't tell which way is which.
To be honest, we're worse at it than you, and you're a foreigner!

012.title: “Someone from out of town for you”
012.sub: Anda calls the office from Shanghai
012.transcriptNote: 甲 is Xie Yun, who answers the phone, 乙 is Anda, and 丙 is Lao Lin (林大刚). This is the phone call from the end of the story in part 010.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 你好！请问老林——林大刚在吗？
Nǐ hǎo! Qǐngwèn Lǎo Lín — Lín Dàgāng zài ma?
Hello! Is Lao Lin, Lin Dagang, there?
老林，电话！有个外地人找您！
Lǎo Lín, diànhuà! Yǒu ge wàidìrén zhǎo nín!
Lao Lin, phone! Someone from out of town for you!
Wéi, nín hǎo! Shì nǎ wèi?
我往你的手机上打了好几次，
Wǒ wǎng nǐ de shǒujī shang dǎ le hǎo jǐ cì,
I called your mobile several times.
刚开始老占线，后来就关机了。
gāng kāishǐ lǎo zhànxiàn, hòulái jiù guānjī le.
At first it was always busy, and then it was switched off.
刚才跟一个客户通话，谈了半个多钟头，
Gāngcái gēn yí ge kèhù tōnghuà, tán le bàn ge duō zhōngtóu,
I was just on the phone with a client and talked for over half an hour,
hòulái shǒujī jiù méi diàn le.
and then my phone battery died.
对了，刚才接电话的是谁呀？
Duì le, gāngcái jiē diànhuà de shì shéi ya?
By the way, who answered the phone just now?
是谢云，她上个星期才来的。
Shì Xiè Yún, tā shàng ge xīngqī cái lái de.
That was Xie Yun. She only started last week.
下一次接电话，先要问问是谁。
xià yí cì jiē diànhuà, xiān yào wènwen shì shéi.
that next time she answers the phone, she should ask who it is first.

grammar: 往……上打
to call (a phone)
往 marks where the call goes: 往你的手机上打 means “call your mobile”.
我往你的手机上打了好几次。
Wǒ wǎng nǐ de shǒujī shang dǎ le hǎo jǐ cì.
I called your mobile several times.
我往家里打了两次电话。
Wǒ wǎng jiā li dǎ le liǎng cì diànhuà.
I called home twice.
刚开始……，后来就……
at first …, then …
This pair shows how a situation changed over time. Here 老 means “always”, not “old”.
刚开始老占线，后来就关机了。
Gāng kāishǐ lǎo zhànxiàn, hòulái jiù guānjī le.
At first it was always busy, and then it was switched off.
刚开始我听不懂，后来就习惯了。
Gāng kāishǐ wǒ tīng bu dǒng, hòulái jiù xíguàn le.
At first I couldn't understand, then I got used to it.
半个多钟头
over half an hour
多 goes after the measure word when the number is less than ten: 半个多钟头, 一个多小时.
谈了半个多钟头。
Tán le bàn ge duō zhōngtóu.
Talked for over half an hour.
我等了一个多小时。
Wǒ děng le yí ge duō xiǎoshí.
I waited for over an hour.
是……才……的
only just (recently)
才 stresses that something happened later or more recently than you might expect, and 是……的 highlights the time.
她上个星期才来的。
Tā shàng ge xīngqī cái lái de.
She only started last week.
我是昨天才知道的。
Wǒ shì zuótiān cái zhīdào de.
I only found out yesterday.
say: One moment, please.
I called your mobile several times.
At first it was always busy, and then it was switched off.
By the way, who answered the phone just now?

013.title: Vocabulary list
013.transcriptNote: The words in the order they're read. The English introduction isn't transcribed. Single words are hard for the models without context, so several were corrected using the sentences in parts 014–016.

lines: to think of, to recall (as in 想起)

014.title: Ten sentences
014.sub: Being late, getting things wrong, and surprises
014.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences using the new words from part 013. Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 老板来上班的时候，大家看见他都跟他打招呼。
Lǎobǎn lái shàngbān de shíhou, dàjiā kànjiàn tā dōu gēn tā dǎ zhāohu.
When the boss comes to work, everyone who sees him says hello.
我以为会迟到，没想到来早了。
Wǒ yǐwéi huì chídào, méi xiǎngdào lái zǎo le.
I thought I'd be late, but I was actually early.
你听懂没听懂我不知道，反正我听懂了。
Nǐ tīngdǒng méi tīngdǒng wǒ bù zhīdào, fǎnzhèng wǒ tīngdǒng le.
I don't know whether you understood, but I did, anyway.
看来今天的作业不多，他已经做完了。
Kànlái jīntiān de zuòyè bù duō, tā yǐjīng zuòwán le.
It looks like there isn't much homework today. He's already finished.
小孙不但迟到了，而且还穿错了袜子。
Xiǎo Sūn búdàn chídào le, érqiě hái chuāncuò le wàzi.
Xiao Sun was not only late, he was wearing the wrong socks too.
那个小姑娘真了不起，才十五岁就学会了好几种外语。
Nàge xiǎo gūniang zhēn liǎobuqǐ, cái shíwǔ suì jiù xuéhuì le hǎo jǐ zhǒng wàiyǔ.
That girl is amazing. She's only fifteen and already speaks several foreign languages.
雅克到了飞机场，才忽然发现他拿错了护照。
Yǎkè dào le fēijīchǎng, cái hūrán fāxiàn tā nácuò le hùzhào.
It wasn't until Jacques got to the airport that he suddenly noticed he'd brought the wrong passport.
真奇怪，老林为什么没说完就走了？
Zhēn qíguài, Lǎo Lín wèishénme méi shuōwán jiù zǒu le?
How strange. Why did Lao Lin leave before he'd finished talking?
正当他穿好衣服准备出门的时候，电话响了。
Zhèngdāng tā chuānhǎo yīfu zhǔnbèi chūmén de shíhou, diànhuà xiǎng le.
Just as he'd got dressed and was about to go out, the phone rang.
来到以前上过的高中，张大海想起了他最讨厌的数学课。
Láidào yǐqián shàng guo de gāozhōng, Zhāng Dàhǎi xiǎngqǐ le tā zuì tǎoyàn de shùxué kè.
Back at his old high school, Zhang Dahai remembered the maths classes he hated most.

vocab: to ring, to make a sound
grammar: 以为……，没想到……
I thought …, but actually …
以为 states the wrong expectation, and 没想到 introduces what really happened.
我以为会迟到，没想到来早了。
Wǒ yǐwéi huì chídào, méi xiǎngdào lái zǎo le.
I thought I'd be late, but I was actually early.
我以为考试很难，没想到这么容易。
Wǒ yǐwéi kǎoshì hěn nán, méi xiǎngdào zhème róngyì.
I thought the exam would be hard, but it was so easy.
whatever the case, …
反正 means the result is the same whatever the situation. It often brushes something aside.
你听懂没听懂我不知道，反正我听懂了。
Nǐ tīngdǒng méi tīngdǒng wǒ bù zhīdào, fǎnzhèng wǒ tīngdǒng le.
I don't know whether you understood, but I did, anyway.
你去不去都行，反正我要去。
Nǐ qù bu qù dōu xíng, fǎnzhèng wǒ yào qù.
Go or don't, it's up to you. I'm going anyway.
不但……而且还……
not only … but also …
The second part adds something stronger or more surprising, and 还 adds emphasis.
小孙不但迟到了，而且还穿错了袜子。
Xiǎo Sūn búdàn chídào le, érqiě hái chuāncuò le wàzi.
Xiao Sun was not only late, he was wearing the wrong socks too.
她不但会说英语，而且还会说法语。
Tā búdàn huì shuō Yīngyǔ, érqiě hái huì shuō Fǎyǔ.
She not only speaks English, she speaks French too.
V + 错
to do something wrong
错 after a verb says the result was wrong: 穿错, 拿错, 写错 and 走错.
他拿错了护照。
Tā nácuò le hùzhào.
He brought the wrong passport.
对不起，我打错电话了。
Duìbuqǐ, wǒ dǎcuò diànhuà le.
Sorry, I dialled the wrong number.
才 (= only then)
not until …
才 after a time or place means the action happened later than it should have.
雅克到了飞机场，才忽然发现……
Yǎkè dào le fēijīchǎng, cái hūrán fāxiàn …
It wasn't until Jacques got to the airport that he noticed …
他十二点才睡觉。
Tā shí'èr diǎn cái shuìjiào.
He didn't go to bed until midnight.
正当……的时候
just when …
This is a more emphatic 正在……的时候. The second clause interrupts the first.
正当他穿好衣服准备出门的时候，电话响了。
Zhèngdāng tā chuānhǎo yīfu zhǔnbèi chūmén de shíhou, diànhuà xiǎng le.
Just as he was about to go out, the phone rang.
正当我们要吃饭的时候，他来了。
Zhèngdāng wǒmen yào chī fàn de shíhou, tā lái le.
Just as we were about to eat, he arrived.

他穿好衣服准备出门的时候，电话响了。

015.title: Fifteen multiple-choice items
015.sub: Sleep, being late and getting annoyed
015.transcriptNote: Each item has a short sentence, a question and four options. The answer key is my own reading. Some item numbers aren't read aloud.

lines: 小孙好不容易才睡着，谁知道闹钟又响了。
Xiǎo Sūn hǎobù róngyì cái shuìzháo, shéi zhīdào nàozhōng yòu xiǎng le.
Xiao Sun had only just managed to fall asleep when the alarm clock went off again.

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: 睡着很容易，闹钟响了没关系。
Shuìzháo hěn róngyì, nàozhōng xiǎng le méi guānxi.
Falling asleep is easy, so the alarm doesn't matter.
睡着很不容易，闹钟不应该响。
Shuìzháo hěn bù róngyì, nàozhōng bù yīnggāi xiǎng.
Falling asleep was hard, and the alarm shouldn't have gone off.
他不能睡着，应该听闹钟的声音。
Tā bù néng shuìzháo, yīnggāi tīng nàozhōng de shēngyīn.
He mustn't fall asleep and should listen for the alarm.
闹钟不容易响，他可以睡着。
Nàozhōng bù róngyì xiǎng, tā kěyǐ shuìzháo.
The alarm rarely rings, so he can sleep.

lines: 你赶快找个位子坐好，听力课马上要开始了。
Nǐ gǎnkuài zhǎo ge wèizi zuòhǎo, tīnglì kè mǎshàng yào kāishǐ le.
Quick, find a seat. The listening class is about to start.

q: 为什么要赶快坐好？
Wèishénme yào gǎnkuài zuòhǎo?
Why sit down quickly?

lines: 这节课不是口语吗？怎么变成了听力了？
Zhè jié kè bú shì kǒuyǔ ma? Zěnme biànchéng le tīnglì le?
Isn't this a speaking class? How did it turn into listening?

q: 这句话的意思是什么？
Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì shénme?
What does this mean?
o: 这节课应该是听力，不应该是口语。
Zhè jié kè yīnggāi shì tīnglì, bù yīnggāi shì kǒuyǔ.
This should be listening, not speaking.
这节课不应该是口语，应该是听力。
Zhè jié kè bù yīnggāi shì kǒuyǔ, yīnggāi shì tīnglì.
This shouldn't be speaking, it should be listening.
这节课应该是口语，不应该是听力。
Zhè jié kè yīnggāi shì kǒuyǔ, bù yīnggāi shì tīnglì.
This should be speaking, not listening.
这节课可以是口语，也可以是听力。
Zhè jié kè kěyǐ shì kǒuyǔ, yě kěyǐ shì tīnglì.
This could be either speaking or listening.

lines: 你要是再迟到，老师会记下你的名字，不让你进教室。
Nǐ yàoshi zài chídào, lǎoshī huì jìxia nǐ de míngzi, bú ràng nǐ jìn jiàoshì.
If you're late again, the teacher will write down your name and won't let you in.

q: 如果再迟到，会怎么样？
Rúguǒ zài chídào, huì zěnmeyàng?
What will happen if you're late again?
o: 老师会记下你的名字，让你进教室上课。
Lǎoshī huì jìxia nǐ de míngzi, ràng nǐ jìn jiàoshì shàngkè.
The teacher will note your name but let you in.
老师不会记下你的名字，可是不让你进教室。
Lǎoshī bú huì jìxia nǐ de míngzi, kěshì bú ràng nǐ jìn jiàoshì.
The teacher won't note your name but won't let you in.
老师会记下你的名字，也不让你进教室。
Lǎoshī huì jìxia nǐ de míngzi, yě bú ràng nǐ jìn jiàoshì.
The teacher will note your name and won't let you in.
老师不会记下你的名字，也会让你进教室。
Lǎoshī bú huì jìxia nǐ de míngzi, yě huì ràng nǐ jìn jiàoshì.
The teacher won't note your name and will let you in.

lines: 他这个人很热情，见到谁都打招呼。
Tā zhège rén hěn rèqíng, jiàndào shéi dōu dǎ zhāohu.
He's a really warm person who says hello to everyone.

q: 这句话告诉我们什么？
Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen shénme?
What does this tell us?
o: 他非常喜欢认识新朋友。
Tā fēicháng xǐhuan rènshi xīn péngyou.

lines: 上个月我在上海看见小李了，他长胖了。
Shàng ge yuè wǒ zài Shànghǎi kànjiàn Xiǎo Lǐ le, tā zhǎngpàng le.
I saw Xiao Li in Shanghai last month. He's put on weight.

q: 小李怎么了？
Xiǎo Lǐ zěnme le?
What about Xiao Li?
o: Xiǎo Lǐ bǐ yǐqián shòu le.
Xiǎo Lǐ bǐ yǐqián pàng le.
He's not as heavy as before.

lines: 昨天晚上我忙到十点多才打开书，到现在还没复习完呢。
Zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ máng dào shí diǎn duō cái dǎkāi shū, dào xiànzài hái méi fùxí wán ne.
Last night I was busy until after ten before I even opened a book, and I still haven't finished revising.

q: 他为什么到现在还没复习完？
Tā wèishénme dào xiànzài hái méi fùxí wán?
Why hasn't he finished revising yet?
o: 他昨天晚上开始看书的时候已经很晚了。
Tā zuótiān wǎnshang kāishǐ kàn shū de shíhou yǐjīng hěn wǎn le.
It was already late when he started studying last night.
他昨天晚上忙到很晚才睡觉。
Tā zuótiān wǎnshang máng dào hěn wǎn cái shuìjiào.
He was busy until late and went to bed late.

lines: 雅克，你不是说能买到飞机票吗？你看现在怎么办呢？
Yǎkè, nǐ bú shì shuō néng mǎidào fēijī piào ma? Nǐ kàn xiànzài zěnme bàn ne?
Jacques, didn't you say you could get plane tickets? So what do we do now?

q: 从这句话里，我们可以知道什么？
Cóng zhè jù huà li, wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: 雅克还没有去买飞机票。
Yǎkè hái méiyǒu qù mǎi fēijī piào.
Jacques hasn't gone to buy tickets yet.
Jacques didn't manage to get tickets.
雅克现在要去买飞机票。
Yǎkè xiànzài yào qù mǎi fēijī piào.
Jacques is going to buy tickets now.
雅克不知道能不能买到飞机票。
Yǎkè bù zhīdào néng bu néng mǎidào fēijī piào.
Jacques doesn't know whether he can get tickets.

lines: 一听到妈妈的开门声，小明赶快关上电视打开书，好像正在看书的样子。
Yì tīngdào māma de kāi mén shēng, Xiǎo Míng gǎnkuài guānshang diànshì dǎkāi shū, hǎoxiàng zhèngzài kàn shū de yàngzi.
As soon as he heard Mum opening the door, Xiao Ming switched off the TV and opened a book, as if he'd been studying.

q: 妈妈回来以前，小明正在做什么？
Māma huílai yǐqián, Xiǎo Míng zhèngzài zuò shénme?
What was Xiao Ming doing before Mum came back?

lines: 电影开始五分钟后我们才到，只能在最后一排找个座位坐下了。
Diànyǐng kāishǐ wǔ fēnzhōng hòu wǒmen cái dào, zhǐ néng zài zuìhòu yì pái zhǎo ge zuòwèi zuòxia le.
We didn't arrive until five minutes after the film started, so we had to sit in the back row.

q: 从这句话我们可以知道什么？
Cóng zhè jù huà wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: Tāmen zhǐ néng zuò zài zuìhòu.
They could only sit at the back.
Tāmen bù xǐhuan zuò zài qiánmiàn.
They don't like sitting at the front.

lines: 花了一下午的时间，我好不容易才写完了作业。
Huā le yí xiàwǔ de shíjiān, wǒ hǎobù róngyì cái xiěwán le zuòyè.
It took me the whole afternoon, but I finally finished my homework.

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: 我没有花很多时间写作业。
Wǒ méiyǒu huā hěn duō shíjiān xiě zuòyè.
I didn't spend much time on homework.
我写完这些作业很不容易。
Wǒ xiěwán zhèxiē zuòyè hěn bù róngyì.
Finishing this homework was really hard.
这些作业我一下午也没写完。
Zhèxiē zuòyè wǒ yí xiàwǔ yě méi xiěwán.
I couldn't finish it in a whole afternoon.

lines: 我好不容易帮你借来了这本书，谁知道你现在又不要了。
Wǒ hǎobù róngyì bāng nǐ jièlai le zhè běn shū, shéi zhīdào nǐ xiànzài yòu bú yào le.
I went to a lot of trouble to borrow this book for you, and now you don't want it.

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: Nǐ bù néng yào zhè běn shū.
Zhè běn shū nǐ bù néng názǒu.
You can't take this book away.

lines: 约好了十点见面，到了十点半你都不来，你怎么能这样呢？
Yuēhǎo le shí diǎn jiànmiàn, dào le shí diǎn bàn nǐ dōu bù lái, nǐ zěnme néng zhèyàng ne?
We agreed to meet at ten, and by half past you still hadn't come. How could you?

q: 说话人怎么了？
Shuōhuàrén zěnme le?
How does the speaker feel?
o: Tā bù gāoxìng yě bù shēngqì.
Tā hěn gāoxìng, yě hěn shēngqì.

lines: 写错了就写错了呗，有什么可不高兴的？
Xiěcuò le jiù xiěcuò le bei, yǒu shénme kě bù gāoxìng de?
So you wrote it wrong. What's there to be upset about?

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: 写错了也没关系，不要不高兴。
Xiěcuò le yě méi guānxi, bú yào bù gāoxìng.
It doesn't matter if you got it wrong. Don't be upset.
写错了，所以应该不高兴。
Xiěcuò le, suǒyǐ yīnggāi bù gāoxìng.
You got it wrong, so you should be upset.

lines: 你怎么又说这些话呀？我都听够了。
Nǐ zěnme yòu shuō zhèxiē huà ya? Wǒ dōu tīng gòu le.
Why are you saying all that again? I've heard enough.

q: 从这句话里，我们知道什么？
Cóng zhè jù huà li, wǒmen zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: 说话人想知道他为什么又说这些话。
Shuōhuàrén xiǎng zhīdào tā wèishénme yòu shuō zhèxiē huà.
The speaker wants to know why he's saying it again.
These words are nice to hear.
说话人不喜欢听这些话。
Shuōhuàrén bù xǐhuan tīng zhèxiē huà.
The speaker doesn't like hearing this.

grammar: 好不容易才……
finally managed to …, with great difficulty
好不容易 looks negative, but it means “very difficult”, the same as 好容易. 才 marks the result that took so long.
小孙好不容易才睡着。
Xiǎo Sūn hǎobù róngyì cái shuìzháo.
Xiao Sun finally managed to fall asleep.
我好不容易才找到他家。
Wǒ hǎobù róngyì cái zhǎodào tā jiā.
It took me ages to find his house.
… but who'd have thought …
谁知道 introduces an unwelcome surprise that undoes what came before.
谁知道闹钟又响了。
Shéi zhīdào nàozhōng yòu xiǎng le.
And then, of all things, the alarm went off again.
我带了伞，谁知道一天都没下雨。
Wǒ dài le sǎn, shéi zhīdào yì tiān dōu méi xià yǔ.
I brought an umbrella, and then it didn't rain all day.
不是……吗？
isn't it …? (surprise or reproach)
This rhetorical question means “I thought …”. It shows surprise that reality is different.
这节课不是口语吗？
Zhè jié kè bú shì kǒuyǔ ma?
Isn't this a speaking class?
你不是说能买到飞机票吗？
Nǐ bú shì shuō néng mǎidào fēijī piào ma?
Didn't you say you could get plane tickets?
A 就 A 呗
so what if …
Repeating the verb phrase around 就 and ending with 呗 waves the problem away.
写错了就写错了呗，有什么可不高兴的？
Xiěcuò le jiù xiěcuò le bei, yǒu shénme kě bù gāoxìng de?
So you wrote it wrong. What's there to be upset about?
不去就不去呗。
Bú qù jiù bú qù bei.
If you don't want to go, then don't.
V + 够了
to have had enough of …
够 after a verb means you've done it enough, often with annoyance.
我都听够了。
Wǒ dōu tīng gòu le.
I've heard enough.
我已经吃够了，不想再吃了。
Wǒ yǐjīng chī gòu le, bù xiǎng zài chī le.
I've had enough to eat. I don't want any more.
say: Quick, find a seat. The listening class is about to start.
Isn't this a speaking class? How did it turn into listening?
We agreed to meet at ten, and by half past you still hadn't come. How could you?
Why are you saying all that again? I've heard enough.

016.title: Xiao Sun in a panic
016.sub: A short story and six questions
016.transcriptNote: A short story told by a narrator, then six questions. The answers are my own wording. The English instructions aren't transcribed.

blocks.label: 故事
lines: Xiao Sun is a university student.
不知道为什么，开学以后他迟到过好几次了，
Bù zhīdào wèishénme, kāixué yǐhòu tā chídào guo hǎo jǐ cì le,
For some reason he's been late several times since term started,
所以老师记住了他的名字。
suǒyǐ lǎoshī jìzhù le tā de míngzi.
so the teacher knows his name.
Zhè yì tiān, tā yòu chídào le.
On this day he was late again.
因为他昨天晚上没有睡好，所以今天早上起晚了。
Yīnwèi tā zuótiān wǎnshang méiyǒu shuìhǎo, suǒyǐ jīntiān zǎoshang qǐ wǎn le.
He hadn't slept well the night before, so he got up late.
因为他要赶到学校去上课，所以他没有洗脸，也没刮胡子，
Yīnwèi tā yào gǎndào xuéxiào qù shàngkè, suǒyǐ tā méiyǒu xǐ liǎn, yě méi guā húzi,
He had to rush to school for class, so he didn't wash his face or shave,
衣服也没穿好，骑上车就出门了。
yīfu yě méi chuānhǎo, qíshang chē jiù chūmén le.
didn't dress properly, and just jumped on his bike and left.
可是，当他着急地跑到教室的时候，
Kěshì, dāng tā zháojí de pǎodào jiàoshì de shíhou,
But when he rushed into the classroom,
发现坐在教室里的人都是他的中学同学，
fāxiàn zuò zài jiàoshì li de rén dōu shì tā de zhōngxué tóngxué,
he found that everyone sitting there was a classmate from secondary school,
大学的听力课也变成了高中的数学课。
dàxué de tīnglì kè yě biànchéng le gāozhōng de shùxué kè.
and his university listening class had turned into a high-school maths class.
他跟大家打招呼，别人也不答应他。
Tā gēn dàjiā dǎ zhāohu, biérén yě bù dāying tā.
He said hello to everyone, but nobody answered.
怎么办呢？在这儿上课，还是回去睡觉呢？
Zěnme bàn ne? Zài zhèr shàngkè, háishi huíqu shuìjiào ne?
What should he do? Stay for the class, or go back to bed?
正在这时，他听到了铃声。
Zhèng zài zhè shí, tā tīngdào le língshēng.
Just then, he heard a bell ringing.
睁开眼睛一看，是床头的闹钟响了。
Zhēngkāi yǎnjing yí kàn, shì chuángtóu de nàozhōng xiǎng le.
He opened his eyes and saw it was the alarm clock by his bed.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 小孙现在在哪儿上学？
Xiǎo Sūn xiànzài zài nǎr shàngxué?
Where does Xiao Sun study now?
ans: 他在大学上学，是个大学生。
Tā zài dàxué shàngxué, shì ge dàxuéshēng.
At university. He's a university student.

q: 老师为什么记住了他的名字？
Lǎoshī wèishénme jìzhù le tā de míngzi?
Why does the teacher know his name?
ans: 因为开学以后他迟到过好几次了。
Yīnwèi kāixué yǐhòu tā chídào guo hǎo jǐ cì le.
Because he's been late several times since term started.

q: 今天他迟到了吗？为什么？
Jīntiān tā chídào le ma? Wèishénme?
Was he late today? Why?
ans: 迟到了，因为他昨天晚上没睡好，今天早上起晚了。
Chídào le, yīnwèi tā zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuìhǎo, jīntiān zǎoshang qǐ wǎn le.
Yes, because he slept badly and got up late.

q: 他早上没有做什么？
Tā zǎoshang méiyǒu zuò shénme?
What didn't he do that morning?
ans: 他没有洗脸，没有刮胡子，衣服也没穿好。
Tā méiyǒu xǐ liǎn, méiyǒu guā húzi, yīfu yě méi chuānhǎo.
He didn't wash his face, didn't shave, and didn't dress properly.

q: 赶到教室以后，他发现了什么奇怪的事情？
Gǎndào jiàoshì yǐhòu, tā fāxiàn le shénme qíguài de shìqing?
What strange thing did he find when he got to the classroom?
ans: 教室里的人都是他的中学同学，听力课变成了高中的数学课。
Jiàoshì li de rén dōu shì tā de zhōngxué tóngxué, tīnglì kè biànchéng le gāozhōng de shùxué kè.
Everyone was a school classmate, and the listening class had become a high-school maths class.

q: 他是怎么醒的？
Tā shì zěnme xǐng de?
How did he wake up?
ans: 床头的闹钟响了，他就醒了。
Chuángtóu de nàozhōng xiǎng le, tā jiù xǐng le.
The alarm clock by his bed went off, and that woke him.

grammar: adjective + 坏了
terribly …
坏了 after a feeling means “to an extreme”. It doesn't mean something is broken.
小孙急坏了
Xiǎo Sūn jí huài le
Xiao Sun was in a total panic.
走了一天，我累坏了。
Zǒu le yì tiān, wǒ lèi huài le.
After walking all day, I'm exhausted.
V过 + 好几次
have done … several times
过 marks experience, and the count goes after it.
开学以后他迟到过好几次了。
Kāixué yǐhòu tā chídào guo hǎo jǐ cì le.
He's been late several times since term started.
这个电影我看过好几次了。
Zhège diànyǐng wǒ kàn guo hǎo jǐ cì le.
I've seen this film several times.
因为……，所以……
because …, so …
This pair links a cause to its result. In speech one half is often dropped, but this story uses both.
因为他昨天晚上没有睡好，所以今天早上起晚了。
Yīnwèi tā zuótiān wǎnshang méiyǒu shuìhǎo, suǒyǐ jīntiān zǎoshang qǐ wǎn le.
He hadn't slept well, so he got up late.
因为下雨，所以我们没去公园。
Yīnwèi xià yǔ, suǒyǐ wǒmen méi qù gōngyuán.
Because it rained, we didn't go to the park.
… or …? (choice question)
Use 还是 to offer two choices in a question. 呢 shows you're thinking it over.
在这儿上课，还是回去睡觉呢？
Zài zhèr shàngkè, háishi huíqu shuìjiào ne?
Stay for class, or go back to bed?
你喝茶还是喝咖啡？
Nǐ hē chá háishi hē kāfēi?
Would you like tea or coffee?
V + 一看
to look and find …
一看 after a verb phrase means “and when he looked …”. What follows is what he discovered.
睁开眼睛一看，是床头的闹钟响了。
Zhēngkāi yǎnjing yí kàn, shì chuángtóu de nàozhōng xiǎng le.
He opened his eyes and saw it was the alarm clock.
我打开门一看，是我妈妈。
Wǒ dǎkāi mén yí kàn, shì wǒ māma.
I opened the door, and it was my mum.
gaps: 他跟大家打招呼，别人也不
眼睛一看，是床头的闹钟响了。
say: Xiao Sun is a university student.
On this day he was late again.
He said hello to everyone, but nobody answered.
What should he do? Stay for the class, or go back to bed?

017.title: An exhausting night's sleep
017.sub: A short monologue and five questions
017.transcriptNote: One speaker explains why they overslept, then five questions follow. The answers are my own wording. The English instructions aren't transcribed.

blocks.label: 独白
lines: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang qǐ wǎn le.
I got up late this morning.
为什么呢？因为昨天晚上我没有睡好。
Wèishénme ne? Yīnwèi zuótiān wǎnshang wǒ méiyǒu shuìhǎo.
Why? Because I didn't sleep well last night.
为什么没睡好呢？因为有很多作业，
Wèishénme méi shuìhǎo ne? Yīnwèi yǒu hěn duō zuòyè,
And why didn't I sleep well? Because I had loads of homework.
我写到夜里两点还没有写完。
wǒ xiě dào yèli liǎng diǎn hái méiyǒu xiěwán.
I was still writing at two in the morning and hadn't finished.
后来，我实在太累了，就睡了。
Hòulái, wǒ shízài tài lèi le, jiù shuì le.
In the end I was just too tired, so I went to bed.
But once I was lying in bed,
因为想的都是作业，一个多小时也没睡着。
yīnwèi xiǎng de dōu shì zuòyè, yí ge duō xiǎoshí yě méi shuìzháo.
all I could think about was homework, and I didn't fall asleep for over an hour.
Zhè yí jiào shuì de zhēn lèi!
看见了吗？我的眼睛还红着呢。
Kànjiàn le ma? Wǒ de yǎnjing hái hóng zhe ne.
See? My eyes are still red.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 他今天早上起床起晚了，是因为什么？
Tā jīntiān zǎoshang qǐchuáng qǐ wǎn le, shì yīnwèi shénme?
Why did he get up late this morning?
ans: 因为他昨天晚上没有睡好。
Yīnwèi tā zuótiān wǎnshang méiyǒu shuìhǎo.
Because he didn't sleep well last night.

q: 老师留的作业他写完了吗？为什么？
Lǎoshī liú de zuòyè tā xiěwán le ma? Wèishénme?
Did he finish the homework the teacher set? Why or why not?
ans: 没写完。作业太多了，他写到夜里两点还没写完，后来实在太累了。
Méi xiěwán. Zuòyè tài duō le, tā xiě dào yèli liǎng diǎn hái méi xiěwán, hòulái shízài tài lèi le.
No. There was too much, and he was still going at 2 a.m. before he got too tired.

q: 上床以后他马上就睡着了吗？为什么？
Shàng chuáng yǐhòu tā mǎshàng jiù shuìzháo le ma? Wèishénme?
Did he fall asleep as soon as he went to bed? Why or why not?
ans: 没有，因为他想的都是作业。
Méiyǒu, yīnwèi tā xiǎng de dōu shì zuòyè.
No, because all he could think about was homework.

q: 他可能是几点钟睡着的？
Tā kěnéng shì jǐ diǎn zhōng shuìzháo de?
What time did he probably fall asleep?
ans: 大概三点多。
Dàgài sān diǎn duō.
Probably some time after three.

q: 昨天夜里他睡得怎么样？为什么？
Zuótiān yèli tā shuì de zěnmeyàng? Wèishénme?
How did he sleep last night? Why?
ans: 睡得很累，因为他一直在想作业。
Shuì de hěn lèi, yīnwèi tā yìzhí zài xiǎng zuòyè.
Badly. It was exhausting, because he kept thinking about homework.

grammar: V + 到 + time
to keep doing … until …
到 after a verb shows how long the action went on.
我写到夜里两点还没有写完。
Wǒ xiě dào yèli liǎng diǎn hái méiyǒu xiěwán.
I was still writing at two in the morning.
昨天我们聊到十二点。
Zuótiān wǒmen liáo dào shí'èr diǎn.
Yesterday we chatted until midnight.
实在太……了
really too …
实在 stresses that something has gone past the limit, which often explains why you gave up.
我实在太累了，就睡了。
Wǒ shízài tài lèi le, jiù shuì le.
I was just too tired, so I went to bed.
这个问题实在太难了。
Zhège wèntí shízài tài nán le.
This question is really too hard.
一 + measure + 也没 V
not … even once / at all
一个多小时也没睡着 means “for over an hour I didn't fall asleep at all”. 也 stresses the negative.
一个多小时也没睡着。
Yí ge duō xiǎoshí yě méi shuìzháo.
I didn't fall asleep for over an hour.
他一句话也没说。
Tā yí jù huà yě méi shuō.
He didn't say a single word.
adjective + 着呢
still …, really …
着呢 after an adjective describes a state that is still going on, often with emphasis.
我的眼睛还红着呢。
Wǒ de yǎnjing hái hóng zhe ne.
My eyes are still red.
外面冷着呢，多穿点儿。
Wàimiàn lěng zhe ne, duō chuān diǎnr.
It's really cold out. Wear more.
say: I got up late this morning.
I was still writing at two in the morning and hadn't finished.
In the end I was just too tired, so I went to bed.
See? My eyes are still red.

018.title: “I must have been mistaken”
018.sub: A hotel joke and six true-or-false statements
018.transcriptNote: A short story with a twist, then true-or-false statements. The true-or-false key is my own reading. Some statement numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 故事
lines: 一个旅馆的男服务员早上去给客人打扫房间。
Yí ge lǚguǎn de nán fúwùyuán zǎoshang qù gěi kèrén dǎsǎo fángjiān.
One morning a male hotel attendant went to clean a guest's room.
他看见一位女客人只穿着睡衣，
Tā kànjiàn yí wèi nǚ kèrén zhǐ chuān zhe shuìyī,
He saw that a female guest was wearing only her pyjamas,
就一边打扫房间一边说：
jiù yìbiān dǎsǎo fángjiān yìbiān shuō:
so as he cleaned the room he said:
“先生，您应该穿好衣服，房间里有点冷。”
“Xiānsheng, nín yīnggāi chuānhǎo yīfu, fángjiān li yǒudiǎn lěng.”
“Sir, you should get dressed. It's a bit cold in here.”
等那位客人穿好衣服以后，他又说：
Děng nà wèi kèrén chuānhǎo yīfu yǐhòu, tā yòu shuō:
Once the guest had got dressed, he said:
“哎呀，我看错了，您是一位漂亮的女士。”
“Āiyā, wǒ kàncuò le, nín shì yí wèi piàoliang de nǚshì.”
“Oh dear, I must have been mistaken. You're a beautiful lady.”

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 判断正误 · True or false

q: 旅馆的服务员是男的。
Lǚguǎn de fúwùyuán shì nán de.
The hotel attendant is a man.
房间里的客人也是男的。
Fángjiān li de kèrén yě shì nán de.
The guest in the room is also a man.
qs.why: she's a woman, 女客人

q: 房间里不冷，所以客人穿得很少。
Fángjiān li bù lěng, suǒyǐ kèrén chuān de hěn shǎo.
The room isn't cold, so the guest is wearing very little.
qs.why: he says it's a bit cold, 有点冷

q: 服务员一边等客人穿好衣服，一边打扫房间。
Fúwùyuán yìbiān děng kèrén chuānhǎo yīfu, yìbiān dǎsǎo fángjiān.
The attendant cleans the room while he waits for the guest to dress.
客人穿好衣服以后，变成了女的。
Kèrén chuānhǎo yīfu yǐhòu, biànchéng le nǚ de.
After getting dressed, the guest turned into a woman.
qs.why: she was a woman all along

q: 服务员没有看错，但是他不想让客人不高兴。
Fúwùyuán méiyǒu kàncuò, dànshì tā bù xiǎng ràng kèrén bù gāoxìng.
The attendant wasn't mistaken. He just didn't want to embarrass the guest.
qs.why: calling her 先生 was a tactful pretence

grammar: 只 + V着……
to have only … on
只 limits the action, and 着 describes the state.
他看见一位女客人只穿着睡衣。
Tā kànjiàn yí wèi nǚ kèrén zhǐ chuān zhe shuìyī.
He saw a female guest wearing only pyjamas.
他只穿着一件衬衫就出去了。
Tā zhǐ chuān zhe yí jiàn chènshān jiù chūqu le.
He went out in just a shirt.
一边……一边……
while …, at the same time
Two actions happen at once. Put 一边 before each verb.
就一边打扫房间一边说。
Jiù yìbiān dǎsǎo fángjiān yìbiān shuō.
As he cleaned the room he said …
我喜欢一边听音乐一边做饭。
Wǒ xǐhuan yìbiān tīng yīnyuè yìbiān zuò fàn.
I like listening to music while I cook.
等……以后
once …, after …
等 means “wait until”. It makes the second action depend on the first finishing.
等那位客人穿好衣服以后，他又说……
Děng nà wèi kèrén chuānhǎo yīfu yǐhòu, tā yòu shuō …
Once the guest had dressed, he said …
等你吃完饭以后，我们再走。
Děng nǐ chīwán fàn yǐhòu, wǒmen zài zǒu.
We'll leave once you've finished eating.
让 + person + feeling
to make someone feel …
让 can mean “cause”: 让客人不高兴 is “make the guest unhappy”.
他不想让客人不高兴。
Tā bù xiǎng ràng kèrén bù gāoxìng.
He didn't want to upset the guest.
这个消息让大家很高兴。
Zhège xiāoxi ràng dàjiā hěn gāoxìng.
The news made everyone very happy.
gaps: 早上去给客人打扫房间。
他看见一位女客人只穿着
先生，您应该穿好衣服，房间里
say: Sir, you should get dressed. It's a bit cold in here.
Oh dear, I must have been mistaken. You're a beautiful lady.

019.title: “Why are you so late?”
019.transcriptNote: 甲 has been waiting, and 乙 is Lao Wang, who arrives late. I assigned the speakers from context.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: Lǎo Wáng, nǐ zěnme xiànzài cái lái?
Lao Wang, why are you only getting here now?
Wǒ zhèng yào gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà ne.
I was just about to call you.
你怎么在这儿等啊？我在车站找遍了都没找到你。
Nǐ zěnme zài zhèr děng a? Wǒ zài chēzhàn zhǎobiàn le dōu méi zhǎodào nǐ.
Why are you waiting here? I searched the whole station and couldn't find you.
我一下车就在车站等你，
Wǒ yí xià chē jiù zài chēzhàn děng nǐ,
I waited for you at the station as soon as I got off,
可是人都走完了，也没等到你，我才来这儿。
kěshì rén dōu zǒuwán le, yě méi děngdào nǐ, wǒ cái lái zhèr.
but everyone had gone and you still hadn't come, so I came over here.
真对不起，我来晚了，因为路上车太多了。
Zhēn duìbuqǐ, wǒ lái wǎn le, yīnwèi lù shang chē tài duō le.
I'm really sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible.
好的。往这边走，我的车停在那边呢。
Hǎo de. Wǎng zhèbiān zǒu, wǒ de chē tíng zài nàbiān ne.
OK. This way. My car's parked over there.

vocab: to get off (a bus or train)
grammar: 怎么现在才……？
why only now?
怎么 + 才 complains that something happened too late.
你怎么现在才来？
Nǐ zěnme xiànzài cái lái?
Why are you only getting here now?
你怎么现在才告诉我？
Nǐ zěnme xiànzài cái gàosu wǒ?
Why are you only telling me now?
正要……呢
to be just about to …
正要 means an action was about to happen at that very moment.
我正要给你打电话呢。
Wǒ zhèng yào gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà ne.
I was just about to call you.
我正要出门呢，你就来了。
Wǒ zhèng yào chūmén ne, nǐ jiù lái le.
I was just about to go out when you arrived.
V遍了都没 + result
searched everywhere but …
遍 after a verb means “all over”, and 都没 says it still didn't work.
我在车站找遍了都没找到你。
Wǒ zài chēzhàn zhǎobiàn le dōu méi zhǎodào nǐ.
I searched the whole station and couldn't find you.
我问遍了朋友，都没人知道。
Wǒ wènbiàn le péngyou, dōu méi rén zhīdào.
I asked all my friends, and nobody knew.
停在 + place
parked at …
在 + place after a verb says where something ends up: 停在, 放在, 住在.
我的车停在那边呢。
Wǒ de chē tíng zài nàbiān ne.
My car's parked over there.
把书放在桌子上吧。
Bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shang ba.
Put the book on the table.
say: Lao Wang, why are you only getting here now?
I searched the whole station and couldn't find you.
I'm really sorry I'm late. The traffic was terrible.
OK. This way. My car's parked over there.

020.title: Vocabulary list
020.transcriptNote: The words in the order they're read: verbs, then adjectives and adverbs, then nouns and measure words, then names. Single words are hard for the models without context, so I used the word-use list in part 021 and the texts in 022–023 to settle them.

lines: Unclear word, so check your book
to take a bath or shower
(measure word for a set of clothes)
blocks.note: Uncertain: the word at 0:17 (heard as 横 or 橙) didn't match anything in the texts, so play it and check your book. The four measure words (节, 身, 口, 名) were heard as 鞋, 真, 口 and 明, and I matched them to how part 022 and 023 use them (一节听力课, 那身衣服, 一口新鲜空气, 第一名).

021.title: How the new words are used
021.transcriptNote: Each group takes one word from the vocabulary in part 020 and uses it in short phrases. Some group numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: front, back, left and right; all around

blocks.h: 记 jì · to remember; to write down

lines: to take a hot shower or bath

blocks.h: 亮 liàng · bright; to light up
lines: the street lights have come on
