022.title: “So why were you late again?”
022.sub: The lesson text, Xiao Sun's dream in his own words
022.transcriptNote: The lesson text, told by Xiao Sun (孙正刚) in the first person and split into paragraphs. It's the same dream as in part 016, with more detail. The title line reappears at the end of the dialogue in part 023.

lines: Nà nǐ zěnme yòu lái wǎn le ne?
So why were you late again?
今天早上我有一节听力课。
Jīntiān zǎoshang wǒ yǒu yì jié tīnglì kè.
This morning I had a listening class.
大概昨天夜里没睡好，所以起晚了。
Dàgài zuótiān yèli méi shuìhǎo, suǒyǐ qǐ wǎn le.
I probably hadn't slept well, so I got up late.
Zhè xià wǒ jí huài le,
Now I was in a real panic,
因为开学才半个多月，我已经迟到过两次了。
yīnwèi kāixué cái bàn ge duō yuè, wǒ yǐjīng chídào guo liǎng cì le.
because term had only been going for a couple of weeks and I'd already been late twice.
老师不但记住了我的名字，而且还说，
Lǎoshī búdàn jìzhù le wǒ de míngzi, érqiě hái shuō,
The teacher not only knew my name, he'd also said
下一次我要是再迟到的话，他就不让我进教室了。
xià yí cì wǒ yàoshi zài chídào de huà, tā jiù bú ràng wǒ jìn jiàoshì le.
that if I was late again, he wouldn't let me into the classroom.
I wanted to wash my face.
嘿，洗澡间的灯怎么不亮了？
Hēi, xǐzǎojiān de dēng zěnme bú liàng le?
Hey, why wasn't the bathroom light working?
Suàn le, fǎnzhèng méi shíjiān le.
Forget it, there was no time anyway.
我又穿上昨天脱下的那身衣服，骑上车就往学校赶。
Wǒ yòu chuānshang zuótiān tuōxia de nà shēn yīfu, qíshang chē jiù wǎng xuéxiào gǎn.
I put on yesterday's clothes again, jumped on my bike and raced to school.
教室里坐着很多学生，可是安静极了，连一点声音也没有。
Jiàoshì li zuò zhe hěn duō xuésheng, kěshì ānjìng jí le, lián yìdiǎn shēngyīn yě méiyǒu.
The classroom was full of students, but it was completely silent. There wasn't a sound.
It looked like the teacher hadn't arrived yet.
我赶快找到一个空座位坐好。
Wǒ gǎnkuài zhǎodào yí ge kòng zuòwèi zuòhǎo.
I quickly found an empty seat and sat down.
这个时候，我忽然发现，周围的人都是我的中学同学。
Zhège shíhou, wǒ hūrán fāxiàn, zhōuwéi de rén dōu shì wǒ de zhōngxué tóngxué.
Then I suddenly noticed that everyone around me was a classmate from secondary school.
每个人的面前还摆着一本数学课本。
Měi ge rén de miànqián hái bǎi zhe yì běn shùxué kèběn.
And each of them had a maths textbook in front of them.
这节课不是听力吗？怎么会变成了我最讨厌的高中数学课呢？
Zhè jié kè bú shì tīnglì ma? Zěnme huì biànchéng le wǒ zuì tǎoyàn de gāozhōng shùxué kè ne?
Wasn't this a listening class? How had it turned into the high-school maths class I hated most?
还有，我跟同学们打招呼，他们都不答应，只是看着我笑。
Hái yǒu, wǒ gēn tóngxuémen dǎ zhāohu, tāmen dōu bù dāying, zhǐshì kàn zhe wǒ xiào.
What's more, when I said hello, nobody answered. They just looked at me and laughed.
是因为我没洗脸、没梳头，也没刮胡子，还是因为我又穿了两只颜色不同的袜子？
Shì yīnwèi wǒ méi xǐ liǎn, méi shū tóu, yě méi guā húzi, háishi yīnwèi wǒ yòu chuān le liǎng zhī yánsè bù tóng de wàzi?
Was it because I hadn't washed, combed my hair or shaved? Or because I was wearing odd socks again?
正当我不知道该怎么办的时候，叮铃铃，上课铃响了。
Zhèngdāng wǒ bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn de shíhou, dīnglínglíng, shàngkè líng xiǎng le.
Just as I was wondering what to do, ring-ring, the class bell went.
I woke up with a start.
睁开眼睛，看了看床头的闹钟，六点半。
Zhēngkāi yǎnjing, kàn le kàn chuángtóu de nàozhōng, liù diǎn bàn.
I opened my eyes and looked at the clock by my bed. Half past six.
我打开窗户，天还没亮呢。
Wǒ dǎkāi chuānghu, tiān hái méi liàng ne.
I opened the window. It wasn't even light yet.
我呼吸了一口新鲜空气，
Wǒ hūxī le yì kǒu xīnxiān kōngqì,
I took a breath of fresh air
心里得意地想：今天肯定不会迟到了。
xīnli déyì de xiǎng: jīntiān kěndìng bú huì chídào le.
and thought smugly, “I definitely won't be late today.”

vocab: (measure word for a set of clothes)
(measure word for one of a pair)
grammar: 这下……
now (as a result)
这下 sums up the new situation that the previous event caused.
这下我急坏了。
Zhè xià wǒ jí huài le.
Now I was in a real panic.
钱包丢了，这下麻烦了。
Qiánbāo diū le, zhè xià máfan le.
I've lost my wallet. Now I'm in trouble.
要是……的话，就……
if …, then …
的话 at the end of the condition adds weight in speech. It's often used with 要是 or 如果.
下一次我要是再迟到的话，他就不让我进教室了。
Xià yí cì wǒ yàoshi zài chídào de huà, tā jiù bú ràng wǒ jìn jiàoshì le.
If I'm late again, he won't let me in.
你要是累的话，就休息一下吧。
Nǐ yàoshi lèi de huà, jiù xiūxi yíxià ba.
If you're tired, have a rest.
adjective + 极了
extremely …
极了 after an adjective is a strong way to say “really” or “extremely”.
可是安静极了。
Kěshì ānjìng jí le.
But it was completely silent.
今天的天气好极了。
Jīntiān de tiānqì hǎo jí le.
The weather is wonderful today.
是因为……，还是因为……？
is it because … or because …?
还是 offers two possible explanations in a question.
是因为我没洗脸……，还是因为我又穿了两只颜色不同的袜子？
Shì yīnwèi wǒ méi xǐ liǎn …, háishi yīnwèi wǒ yòu chuān le liǎng zhī yánsè bù tóng de wàzi?
Was it because I hadn't washed, or because I was wearing odd socks?
他没来，是因为生病了，还是因为忘了？
Tā méi lái, shì yīnwèi shēngbìng le, háishi yīnwèi wàng le?
Didn't he come because he's ill, or because he forgot?
不知道该怎么办
not to know what to do
该 means “should”. In 该怎么办 it asks what the right thing to do is.
正当我不知道该怎么办的时候……
Zhèngdāng wǒ bù zhīdào gāi zěnme bàn de shíhou …
Just as I was wondering what to do …
我不知道该说什么。
Wǒ bù zhīdào gāi shuō shénme.
I don't know what to say.
gaps: 教室里坐着很多学生，可是
发现，周围的人都是我的中学同学。
say: This morning I had a listening class.
Forget it, there was no time anyway.
It looked like the teacher hadn't arrived yet.
I opened the window. It wasn't even light yet.

023.title: Between classes
023.sub: Two classmates talk about Sun Zhenggang, who then joins them
023.transcriptNote: 旁白 is the narrator, 甲 is Fang Xiaoying, 乙 is Qi Wanchun, and 丙 is Sun Zhenggang (老孙). I assigned the speakers from context.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 课间休息的时候，方小英和齐万春在楼道里说话。
Kèjiān xiūxi de shíhou, Fāng Xiǎoyīng hé Qí Wànchūn zài lóudào li shuōhuà.
During the break, Fang Xiaoying and Qi Wanchun are chatting in the corridor.
你看那个矮个子的男生，他是我们班的，
Nǐ kàn nàge ǎi gèzi de nánshēng, tā shì wǒmen bān de,
See that short guy? He's in our class,
可是我不知道他叫什么名字。
kěshì wǒ bù zhīdào tā jiào shénme míngzi.
but I don't know his name.
Ò, nǐ shuō de shì Sūn Zhènggāng ba?
我跟他太熟了，我们在高中是同班同学。
Wǒ gēn tā tài shú le, wǒmen zài gāozhōng shì tóngbān tóngxué.
I know him really well. We were in the same class at high school.
是吗？他真有意思，平时老是没睡醒的样子。
Shì ma? Tā zhēn yǒu yìsi, píngshí lǎoshì méi shuìxǐng de yàngzi.
Really? He's funny. He always looks half asleep.
有一次，他一进教室，大家都笑了，
Yǒu yí cì, tā yí jìn jiàoshì, dàjiā dōu xiào le,
Once, as soon as he walked into the classroom, everyone laughed,
因为一看就知道他起晚了，
yīnwèi yí kàn jiù zhīdào tā qǐ wǎn le,
because you could tell at a glance he'd overslept.
不但没梳头，还扣错了扣子。
búdàn méi shū tóu, hái kòucuò le kòuzi.
He hadn't combed his hair, and his buttons were done up wrong.
刚才的听力课他又迟到了，老师没让他进教室。
Gāngcái de tīnglì kè tā yòu chídào le, lǎoshī méi ràng tā jìn jiàoshì.
He was late again for the listening class just now, and the teacher didn't let him in.
不过，你知道吗？他可了不起了，
Búguò, nǐ zhīdào ma? Tā kě liǎobuqǐ le,
But you know what? He's actually brilliant.
功课在我们班是第一名。
gōngkè zài wǒmen bān shì dì yī míng.
He was top of our class.
哎，老孙，你过来，我问问你：
Āi, Lǎo Sūn, nǐ guòlai, wǒ wènwen nǐ:
Hey, Lao Sun, come here, I want to ask you something.
我是不是应该送你一个新闹钟啊？
Wǒ shì bu shì yīnggāi sòng nǐ yí ge xīn nàozhōng a?
Should I buy you a new alarm clock?
Nǐ yòu kāi wǒ de wánxiào.
告诉你，今天我六点半就起床了。
Gàosu nǐ, jīntiān wǒ liù diǎn bàn jiù qǐchuáng le.
For your information, I got up at half past six today.
Nà nǐ zěnme yòu lái wǎn le ne?
So why were you late again?
唉，别提了，没想到半路上我的自行车坏了。
Āi, bié tí le, méi xiǎngdào bànlù shang wǒ de zìxíngchē huài le.
Don't ask. My bike broke down halfway, of all things.

grammar: 老是 + V
always … (with complaint)
老是 means “always” and often sounds critical.
平时老是没睡醒的样子。
Píngshí lǎoshì méi shuìxǐng de yàngzi.
He always looks half asleep.
他老是忘带钥匙。
Tā lǎoshì wàng dài yàoshi.
He's always forgetting his keys.
一看就知道
you can tell at a glance
一 + V + 就 + result: as soon as you look, you know.
一看就知道他起晚了。
Yí kàn jiù zhīdào tā qǐ wǎn le.
You could tell at a glance he'd overslept.
他一听就明白了。
Tā yì tīng jiù míngbai le.
He understood as soon as he heard it.
不但没……，还……
not only didn't …, but also …
This is the negative form of 不但……还……: it lists things that went wrong.
不但没梳头，还扣错了扣子。
Búdàn méi shū tóu, hái kòucuò le kòuzi.
He hadn't combed his hair, and his buttons were done up wrong.
他不但没帮忙，还说了很多不好听的话。
Tā búdàn méi bāngmáng, hái shuō le hěn duō bù hǎotīng de huà.
Not only didn't he help, he said a lot of nasty things.
开 + person + 的玩笑
to tease someone
The person being teased goes between 开 and 玩笑, linked with 的.
你又开我的玩笑。
Nǐ yòu kāi wǒ de wánxiào.
You're teasing me again.
别开他的玩笑了。
Bié kāi tā de wánxiào le.
Stop teasing him.
V坏了 (literal)
broken
Compare part 016's 急坏了 (“terribly anxious”). Here 坏了 just means the bike broke.
没想到半路上我的自行车坏了。
Méi xiǎngdào bànlù shang wǒ de zìxíngchē huài le.
My bike broke down halfway.
我的手机坏了。
Wǒ de shǒujī huài le.
My phone's broken.
gaps: 的时候，方小英和齐万春在楼道里说话。
say: Oh, you mean Sun Zhenggang?
I know him really well. We were in the same class at high school.
You're teasing me again.
Don't ask. My bike broke down halfway, of all things.

025.title: Ten sentences
025.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences. Many of them use direction words after a verb (回……去, 下楼来, 拿出, 买来). Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 外面正在下雨呢，你就别出去了。
Wàimiàn zhèngzài xià yǔ ne, nǐ jiù bié chūqu le.
It's raining out, so don't go out.
今天晚上女儿有事儿问你，你能不能早点儿回来？
Jīntiān wǎnshang nǚ'ér yǒu shìr wèn nǐ, nǐ néng bu néng zǎo diǎnr huílai?
Our daughter wants to ask you something tonight. Could you come home a bit earlier?
听说雅克上个月回法国去了。
Tīngshuō Yǎkè shàng ge yuè huí Fǎguó qù le.
I heard Jacques went back to France last month.
你知道吗？那个老太太已经好几天没有下楼来了。
Nǐ zhīdào ma? Nàge lǎotàitai yǐjīng hǎo jǐ tiān méiyǒu xià lóu lái le.
Did you know? That old lady hasn't come downstairs for days.
爸爸从妈妈的钱包里拿出了十块钱，到商店去买来了一瓶酒。
Bàba cóng māma de qiánbāo li náchū le shí kuài qián, dào shāngdiàn qù mǎilai le yì píng jiǔ.
Dad took ten yuan out of Mum's purse and went to the shop and bought a bottle of alcohol.
玛丽上完口语课就回家去了。
Mǎlì shàngwán kǒuyǔ kè jiù huí jiā qù le.
Mary went home as soon as her speaking class finished.
小张在电影院门口看来看去，就是没看到女朋友在哪里。
Xiǎo Zhāng zài diànyǐngyuàn ménkǒu kàn lái kàn qù, jiù shì méi kàndào nǚpéngyou zài nǎlǐ.
Xiao Zhang looked all around outside the cinema, but just couldn't see his girlfriend anywhere.
快点儿起来吧！要是你不快点儿，你跟女朋友的约会就要迟到了。
Kuài diǎnr qǐlai ba! Yàoshi nǐ bú kuài diǎnr, nǐ gēn nǚpéngyou de yuēhuì jiù yào chídào le.
Get up, quick! If you don't hurry, you'll be late for your date.
放下你手里的刀！手放在头上！
Fàngxia nǐ shǒu li de dāo! Shǒu fàng zài tóu shang!
Put down the knife! Hands on your head!
走出飞机场的大门，人们发现他们来到了一个美丽的地方。
Zǒuchū fēijīchǎng de dàmén, rénmen fāxiàn tāmen láidào le yí ge měilì de dìfang.
Walking out of the airport gates, people found they'd arrived somewhere beautiful.

grammar: V + 回/下/上 + place + 来/去
go or come (back, down, up) to …
The place goes between the two direction words. Use 来 for movement towards the speaker and 去 for movement away.
听说雅克上个月回法国去了。
Tīngshuō Yǎkè shàng ge yuè huí Fǎguó qù le.
I heard Jacques went back to France last month.
你什么时候回家来？
Nǐ shénme shíhou huí jiā lái?
When are you coming home?
V + 出/来 (result of movement)
take out, bring back
出 means out of something, and 来 means towards here. 拿出 is “take out”, and 买来 is “buy and bring back”.
爸爸从妈妈的钱包里拿出了十块钱，到商店去买来了一瓶酒。
Bàba cóng māma de qiánbāo li náchū le shí kuài qián, dào shāngdiàn qù mǎilai le yì píng jiǔ.
Dad took ten yuan out of Mum's purse and bought a bottle of alcohol.
他从书包里拿出一本书。
Tā cóng shūbāo li náchū yì běn shū.
He took a book out of his bag.
V来V去
to … back and forth, all over
Repeating a verb with 来 and 去 shows the action going on again and again, often getting nowhere.
小张在电影院门口看来看去。
Xiǎo Zhāng zài diànyǐngyuàn ménkǒu kàn lái kàn qù.
Xiao Zhang looked all around outside the cinema.
我想来想去，还是不去了。
Wǒ xiǎng lái xiǎng qù, háishi bú qù le.
I thought it over and over, and decided not to go.
就是 + negative
just won't, just doesn't
就是 stresses that, despite everything, the result didn't happen.
就是没看到女朋友在哪里。
Jiù shì méi kàndào nǚpéngyou zài nǎlǐ.
He just couldn't see his girlfriend anywhere.
我说了很多次，他就是不听。
Wǒ shuō le hěn duō cì, tā jiù shì bù tīng.
I told him many times, but he just won't listen.
V起来 / 放下
get up / put down
起来 means up from lying or sitting, and 下 means down: 坐下, 放下.
快点儿起来吧！
Kuài diǎnr qǐlai ba!
Get up, quick!
请坐下。
Qǐng zuòxia.
Please sit down.
gaps: 外面正在下雨呢，你就别
听说雅克上个月回法国
那个老太太已经好几天没有
小张在电影院门口看来看
走出飞机场的大门，人们发现他们来到了一个
say: It's raining out, so don't go out.
I heard Jacques went back to France last month.
Get up, quick! If you don't hurry, you'll be late for your date.
Put down the knife! Hands on your head!

026.title: Fifteen multiple-choice items
026.transcriptNote: Each item has a short sentence or exchange, a question and four options. The answer key is my own reading. Some item numbers aren't read aloud.

lines: 刘经理，您准备好了吗？我可以让第一个面试的人进来吗？
Liú jīnglǐ, nín zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Wǒ kěyǐ ràng dì yī ge miànshì de rén jìnlai ma?
Manager Liu, are you ready? Can I send in the first interviewee?

q: 说话人可能是什么人？
Shuōhuàrén kěnéng shì shénme rén?
Who is the speaker probably?

lines: 小周，你告诉那些来面试的人，如果会外语就留下等着，要是不会就回去吧。
Xiǎo Zhōu, nǐ gàosu nàxiē lái miànshì de rén, rúguǒ huì wàiyǔ jiù liúxia děng zhe, yàoshi bú huì jiù huíqu ba.
Xiao Zhou, tell the interviewees that those who speak a foreign language should stay and wait, and the rest can go home.

q: 哪些人不能留下来？
Nǎxiē rén bù néng liú xialai?
Who can't stay?
o: people who speak a foreign language
people who don't speak a foreign language
zài wàimiàn děng zhe de rén

lines: 这本词典我是从别人那里借来的，你看完以后赶快还给我。
Zhè běn cídiǎn wǒ shì cóng biérén nàlǐ jièlai de, nǐ kànwán yǐhòu gǎnkuài huán gěi wǒ.
I borrowed this dictionary from someone else, so give it back as soon as you've finished.

q: 这本词典是谁的？
Zhè běn cídiǎn shì shéi de?
Whose dictionary is it?

lines: 他明天就要离开北京回美国去了，我不能不陪陪他。
Tā míngtiān jiù yào líkāi Běijīng huí Měiguó qù le, wǒ bù néng bù péipei tā.
He's leaving Beijing for America tomorrow, so I have to spend some time with him.

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: 他明天一定要回美国去。
Tā míngtiān yídìng yào huí Měiguó qù.
He absolutely must go back to America tomorrow.
他明天一定要离开北京。
Tā míngtiān yídìng yào líkāi Běijīng.
He absolutely must leave Beijing tomorrow.
I should spend time with him.
He has no time for me.

lines: 快点吃吧，吃完饭我们先去买东西，然后去看电影，最后我送你回家去。
Kuài diǎn chī ba, chīwán fàn wǒmen xiān qù mǎi dōngxi, ránhòu qù kàn diànyǐng, zuìhòu wǒ sòng nǐ huí jiā qù.
Eat up. After dinner we'll go shopping first, then see a film, and then I'll take you home.

q: 他们现在在做什么？
Tāmen xiànzài zài zuò shénme?
What are they doing now?

lines: 小王到南方去了三个月，回来后好胖啊！
Xiǎo Wáng dào nánfāng qù le sān ge yuè, huílai hòu hǎo pàng a!
Xiao Wang went south for three months and came back so much heavier!

q: 根据这句话，我们可以知道什么？
Gēnjù zhè jù huà, wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: Xiao Wang has always been heavy.
Xiǎo Wáng bǐ yǐqián pàng duō le.
Xiao Wang is much heavier than before.
Xiǎo Wáng méiyǒu yǐqián pàng le.
Xiao Wang isn't as heavy as before.
Xiao Wang looks better a bit heavier.

lines: 今天去学校找老师，可是老师有事出去了。
Jīntiān qù xuéxiào zhǎo lǎoshī, kěshì lǎoshī yǒu shì chūqu le.
I went to school to see the teacher today, but she'd gone out on business.

q: 从这句话我们可以知道什么？
Cóng zhè jù huà wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: The speaker didn't go to the teacher's.
The speaker didn't get to see the teacher.
The teacher didn't want to see the speaker.
说话人最后见到了老师。
The speaker saw the teacher in the end.

lines: 想让小明改掉坏毛病，那得等到太阳从西边出来还差不多。
Xiǎng ràng Xiǎo Míng gǎidiào huài máobìng, nà děi děngdào tàiyáng cóng xībian chūlai hái chàbuduō.
Get Xiao Ming to give up his bad habits? That'll happen when the sun rises in the west.

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: 他不相信小明会改掉坏毛病。
Tā bù xiāngxìn Xiǎo Míng huì gǎidiào huài máobìng.
He doesn't believe Xiao Ming will give up his bad habits.
他也知道小明要改掉坏毛病。
Tā yě zhīdào Xiǎo Míng yào gǎidiào huài máobìng.
He knows Xiao Ming wants to give them up.
Xiǎo Míng shì cóng xībian guòlai de.
Xiao Ming came from the west.
太阳也可以从西边出来。
Tàiyáng yě kěyǐ cóng xībian chūlai.
The sun can rise in the west too.

lines: 从公园出来后，我和他一起吃的晚饭，饭后我们就分手了。
Cóng gōngyuán chūlai hòu, wǒ hé tā yìqǐ chī de wǎnfàn, fàn hòu wǒmen jiù fēnshǒu le.
After leaving the park, he and I had dinner together, and after dinner we went our separate ways.

q: 说话人的意思是什么？
Shuōhuàrén de yìsi shì shénme?
What does the speaker mean?
o: Wǒmen méi zài yìqǐ chī wǎnfàn.
我和他分手以后去的公园。
Wǒ hé tā fēnshǒu yǐhòu qù de gōngyuán.
I went to the park after we parted.
Wǒmen wǎnfàn qián jiù fēnshǒu le.
Wǒmen chīwán fàn jiù fēnshǒu le.

lines: 昨天我刚从马赛回来，那地方可真够热的。
Zuótiān wǒ gāng cóng Mǎsài huílai, nà dìfang kě zhēn gòu rè de.
I only got back from Marseille yesterday. It's really hot there.

q: 根据这句话，下面哪句话的意思不对？
Gēnjù zhè jù huà, xiàmiàn nǎ jù huà de yìsi bú duì?
Which statement is NOT true?

blocks.note: This question asks which statement is wrong: he came back yesterday, he didn't go yesterday.

lines: 小张要是决定去做一件事，那可是八匹马也不能拉回来。
Xiǎo Zhāng yàoshi juédìng qù zuò yí jiàn shì, nà kě shì bā pǐ mǎ yě bù néng lā huilai.
Once Xiao Zhang decides to do something, not even eight horses could pull him back.

q: 根据这句话，我们可以知道什么？
Gēnjù zhè jù huà, wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: 小张要做的事，就一定要去做。
Xiǎo Zhāng yào zuò de shì, jiù yídìng yào qù zuò.
Whatever Xiao Zhang decides to do, he'll do.
Xiǎo Zhāng lā huilai bā pǐ mǎ.
Xiao Zhang pulled back eight horses.
Xiǎo Zhāng yào qù lā bā pǐ mǎ.
Xiao Zhang is going to pull eight horses.
Xiǎo Zhāng bù xiǎng qù zuò yí jiàn shì.
Xiao Zhang doesn't want to do something.

lines: 我现在得上楼去，要是大卫来了，你就让他等我一下，告诉他我马上就下来。
Wǒ xiànzài děi shàng lóu qù, yàoshi Dàwèi lái le, nǐ jiù ràng tā děng wǒ yíxià, gàosu tā wǒ mǎshàng jiù xiàlai.
I need to go upstairs now. If David comes, ask him to wait, and tell him I'll be right down.

q: 这句话告诉我们什么？
Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen shénme?
What does this tell us?

lines: 老王，我想看看你上个星期从图书馆借来的那本书，可以吗？
Lǎo Wáng, wǒ xiǎng kànkan nǐ shàng ge xīngqī cóng túshūguǎn jièlai de nà běn shū, kěyǐ ma?
Lao Wang, could I have a look at the book you borrowed from the library last week?
真对不起，小刘，那本书我昨天就请小李帮我还了。
Zhēn duìbuqǐ, Xiǎo Liú, nà běn shū wǒ zuótiān jiù qǐng Xiǎo Lǐ bāng wǒ huán le.
Sorry, Xiao Liu, I asked Xiao Li to return it for me yesterday.

q: 那本书现在在哪里？
Nà běn shū xiànzài zài nǎlǐ?
Where is the book now?

lines: 你看，外面好像要下雨了。
Nǐ kàn, wàimiàn hǎoxiàng yào xià yǔ le.
Look, it looks like it's going to rain.
你是不是又不想出去散步了？
Nǐ shì bu shì yòu bù xiǎng chūqu sànbù le?
Don't tell me you don't want to go for a walk again?

q: 从对话中我们可以知道什么？
Cóng duìhuà zhōng wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from the dialogue?
o: 男的很不喜欢出去散步。
Nán de hěn bù xǐhuan chūqu sànbù.
The man really doesn't like going for walks.
The man often goes for walks.
女的很不喜欢出去散步。
Nǚ de hěn bù xǐhuan chūqu sànbù.
The woman really doesn't like going for walks.
今天的天气很适合出去散步。
Jīntiān de tiānqì hěn shìhé chūqu sànbù.
Today's weather is perfect for a walk.

blocks.note: By voice pitch (about 140 Hz against 265 Hz), the man says the first line, making an excuse about the rain, and the woman says the second. So the man is the one who doesn't like walks.

lines: 姐姐，快下来呀！爸爸说要带咱们去城里吃饭。
Jiějie, kuài xiàlai ya! Bàba shuō yào dài zánmen qù chéng li chī fàn.
Come down, sis! Dad says he's taking us into town for dinner.
你们在客厅里等我一会儿，我过两分钟就下去。
Nǐmen zài kètīng li děng wǒ yíhuìr, wǒ guò liǎng fēnzhōng jiù xiàqu.
Wait for me in the living room. I'll be down in two minutes.

q: 女的现在在哪儿？
Nǚ de xiànzài zài nǎr?
Where is the woman now?

grammar: 不能不 + V
have to, can't not …
A double negative makes a strong obligation, a bit like 一定要.
我不能不陪陪他。
Wǒ bù néng bù péipei tā.
I have to spend some time with him.
明天考试，我不能不复习。
Míngtiān kǎoshì, wǒ bù néng bú fùxí.
There's an exam tomorrow. I have to revise.
first …, then …, finally …
These words put a series of actions in order.
吃完饭我们先去买东西，然后去看电影，最后我送你回家去。
Chīwán fàn wǒmen xiān qù mǎi dōngxi, ránhòu qù kàn diànyǐng, zuìhòu wǒ sòng nǐ huí jiā qù.
After dinner we'll go shopping, then see a film, and then I'll take you home.
我先洗澡，然后吃早饭，最后去上班。
Wǒ xiān xǐzǎo, ránhòu chī zǎofàn, zuìhòu qù shàngbān.
First I shower, then have breakfast, then go to work.
太阳从西边出来
when pigs fly
“When the sun rises in the west” is a set phrase for something that will never happen. 还差不多 adds sarcasm.
那得等到太阳从西边出来还差不多。
Nà děi děngdào tàiyáng cóng xībian chūlai hái chàbuduō.
That'll happen when the sun rises in the west.
他会早起？太阳从西边出来了！
Tā huì zǎoqǐ? Tàiyáng cóng xībian chūlai le!
Him get up early? That'll be the day!
真够 + adjective + 的
really quite …
够 before an adjective means “really” in speech, and 的 at the end rounds it off.
那地方可真够热的。
Nà dìfang kě zhēn gòu rè de.
It's really hot there.
今天真够冷的。
Jīntiān zhēn gòu lěng de.
It's really cold today.
八匹马也拉不回来
nothing can change his mind
Literally, “eight horses couldn't pull him back”. It describes someone stubborn and determined.
那可是八匹马也不能拉回来。
Nà kě shì bā pǐ mǎ yě bù néng lā huilai.
Not even eight horses could pull him back.
她决定了的事，八匹马也拉不回来。
Tā juédìng le de shì, bā pǐ mǎ yě lā bu huílai.
Once she's decided something, nothing will change her mind.
say: Manager Liu, are you ready? Can I send in the first interviewee?
I borrowed this dictionary from someone else, so give it back as soon as you've finished.
I need to go upstairs now. If David comes, ask him to wait, and tell him I'll be right down.
Wait for me in the living room. I'll be down in two minutes.

027.title: Hiring a new employee
027.sub: A story about six interviews, with ten questions
027.transcriptNote: A story told by a narrator, then ten questions. The answers are my own wording. The English instructions aren't transcribed.

lines: 海天公司要招一名新员工，
Hǎitiān Gōngsī yào zhāo yì míng xīn yuángōng,
Haitian Company wanted to hire a new employee.
这个人要会讲外语，还要会用电脑。
zhège rén yào huì jiǎng wàiyǔ, hái yào huì yòng diànnǎo.
The person had to speak a foreign language and be able to use a computer.
听到这个消息以后，很多人都报了名，
Tīngdào zhège xiāoxi yǐhòu, hěn duō rén dōu bào le míng,
When they heard the news, lots of people applied
On the day of the interviews,
第一个进来的人虽然很年轻，但是很有礼貌，
dì yī ge jìnlai de rén suīrán hěn niánqīng, dànshì hěn yǒu lǐmào,
the first person to come in was young but very polite,
but the only thing he could do was sing.
第二个是个姑娘，进来以后就从书包里拿出一大堆证书，
Dì èr ge shì ge gūniang, jìnlai yǐhòu jiù cóng shūbāo li náchū yí dà duī zhèngshū,
The second was a young woman, who came in and pulled a big pile of certificates out of her bag,
可是她写的简历里边少了很多东西。
kěshì tā xiě de jiǎnlì lǐbian shǎo le hěn duō dōngxi.
but her CV was missing a lot of things.
第三个人是个中年人，好像很有知识，像个大学老师。
Dì sān ge rén shì ge zhōngniánrén, hǎoxiàng hěn yǒu zhīshi, xiàng ge dàxué lǎoshī.
The third was middle-aged, seemed very knowledgeable and looked like a university lecturer.
他一进来，就用英语跟刘经理打招呼，
Tā yí jìnlai, jiù yòng Yīngyǔ gēn Liú jīnglǐ dǎ zhāohu,
As soon as he came in, he greeted Manager Liu in English,
可是刘经理用英语问他问题，他连一句也不会回答。
kěshì Liú jīnglǐ yòng Yīngyǔ wèn tā wèntí, tā lián yí jù yě bú huì huídá.
but when Manager Liu asked him questions in English, he couldn't answer a single one.
第四个进来的人个子不高，还挺胖，
Dì sì ge jìnlai de rén gèzi bù gāo, hái tǐng pàng,
The fourth was short and quite plump.
过来跟每个人都握手以后才开始介绍自己，
Guòlai gēn měi ge rén dōu wòshǒu yǐhòu cái kāishǐ jièshào zìjǐ,
He shook hands with everyone before he even started introducing himself,
dòngzuò màn de ràng rén zháojí.
and moved so slowly it was frustrating to watch.
后来又进来了一个穿着中式衣服的外国人，
Hòulái yòu jìnlai le yí ge chuān zhe zhōngshì yīfu de wàiguórén,
Then a foreigner in Chinese-style clothes came in.
他说的普通话很地道，而且还会说很多土话，
Tā shuō de pǔtōnghuà hěn dìdao, érqiě hái huì shuō hěn duō tǔhuà,
His Mandarin was very authentic, and he could speak lots of local dialects too,
可是他一点儿也不懂计算机。
kěshì tā yìdiǎnr yě bù dǒng jìsuànjī.
but he knew nothing at all about computers.
最后进来的那个女人打扮得时髦极了，
Zuìhòu jìnlai de nàge nǚrén dǎban de shímáo jí le,
The last one in was a very fashionably dressed woman,
chuān zhe gāogēnxié, dài zhe màozi,
in high heels and a hat,
而且不管刘经理说什么，她都笑一笑。
érqiě bùguǎn Liú jīnglǐ shuō shénme, tā dōu xiào yi xiào.
and whatever Manager Liu said, she just smiled.
Zhè yì tiān, Liú jīnglǐ lèi huài le,
By the end of the day, Manager Liu was exhausted,
不但身体累，而且心也累，
búdàn shēntǐ lèi, érqiě xīn yě lèi,
not just physically but mentally too,
因为他不知道这几个人里边，哪一个可以进海天公司来工作。
yīnwèi tā bù zhīdào zhè jǐ ge rén lǐbian, nǎ yí ge kěyǐ jìn Hǎitiān Gōngsī lái gōngzuò.
because he had no idea which of them could come and work at Haitian Company.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 海天公司需要一个什么样的新员工？
Hǎitiān Gōngsī xūyào yí ge shénmeyàng de xīn yuángōng?
What kind of new employee does Haitian Company need?
ans: 一个会讲外语、会用电脑的人。
Yí ge huì jiǎng wàiyǔ, huì yòng diànnǎo de rén.
Someone who speaks a foreign language and can use a computer.

q: 他们用什么办法招收新员工？
Tāmen yòng shénme bànfǎ zhāoshōu xīn yuángōng?
How do they recruit new staff?
ans: 面试。
Miànshì.
Through interviews.

q: 这一天，一共有几个人来参加面试？
Zhè yì tiān, yígòng yǒu jǐ ge rén lái cānjiā miànshì?
How many people came for an interview that day?
ans: 六个人。
Liù ge rén.
Six.

q: 第一个人特别会做什么？
Dì yī ge rén tèbié huì zuò shénme?
What is the first person especially good at?
ans: 唱歌。
Chàng gē.
Singing.

q: 第二个人为什么带来了很多证书？
Dì èr ge rén wèishénme dàilai le hěn duō zhèngshū?
Why did the second person bring lots of certificates?
ans: 她想用证书说明自己的能力，因为她的简历写得不好。
Tā xiǎng yòng zhèngshū shuōmíng zìjǐ de nénglì, yīnwèi tā de jiǎnlì xiě de bù hǎo.
To show what she can do, since her CV was weak.

q: 第三个人的英语怎么样？
Dì sān ge rén de Yīngyǔ zěnmeyàng?
How is the third person's English?
ans: 不好，他只会打招呼，问题一句也不会回答。
Bù hǎo, tā zhǐ huì dǎ zhāohu, wèntí yí jù yě bú huì huídá.
Poor. He could only say hello and couldn't answer a single question.

q: 第四个人进了办公室，里面除了刘经理，还有别的人吗？从哪句话里可以知道？
Dì sì ge rén jìn le bàngōngshì, lǐmiàn chúle Liú jīnglǐ, hái yǒu biéde rén ma? Cóng nǎ jù huà li kěyǐ zhīdào?
When the fourth person came in, was anyone there besides Manager Liu? Which sentence tells you?
ans: 有。“过来跟每个人都握手。”
Yǒu. “Guòlai gēn měi ge rén dōu wòshǒu.”
Yes: “he shook hands with everyone.”

q: 那个外国人会什么，不会什么？
Nàge wàiguórén huì shénme, bú huì shénme?
What can the foreigner do, and what can't he do?
ans: 会说地道的普通话和很多土话，不懂计算机。
Huì shuō dìdao de pǔtōnghuà hé hěn duō tǔhuà, bù dǒng jìsuànjī.
He speaks authentic Mandarin and lots of dialects, but knows nothing about computers.

q: 最后一个是什么人？
Zuìhòu yí ge shì shénme rén?
Who was the last one?
ans: 一个打扮得很时髦的女人。
Yí ge dǎban de hěn shímáo de nǚrén.
A very fashionably dressed woman.

q: 刘经理看了这些人以后，觉得怎么样？为什么？
Liú jīnglǐ kàn le zhèxiē rén yǐhòu, juéde zěnmeyàng? Wèishénme?
How did Manager Liu feel after seeing them all? Why?
ans: 他累坏了，因为不知道哪一个可以来公司工作。
Tā lèi huài le, yīnwèi bù zhīdào nǎ yí ge kěyǐ lái gōngsī gōngzuò.
Exhausted, because he didn't know which of them could do the job.

grammar: 虽然……但是……，不过……
although …, …; but …
The story stacks contrasts. 虽然 and 但是 balance two qualities, then 不过 adds a weakness.
第一个进来的人虽然很年轻，但是很有礼貌，不过只会唱歌。
Dì yī ge jìnlai de rén suīrán hěn niánqīng, dànshì hěn yǒu lǐmào, búguò zhǐ huì chàng gē.
The first was young but polite, though all he could do was sing.
这家饭馆虽然小，但是很干净，不过有点儿贵。
Zhè jiā fànguǎn suīrán xiǎo, dànshì hěn gānjìng, búguò yǒudiǎnr guì.
This restaurant is small but clean, though a bit pricey.
V得让人 + feeling
so … that it makes people …
This degree complement describes the effect on the people watching.
动作慢得让人着急。
Dòngzuò màn de ràng rén zháojí.
He moved so slowly it was frustrating to watch.
这个电影好看得让人不想走。
Zhège diànyǐng hǎokàn de ràng rén bù xiǎng zǒu.
This film is so good nobody wants to leave.
一点儿也不 + V
not … at all
一点儿也 with a negative means “not even a little”.
可是他一点儿也不懂计算机。
Kěshì tā yìdiǎnr yě bù dǒng jìsuànjī.
But he knew nothing at all about computers.
今天一点儿也不冷。
Jīntiān yìdiǎnr yě bù lěng.
It's not cold at all today.
no matter …, always …
不管 goes with a question word or an either-or choice, and 都 gives the result that doesn't change.
不管刘经理说什么，她都笑一笑。
Bùguǎn Liú jīnglǐ shuō shénme, tā dōu xiào yi xiào.
Whatever Manager Liu said, she just smiled.
不管多忙，他都每天跑步。
Bùguǎn duō máng, tā dōu měi tiān pǎobù.
However busy he is, he runs every day.
besides …, also …
除了 with 还 adds to the list. With 都 it excludes instead (“except”).
里面除了刘经理，还有别的人吗？
Lǐmiàn chúle Liú jīnglǐ, hái yǒu biéde rén ma?
Was anyone there besides Manager Liu?
除了汉语，他还会说日语。
Chúle Hànyǔ, tā hái huì shuō Rìyǔ.
Besides Chinese, he also speaks Japanese.
gaps: 进来以后就从书包里拿出一大堆
刘经理说什么，她都笑一笑。
say: The person had to speak a foreign language and be able to use a computer.
When Manager Liu asked him questions in English, he couldn't answer a single one.
But he knew nothing at all about computers.
By the end of the day, Manager Liu was exhausted.

028.title: “Where's Lili?”
028.sub: A short dialogue at the door, with five questions
028.transcriptNote: 甲 is Liu Shan, who is visiting, and 乙 is Meiyun, Lili's roommate. The answers are my own wording.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 她出去了，可能一会儿就回来。
Tā chūqu le, kěnéng yíhuìr jiù huílai.
She's gone out. She'll probably be back soon.
Liú Shān, nǐ jìnlai děng tā ba.
Come in and wait for her, Liu Shan.
你正在做功课吧？不打扰你吗？
Nǐ zhèngzài zuò gōngkè ba? Bù dǎrǎo nǐ ma?
Aren't you doing your homework? I won't be disturbing you?
Not at all. Come on in.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 丽丽在房间里吗？
Lìli zài fángjiān li ma?
Is Lili in the room?
ans: 不在，她出去了。
Bú zài, tā chūqu le.
No, she's gone out.

q: 丽丽到哪儿去了？
Lìli dào nǎr qù le?
Where has Lili gone?
ans: 她到图书馆去了。
Tā dào túshūguǎn qù le.
To the library.

q: 丽丽什么时候回来？
Lìli shénme shíhou huílai?
When will Lili be back?
ans: 可能一会儿就回来。
Kěnéng yíhuìr jiù huílai.
Probably soon.

q: 美云让刘珊在哪儿等丽丽？
Měiyún ràng Liú Shān zài nǎr děng Lìli?
Where does Meiyun tell Liu Shan to wait?
ans: 在房间里等。
Zài fángjiān li děng.
In the room.

q: 美云可能正在房间里做什么？
Měiyún kěnéng zhèngzài fángjiān li zuò shénme?
What is Meiyun probably doing in the room?
ans: 她可能正在做功课。
Tā kěnéng zhèngzài zuò gōngkè.
Probably her homework.

grammar: Noun + 呢？
where's …?
With no other context, 呢 after a person or thing asks where they are.
美云，丽丽呢？
Měiyún, Lìli ne?
Meiyun, where's Lili?
我的手机呢？
Wǒ de shǒujī ne?
Where's my phone?
一会儿就……
soon, in a moment
一会儿 is a short time, and 就 stresses how soon.
可能一会儿就回来。
Kěnéng yíhuìr jiù huílai.
She'll probably be back soon.
你等一下，我一会儿就好。
Nǐ děng yíxià, wǒ yíhuìr jiù hǎo.
Wait a moment, I'll be ready soon.
到 + place + 去了
has gone to …
This is a common spoken way to say where someone has gone. 去 goes after the place.
到图书馆去了。
Dào túshūguǎn qù le.
She's gone to the library.
他到上海去了。
Tā dào Shànghǎi qù le.
He's gone to Shanghai.
……吧？ (guess)
I suppose …, right?
吧 at the end of a statement turns it into a guess that you want confirmed.
你正在做功课吧？
Nǐ zhèngzài zuò gōngkè ba?
You're doing your homework, aren't you?
你是新来的吧？
Nǐ shì xīn lái de ba?
You're new here, right?
say: Meiyun, where's Lili?
She's gone out. She'll probably be back soon.
Aren't you doing your homework? I won't be disturbing you?

029.title: Presents for Mum and Dad
029.sub: A student in France talks about presents, with four multiple-choice items
029.transcriptNote: One speaker, a Chinese student living in France, then four questions. The answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 独白
lines: 我到法国已经一年多了。
Wǒ dào Fǎguó yǐjīng yì nián duō le.
I've been in France for over a year now.
妈妈从国内给我寄来了一些好吃的。
māma cóng guónèi gěi wǒ jìlai le yìxiē hǎochī de.
and Mum sent me some treats from home.
其实我已经是大人了，妈妈还总觉得我是小孩子。
Qíshí wǒ yǐjīng shì dàrén le, māma hái zǒng juéde wǒ shì xiǎo háizi.
I'm actually a grown-up now, but Mum still thinks of me as a little kid.
再过一个多月，妈妈的生日也要到了，
Zài guò yí ge duō yuè, māma de shēngrì yě yào dào le,
In just over a month it'll be Mum's birthday too,
我打算买一些化妆品给妈妈寄去，算是我送给她的礼物。
wǒ dǎsuan mǎi yìxiē huàzhuāngpǐn gěi māma jìqu, suànshì wǒ sòng gěi tā de lǐwù.
so I'm planning to buy some cosmetics and post them to her as my present.
当然了，我也要送给爸爸一件礼物。
Dāngrán le, wǒ yě yào sòng gěi bàba yí jiàn lǐwù.
Of course, I want to give Dad a present too.
爸爸爱喝白酒，可是白酒喝多了对身体不好，
Bàba ài hē báijiǔ, kěshì báijiǔ hē duō le duì shēntǐ bù hǎo,
Dad loves baijiu, but drinking too much of it is bad for his health,
wǒ xiǎng sòng tā Fǎguó pútaojiǔ.
so I want to give him French wine.
可是酒不能从邮局寄，只好请别人回中国去的时候帮我带回去。
Kěshì jiǔ bù néng cóng yóujú jì, zhǐhǎo qǐng biérén huí Zhōngguó qù de shíhou bāng wǒ dài huiqu.
But you can't post alcohol, so I'll have to ask someone going back to China to take it for me.

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 我是什么时候到法国的？
Wǒ shì shénme shíhou dào Fǎguó de?
When did I arrive in France?
妈妈从中国寄来了什么？
Māma cóng Zhōngguó jìlai le shénme?
What did Mum send from China?
我可能用什么方法送给妈妈化妆品？
Wǒ kěnéng yòng shénme fāngfǎ sòng gěi māma huàzhuāngpǐn?
How will I probably get the cosmetics to Mum?
o: zìjǐ huí guó de shíhou dài
take them myself when I go home
妈妈来法国的时候送给她
māma lái Fǎguó de shíhou sòng gěi tā
give them when Mum visits France

q: 我可能用什么方法送给爸爸法国葡萄酒？
Wǒ kěnéng yòng shénme fāngfǎ sòng gěi bàba Fǎguó pútaojiǔ?
How will I probably get the wine to Dad?
o: zìjǐ huí guó de shíhou dài
take it myself when I go home
爸爸来法国的时候送给他
bàba lái Fǎguó de shíhou sòng gěi tā
give it when Dad visits France

vocab: to have no choice but to
grammar: 再过 + time
in … (from now)
再过 counts forward from now to an upcoming event.
再过一个多月，妈妈的生日也要到了。
Zài guò yí ge duō yuè, māma de shēngrì yě yào dào le.
In just over a month it'll be Mum's birthday.
再过三天就放假了。
Zài guò sān tiān jiù fàngjià le.
The holidays start in three days.
给 + person + 寄来 / 寄去
send to … (here / there)
寄来 means sent towards the speaker, and 寄去 means sent away from them.
妈妈从国内给我寄来了一些好吃的。
Māma cóng guónèi gěi wǒ jìlai le yìxiē hǎochī de.
Mum sent me some treats from home.
我给朋友寄去了一张明信片。
Wǒ gěi péngyou jìqu le yì zhāng míngxìnpiàn.
I sent my friend a postcard.
算是……
to count as …, sort of …
算是 presents something as more or less fitting a category.
算是我送给她的礼物。
Suànshì wǒ sòng gěi tā de lǐwù.
As my present to her.
这算是我的一点儿心意。
Zhè suànshì wǒ de yìdiǎnr xīnyì.
Take this as a small token of thanks.
V多了对……不好
too much … is bad for …
V + 多了 means overdoing something, and 对……不好 gives the harm.
白酒喝多了对身体不好。
Báijiǔ hē duō le duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
Drinking too much baijiu is bad for your health.
电视看多了对眼睛不好。
Diànshì kàn duō le duì yǎnjing bù hǎo.
Watching too much TV is bad for your eyes.
只好……
to have no choice but to …
只好 introduces the fallback option when the first plan isn't possible.
只好请别人回中国去的时候帮我带回去。
Zhǐhǎo qǐng biérén huí Zhōngguó qù de shíhou bāng wǒ dài huiqu.
I'll have to ask someone going back to China to take it.
没有公共汽车了，我只好走回家。
Méiyǒu gōnggòng qìchē le, wǒ zhǐhǎo zǒu huí jiā.
There were no more buses, so I had to walk home.
gaps: 请别人回中国去的时候帮我带回去。
say: I've been in France for over a year now.
I'm actually a grown-up now, but Mum still thinks of me as a little kid.
Dad loves baijiu, but drinking too much of it is bad for his health.

030.title: The invitation
030.sub: An assistant tells Manager Lin about a dinner invitation
030.transcriptNote: 甲 is the assistant, and 乙 is Manager Lin. I assigned the speakers from context.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 刚才大华公司的人送来一张请柬，请您吃饭。
Gāngcái Dàhuá Gōngsī de rén sònglai yì zhāng qǐngjiǎn, qǐng nín chī fàn.
Someone from Dahua Company just brought an invitation to dinner for you.
是明天晚上八点，在大家乐饭馆。
Shì míngtiān wǎnshang bā diǎn, zài Dàjiālè Fànguǎn.
Tomorrow at eight in the evening, at the Dajiale Restaurant.
大华公司的人说，如果您愿意去的话，请您八点以前到。
Dàhuá Gōngsī de rén shuō, rúguǒ nín yuànyì qù de huà, qǐng nín bā diǎn yǐqián dào.
The Dahua people said that if you'd like to go, please arrive before eight.
好的，你告诉他们，就说我一定过去。
Hǎo de, nǐ gàosu tāmen, jiù shuō wǒ yídìng guòqu.
OK. Tell them I'll definitely be there.
我看了一下地图，大家乐饭馆离咱们公司不远。
Wǒ kàn le yíxià dìtú, Dàjiālè Fànguǎn lí zánmen gōngsī bù yuǎn.
I had a look at the map, and the Dajiale Restaurant isn't far from our office.
您怎么过去呢？要用车吗？
Nín zěnme guòqu ne? Yào yòng chē ma?
How will you get there? Do you need the car?
不用了，下班以后我走过去就行了。
Búyòng le, xiàbān yǐhòu wǒ zǒu guòqu jiù xíng le.
No need. I'll just walk over after work.

vocab: to be willing, to like to
grammar: 请 + person + V
to invite someone to …
请 here means “invite or treat”: 请您吃饭 is “invite you to dinner”.
大华公司的人送来一张请柬，请您吃饭。
Dàhuá Gōngsī de rén sònglai yì zhāng qǐngjiǎn, qǐng nín chī fàn.
Someone from Dahua Company brought an invitation to dinner.
今天我请你喝咖啡。
Jīntiān wǒ qǐng nǐ hē kāfēi.
Coffee's on me today.
如果……的话
if …
This is the formal partner of 要是……的话 from part 022.
如果您愿意去的话，请您八点以前到。
Rúguǒ nín yuànyì qù de huà, qǐng nín bā diǎn yǐqián dào.
If you'd like to go, please arrive before eight.
如果明天下雨的话，我们就不去了。
Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ de huà, wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
你告诉他们，就说……
tell them that …
就说 introduces the exact message to pass on.
你告诉他们，就说我一定过去。
Nǐ gàosu tāmen, jiù shuō wǒ yídìng guòqu.
Tell them I'll definitely be there.
有人找我，就说我不在。
Yǒu rén zhǎo wǒ, jiù shuō wǒ bú zài.
If anyone asks for me, say I'm out.
A 离 B 不远
A isn't far from B
离 measures distance between two places.
大家乐饭馆离咱们公司不远。
Dàjiālè Fànguǎn lí zánmen gōngsī bù yuǎn.
The Dajiale Restaurant isn't far from our office.
我家离学校很近。
Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.
My home is close to school.
V过去就行了
just … over there
过去 is movement towards somewhere else, and 就行了 means that's all it takes.
下班以后我走过去就行了。
Xiàbān yǐhòu wǒ zǒu guòqu jiù xíng le.
I'll just walk over after work.
你打个电话就行了。
Nǐ dǎ ge diànhuà jiù xíng le.
Just give them a call.
gaps: 刚才大华公司的人送来一张
是明天晚上八点，在大家乐
去的话，请您八点以前到。
say: Manager Lin, you're back.
When? Where?
OK. Tell them I'll definitely be there.
No need. I'll just walk over after work.

031.title: “You're mine too”
031.sub: A joke about a quarrel, with seven true-or-false statements
031.transcriptNote: A short story with a twist, then true-or-false statements. The key is my own reading. Some statement numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 故事
lines: 一天，王先生跟他太太吵架了。
Yì tiān, Wáng xiānsheng gēn tā tàitai chǎojià le.
One day Mr Wang had a row with his wife.
王先生生气地说：“你带走你的东西，别回来了！”
Wáng xiānsheng shēngqì de shuō: “Nǐ dàizǒu nǐ de dōngxi, bié huílai le!”
Mr Wang said angrily, “Take your things and don't come back!”
他太太听了，哭着跑进房间。
Tā tàitai tīng le, kū zhe pǎojìn fángjiān.
His wife ran into the bedroom in tears.
过了一会儿，她从房间里拿出一个大袋子，对王先生说：
Guò le yíhuìr, tā cóng fángjiān li náchū yí ge dà dàizi, duì Wáng xiānsheng shuō:
A little later she came out of the room with a big bag and said to Mr Wang,
王先生说：“我为什么要进袋子里去？”
Wáng xiānsheng shuō: “Wǒ wèishénme yào jìn dàizi li qù?”
“Why should I get in the bag?” said Mr Wang.
他太太说：“你让我带走我的东西，你也是我的，我当然要带走。”
Tā tàitai shuō: “Nǐ ràng wǒ dàizǒu wǒ de dōngxi, nǐ yě shì wǒ de, wǒ dāngrán yào dàizǒu.”
His wife said, “You told me to take my things. You're mine too, so of course I'm taking you.”

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 判断正误 · True or false

q: 王先生跟太太生气了，所以不让太太回来了。
Wáng xiānsheng gēn tàitai shēngqì le, suǒyǐ bú ràng tàitai huílai le.
Mr Wang was angry with his wife, so he told her not to come back.
王太太很高兴，笑着走进了房间。
Wáng tàitai hěn gāoxìng, xiào zhe zǒujìn le fángjiān.
Mrs Wang was happy and walked into the room smiling.
qs.why: she ran in crying, 哭着跑进

q: 那个大袋子是从房间里拿出来的。
Nàge dà dàizi shì cóng fángjiān li ná chulai de.
The big bag was brought out of the bedroom.
王先生让王太太进袋子里去。
Wáng xiānsheng ràng Wáng tàitai jìn dàizi li qù.
Mr Wang told Mrs Wang to get in the bag.
qs.why: it's the other way round

q: 王先生不明白为什么要进袋子里去。
Wáng xiānsheng bù míngbai wèishénme yào jìn dàizi li qù.
Mr Wang didn't understand why he should get in the bag.
王先生还爱着太太，他会跟太太一起走。
Wáng xiānsheng hái ài zhe tàitai, tā huì gēn tàitai yìqǐ zǒu.
Mr Wang still loves his wife and will leave with her.
qs.why: the story shows that she still loves him, but says nothing about his feelings or what he'll do

q: 他们最后还是分手了。
Tāmen zuìhòu háishi fēnshǒu le.
In the end they split up anyway.
qs.why: she wants to take him with her, so the story doesn't end in a split

blocks.note: Statements 6 and 7 aren't stated directly in the story, so check them against your book if it has a key.

grammar: 跟 + person + 吵架
to quarrel with someone
跟 marks the other person in a two-way action, as in 吵架, 结婚 and 见面.
王先生跟他太太吵架了。
Wáng xiānsheng gēn tā tàitai chǎojià le.
Mr Wang had a row with his wife.
我昨天跟朋友吵架了。
Wǒ zuótiān gēn péngyou chǎojià le.
I had an argument with a friend yesterday.
V着 + V
doing one thing while doing another
The first verb with 着 describes the manner of the second: 哭着跑 means “ran, crying”.
他太太听了，哭着跑进房间。
Tā tàitai tīng le, kū zhe pǎojìn fángjiān.
His wife ran into the room in tears.
他笑着说：“没关系。”
Tā xiào zhe shuō: “Méi guānxi.”
He said with a smile, “No problem.”
进 + place + 去
to go into …
The place goes between 进 and 去. Use 来 when the movement is towards the speaker.
你进袋子里去吧。
Nǐ jìn dàizi li qù ba.
Get in the bag.
外面冷，快进屋里来吧。
Wàimiàn lěng, kuài jìn wū li lái ba.
It's cold out. Come inside.
让 + person + V
to tell or let someone do …
让 introduces who is told or allowed to act.
你让我带走我的东西。
Nǐ ràng wǒ dàizǒu wǒ de dōngxi.
You told me to take my things.
妈妈不让我看电视。
Māma bú ràng wǒ kàn diànshì.
Mum won't let me watch TV.
gaps: 过了一会儿，她从房间里拿出一个大
say: One day Mr Wang had a row with his wife.
Take your things and don't come back!
Get in the bag.
You're mine too, so of course I'm taking you.

下一个是个短发圆脸的姑娘，背着一个大书包，
Xià yí ge shì ge duǎn fà yuán liǎn de gūniang, bēi zhe yí ge dà shūbāo,
Next was a young woman with short hair and a round face, carrying a big school bag.
一进门就从里面拿出一大堆各种各样的证书，
Yí jìn mén jiù cóng lǐmiàn náchū yí dà duī gè zhǒng gè yàng de zhèngshū,
As soon as she came in, she pulled out a big pile of all kinds of certificates
yí fèn yí fèn de gěi jīnglǐ kàn.
and showed them to the manager one by one.
第三个人有四十多岁了，戴眼镜，样子像个大学老师，
Dì sān ge rén yǒu sìshí duō suì le, dài yǎnjìng, yàngzi xiàng ge dàxué lǎoshī,
The third was over forty, wore glasses and looked like a university lecturer,
可是好像连一句英语也不会说。
kěshì hǎoxiàng lián yí jù Yīngyǔ yě bú huì shuō.
but he didn't seem able to say a single sentence in English.
接着是个矮胖子，穿着一身西服。
Jiēzhe shì ge ǎi pàngzi, chuān zhe yì shēn xīfú.
Then came a short, plump man in a suit.
他先过来跟经理握了握手，又过去跟秘书打招呼，
Tā xiān guòlai gēn jīnglǐ wò le wò shǒu, yòu guòqu gēn mìshū dǎ zhāohu,
First he came over and shook the manager's hand, then he went over to greet the secretary,
dòngzuò màn de ràng rén zháojí.
moving so slowly it was frustrating to watch.
第五个是个外国人，黄头发，蓝眼睛，又高又瘦，
Dì wǔ ge shì ge wàiguórén, huáng tóufa, lán yǎnjing, yòu gāo yòu shòu,
The fifth was a foreigner, blond and blue-eyed, tall and thin,
穿着一身中式衣服和一双布鞋。
chuān zhe yì shēn zhōngshì yīfu hé yì shuāng bùxié.
wearing Chinese-style clothes and cloth shoes.
他不但普通话句句都说得很地道，而且还懂当地的土话。
Tā búdàn pǔtōnghuà jùjù dōu shuō de hěn dìdao, érqiě hái dǒng dāngdì de tǔhuà.
Every sentence of his Mandarin was authentic, and he understood the local dialect too.
最后是一个打扮得非常时髦的妇女，
Zuìhòu shì yí ge dǎban de fēicháng shímáo de fùnǚ,
Last was a very fashionably dressed woman,
戴着一顶浅黄色的帽子，穿着高跟鞋，
dài zhe yì dǐng qiǎn huángsè de màozi, chuān zhe gāogēnxié,
wearing a pale yellow hat and high heels,
手里还提着一只很讲究的皮包。
shǒu li hái tí zhe yì zhī hěn jiǎngjiu de píbāo.
and carrying a very elegant leather handbag.
不管经理说什么，她都笑一笑。
Bùguǎn jīnglǐ shuō shénme, tā dōu xiào yi xiào.
Whatever the manager said, she just smiled.

grammar: and also … (formal)
并且 links two requirements or qualities. It's more formal than 而且.
需要招收一名会讲外语并且懂计算机的人。
Xūyào zhāoshōu yì míng huì jiǎng wàiyǔ bìngqiě dǒng jìsuànjī de rén.
They needed someone who spoke a foreign language and knew about computers.
他学习很努力，并且成绩很好。
Tā xuéxí hěn nǔlì, bìngqiě chéngjì hěn hǎo.
He studies hard, and his grades are good too.
一 + MW + 一 + MW + 地
one by one
Repeating 一 + measure word describes doing something item by item.
一份一份地给经理看。
Yí fèn yí fèn de gěi jīnglǐ kàn.
She showed them to the manager one by one.
请一个一个地进来。
Qǐng yí ge yí ge de jìnlai.
Please come in one at a time.
both … and …
This links two adjectives that describe the same thing.
黄头发，蓝眼睛，又高又瘦。
Huáng tóufa, lán yǎnjing, yòu gāo yòu shòu.
Blond, blue-eyed, tall and thin.
这家饭馆的菜又便宜又好吃。
Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
The food at this restaurant is cheap and tasty.
MW + MW + 都
every single …
A doubled measure word means “every one”, and 都 goes with it: 句句都, 天天都, 个个都.
他不但普通话句句都说得很地道……
Tā búdàn pǔtōnghuà jùjù dōu shuō de hěn dìdao …
Every sentence of his Mandarin was authentic …
我们班的学生个个都很努力。
Wǒmen bān de xuésheng gègè dōu hěn nǔlì.
Every student in our class works hard.
number + 上下
about …, or so
上下 after a number means roughly, give or take. It's common with ages and weights.
岁数在三十五岁上下。
Suìshu zài sānshíwǔ suì shàngxià.
About thirty-five years old.
这个箱子有二十公斤上下。
Zhège xiāngzi yǒu èrshí gōngjīn shàngxià.
This suitcase weighs about twenty kilos.
Measure words for things you wear
一身、一双、一顶、一只
Each item takes its own measure word: 一身 for a full outfit, 一双 for a pair, 一顶 for a hat and 一只 for a bag.
戴着一顶浅黄色的帽子，穿着高跟鞋。
Dài zhe yì dǐng qiǎn huángsè de màozi, chuān zhe gāogēnxié.
Wearing a pale yellow hat and high heels.
他买了一双新鞋和一顶帽子。
Tā mǎi le yì shuāng xīn xié hé yì dǐng màozi.
He bought a new pair of shoes and a hat.
gaps: 需要招收一名会讲外语
还很有礼貌地给经理行了个
一进门就从里面拿出一大堆
接着是个矮胖子，穿着一身
穿着一身中式衣服和一
say: The person who came in was young and not very tall.
The third was over forty, wore glasses and looked like a university lecturer.
Then came a short, plump man in a suit.
Whatever the manager said, she just smiled.

035.title: The interviews
035.sub: Six short scenes from the interview day, and a question for you
035.transcriptNote: Each scene is one candidate's interview from part 034. Lines are labelled by who speaks, and 旁白 is the narrator. Speakers are assigned from context.

lines: Manager Liu asked the young man,
“Tell me, what are your special skills?”
“我是问你，特别会做什么事情？”
“Wǒ shì wèn nǐ, tèbié huì zuò shénme shìqing?”
“I'm asking what you're especially good at.”
年轻人不回答，站起来开始大声地唱歌。
Niánqīngrén bù huídá, zhàn qilai kāishǐ dàshēng de chàng gē.
Without answering, the young man stood up and started singing loudly.
“好了好了好了，唱得不错，你可以回去了。”
“Hǎo le hǎo le hǎo le, chàng de búcuò, nǐ kěyǐ huíqu le.”
“All right, all right, that's very nice. You can go now.”
blocks.note: The joke is that 特长 can be read as tècháng (special skill) or tè cháng (extra long).

lines: 刘经理看了看姑娘带来的证书：
Liú jīnglǐ kàn le kàn gūniang dàilai de zhèngshū:
Manager Liu looked through the certificates the young woman had brought.
“Nǐ zài jiǎnlì li bú shì dōu xiě le ma?”
“Didn't you put all this in your CV?”
“No, I didn't put it all in.”
“还有，这是我以前在学校的成绩，我可以给您留下。”
“Hái yǒu, zhè shì wǒ yǐqián zài xuéxiào de chéngjì, wǒ kěyǐ gěi nín liúxia.”
“And these are my old school grades. I can leave them with you.”
“这怎么行呢？好了，你回去吧，先学学怎么写简历。”
“Zhè zěnme xíng ne? Hǎo le, nǐ huíqu ba, xiān xuéxue zěnme xiě jiǎnlì.”
“That won't do. Off you go, and learn how to write a CV first.”
“那我明天写好了简历，可以再回来试试吗？”
“Nà wǒ míngtiān xiěhǎo le jiǎnlì, kěyǐ zài huílai shìshi ma?”
“So if I write a proper CV tomorrow, can I come back and try again?”
刘经理等中年人坐下以后，用英文问了他一个问题。
Liú jīnglǐ děng zhōngniánrén zuòxia yǐhòu, yòng Yīngwén wèn le tā yí ge wèntí.
Once the middle-aged man sat down, Manager Liu asked him a question in English.
“咱们都是中国人，最好还是说母语吧。”
“Zánmen dōu shì Zhōngguórén, zuìhǎo háishi shuō mǔyǔ ba.”
“We're both Chinese. We'd better stick to our own language.”

blocks.h: 矮胖子 · the short, plump man
lines: Liú jīnglǐ duì ǎi pàngzi shuō:
Manager Liu said to the short, plump man,
“你不会外语，也不喜欢用电脑，那你来干什么？”
“Nǐ bú huì wàiyǔ, yě bù xǐhuan yòng diànnǎo, nà nǐ lái gàn shénme?”
“You don't speak a foreign language and you don't like computers, so why are you here?”
Ǎi pàngzi xiǎng le hǎo yíhuìr:
He thought for quite a while.
“Nín… nín… xūyào bu xūyào yí ge bǎo'ān?”
“Do… do you need a security guard?”
Manager Liu said to the foreigner,
“你普通话说得很流利，那，你有计算机专业的证书吗？”
“Nǐ pǔtōnghuà shuō de hěn liúlì, nà, nǐ yǒu jìsuànjī zhuānyè de zhèngshū ma?”
“Your Mandarin is very fluent. Do you have a computing qualification?”
“这玩意儿我真的没有。不过我会说英语啊。”
“Zhè wányìr wǒ zhēn de méiyǒu. Búguò wǒ huì shuō Yīngyǔ a.”
“I really don't have one of those. But I can speak English!”
妇女在办公室门外对小周说：
Fùnǚ zài bàngōngshì mén wài duì Xiǎo Zhōu shuō:
Outside the office door, the woman said to Xiao Zhou,
“劳驾，我有急事儿，不能等了，现在就让我进去吧。”
“Láojià, wǒ yǒu jí shìr, bù néng děng le, xiànzài jiù ràng wǒ jìnqu ba.”
“Excuse me, I'm in a hurry and can't wait. Please let me in now.”
“不行，前面的人刚出来，我要等五分钟以后才让您进去。”
“Bù xíng, qiánmiàn de rén gāng chūlai, wǒ yào děng wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu cái ràng nín jìnqu.”
“Sorry, the last person has only just come out. I can't let you in for another five minutes.”

q: 现在你来说说：如果你是刘经理的话，这几个人当中，你会招收哪一个？
Xiànzài nǐ lái shuōshuo: rúguǒ nǐ shì Liú jīnglǐ de huà, zhè jǐ ge rén dāngzhōng, nǐ huì zhāoshōu nǎ yí ge?
Now it's your turn. If you were Manager Liu, which of these people would you hire?
ans: （你自己的答案）
(nǐ zìjǐ de dá'àn)
There's no fixed answer. Say yours in Chinese using 因为……所以…….

grammar: 特长 (two readings)
a pun
特长 means “special skill” (tècháng), but 特 + 长 can also mean “extra long”. The young man answers the wrong one.
你有什么特长？——我头发特长。
Nǐ yǒu shénme tècháng? — Wǒ tóufa tè cháng.
What are your special skills? — My hair is extra long.
我的特长是画画。
Wǒ de tècháng shì huà huà.
My special skill is painting.
这怎么行呢？
how can that be OK?
This rhetorical question means “that won't do” and firmly turns something down.
这怎么行呢？
Zhè zěnme xíng ne?
That won't do.
你不吃饭，这怎么行呢？
Nǐ bù chī fàn, zhè zěnme xíng ne?
You can't just not eat!
最好还是……吧
it'd be best to …
最好 gives advice, and 还是 suggests going back to the safer option.
咱们都是中国人，最好还是说母语吧。
Zánmen dōu shì Zhōngguórén, zuìhǎo háishi shuō mǔyǔ ba.
We're both Chinese. We'd better stick to our own language.
天太晚了，你最好还是坐出租车吧。
Tiān tài wǎn le, nǐ zuìhǎo háishi zuò chūzūchē ba.
It's very late. You'd better take a taxi.
V了好一会儿
for quite a while
好一会儿 stresses that the time felt long.
矮胖子想了好一会儿。
Ǎi pàngzi xiǎng le hǎo yíhuìr.
He thought for quite a while.
我等了好一会儿，他才来。
Wǒ děng le hǎo yíhuìr, tā cái lái.
I waited a good while before he came.
要等……以后才……
not until …
才 after a time limit means the action can't happen before then.
我要等五分钟以后才让您进去。
Wǒ yào děng wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu cái ràng nín jìnqu.
I can't let you in for another five minutes.
你要等考完试以后才能玩。
Nǐ yào děng kǎowán shì yǐhòu cái néng wán.
You can't play until the exam is over.
gaps: 咱们都是中国人，最好还是说

036.title: Vocabulary list
036.transcriptNote: The words in the order they're read. The English introduction isn't transcribed. Single words were matched to how parts 038–039 use them.

lines: even (as in 搅匀, stir well)
blocks.note: Matched to the texts: 丁 (heard as 冰; part 038 has 别切成丁儿), 匀 (heard as 云; part 039 has 搅匀), 烤模 (one model heard 草莓; 039 has 倒进烤模里) and 烤 (heard as 好 or 考).

037.title: Ten 把 sentences
037.sub: Doing things to things: cutting, closing, finding, separating
037.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences, all built with 把. Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 女儿，帮妈妈把做好的菜拿来。
Nǚ'ér, bāng māma bǎ zuòhǎo de cài nálai.
Sweetheart, bring Mum the dishes that are ready.
妈妈，我把大片巧克力切成小块了，还做什么？
Māma, wǒ bǎ dà piàn qiǎokèlì qiēchéng xiǎo kuài le, hái zuò shénme?
Mum, I've cut the big slabs of chocolate into small pieces. What next?
现在是考试的时间，请大家把手机关上。
Xiànzài shì kǎoshì de shíjiān, qǐng dàjiā bǎ shǒujī guānshang.
The exam is starting now. Please switch off your phones.
请你把这个菜的食谱从网上找出来。
Qǐng nǐ bǎ zhège cài de shípǔ cóng wǎngshang zhǎo chulai.
Please find the recipe for this dish online.
你得把化好的巧克力和黄油倒进大碗里。
Nǐ děi bǎ huàhǎo de qiǎokèlì hé huángyóu dàojìn dà wǎn li.
You need to pour the melted chocolate and butter into a big bowl.
打鸡蛋的时候，要把蛋清和蛋黄分开。
Dǎ jīdàn de shíhou, yào bǎ dànqīng hé dànhuáng fēnkāi.
When you crack the eggs, separate the whites from the yolks.
你知道吗？怎么才能把蛋清打成雪的样子？
Nǐ zhīdào ma? Zěnme cái néng bǎ dànqīng dǎchéng xuě de yàngzi?
Do you know how to whisk egg whites until they look like snow?
上课了，同学们把书放在桌子上。
Shàngkè le, tóngxuémen bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
Class is starting. Everyone, put your books on the desk.
安达把两个外地人一直带到大街上。
Āndá bǎ liǎng ge wàidìrén yìzhí dàidào dàjiē shang.
Anda took the two out-of-towners all the way to the main street.
妈妈把好吃的分给孩子们。
Māma bǎ hǎochī de fēn gěi háizimen.
Mum shared the treats out among the children.

grammar: 把 + object + V + result
to do something to something
把 moves the object in front of the verb. The verb must then show a result or a change, for example 拿来, 关上 or 分开.
请大家把手机关上。
Qǐng dàjiā bǎ shǒujī guānshang.
Please switch off your phones.
请把门关上。
Qǐng bǎ mén guānshang.
Please close the door.
把 A + V成 + B
to turn A into B
成 shows what the object becomes: 切成小块 (cut into pieces), 打成雪的样子 (beat until snowy) and 翻译成中文 (translate into Chinese).
我把大片巧克力切成小块了。
Wǒ bǎ dà piàn qiǎokèlì qiēchéng xiǎo kuài le.
I've cut the big slabs of chocolate into small pieces.
请把这个句子翻译成英文。
Qǐng bǎ zhège jùzi fānyì chéng Yīngwén.
Please translate this sentence into English.
把 + object + V在/进 + place
to put something somewhere
在 or 进 + place says where the object ends up.
同学们把书放在桌子上。
Tóngxuémen bǎ shū fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
Everyone, put your books on the desk.
把牛奶放进冰箱里。
Bǎ niúnǎi fàngjìn bīngxiāng li.
Put the milk in the fridge.
把 + object + V给 + person
to give or pass something to someone
给 + person after the verb names who receives the object.
妈妈把好吃的分给孩子们。
Māma bǎ hǎochī de fēn gěi háizimen.
Mum shared the treats out among the children.
请把盐递给我。
Qǐng bǎ yán dì gěi wǒ.
Please pass me the salt.
把 + object + V到 + place
to take something as far as …
到 + place says how far the object or person is moved.
安达把两个外地人一直带到大街上。
Āndá bǎ liǎng ge wàidìrén yìzhí dàidào dàjiē shang.
Anda took the two out-of-towners all the way to the main street.
我把他送到了机场。
Wǒ bǎ tā sòngdào le jīchǎng.
I took him to the airport.
gaps: 我把大片巧克力切成小
你得把化好的巧克力和黄油
say: The exam is starting now. Please switch off your phones.
Please find the recipe for this dish online.

038.title: Fifteen multiple-choice items
038.sub: 把 sentences in the kitchen, at school and at home
038.transcriptNote: Each item has a sentence or short exchange, a question and four options. The answer key is my own reading. In the dialogues, 男 and 女 come from voice pitch.

lines: 你帮我把土豆切成丝儿，别切成丁儿，再把肉切成片儿。
Nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ tǔdòu qiēchéng sīr, bié qiēchéng dīngr, zài bǎ ròu qiēchéng piànr.
Cut the potatoes into thin strips for me, not cubes, and then slice the meat.

q: 应该把土豆切成什么样子？
Yīnggāi bǎ tǔdòu qiēchéng shénme yàngzi?
How should the potatoes be cut?

blocks.note: Options B and D were too short for the first pass, so I re-transcribed them separately.

lines: 小丁，请你把菜刀和那瓶油拿给我，我马上要做饭了。
Xiǎo Dīng, qǐng nǐ bǎ càidāo hé nà píng yóu ná gěi wǒ, wǒ mǎshàng yào zuò fàn le.
Xiao Ding, pass me the knife and that bottle of oil. I'm about to start cooking.

q: 这可能是在哪儿说的话？
Zhè kěnéng shì zài nǎr shuō de huà?
Where is this probably said?

lines: 大卫，老师让我告诉你和雅克，明天把作业交给他。
Dàwèi, lǎoshī ràng wǒ gàosu nǐ hé Yǎkè, míngtiān bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi tā.
David, the teacher asked me to tell you and Jacques to hand in your homework tomorrow.

q: 谁明天应该把作业交给老师？
Shéi míngtiān yīnggāi bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī?
Who has to hand in homework tomorrow?

lines: 我要把这封信翻译成中文，你把那本法汉词典借给我用一下好吗？
Wǒ yào bǎ zhè fēng xìn fānyì chéng Zhōngwén, nǐ bǎ nà běn Fǎ-Hàn cídiǎn jiè gěi wǒ yòng yíxià hǎo ma?
I need to translate this letter into Chinese. Could you lend me that French–Chinese dictionary?

q: 这封信原来是用哪种文字写的？
Zhè fēng xìn yuánlái shì yòng nǎ zhǒng wénzì xiě de?
What language was the letter originally written in?

lines: 我还以为怎么了呢，不就是把盐当成白糖了吗？
Wǒ hái yǐwéi zěnme le ne, bú jiù shì bǎ yán dàngchéng báitáng le ma?
I thought something serious had happened. You only mistook the salt for sugar!

q: 这句话是什么意思？
Zhè jù huà shì shénme yìsi?
What does this mean?
o: 把盐当成白糖了，问题很大。
Bǎ yán dàngchéng báitáng le, wèntí hěn dà.
Mistaking salt for sugar is a big problem.
把盐当成白糖了，没什么问题。
Bǎ yán dàngchéng báitáng le, méi shénme wèntí.
Mistaking salt for sugar is no big deal.
把盐当成白糖了，有什么问题？
Bǎ yán dàngchéng báitáng le, yǒu shénme wèntí?
What's wrong with mistaking salt for sugar?
把盐当成白糖了，会不会有问题？
Bǎ yán dàngchéng báitáng le, huì bu huì yǒu wèntí?
Will mistaking salt for sugar cause problems?

lines: 马上就要去见那个人了，可是我不太了解他，你快给我介绍介绍吧。
Mǎshàng jiù yào qù jiàn nàge rén le, kěshì wǒ bú tài liǎojiě tā, nǐ kuài gěi wǒ jièshào jièshào ba.
I'm about to go and meet that person, but I hardly know anything about him. Quick, tell me about him.

q: 我们从这句话可以知道什么？
Wǒmen cóng zhè jù huà kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: The speaker doesn't know the person.
听话人跟那个人比较熟悉。
Tīnghuàrén gēn nàge rén bǐjiào shúxī.
The listener knows the person fairly well.
Tīnghuàrén gēn nàge rén bù shú.
The listener doesn't know the person.

blocks.note: B is tempting, but 不太了解 means “not know much about”, not “not know at all”. The speaker asks the listener because the listener knows the person, which makes C the safer answer.

lines: 真对不起，我忘了把你的酒杯拿来了。
Zhēn duìbuqǐ, wǒ wàng le bǎ nǐ de jiǔbēi nálai le.
I'm so sorry, I forgot to bring your glass.
没关系，我这里还有一个。
Méi guānxi, wǒ zhèlǐ hái yǒu yí ge.
No problem, I've got another one here.

q: 从这段话里我们知道什么？
Cóng zhè duàn huà li wǒmen zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: The man took the wrong glass.
Nán de yǒu liǎng ge jiǔbēi.
女的要男的帮忙拿酒杯。
Nǚ de yào nán de bāngmáng ná jiǔbēi.
The woman wants the man to fetch a glass.
The woman took the wrong glass.

lines: 早就告诉你天热的时候不要把苹果和葡萄放在一起，现在你看吧，都坏了。
Zǎo jiù gàosu nǐ tiān rè de shíhou bú yào bǎ píngguǒ hé pútao fàng zài yìqǐ, xiànzài nǐ kàn ba, dōu huài le.
I told you not to keep the apples and grapes together in hot weather. Look, they've all gone bad.
我也没想到这几天这么热。
Wǒ yě méi xiǎngdào zhè jǐ tiān zhème rè.
I didn't expect it to be this hot either.

q: 男的是什么意思？
Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
What does the man mean?
o: 他没有把两种水果放在一起。
Tā méiyǒu bǎ liǎng zhǒng shuǐguǒ fàng zài yìqǐ.
He didn't keep the two fruits together.
他就是想把水果放坏了。
Tā jiù shì xiǎng bǎ shuǐguǒ fàng huài le.
He wanted the fruit to go bad.
他没听说过两种水果不能放在一起。
Tā méi tīngshuō guo liǎng zhǒng shuǐguǒ bù néng fàng zài yìqǐ.
He'd never heard that you can't keep them together.
Tā bù zhīdào tiānqì huì hěn rè.
He didn't know it would be so hot.

lines: 马上就要上班了，可你现在还没有吃早饭，怎么办呢？
Mǎshàng jiù yào shàngbān le, kě nǐ xiànzài hái méiyǒu chī zǎofàn, zěnme bàn ne?
It's nearly time for work and you haven't had breakfast. What are we going to do?
应该早点儿把早饭做好，可我怎么叫都没办法把你叫醒。
Yīnggāi zǎo diǎnr bǎ zǎofàn zuòhǎo, kě wǒ zěnme jiào dōu méi bànfǎ bǎ nǐ jiàoxǐng.
Breakfast should've been ready earlier, but no matter how much I called, I couldn't wake you.

q: 女的没有把早饭做好是因为什么？
Nǚ de méiyǒu bǎ zǎofàn zuòhǎo shì yīnwèi shénme?
Why didn't the woman get breakfast ready?
o: She didn't want to make breakfast.

blocks.note: By pitch, the woman speaks the first line and the man the second. The man couldn't wake her, so she overslept.

lines: 等以后你有了孩子，把他送到我们学校来上学吧。
Děng yǐhòu nǐ yǒu le háizi, bǎ tā sòngdào wǒmen xuéxiào lái shàngxué ba.
When you have children one day, send them to our school.
那当然，可是孩子他妈妈现在还不知道在哪儿呢。
Nà dāngrán, kěshì háizi tā māma xiànzài hái bù zhīdào zài nǎr ne.
Of course. But I don't even know where the children's mother is yet!

q: 男的说的话是什么意思？
Nán de shuō de huà shì shénme yìsi?
What does the man mean?
o: Tā bú tài shúxī zhège xuéxiào.
He doesn't know the school well.
He needs to ask his wife.
Tā yǐhòu bù yídìng yǒu háizi.

lines: 能不能把你的作业借给我看看？
Néng bu néng bǎ nǐ de zuòyè jiè gěi wǒ kànkan?
Can I have a look at your homework?
Lǎoshī zhīdào le huì shēngqì de.
The teacher will be angry if she finds out.

q: 他们可能是什么关系？
Tāmen kěnéng shì shénme guānxi?
What's their relationship?

lines: 我把妈妈的花瓶打了，我怕妈妈说我。
Wǒ bǎ māma de huāpíng dǎ le, wǒ pà māma shuō wǒ.
I broke Mum's vase, and I'm scared she'll tell me off.

q: 丽丽为什么怕妈妈说她？
Lìli wèishénme pà māma shuō tā?
Why is Lili afraid Mum will tell her off?
o: Yīnwèi tā zuò le yí jiàn hǎoshì.
Yīnwèi tā zuò le yí jiàn cuòshì.
妈妈常常说她，她不喜欢听。
Māma chángcháng shuō tā, tā bù xǐhuan tīng.
Mum often tells her off, and she doesn't like it.
妈妈把花瓶打了，很生气。
Māma bǎ huāpíng dǎ le, hěn shēngqì.
Mum broke the vase and is angry.

lines: 我很喜欢安娜，想跟她交朋友，可是她不知道，怎么办呢？
Wǒ hěn xǐhuan Ānnà, xiǎng gēn tā jiāo péngyou, kěshì tā bù zhīdào, zěnme bàn ne?
I really like Anna and want to go out with her, but she doesn't know. What should I do?
那你得把你的想法告诉她呀，你不说，她怎么知道呢？
Nà nǐ děi bǎ nǐ de xiǎngfǎ gàosu tā ya, nǐ bù shuō, tā zěnme zhīdào ne?
Then you have to tell her how you feel. If you don't say anything, how will she know?

q: 女的是什么意思？
Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
What does the woman mean?
o: 你想跟安娜交朋友，不应该让安娜知道。
Nǐ xiǎng gēn Ānnà jiāo péngyou, bù yīnggāi ràng Ānnà zhīdào.
Don't let Anna know you like her.
跟安娜说不说你的想法都没关系。
Gēn Ānnà shuō bu shuō nǐ de xiǎngfǎ dōu méi guānxi.
It doesn't matter whether you tell her.
应该把自己的想法告诉安娜。
Yīnggāi bǎ zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ gàosu Ānnà.
You should tell Anna how you feel.
安娜应该把她的意思告诉你。
Ānnà yīnggāi bǎ tā de yìsi gàosu nǐ.
Anna should tell you what she thinks.

lines: 妈妈，我把巧克力切成小块了，然后怎么做？
Māma, wǒ bǎ qiǎokèlì qiēchéng xiǎo kuài le, ránhòu zěnme zuò?
Mum, I've cut the chocolate into small pieces. What do I do next?
你把巧克力块和黄油一起放在锅里，加热化开。
Nǐ bǎ qiǎokèlì kuài hé huángyóu yìqǐ fàng zài guō li, jiārè huàkāi.
Put the chocolate and butter in a pan together and heat until melted.

q: 把巧克力放在锅里以前，应该先怎么做？
Bǎ qiǎokèlì fàng zài guō li yǐqián, yīnggāi xiān zěnme zuò?
What should you do before putting the chocolate in the pan?
o: 先把巧克力和黄油放在一起。
Xiān bǎ qiǎokèlì hé huángyóu fàng zài yìqǐ.
Put the chocolate and butter together.
先把巧克力切成小块儿。
Xiān bǎ qiǎokèlì qiēchéng xiǎo kuàir.
Cut the chocolate into small pieces.

lines: 我想知道怎么才能把蛋清打成雪的样子，用筷子还是用叉子？
Wǒ xiǎng zhīdào zěnme cái néng bǎ dànqīng dǎchéng xuě de yàngzi, yòng kuàizi háishi yòng chāzi?
How do I whisk egg whites until they look like snow? With chopsticks or a fork?
这太容易了，你买一个打蛋机就可以了。
Zhè tài róngyì le, nǐ mǎi yí ge dǎdànjī jiù kěyǐ le.
That's easy. Just buy an electric whisk.

q: 想把蛋清很快打成雪的样子，应该怎么办？
Xiǎng bǎ dànqīng hěn kuài dǎchéng xuě de yàngzi, yīnggāi zěnme bàn?
How do you whisk egg whites to snow quickly?

vocab: to mistake for, to treat as
grammar: 把 A 当成 B
to take A for B
当成 means treating or mistaking one thing as another.
不就是把盐当成白糖了吗？
Bú jiù shì bǎ yán dàngchéng báitáng le ma?
You only mistook the salt for sugar!
他把我当成他哥哥了。
Tā bǎ wǒ dàngchéng tā gēge le.
He mistook me for his brother.
不就是……吗？
isn't it just …?
This rhetorical question plays something down: “it's only …”.
不就是把盐当成白糖了吗？
Bú jiù shì bǎ yán dàngchéng báitáng le ma?
You only mistook the salt for sugar!
不就是一次考试吗？别担心。
Bú jiù shì yí cì kǎoshì ma? Bié dānxīn.
It's just one exam. Don't worry.
把 + object + V + 给 + person
to hand or lend something to someone
交给 means hand in to, 借给 means lend to, and 拿给 means pass to.
明天把作业交给他。
Míngtiān bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi tā.
Hand your homework in to him tomorrow.
你把书借给我好吗？
Nǐ bǎ shū jiè gěi wǒ hǎo ma?
Could you lend me the book?
怎么 V 都 + 没/不……
no matter how …
怎么 + V + 都 means however much you try, the result doesn't change.
可我怎么叫都没办法把你叫醒。
Kě wǒ zěnme jiào dōu méi bànfǎ bǎ nǐ jiàoxǐng.
However much I called, I couldn't wake you.
这个字我怎么写都写不好。
Zhège zì wǒ zěnme xiě dōu xiě bu hǎo.
However I write this character, it never looks right.
……，……怎么知道呢？
how would … know?
A rhetorical question that means “they can't possibly know”.
你不说，她怎么知道呢？
Nǐ bù shuō, tā zěnme zhīdào ne?
If you don't say anything, how will she know?
你不问，怎么知道答案呢？
Nǐ bú wèn, zěnme zhīdào dá'àn ne?
If you don't ask, how will you find out?
say: Cut the potatoes into thin strips for me, not cubes.
I need to translate this letter into Chinese.
I broke Mum's vase, and I'm scared she'll tell me off.
That's easy. Just buy an electric whisk.

039.title: Making a chocolate cake
039.sub: A recipe told step by step, with five questions
039.transcriptNote: One speaker gives the recipe, then five questions follow. The answers are my own wording. The recording seems to run two questions together under number 3, so I've kept them together.

lines: dàngāo jiù yǒu hěn duō zhǒng,
and there are lots of kinds of cake:
什么奶油蛋糕、巧克力蛋糕，各种各样，都很好吃。
shénme nǎiyóu dàngāo, qiǎokèlì dàngāo, gè zhǒng gè yàng, dōu hěn hǎochī.
cream cakes, chocolate cakes, all sorts, and they're all delicious.
Dàngāo hǎochī, zuòfǎ yě bù nán.
Cake tastes great, and it isn't hard to make.
Xiān bǎ qiǎokèlì qiēchéng xiǎo kuài,
First cut the chocolate into small pieces,
再把巧克力和黄油一起放在锅里，加热化开。
zài bǎ qiǎokèlì hé huángyóu yìqǐ fàng zài guō li, jiārè huàkāi.
then put the chocolate and butter in a pan and heat until melted.
打几个鲜鸡蛋，注意，要把蛋清和蛋黄分开。
Dǎ jǐ ge xiān jīdàn, zhùyì, yào bǎ dànqīng hé dànhuáng fēnkāi.
Crack a few fresh eggs, and be careful to separate the whites from the yolks.
把白糖加在蛋黄里搅匀，
Bǎ báitáng jiā zài dànhuáng li jiǎoyún,
Add sugar to the yolks and mix well,
然后把化开了的巧克力和黄油也加进去，
ránhòu bǎ huàkāi le de qiǎokèlì hé huángyóu yě jiā jinqu,
then add the melted chocolate and butter,
再慢慢地加一点儿面粉，一起搅匀。
zài mànmàn de jiā yìdiǎnr miànfěn, yìqǐ jiǎoyún.
and slowly add a little flour, mixing it all together.
最难的是得把蛋清打成雪的样子，
Zuì nán de shì děi bǎ dànqīng dǎchéng xuě de yàngzi,
The hardest part is whisking the egg whites until they look like snow,
要是有打蛋机的话，也就不难了。
yàoshi yǒu dǎdànjī de huà, yě jiù bù nán le.
but if you have an electric whisk, it's easy.
最后，把准备好的这些东西都放在一起，慢慢地搅匀，
Zuìhòu, bǎ zhǔnbèi hǎo de zhèxiē dōngxi dōu fàng zài yìqǐ, mànmàn de jiǎoyún,
Finally, put everything together and slowly mix it well,
pour it into a cake tin,
然后把它们放进烤箱里烤半个小时就成了。
ránhòu bǎ tāmen fàngjìn kǎoxiāng li kǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí jiù chéng le.
then bake it in the oven for half an hour, and it's done.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 做蛋糕需要准备什么东西？
Zuò dàngāo xūyào zhǔnbèi shénme dōngxi?
What do you need to make the cake?
ans: 巧克力、黄油、鸡蛋、白糖和面粉。
Qiǎokèlì, huángyóu, jīdàn, báitáng hé miànfěn.
Chocolate, butter, eggs, sugar and flour.

q: 做巧克力蛋糕的时候，应该先把巧克力怎么样？
Zuò qiǎokèlì dàngāo de shíhou, yīnggāi xiān bǎ qiǎokèlì zěnmeyàng?
What do you do with the chocolate first?
ans: 先把巧克力切成小块。
Xiān bǎ qiǎokèlì qiēchéng xiǎo kuài.
Cut it into small pieces.

q: 鸡蛋应该怎么准备？蛋清和蛋黄要放在一起吗？
Jīdàn yīnggāi zěnme zhǔnbèi? Dànqīng hé dànhuáng yào fàng zài yìqǐ ma?
How should the eggs be prepared? Do the whites and yolks go together?
ans: 不要放在一起，要把蛋清和蛋黄分开。
Bú yào fàng zài yìqǐ, yào bǎ dànqīng hé dànhuáng fēnkāi.
No, separate the whites from the yolks.

q: 蛋清和蛋黄应该怎么准备？
Dànqīng hé dànhuáng yīnggāi zěnme zhǔnbèi?
How are the whites and yolks prepared?
ans: 把白糖加在蛋黄里搅匀，把蛋清打成雪的样子。
Bǎ báitáng jiā zài dànhuáng li jiǎoyún, bǎ dànqīng dǎchéng xuě de yàngzi.
Mix sugar into the yolks, and whisk the whites until snowy.

q: 做蛋糕的最后一个工作是什么？
Zuò dàngāo de zuìhòu yí ge gōngzuò shì shénme?
What's the last step?
ans: 把它们放进烤箱里烤半个小时。
Bǎ tāmen fàngjìn kǎoxiāng li kǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí.
Bake it in the oven for half an hour.

grammar: 什么 A、B，……
such as A and B
什么 before a list gives examples, a bit like “you know, A, B …”.
什么奶油蛋糕、巧克力蛋糕，各种各样。
Shénme nǎiyóu dàngāo, qiǎokèlì dàngāo, gè zhǒng gè yàng.
Cream cakes, chocolate cakes, all sorts.
什么苹果、香蕉，他都喜欢吃。
Shénme píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo, tā dōu xǐhuan chī.
Apples, bananas, he likes them all.
first …, then …, next …, finally …
These words put recipe steps in order.
先把巧克力切成小块，再把巧克力和黄油一起放在锅里。
Xiān bǎ qiǎokèlì qiēchéng xiǎo kuài, zài bǎ qiǎokèlì hé huángyóu yìqǐ fàng zài guō li.
First cut the chocolate, then put it in a pan with the butter.
先洗手，再吃饭。
Xiān xǐ shǒu, zài chī fàn.
Wash your hands first, then eat.
把 + object + V进去
to add in
进去 shows the object going into something already there.
然后把化开了的巧克力和黄油也加进去。
Ránhòu bǎ huàkāi le de qiǎokèlì hé huángyóu yě jiā jinqu.
Then add the melted chocolate and butter.
把这些菜都放进去。
Bǎ zhèxiē cài dōu fàng jinqu.
Put all these vegetables in.
最……的是……
the most … thing is …
This highlights the key point.
最难的是得把蛋清打成雪的样子。
Zuì nán de shì děi bǎ dànqīng dǎchéng xuě de yàngzi.
The hardest part is whisking the egg whites.
最重要的是多练习。
Zuì zhòngyào de shì duō liànxí.
The most important thing is to practise a lot.
……就成了
and that's it
成 means “done”. It's a casual ending for instructions.
放进烤箱里烤半个小时就成了。
Fàngjìn kǎoxiāng li kǎo bàn ge xiǎoshí jiù chéng le.
Bake for half an hour, and it's done.
你签个字就成了。
Nǐ qiān ge zì jiù chéng le.
Just sign here and you're done.
gaps: 再把巧克力和黄油一起放在锅里，加热
say: First cut the chocolate into small pieces.
Crack a few fresh eggs, and be careful to separate the whites from the yolks.
The hardest part is whisking the egg whites until they look like snow.
Then bake it in the oven for half an hour, and it's done.

040.zh: 我把你当成学英语的了
040.title: “I thought you studied English”
040.sub: A favour that can't be done, with three questions
040.transcriptNote: 甲 is Zhang Wen and 乙 is Li Yun. The answers are my own wording.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: Lǐ Yún, wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng ge máng.
Li Yun, can I ask you a favour?
Zhāng Wén, shénme shìr, nǐ shuō ba.
Sure, Zhang Wen. What is it?
请你帮我把这封信翻译成英文，好吗？
Qǐng nǐ bāng wǒ bǎ zhè fēng xìn fānyì chéng Yīngwén, hǎo ma?
Could you translate this letter into English for me?
我的英文不怎么样，怎么能帮你翻译呀？
Wǒ de Yīngwén bù zěnmeyàng, zěnme néng bāng nǐ fānyì ya?
My English isn't great. How could I translate it for you?
Nǐ bú shì xué Yīngyǔ de ma?
Nǎr a, wǒ shì xué Fǎyǔ de.
真的吗？我把你当成学英语的了。
Zhēn de ma? Wǒ bǎ nǐ dàngchéng xué Yīngyǔ de le.
Really? I thought you were an English student.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 张文请李云做什么？为什么？
Zhāng Wén qǐng Lǐ Yún zuò shénme? Wèishénme?
What does Zhang Wen ask Li Yun to do, and why?
ans: 请她把一封信翻译成英文，因为她以为李云是学英语的。
Qǐng tā bǎ yì fēng xìn fānyì chéng Yīngwén, yīnwèi tā yǐwéi Lǐ Yún shì xué Yīngyǔ de.
To translate a letter into English, because she thought Li Yun studied English.

q: 李云能帮张文吗？为什么？
Lǐ Yún néng bāng Zhāng Wén ma? Wèishénme?
Can Li Yun help? Why or why not?
ans: 不能，因为她是学法语的，英文不怎么样。
Bù néng, yīnwèi tā shì xué Fǎyǔ de, Yīngwén bù zěnmeyàng.
No, because she studies French and her English isn't good.

q: 什么人可以帮张文的忙？
Shénme rén kěyǐ bāng Zhāng Wén de máng?
Who could help Zhang Wen?
ans: 学英语的人，或者英文很好的人。
Xué Yīngyǔ de rén, huòzhě Yīngwén hěn hǎo de rén.
Someone who studies English or whose English is good.

vocab: to help, to do a favour
to take for, to mistake for
grammar: 请 + person + 帮个忙
to ask someone a favour
个 makes it sound casual: 帮个忙 means “do a little favour”.
我想请你帮个忙。
Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng ge máng.
Can I ask you a favour?
你能帮我个忙吗？
Nǐ néng bāng wǒ ge máng ma?
Could you do me a favour?
不怎么样
not that good
This is a modest or critical way to say something is mediocre.
我的英文不怎么样。
Wǒ de Yīngwén bù zěnmeyàng.
My English isn't great.
这家饭馆的菜不怎么样。
Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài bù zěnmeyàng.
The food here isn't up to much.
哪儿啊
no, not at all
A casual way to deny something. It doesn't ask about a place.
哪儿啊，我是学法语的。
Nǎr a, wǒ shì xué Fǎyǔ de.
No way, I study French.
你是老师吗？——哪儿啊，我是学生。
Nǐ shì lǎoshī ma? — Nǎr a, wǒ shì xuésheng.
Are you a teacher? — No, I'm a student.
是学……的
to study … (as one's subject)
学 + subject + 的 means “a … student”, and 是……的 identifies the person by it.
我是学法语的。
Wǒ shì xué Fǎyǔ de.
I study French.
他是学医的。
Tā shì xué yī de.
He studies medicine.
say: Li Yun, can I ask you a favour?
My English isn't great. How could I translate it for you?
No way, I study French.
Really? I thought you were an English student.

041.title: Stir-fried shredded potato
041.sub: A friend explains a simple Chinese dish
041.transcriptNote: 甲 asks and 乙 explains. Speakers are assigned from context.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 有一个中国菜叫炒土豆丝，你会做吗？
Yǒu yí ge Zhōngguó cài jiào chǎo tǔdòusī, nǐ huì zuò ma?
There's a Chinese dish called stir-fried shredded potato. Can you make it?
当然会，这个菜太好做了。
Dāngrán huì, zhège cài tài hǎo zuò le.
Of course. It's really easy to make.
那你教我做吧，要准备什么？
Nà nǐ jiāo wǒ zuò ba, yào zhǔnbèi shénme?
Then teach me. What do I need to do first?
先把土豆洗干净，再把土豆切成丝儿。
Xiān bǎ tǔdòu xǐ gānjìng, zài bǎ tǔdòu qiēchéng sīr.
First wash the potatoes, then cut them into thin strips.
再把土豆丝用水洗一下，这样炒出来比较好吃。
Zài bǎ tǔdòusī yòng shuǐ xǐ yíxià, zhèyàng chǎo chulai bǐjiào hǎochī.
Rinse the strips in water. That way they taste better when fried.
Ránhòu jiù gāi chǎo le ba?
Then it's time to fry them, right?
先在锅里放一点儿油，等油热了以后，再把土豆丝放进去，
Xiān zài guō li fàng yìdiǎnr yóu, děng yóu rè le yǐhòu, zài bǎ tǔdòusī fàng jinqu,
Put a little oil in the wok first. When it's hot, add the potato strips,
再放一点儿醋，然后炒几分钟，最后加些盐就可以吃了。
zài fàng yìdiǎnr cù, ránhòu chǎo jǐ fēnzhōng, zuìhòu jiā xiē yán jiù kěyǐ chī le.
then a little vinegar. Stir-fry for a few minutes, add some salt, and it's ready.
听起来还挺简单的，不知道我能不能做好。
Tīng qilai hái tǐng jiǎndān de, bù zhīdào wǒ néng bu néng zuòhǎo.
Sounds pretty simple. I wonder if I can make it properly.
Huí jiā yǐhòu wǒ jiù shìshi.
I'll try it when I get home.

grammar: 太好 + V 了
really easy to …
好 + verb means “easy to …”: 好做 (easy to make), 好找 (easy to find).
这个菜太好做了。
Zhège cài tài hǎo zuò le.
It's really easy to make.
这个字很好写。
Zhège zì hěn hǎo xiě.
This character is easy to write.
把 + object + V干净
to … clean
干净 after the verb gives the result: 洗干净, 擦干净.
先把土豆洗干净。
Xiān bǎ tǔdòu xǐ gānjìng.
First wash the potatoes.
把桌子擦干净。
Bǎ zhuōzi cā gānjìng.
Wipe the table clean.
V出来
when it comes out (result)
出来 after a verb shows how the result turns out.
这样炒出来比较好吃。
Zhèyàng chǎo chulai bǐjiào hǎochī.
That way they taste better when fried.
这张照片拍出来很漂亮。
Zhè zhāng zhàopiàn pāi chulai hěn piàoliang.
This photo came out beautifully.
等……以后，再……
once …, then …
Wait for one thing to finish, then do the next.
等油热了以后，再把土豆丝放进去。
Děng yóu rè le yǐhòu, zài bǎ tǔdòusī fàng jinqu.
When the oil is hot, add the potato strips.
等雨停了以后，我们再走。
Děng yǔ tíng le yǐhòu, wǒmen zài zǒu.
We'll go once the rain stops.
听起来挺……的
sounds quite …
V起来 gives an impression: 听起来 (sounds), 看起来 (looks).
听起来还挺简单的。
Tīng qilai hái tǐng jiǎndān de.
Sounds pretty simple.
这个菜看起来挺好吃的。
Zhège cài kàn qilai tǐng hǎochī de.
This dish looks delicious.
say: Can you make it?
Then teach me. What do I need to do first?
First wash the potatoes, then cut them into thin strips.
Sounds pretty simple. I wonder if I can make it properly.

042.title: Vocabulary list

lines: to get to work, to start doing
blocks.note: Matched to part 043: 搅 (heard as 角), 加 (heard as 家), 尝 (heard as 糖 or 长), 勺 (heard as 找) and 叉子 (heard as 哈子). Less certain: 闻 (heard as 文) and 饱 (heard as 高). 饱 fits because part 043 has a group for it, but play it and check. 明白 is read twice, once as a verb and once as an adjective.

043.title: How the new words are used
043.transcriptNote: Each group takes one word from the vocabulary in part 042 and uses it in short phrases. Some group numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: sour, sweet, bitter and spicy; all of life's flavours

blocks.h: 分 fēn · to divide, to share
lines: to split the household with him
to not tell good from bad

blocks.h: 倒 dào · to pour; upside down, backwards
lines: to pour a glass of water
to pour a cup of tea
with hands clasped behind the back
yí jiàn bù yúkuài de shì
you've come at just the right time
bú yào chī de tài bǎo
had a taste of this dish
suān tián kǔ là dōu cháng guo
to have tasted all of life's flavours
