044.title: The story of the cake
044.sub: The lesson text, part 1: Zhao Jing tries baking
044.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. It continues in part 045. 他 and 她 sound the same, and I used 她 for Zhao Jing.

lines: 赵静是中国留学生，到里昂来学习法律有半年多了。
Zhào Jìng shì Zhōngguó liúxuéshēng, dào Lǐ'áng lái xuéxí fǎlǜ yǒu bàn nián duō le.
Zhao Jing is a Chinese student. She came to Lyon to study law over six months ago.
要是有人问她是不是已经习惯了学生食堂的饭菜，
Yàoshi yǒu rén wèn tā shì bu shì yǐjīng xíguàn le xuésheng shítáng de fàncài,
If anyone asks whether she's got used to the food in the student canteen,
她就会回答说，她最不喜欢奶酪的味道，但是最爱吃的是法式甜点。
tā jiù huì huídá shuō, tā zuì bù xǐhuan nǎilào de wèidao, dànshì zuì ài chī de shì fǎshì tiándiǎn.
she'll say that what she dislikes most is the taste of cheese, but what she loves most is French desserts.
她现在想，中国人没有吃甜点的习惯，实在是太遗憾了。
Tā xiànzài xiǎng, Zhōngguórén méiyǒu chī tiándiǎn de xíguàn, shízài shì tài yíhàn le.
She now thinks it's a real pity that Chinese people don't have a habit of eating desserts.
这天晚上，她约了几个同学到她这儿来给马新平过生日。
Zhè tiān wǎnshang, tā yuē le jǐ ge tóngxué dào tā zhèr lái gěi Mǎ Xīnpíng guò shēngrì.
That evening she'd invited a few classmates over to celebrate Ma Xinping's birthday.
大家事先说好了，每个人带一个菜来。
Dàjiā shìxiān shuōhǎo le, měi ge rén dài yí ge cài lái.
They'd agreed beforehand that everyone would bring a dish.
赵静决定自己动手做一个巧克力蛋糕。
Zhào Jìng juédìng zìjǐ dòngshǒu zuò yí ge qiǎokèlì dàngāo.
Zhao Jing decided to make a chocolate cake herself.
她在美食网上找到了一个看来比较简单的食谱。
Tā zài měishí wǎng shang zhǎodào le yí ge kànlái bǐjiào jiǎndān de shípǔ.
She found a recipe on a food website that looked fairly simple.
她先把一大片巧克力切成小块儿，
Tā xiān bǎ yí dà piàn qiǎokèlì qiēchéng xiǎo kuàir,
First she cut a big bar of chocolate into small pieces
和一百五十克黄油一起放进一个小锅里，用小火化开，
hé yìbǎi wǔshí kè huángyóu yìqǐ fàngjìn yí ge xiǎo guō li, yòng xiǎo huǒ huàkāi,
and put them in a small pan with 150 grams of butter to melt over a low heat.
又打了四个鲜鸡蛋，并小心地把蛋黄和蛋清分开，放在两个大碗里。
Yòu dǎ le sì ge xiān jīdàn, bìng xiǎoxīn de bǎ dànhuáng hé dànqīng fēnkāi, fàng zài liǎng ge dà wǎn li.
Then she cracked four fresh eggs and carefully separated the yolks and whites into two big bowls.
接着，她把五大勺白糖放在蛋黄里一起搅，
Jiēzhe, tā bǎ wǔ dà sháo báitáng fàng zài dànhuáng li yìqǐ jiǎo,
Next she stirred five big spoonfuls of sugar into the yolks,
再把小锅里化好的巧克力和黄油也倒进碗里，
zài bǎ xiǎo guō li huàhǎo de qiǎokèlì hé huángyóu yě dàojìn wǎn li,
poured in the melted chocolate and butter from the pan,
一边搅一边慢慢地加进一勺面粉。
yìbiān jiǎo yìbiān mànmàn de jiājìn yì sháo miànfěn.
and slowly added a spoonful of flour as she stirred.
最后，按照食谱上的说法，要把蛋清打得像雪一样。
Zuìhòu, ànzhào shípǔ shang de shuōfǎ, yào bǎ dànqīng dǎ de xiàng xuě yíyàng.
Finally, the recipe said to whisk the egg whites until they were like snow.
可是用什么打呢？那上边一个字也没提。
Kěshì yòng shénme dǎ ne? Nà shàngbian yí ge zì yě méi tí.
But whisk them with what? The recipe didn't say a word about it.
赵静先用筷子打，然后又换成叉子继续打，
Zhào Jìng xiān yòng kuàizi dǎ, ránhòu yòu huànchéng chāzi jìxù dǎ,
Zhao Jing tried chopsticks first, then switched to a fork,
把胳膊打得酸疼，蛋清还是没有变成雪的样子。
bǎ gēbo dǎ de suānténg, dànqīng háishi méiyǒu biànchéng xuě de yàngzi.
and whisked until her arm ached, but the whites still didn't turn snowy.
心里想：不知道是法国甜点太复杂，还是自己太笨了。
xīnli xiǎng: bù zhīdào shì Fǎguó tiándiǎn tài fùzá, háishi zìjǐ tài bèn le.
and thought, “I don't know if French desserts are too complicated or I'm just too clumsy.”

grammar: 来……有 + time + 了
has been … for (time)
有 + duration + 了 says how long something has been going on.
到里昂来学习法律有半年多了。
Dào Lǐ'áng lái xuéxí fǎlǜ yǒu bàn nián duō le.
She came to Lyon to study law over six months ago.
我学汉语有两年了。
Wǒ xué Hànyǔ yǒu liǎng nián le.
I've been learning Chinese for two years.
最不……的是A，最……的是B
what … least is A, what … most is B
This sets two extremes side by side.
她最不喜欢奶酪的味道，但是最爱吃的是法式甜点。
Tā zuì bù xǐhuan nǎilào de wèidao, dànshì zuì ài chī de shì fǎshì tiándiǎn.
What she likes least is cheese, but what she loves most is French desserts.
我最喜欢的季节是秋天。
Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de jìjié shì qiūtiān.
My favourite season is autumn.
给 + person + 过生日
to celebrate someone's birthday
给 marks who the celebration is for.
她约了几个同学到她这儿来给马新平过生日。
Tā yuē le jǐ ge tóngxué dào tā zhèr lái gěi Mǎ Xīnpíng guò shēngrì.
She invited some classmates over to celebrate Ma Xinping's birthday.
明天我们给妈妈过生日。
Míngtiān wǒmen gěi māma guò shēngrì.
Tomorrow we're celebrating Mum's birthday.
把 + object + V得 + description
to … until …
把 can also take a degree complement: 把蛋清打得像雪一样 (whisk the whites snow-like), 把胳膊打得酸疼 (whisk until your arm aches).
把胳膊打得酸疼。
Bǎ gēbo dǎ de suānténg.
Whisked until her arm ached.
他把房间打扫得很干净。
Tā bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de hěn gānjìng.
He cleaned the room spotless.
一个字也没提
didn't say a word
一 + measure word + 也没 is a strong “not at all”.
那上边一个字也没提。
Nà shàngbian yí ge zì yě méi tí.
The recipe didn't say a word about it.
他一分钱也没有。
Tā yì fēn qián yě méiyǒu.
He hasn't got a penny.
不知道是……还是……
not sure whether … or …
This weighs two possible explanations.
不知道是法国甜点太复杂，还是自己太笨了。
Bù zhīdào shì Fǎguó tiándiǎn tài fùzá, háishi zìjǐ tài bèn le.
I don't know if French desserts are too complicated or I'm just too clumsy.
不知道是我错了，还是他错了。
Bù zhīdào shì wǒ cuò le, háishi tā cuò le.
I don't know whether I'm wrong or he is.
gaps: 说好了，每个人带一个菜来。
食谱上的说法，要把蛋清打得像雪一样。
say: Zhao Jing is a Chinese student. She came to Lyon to study law over six months ago.
They'd agreed beforehand that everyone would bring a dish.
The recipe didn't say a word about it.
I don't know if French desserts are too complicated or I'm just too clumsy.

045.title: The story of the cake, part 2
045.transcriptNote: Continued from part 044. 旁白 is the narrator, 同学 is a classmate and 新平 is Ma Xinping, whose birthday it is. Speakers are assigned from context, and the line about the electric whisk could belong to another classmate.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 晚上，同学们坐在一起愉快地吃着饭。
Wǎnshang, tóngxuémen zuò zài yìqǐ yúkuài de chī zhe fàn.
That evening, the classmates were sitting together enjoying dinner.
赵静，听说你给新平做了一个巧克力蛋糕，
Zhào Jìng, tīngshuō nǐ gěi Xīnpíng zuò le yí ge qiǎokèlì dàngāo,
Zhao Jing, I hear you made Xinping a chocolate cake.
正巧我没吃过，快拿来吧。
zhèngqiǎo wǒ méi chī guo, kuài nálai ba.
As it happens, I've never had one. Bring it out!
Jí shénme, nǐ hái méi chī bǎo a?
What's the rush? Aren't you full yet?
这么多美味的菜，当然吃饱了。
Zhème duō měiwèi de cài, dāngrán chī bǎo le.
With all this delicious food, of course I'm full.
可是你自己做的蛋糕我们能不尝尝吗？
Kěshì nǐ zìjǐ zuò de dàngāo wǒmen néng bù chángchang ma?
But how could we not try a cake you made yourself?
好好，我去拿。你们千万别笑我。
Hǎo hǎo, wǒ qù ná. Nǐmen qiānwàn bié xiào wǒ.
OK, OK, I'll get it. Just promise not to laugh at me.
赵静把刚才做的蛋糕放在桌子上。
Zhào Jìng bǎ gāngcái zuò de dàngāo fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
Zhao Jing put the cake she'd made on the table.
真不好意思，我本来以为挺容易的，
Zhēn bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ běnlái yǐwéi tǐng róngyì de,
I'm really embarrassed. I thought it would be easy,
可是忙了一下午，还是把蛋糕做成了大饼。
kěshì máng le yí xiàwǔ, háishi bǎ dàngāo zuòchéng le dà bǐng.
but after working on it all afternoon, it still came out like a big flat pancake.
Zhēn xiāng! Zhè bú shì hěn hǎo ma?
It smells great! Isn't it fine?
好什么，我到现在也没明白，怎么能把蛋清打成雪的样子。
Hǎo shénme, wǒ dào xiànzài yě méi míngbai, zěnme néng bǎ dànqīng dǎchéng xuě de yàngzi.
Fine? I still don't get how you whisk egg whites until they're like snow.
哦，我记得在别人家见过一种打蛋机，两三分钟就能打好。
Ò, wǒ jìde zài biérén jiā jiàn guo yì zhǒng dǎdànjī, liǎng sān fēnzhōng jiù néng dǎhǎo.
Oh, I remember seeing an electric whisk at someone's house. It does it in two or three minutes.
是吗？我要是早知道就好了。
Shì ma? Wǒ yàoshi zǎo zhīdào jiù hǎo le.
新平，我下次给你重新做一个，希望能做得好一些。
Xīnpíng, wǒ xià cì gěi nǐ chóngxīn zuò yí ge, xīwàng néng zuò de hǎo yìxiē.
Xinping, next time I'll make you a new one. Hopefully it'll turn out better.
Méi guānxi, nǐ de yìsi dào le.
Don't worry. It's the thought that counts.

grammar: 急什么 / 好什么
what's the rush? / fine? hardly!
Adjective or verb + 什么 rejects what was just said.
急什么，你还没吃饱啊？
Jí shénme, nǐ hái méi chī bǎo a?
What's the rush? Aren't you full yet?
贵什么？一点儿也不贵。
Guì shénme? Yìdiǎnr yě bú guì.
Expensive? Not at all.
能不……吗？
how could we not …?
A double-negative rhetorical question that means “of course we will”.
你自己做的蛋糕我们能不尝尝吗？
Nǐ zìjǐ zuò de dàngāo wǒmen néng bù chángchang ma?
How could we not try a cake you made yourself?
这么好的机会，我能不去吗？
Zhème hǎo de jīhuì, wǒ néng bú qù ma?
With a chance like this, how could I not go?
千万别……
whatever you do, don't …
千万 makes a warning or plea stronger.
你们千万别笑我。
Nǐmen qiānwàn bié xiào wǒ.
Just promise not to laugh at me.
你千万别忘了。
Nǐ qiānwàn bié wàng le.
Whatever you do, don't forget.
本来以为……，可是……
I'd thought …, but …
本来 marks the original expectation, and 可是 the reality.
我本来以为挺容易的，可是忙了一下午，还是把蛋糕做成了大饼。
Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi tǐng róngyì de, kěshì máng le yí xiàwǔ, háishi bǎ dàngāo zuòchéng le dà bǐng.
I thought it'd be easy, but after all afternoon it still came out like a pancake.
我本来以为他会来，可是他没来。
Wǒ běnlái yǐwéi tā huì lái, kěshì tā méi lái.
I'd thought he would come, but he didn't.
要是早知道就好了
if only I'd known
要是……就好了 expresses a wish or regret.
我要是早知道就好了。
Wǒ yàoshi zǎo zhīdào jiù hǎo le.
I wish I'd known.
要是明天不下雨就好了。
Yàoshi míngtiān bú xià yǔ jiù hǎo le.
If only it doesn't rain tomorrow.
say: What's the rush? Aren't you full yet?
Just promise not to laugh at me.
I wish I'd known.
Don't worry. It's the thought that counts.

046.title: Vocabulary list
046.transcriptNote: The words in the order they're read. The English introduction isn't transcribed. Single words were matched to how parts 047–049 use them.

lines: in passing, while you're at it
to treat, to host a meal
blocks.note: Matched to the texts: 吵 (heard as 好 or 炒; part 047 has 吵了起来), 道 (heard as 到; part 049 has 一道一道地吃) and 餐巾 (heard as 餐金).

047.title: Ten sentences
047.sub: Eating out, table talk and etiquette
047.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences using the new words from part 046. Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 服务员把客人带到桌子旁，还随手拿来几份菜单。
Fúwùyuán bǎ kèrén dàidào zhuōzi páng, hái suíshǒu nálai jǐ fèn càidān.
The waiter showed the guests to their table and brought over some menus while he was at it.
每到周末，爸爸都带我们去中国饭馆吃饭。
Měi dào zhōumò, bàba dōu dài wǒmen qù Zhōngguó fànguǎn chī fàn.
Every weekend, Dad takes us out to a Chinese restaurant.
女儿每次去中餐馆，都跟服务员要筷子，就像没有筷子就不能吃饭一样。
Nǚ'ér měi cì qù zhōngcānguǎn, dōu gēn fúwùyuán yào kuàizi, jiù xiàng méiyǒu kuàizi jiù bù néng chī fàn yíyàng.
Every time our daughter goes to a Chinese restaurant, she asks for chopsticks, as if she couldn't eat without them.
来法国以前，老王什么法国菜都没吃过。
Lái Fǎguó yǐqián, Lǎo Wáng shénme Fǎguó cài dōu méi chī guo.
Before coming to France, Lao Wang had never had any French food.
在饭桌上，大家七嘴八舌地谈着话，什么话题都说。
Zài fànzhuō shang, dàjiā qī zuǐ bā shé de tán zhe huà, shénme huàtí dōu shuō.
At the table everyone talked at once about anything and everything.
中国人和法国人把请客吃饭看作非常重要的事。
Zhōngguórén hé Fǎguórén bǎ qǐngkè chī fàn kànzuò fēicháng zhòngyào de shì.
Chinese and French people both see hosting a meal as very important.
一家人正在吃饭的时候，发生了一件奇怪的事儿。
Yì jiā rén zhèngzài chī fàn de shíhou, fāshēng le yí jiàn qíguài de shìr.
While the family was eating, something strange happened.
在这个问题上，他们两个人的意见不合，吵了起来。
Zài zhège wèntí shang, tāmen liǎng ge rén de yìjiàn bùhé, chǎo le qilai.
The two of them disagreed on this question and started arguing.
这是个很重要的宴会，每个人的座位都事先安排好了，不能随便坐。
Zhè shì ge hěn zhòngyào de yànhuì, měi ge rén de zuòwèi dōu shìxiān ānpái hǎo le, bù néng suíbiàn zuò.
This is a very important banquet. Everyone's seat has been arranged in advance, so you can't sit just anywhere.
快点儿工作吧，别聊天儿了。
Kuài diǎnr gōngzuò ba, bié liáotiānr le.

grammar: every time …
每 + 到 + time, with 都 in the second clause, describes a regular habit.
每到周末，爸爸都带我们去中国饭馆吃饭。
Měi dào zhōumò, bàba dōu dài wǒmen qù Zhōngguó fànguǎn chī fàn.
Every weekend, Dad takes us to a Chinese restaurant.
每到春节，我们都回老家。
Měi dào Chūnjié, wǒmen dōu huí lǎojiā.
Every Spring Festival we go back to our hometown.
就像……一样
just as if …
像……一样 can compare whole situations, not just things.
就像没有筷子就不能吃饭一样。
Jiù xiàng méiyǒu kuàizi jiù bù néng chī fàn yíyàng.
As if she couldn't eat without chopsticks.
他说汉语就像中国人一样。
Tā shuō Hànyǔ jiù xiàng Zhōngguórén yíyàng.
He speaks Chinese just like a Chinese person.
把 A 看作 B
to regard A as B
看作 (also written 看做) means treating something as a certain kind of thing.
中国人和法国人把请客吃饭看作非常重要的事。
Zhōngguórén hé Fǎguórén bǎ qǐngkè chī fàn kànzuò fēicháng zhòngyào de shì.
Chinese and French people see hosting a meal as very important.
他把我看作他的好朋友。
Tā bǎ wǒ kànzuò tā de hǎo péngyou.
He thinks of me as a good friend.
在……问题上
on the question of …
This frames the topic of a disagreement or decision.
在这个问题上，他们两个人的意见不合。
Zài zhège wèntí shang, tāmen liǎng ge rén de yìjiàn bùhé.
The two of them disagreed on this question.
在这个问题上，我同意你的看法。
Zài zhège wèntí shang, wǒ tóngyì nǐ de kànfǎ.
On this question, I agree with you.
V了起来
to start …
起来 after a verb marks the start of an action that then goes on.
他们两个人的意见不合，吵了起来。
Tāmen liǎng ge rén de yìjiàn bùhé, chǎo le qilai.
They disagreed and started arguing.
听完这个笑话，大家都笑了起来。
Tīngwán zhège xiàohua, dàjiā dōu xiào le qilai.
When they heard the joke, everyone burst out laughing.
gaps: ，爸爸都带我们去中国饭馆吃饭。
中国人和法国人把请客吃饭
一家人正在吃饭的时候，
say: Every weekend, Dad takes us out to a Chinese restaurant.
Before coming to France, Lao Wang had never had any French food.
While the family was eating, something strange happened.

048.title: Ten multiple-choice items
048.transcriptNote: Each item is a short exchange, a question and four options. The answer key is my own reading. In the dialogues, 男 and 女 come from voice pitch where it matters.

lines: 小王没有说一定要来吃晚饭，你不用准备那么多菜。
Xiǎo Wáng méiyǒu shuō yídìng yào lái chī wǎnfàn, nǐ búyòng zhǔnbèi nàme duō cài.
Xiao Wang didn't say he'd definitely come for dinner. You don't need to make so much food.
Yàoshi tā zhēn de lái le ne?
And what if he does come?

q: 女的是什么意思？
Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
What does the woman mean?
o: Xiǎo Wáng yǒu kěnéng huì lái.
Xiǎo Wáng zhēn de bù néng lái.

lines: Hāi, Xiǎo Lǐ, chī le ma?
Hi, Xiao Li, have you eaten?
还得等一会儿呢，回去以后得自己做，不像你每天在食堂吃。
Hái děi děng yíhuìr ne, huíqu yǐhòu děi zìjǐ zuò, bú xiàng nǐ měi tiān zài shítáng chī.
Not yet. I have to cook for myself when I get home, unlike you, eating in the canteen every day.

q: 从小李的这句话里，我们可以知道什么？
Cóng Xiǎo Lǐ de zhè jù huà li, wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from what Xiao Li says?
o: Tā jīngcháng zài shítáng chī fàn.
He often eats in the canteen.
Tā jiā li yǒu rén zuò fàn.
Someone at home cooks for him.
He has to cook for himself.
Tā jiā zhǐ yǒu tā yí ge rén.

lines: 你看一下，我们点了几个菜了？
Nǐ kàn yíxià, wǒmen diǎn le jǐ ge cài le?
Could you check how many dishes we've ordered?
你们一共要了两个凉菜、三个热菜，还需要来点儿别的吗？
Nǐmen yígòng yào le liǎng ge liángcài, sān ge rècài, hái xūyào lái diǎnr biéde ma?
You've ordered two cold dishes and three hot dishes. Would you like anything else?

q: 这个对话可能发生在什么地方？
Zhège duìhuà kěnéng fāshēng zài shénme dìfang?
Where does this conversation probably take place?

lines: 大家都很喜欢今天的菜，只是因为点得太多，最后还剩了很多。
Dàjiā dōu hěn xǐhuan jīntiān de cài, zhǐshì yīnwèi diǎn de tài duō, zuìhòu hái shèng le hěn duō.
Everyone loved the food. We just ordered too much, so there was a lot left over.

q: 从他们的话里我们可以知道什么？
Cóng tāmen de huà li wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: Méiyǒu dàjiā ài chī de cài.
Cài bú gòu dàjiā chī de.
The food was good but not all eaten.
Dàjiā dōu bú tài xiǎng chī.

lines: Fúwùyuán, qǐng zài lái píng píjiǔ.
Waiter, another bottle of beer, please.
别要了，够了，再喝就该喝多了。
Bié yào le, gòu le, zài hē jiù gāi hē duō le.
Don't order any more, that's enough. Any more and you'll have had too much.

q: 这个对话可能发生在哪儿？
Zhège duìhuà kěnéng fāshēng zài nǎr?
Where does this probably take place?

lines: 月饼？我连见都没见过，别说做了。
Yuèbing? Wǒ lián jiàn dōu méi jiàn guo, bié shuō zuò le.
Mooncakes? I've never even seen one, let alone made one.

q: 男的是什么意思？
Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
What does the man mean?
o: Tā xiǎng zhīdào zěnme zuò yuèbing.
He wants to know how to make them.

lines: 凉菜我要一个沙拉，主菜要一个鱼，还有，多加些薯条。
Liángcài wǒ yào yí ge shālā, zhǔcài yào yí ge yú, hái yǒu, duō jiā xiē shǔtiáo.
For a starter I'll have a salad, fish for the main, and extra chips, please.
不要一点儿白葡萄酒吗？
Bú yào yìdiǎnr bái pútaojiǔ ma?
Wouldn't you like some white wine?

q: 他们的对话里没有说到哪种菜？
Tāmen de duìhuà li méiyǒu shuōdào nǎ zhǒng cài?
Which food is NOT mentioned?

lines: 孩子，冰激凌是最后吃的，要先吃凉菜，再吃热菜，最后吃甜点。
Háizi, bīngjīlíng shì zuìhòu chī de, yào xiān chī liángcài, zài chī rècài, zuìhòu chī tiándiǎn.
Sweetheart, ice cream comes last. First the starters, then the hot dishes, and dessert at the end.

q: 什么时候吃凉菜？
Shénme shíhou chī liángcài?
When are the cold dishes eaten?

blocks.note: C is also technically true, but A is the most direct answer, since cold dishes come first, before the hot ones.

lines: 你听，他们在饭桌上吵起来了。
Nǐ tīng, tāmen zài fànzhuō shang chǎo qilai le.
Listen, they've started arguing at the table.
没关系，他们的意见不一样吧？吵完以后他们就会忘了。
Méi guānxi, tāmen de yìjiàn bù yíyàng ba? Chǎowán yǐhòu tāmen jiù huì wàng le.
Never mind. They probably just disagree. Once they've had it out, they'll forget about it.

q: 为什么有人在饭桌上会吵起来？
Wèishénme yǒu rén zài fànzhuō shang huì chǎo qilai?
Why do people start arguing at the table?
o: Tāmen dōu yào chī yíyàng de cài.
They both want the same dish.

lines: 小胖，鱼刺不要放在桌子上，要放在盘子里。
Xiǎo Pàng, yúcì bú yào fàng zài zhuōzi shang, yào fàng zài pánzi li.
Xiao Pang, don't put fish bones on the table. Put them on your plate.
Mum, why is it so complicated?
咱们这是吃西餐，得讲规矩。
Zánmen zhè shì chī xīcān, děi jiǎng guīju.
This is Western food. You have to mind your manners.

q: 下面哪句话不是妈妈的意思？
Xiàmiàn nǎ jù huà bú shì māma de yìsi?
Which is NOT what Mum means?
o: 吃西餐的时候，不能把鱼刺放在桌子上。
Chī xīcān de shíhou, bù néng bǎ yúcì fàng zài zhuōzi shang.
Don't put fish bones on the table when eating Western food.
吃西餐的时候要讲规矩。
Chī xīcān de shíhou yào jiǎng guīju.
Mind your manners when eating Western food.
吃西餐的时候不要把鱼刺放在盘子里。
Chī xīcān de shíhou bú yào bǎ yúcì fàng zài pánzi li.
Don't put fish bones on your plate when eating Western food.
Shàngmiàn de shuōfǎ dōu bú duì.

grammar: 要是……呢？
what if …?
要是 + situation + 呢 raises a possibility the other person hasn't considered.
要是他真的来了呢？
Yàoshi tā zhēn de lái le ne?
And what if he does come?
要是下雨了呢？
Yàoshi xià yǔ le ne?
What if it rains?
不像……
unlike …
不像 contrasts your situation with someone else's.
不像你每天在食堂吃。
Bú xiàng nǐ měi tiān zài shítáng chī.
Unlike you, eating in the canteen every day.
我不像他那么喜欢运动。
Wǒ bú xiàng tā nàme xǐhuan yùndòng.
I'm not as into sport as he is.
再……就该……了
any more and …
再 + verb gives the condition, and 就该……了 gives the result that will follow.
再喝就该喝多了。
Zài hē jiù gāi hē duō le.
Any more and you'll have had too much.
再不走就该迟到了。
Zài bù zǒu jiù gāi chídào le.
If we don't leave now, we'll be late.
连……都没……，别说……了
not even …, let alone …
The first part gives the easier case, and 别说 dismisses the harder one.
我连见都没见过，别说做了。
Wǒ lián jiàn dōu méi jiàn guo, bié shuō zuò le.
I've never even seen one, let alone made one.
我连汉字都不认识，别说写了。
Wǒ lián Hànzì dōu bú rènshi, bié shuō xiě le.
I can't even read Chinese characters, let alone write them.
讲规矩
to follow the rules
讲 here means “pay attention to”: 讲规矩 (follow etiquette), 讲卫生 (keep clean).
咱们这是吃西餐，得讲规矩。
Zánmen zhè shì chī xīcān, děi jiǎng guīju.
This is Western food. You have to mind your manners.
在饭馆吃饭要讲卫生。
Zài fànguǎn chī fàn yào jiǎng wèishēng.
You should keep things clean when eating out.
gaps: 只是因为点得太多，最后还
say: And what if he does come?
Waiter, another bottle of beer, please.
Mooncakes? I've never even seen one, let alone made one.
This is Western food. You have to mind your manners.

049.title: French dining etiquette
049.sub: Jacques explains a French dinner to Xiao Zhang, with ten true-or-false statements
049.transcriptNote: 甲 is Jacques and 乙 is Xiao Zhang. The true-or-false key is my own reading. Some statement numbers aren't read aloud.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 小张，昨天晚上的法国菜吃得怎么样？
Xiǎo Zhāng, zuótiān wǎnshang de Fǎguó cài chī de zěnmeyàng?
Xiao Zhang, how was the French dinner last night?
吃得真不错。不过，雅克，吃法国菜怎么用这么长时间啊？
Chī de zhēn búcuò. Búguò, Yǎkè, chī Fǎguó cài zěnme yòng zhème cháng shíjiān a?
It was really good. But Jacques, why does a French meal take so long?
法国人和中国人一样，也把吃饭看作非常重要的事儿。
Fǎguórén hé Zhōngguórén yíyàng, yě bǎ chī fàn kànzuò fēicháng zhòngyào de shìr.
The French are like the Chinese. They see eating as very important too.
一起吃饭也是社交的好方法，一边吃一边聊天儿，所以时间就长了。
Yìqǐ chī fàn yě shì shèjiāo de hǎo fāngfǎ, yìbiān chī yìbiān liáotiānr, suǒyǐ shíjiān jiù cháng le.
Eating together is a good way to socialise. You eat and chat at the same time, so it takes a while.
还有，一顿饭不能只是吃得好，怎么吃也非常重要，有很多讲究呢。
Hái yǒu, yí dùn fàn bù néng zhǐshì chī de hǎo, zěnme chī yě fēicháng zhòngyào, yǒu hěn duō jiǎngjiu ne.
And a meal isn't just about eating well. How you eat matters a lot too, and there are lots of rules.
Nà nǐ děi gēn wǒ shuōshuo.
Then you'll have to tell me about them.
先得把桌子摆好，盘子、刀叉、餐巾，还有不同的杯子，都不能随便放。
Xiān děi bǎ zhuōzi bǎihǎo, pánzi, dāochā, cānjīn, hái yǒu bù tóng de bēizi, dōu bù néng suíbiàn fàng.
First you have to lay the table. Plates, knives and forks, napkins and the different glasses can't just go anywhere.
那客人来了以后马上就吃饭吗？
Nà kèrén lái le yǐhòu mǎshàng jiù chī fàn ma?
Do you start eating as soon as the guests arrive?
一般要先喝点儿开胃酒，聊一会儿天儿。
Yìbān yào xiān hē diǎnr kāiwèijiǔ, liáo yíhuìr tiānr.
Usually you have an aperitif first and chat for a while.
我记得昨天吃饭的时候换了很多次盘子，这是为什么？
Wǒ jìde zuótiān chī fàn de shíhou huàn le hěn duō cì pánzi, zhè shì wèishénme?
I remember they changed the plates lots of times yesterday. Why was that?
法国菜是一道一道地吃，先吃凉菜，然后是主菜，接着是奶酪，最后吃甜点。
Fǎguó cài shì yí dào yí dào de chī, xiān chī liángcài, ránhòu shì zhǔcài, jiēzhe shì nǎilào, zuìhòu chī tiándiǎn.
French food is eaten course by course: starter, main course, then cheese, and dessert last.
吃完一道菜，就要把脏盘子拿走，换上干净的盘子。
Chīwán yí dào cài, jiù yào bǎ zāng pánzi názǒu, huànshang gānjìng de pánzi.
After each course, the dirty plates are taken away and replaced with clean ones.
哦，这和吃中国菜完全不一样。
Ò, zhè hé chī Zhōngguó cài wánquán bù yíyàng.
Oh, that's completely different from eating Chinese food.
小张，吃中国菜有什么规矩呢？和吃法国菜一样吗？
Xiǎo Zhāng, chī Zhōngguó cài yǒu shénme guīju ne? Hé chī Fǎguó cài yíyàng ma?
Xiao Zhang, what are the rules for Chinese food? Are they the same as for French?
有一样的，也有不一样的。以后有机会的话，我一定给你好好介绍介绍。
Yǒu yíyàng de, yě yǒu bù yíyàng de. Yǐhòu yǒu jīhuì de huà, wǒ yídìng gěi nǐ hǎohǎo jièshào jièshào.
Some are the same, some aren't. Next time I get the chance, I'll tell you all about it.

blocks.label: 判断
blocks.h: 判断正误 · True or false

q: 法国人和中国人都把吃饭看作重要的事儿。
Fǎguórén hé Zhōngguórén dōu bǎ chī fàn kànzuò zhòngyào de shìr.
The French and the Chinese both see eating as important.
吃法国菜用的时间不长。
Chī Fǎguó cài yòng de shíjiān bù cháng.
A French meal doesn't take long.
qs.why: it takes a long time

q: 吃法国菜有很多规矩。
Chī Fǎguó cài yǒu hěn duō guīju.
French dining has lots of rules.
开胃酒是吃饭的时候喝的。
Kāiwèijiǔ shì chī fàn de shíhou hē de.
The aperitif is drunk during the meal.
qs.why: it's drunk before the meal

q: 吃法国菜的时候，每个人只用一个盘子。
Chī Fǎguó cài de shíhou, měi ge rén zhǐ yòng yí ge pánzi.
Each person uses only one plate.
qs.why: plates are changed after each course

q: 因为盘子脏了，所以要换盘子。
Yīnwèi pánzi zāng le, suǒyǐ yào huàn pánzi.
Plates are changed because they're dirty.
甜点最后才吃。
Tiándiǎn zuìhòu cái chī.
Dessert comes last.
吃饭以前，餐桌要摆好。
Chī fàn yǐqián, cānzhuō yào bǎihǎo.
The table must be laid before eating.
刀叉、杯子怎么放没关系。
Dāochā, bēizi zěnme fàng méi guānxi.
It doesn't matter where the cutlery and glasses go.
qs.why: they can't be put just anywhere

q: 吃中国菜的规矩和吃法国菜的规矩不都一样。
Chī Zhōngguó cài de guīju hé chī Fǎguó cài de guīju bù dōu yíyàng.
The rules for Chinese food and French food aren't all the same.
qs.why: 有一样的，也有不一样的

blocks.note: Statement 10: one model heard 都一样 (all the same) and the other 不都一样 (not all the same). I used 不都一样, which makes it true. If you hear 都一样, it's false.

grammar: A 和 B 一样，也……
A is like B in also …
This compares two groups and adds what they share.
法国人和中国人一样，也把吃饭看作非常重要的事儿。
Fǎguórén hé Zhōngguórén yíyàng, yě bǎ chī fàn kànzuò fēicháng zhòngyào de shìr.
The French are like the Chinese. They see eating as very important too.
我和你一样，也喜欢看电影。
Wǒ hé nǐ yíyàng, yě xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng.
I'm like you. I love films too.
不能只是……，……也……
it's not just about …, … also …
This adds a second, equally important point.
一顿饭不能只是吃得好，怎么吃也非常重要。
Yí dùn fàn bù néng zhǐshì chī de hǎo, zěnme chī yě fēicháng zhòngyào.
A meal isn't just about eating well. How you eat matters too.
学语言不能只是看书，多说也很重要。
Xué yǔyán bù néng zhǐshì kàn shū, duō shuō yě hěn zhòngyào.
Learning a language isn't just reading. Speaking a lot matters too.
一 + MW + 一 + MW + 地
course by course, one by one
Repeating 一道 means each course comes separately.
法国菜是一道一道地吃。
Fǎguó cài shì yí dào yí dào de chī.
French food is eaten course by course.
他一句一句地翻译。
Tā yí jù yí jù de fānyì.
He translated sentence by sentence.
把 + object + 拿走，换上……
to take away and replace with …
换上 means to put the new item in place of the old.
就要把脏盘子拿走，换上干净的盘子。
Jiù yào bǎ zāng pánzi názǒu, huànshang gānjìng de pánzi.
The dirty plates are taken away and replaced with clean ones.
他换上了一件新衬衫。
Tā huànshang le yí jiàn xīn chènshān.
He changed into a new shirt.
有……的，也有……的
some …, some …
This splits a group into two kinds.
有一样的，也有不一样的。
Yǒu yíyàng de, yě yǒu bù yíyàng de.
Some are the same, some aren't.
有喜欢的，也有不喜欢的。
Yǒu xǐhuan de, yě yǒu bù xǐhuan de.
Some people like it, some don't.
gaps: 怎么吃也非常重要，有很多
say: But Jacques, why does a French meal take so long?
Usually you have an aperitif first and chat for a while.
Oh, that's completely different from eating Chinese food.
Some are the same, some aren't.

050.title: Where's the rice?
050.sub: The order of dishes in a Chinese restaurant, with three questions
050.transcriptNote: One speaker explains the order dishes arrive in, then three questions follow. The answers are my own wording.

blocks.label: 独白
lines: 在中国的饭馆里吃饭，一般是先上凉菜，再上热菜，最后上汤。
Zài Zhōngguó de fànguǎn li chī fàn, yìbān shì xiān shàng liángcài, zài shàng rècài, zuìhòu shàng tāng.
In a Chinese restaurant, cold dishes usually come first, then hot dishes, and soup last.
Nǐ yào le jiǔ, yě yào le mǐfàn,
但是，可能你的菜都快吃完了，米饭还没有来。
dànshì, kěnéng nǐ de cài dōu kuài chīwán le, mǐfàn hái méiyǒu lái.
but you might nearly finish your dishes before the rice arrives.
为什么呢？因为中国人有先喝酒后吃饭的习惯。
Wèishénme ne? Yīnwèi Zhōngguórén yǒu xiān hē jiǔ hòu chī fàn de xíguàn.
Why? Because Chinese people have a habit of drinking first and eating the rice afterwards.
你要想一边吃饭一边喝酒的话，最好点菜的时候告诉服务员一声，
Nǐ yào xiǎng yìbiān chī fàn yìbiān hē jiǔ de huà, zuìhǎo diǎn cài de shíhou gàosu fúwùyuán yì shēng,
If you want to drink and eat rice at the same time, it's best to tell the waiter when you order
to bring the rice with the dishes.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 在中国饭馆里吃饭，一般什么时候上热菜？
Zài Zhōngguó fànguǎn li chī fàn, yìbān shénme shíhou shàng rècài?
When are hot dishes usually served in a Chinese restaurant?
ans: 上完凉菜以后，上汤以前。
Shàngwán liángcài yǐhòu, shàng tāng yǐqián.
After the cold dishes and before the soup.

q: 为什么有的时候菜都快吃完了，还没有上米饭？
Wèishénme yǒu de shíhou cài dōu kuài chīwán le, hái méiyǒu shàng mǐfàn?
Why does the rice sometimes come so late?
ans: 因为中国人有先喝酒后吃饭的习惯。
Yīnwèi Zhōngguórén yǒu xiān hē jiǔ hòu chī fàn de xíguàn.
Because Chinese people usually drink first and have rice afterwards.

q: 如果想一边喝酒一边吃饭，最好怎么做？
Rúguǒ xiǎng yìbiān hē jiǔ yìbiān chī fàn, zuìhǎo zěnme zuò?
What should you do if you want rice with your drinks?
ans: 点菜的时候告诉服务员，米饭和菜一起上。
Diǎn cài de shíhou gàosu fúwùyuán, mǐfàn hé cài yìqǐ shàng.
Tell the waiter when ordering to bring the rice with the dishes.

grammar: 先上……，再上……，最后上……
first …, then …, finally …
上 + dish means “serve”, and the sequence words set the order.
一般是先上凉菜，再上热菜，最后上汤。
Yìbān shì xiān shàng liángcài, zài shàng rècài, zuìhòu shàng tāng.
Cold dishes usually come first, then hot dishes, and soup last.
服务员，请先上汤吧。
Fúwùyuán, qǐng xiān shàng tāng ba.
Waiter, please bring the soup first.
都快……了
almost …
快……了 means “nearly”, and 都 adds “already”.
可能你的菜都快吃完了，米饭还没有来。
Kěnéng nǐ de cài dōu kuài chīwán le, mǐfàn hái méiyǒu lái.
You might nearly finish your dishes before the rice arrives.
都快十二点了，你怎么还不睡？
Dōu kuài shí'èr diǎn le, nǐ zěnme hái bú shuì?
It's almost midnight. Why aren't you in bed?
first … then …
This is a compact way to give an order of actions, often inside a noun phrase.
中国人有先喝酒后吃饭的习惯。
Zhōngguórén yǒu xiān hē jiǔ hòu chī fàn de xíguàn.
Chinese people tend to drink first and eat rice after.
我们先吃饭后看电影。
Wǒmen xiān chī fàn hòu kàn diànyǐng.
We'll eat first and see a film after.
告诉……一声
to let someone know
一声 makes it a quick word, a simple heads-up.
最好点菜的时候告诉服务员一声。
Zuìhǎo diǎn cài de shíhou gàosu fúwùyuán yì shēng.
It's best to tell the waiter when you order.
你到了告诉我一声。
Nǐ dào le gàosu wǒ yì shēng.
Let me know when you arrive.
gaps: 因为中国人有先喝酒后吃饭的
的时候告诉服务员一声。
say: In a Chinese restaurant, cold dishes usually come first, then hot dishes, and soup last.
Why? Because Chinese people have a habit of drinking first and eating the rice afterwards.
Bring the rice with the dishes.

053.title: How the French host a meal
053.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. It brings together the dining vocabulary from parts 046–052.

lines: How the French host a meal
中国人把吃饭看作生活中一件很重要的事儿，法国人也一样。
Zhōngguórén bǎ chī fàn kànzuò shēnghuó zhōng yí jiàn hěn zhòngyào de shìr, Fǎguórén yě yíyàng.
Chinese people see eating as one of the most important things in life, and so do the French.
不同的是，法国人在饭桌上的时间比中国人长得多，
Bù tóng de shì, Fǎguórén zài fànzhuō shang de shíjiān bǐ Zhōngguórén cháng de duō,
The difference is that the French spend much longer at the table than the Chinese,
特别是请客的时候，一顿饭一般要四五个小时才能吃完。
tèbié shì qǐngkè de shíhou, yí dùn fàn yìbān yào sì wǔ ge xiǎoshí cái néng chīwán.
especially when they have guests. A meal usually takes four or five hours.
午饭从中午一直吃到下午，晚饭呢，就一直吃到夜里一两点钟。
Wǔfàn cóng zhōngwǔ yìzhí chī dào xiàwǔ, wǎnfàn ne, jiù yìzhí chī dào yèli yì liǎng diǎn zhōng.
Lunch goes on from midday into the afternoon, and dinner can last until one or two in the morning.
首先，一顿饭不但要吃得好，而且要讲究怎么吃。
Shǒuxiān, yí dùn fàn búdàn yào chī de hǎo, érqiě yào jiǎngjiu zěnme chī.
First of all, a meal has to be good, and the way it's eaten matters too.
餐桌怎么摆，盘子、杯子、刀叉和餐巾应该放在哪里，都不能随便。
Cānzhuō zěnme bǎi, pánzi, bēizi, dāochā hé cānjīn yīnggāi fàng zài nǎlǐ, dōu bù néng suíbiàn.
How the table is laid and where the plates, glasses, cutlery and napkins go are all carefully decided.
客人到了以后，先在客厅里喝开胃酒，
Kèrén dào le yǐhòu, xiān zài kètīng li hē kāiwèijiǔ,
When the guests arrive, they first have an aperitif in the living room.
过一会儿，主人才把大家请到餐桌前，安排好座位，开始吃饭。
guò yíhuìr, zhǔrén cái bǎ dàjiā qǐngdào cānzhuō qián, ānpái hǎo zuòwèi, kāishǐ chī fàn.
After a while, the host invites everyone to the table, seats them, and the meal begins.
饭菜是一道一道地端上来的，
Fàncài shì yí dào yí dào de duān shanglai de,
The food is brought out course by course:
先吃凉菜或者喝汤，然后是主菜，接着是奶酪，最后吃甜点或水果。
xiān chī liángcài huòzhě hē tāng, ránhòu shì zhǔcài, jiēzhe shì nǎilào, zuìhòu chī tiándiǎn huò shuǐguǒ.
first a starter or soup, then the main course, then cheese, and finally dessert or fruit.
每吃完一道，主人都要把用过的脏盘子拿走，换上干净的。
Měi chīwán yí dào, zhǔrén dōu yào bǎ yòng guo de zāng pánzi názǒu, huànshang gānjìng de.
After each course, the host takes away the used plates and brings clean ones.
饭后，大家回到客厅里，主人还会拿出饭后酒。
Fàn hòu, dàjiā huídào kètīng li, zhǔrén hái huì náchū fànhòujiǔ.
After the meal, everyone goes back to the living room, and the host brings out a digestif.
有人开玩笑说，这样可以把吃下的东西推进胃里去。
Yǒu rén kāi wánxiào shuō, zhèyàng kěyǐ bǎ chīxia de dōngxi tuījìn wèi li qù.
Some joke that this helps push the food down into your stomach.
但是，时间长主要是因为人们一边吃饭一边聊天，
Dànshì, shíjiān cháng zhǔyào shì yīnwèi rénmen yìbiān chī fàn yìbiān liáotiān,
But the main reason it takes so long is that people chat while they eat,
从生活小事儿到国家大事儿，什么话题都可以说。
cóng shēnghuó xiǎo shìr dào guójiā dà shìr, shénme huàtí dōu kěyǐ shuō.
about anything from everyday trivia to national affairs.
高兴的时候七嘴八舌，有说有笑，
Gāoxìng de shíhou qī zuǐ bā shé, yǒu shuō yǒu xiào,
When they're happy, everyone talks and laughs at once.
要是意见不合的话，也会大声地吵起来。
yàoshi yìjiàn bùhé de huà, yě huì dàshēng de chǎo qilai.
If they disagree, they may argue loudly.
不过，最后大家分手的时候，又把刚才的不愉快都忘了，
Búguò, zuìhòu dàjiā fēnshǒu de shíhou, yòu bǎ gāngcái de bù yúkuài dōu wàng le,
But when they say goodbye at the end, all the unpleasantness is forgotten,
好像什么事儿都没发生过一样。
hǎoxiàng shénme shìr dōu méi fāshēng guo yíyàng.
很多人把餐桌上的谈话看作一种艺术，或者一种社交方式。
Hěn duō rén bǎ cānzhuō shang de tánhuà kànzuò yì zhǒng yìshù, huòzhě yì zhǒng shèjiāo fāngshì.
Many people see conversation at the table as an art, or as a way of socialising.

grammar: A 比 B + adj + 得多
A is much more … than B
得多 after the adjective means “much more”.
法国人在饭桌上的时间比中国人长得多。
Fǎguórén zài fànzhuō shang de shíjiān bǐ Zhōngguórén cháng de duō.
The French spend much longer at the table than the Chinese.
今天比昨天冷得多。
Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng de duō.
Today is much colder than yesterday.
从……一直 V 到……
to keep … from … until …
从 and 到 mark the start and end, and 一直 means without stopping.
午饭从中午一直吃到下午。
Wǔfàn cóng zhōngwǔ yìzhí chī dào xiàwǔ.
Lunch goes on from midday into the afternoon.
他从早上一直工作到晚上。
Tā cóng zǎoshang yìzhí gōngzuò dào wǎnshang.
He worked from morning till night.
each time …
每 + verb phrase, with 都 in the second clause, describes a repeated pattern.
每吃完一道，主人都要把用过的脏盘子拿走。
Měi chīwán yí dào, zhǔrén dōu yào bǎ yòng guo de zāng pánzi názǒu.
After each course, the host takes away the used plates.
他每次来都带礼物。
Tā měi cì lái dōu dài lǐwù.
He brings a present every time he comes.
from … to …, any …
This covers a whole range: “anything at all”.
从生活小事儿到国家大事儿，什么话题都可以说。
Cóng shēnghuó xiǎo shìr dào guójiā dà shìr, shénme huàtí dōu kěyǐ shuō.
Anything from everyday trivia to national affairs.
从早到晚，他什么都不想做。
Cóng zǎo dào wǎn, tā shénme dōu bù xiǎng zuò.
From morning till night, he doesn't want to do anything.
好像……一样
as if …
This compares a situation to an imagined one.
好像什么事儿都没发生过一样。
Hǎoxiàng shénme shìr dōu méi fāshēng guo yíyàng.
As if nothing had happened.
他好像不认识我一样。
Tā hǎoxiàng bú rènshi wǒ yíyàng.
He acted as if he didn't know me.
gaps: 法国人在饭桌上的时间比中国人长得
，一顿饭不但要吃得好，而且要讲究怎么吃。
这样可以把吃下的东西推进
很多人把餐桌上的谈话看作一种
say: Chinese people see eating as one of the most important things in life, and so do the French.
When the guests arrive, they first have an aperitif in the living room.
After the meal, everyone goes back to the living room, and the host brings out a digestif.
As if nothing had happened.

055.title: Ten sentences
055.sub: Can you make it? Potential complements
055.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences. Many use the “can / can't” verb forms (赶得上, 看不见, 挤不上去). Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 现在是差五分钟十二点，还赶得上末班车吗？
Xiànzài shì chà wǔ fēnzhōng shí'èr diǎn, hái gǎn de shàng mòbānchē ma?
It's five to twelve. Can we still catch the last bus?
于飞和小青一边走路一边唱着刚才听到的歌。
Yú Fēi hé Xiǎo Qīng yìbiān zǒulù yìbiān chàng zhe gāngcái tīngdào de gē.
Yu Fei and Xiao Qing walked along singing the songs they'd just heard.
考试的时候，有很多句子我都不会，不是不认识汉字，就是看不懂意思。
Kǎoshì de shíhou, yǒu hěn duō jùzi wǒ dōu bú huì, bú shì bú rènshi Hànzì, jiù shì kàn bu dǒng yìsi.
In the exam there were lots of sentences I couldn't do. Either I didn't know the characters or I couldn't understand the meaning.
我们好不容易才买到演唱会的票，你怎么又不去了？
Wǒmen hǎobù róngyì cái mǎidào yǎnchànghuì de piào, nǐ zěnme yòu bú qù le?
We went to so much trouble to get concert tickets. Why aren't you going now?
今天天气这么暖和，根本用不着穿大衣。
Jīntiān tiānqì zhème nuǎnhuo, gēnběn yòng bu zháo chuān dàyī.
It's so warm today. There's no need at all for a coat.
前面那位女士，您能不能不戴帽子？我看不见舞台了。
Qiánmiàn nà wèi nǚshì, nín néng bu néng bú dài màozi? Wǒ kàn bu jiàn wǔtái le.
Excuse me, madam in front, could you take your hat off? I can't see the stage.
要是赶不上末班地铁，咱们只好打的回家了。
Yàoshi gǎn bu shàng mòbān dìtiě, zánmen zhǐhǎo dǎdī huí jiā le.
If we miss the last train, we'll have to take a taxi home.
你看啊，公交车上那么多人，咱们肯定挤不上去。
Nǐ kàn a, gōngjiāochē shang nàme duō rén, zánmen kěndìng jǐ bu shàngqu.
Look how many people are on the bus. We'll never squeeze on.
好不容易休息一天，可是旁边那家人的孩子一整天都在唱歌，真没有办法。
Hǎobù róngyì xiūxi yì tiān, kěshì pángbiān nà jiā rén de háizi yì zhěng tiān dōu zài chàng gē, zhēn méiyǒu bànfǎ.
I finally get a day off, and the neighbours' kid sings all day. There's nothing I can do.
下一站是终点站，请大家拿好自己的东西，准备下车。
Xià yí zhàn shì zhōngdiǎnzhàn, qǐng dàjiā náhǎo zìjǐ de dōngxi, zhǔnbèi xià chē.
The next stop is the last stop. Please take all your belongings and get ready to leave.

grammar: 差 + time + hour
… to (the hour)
差五分钟十二点 means “five to twelve”, literally “short five minutes of twelve”.
现在是差五分钟十二点。
Xiànzài shì chà wǔ fēnzhōng shí'èr diǎn.
It's five to twelve.
现在差一刻八点。
Xiànzài chà yí kè bā diǎn.
It's a quarter to eight.
V得上 / V不上
can / can't make it
得 or 不 between the verb and its result says whether the result is possible: 赶得上 (can catch), 挤不上去 (can't squeeze on), 看不见 (can't see).
还赶得上末班车吗？
Hái gǎn de shàng mòbānchē ma?
Can we still catch the last bus?
这么多作业，我做不完。
Zhème duō zuòyè, wǒ zuò bu wán.
There's too much homework. I can't finish it.
不是……，就是……
if it's not …, it's …
This gives two possibilities, one of which always applies.
不是不认识汉字，就是看不懂意思。
Bú shì bú rènshi Hànzì, jiù shì kàn bu dǒng yìsi.
Either I didn't know the characters or I couldn't understand the meaning.
他周末不是看书，就是睡觉。
Tā zhōumò bú shì kàn shū, jiù shì shuìjiào.
At weekends he's either reading or sleeping.
根本 + negative
not at all
根本 makes a negative absolute.
根本用不着穿大衣。
Gēnběn yòng bu zháo chuān dàyī.
There's no need at all for a coat.
我根本不认识他。
Wǒ gēnběn bú rènshi tā.
I don't know him at all.
能不能不……？
could you please not …?
This is a polite way to ask someone to stop doing something.
您能不能不戴帽子？
Nín néng bu néng bú dài màozi?
Could you take your hat off?
你能不能不说话？
Nǐ néng bu néng bù shuōhuà?
Could you stop talking?
gaps: 不认识汉字，就是看不懂意思。
公交车上那么多人，咱们肯定
say: It's five to twelve. Can we still catch the last bus?
It's so warm today. There's no need at all for a coat.
Could you take your hat off? I can't see the stage.
If we miss the last train, we'll have to take a taxi home.

056.title: Eighteen multiple-choice items
056.sub: Can or can't: catching buses, finishing homework, seeing clearly
056.transcriptNote: Each item has a sentence or short exchange, a question and four options. The answer key is my own reading. Some item numbers aren't read aloud.

lines: 你要是早点儿出门的话，还能赶得上去长城的旅游大巴，晚了就赶不上了。
Nǐ yàoshi zǎo diǎnr chūmén de huà, hái néng gǎn de shàng qù Chángchéng de lǚyóu dàbā, wǎn le jiù gǎn bu shàng le.
If you leave a bit earlier, you can still catch the tour coach to the Great Wall. Any later and you'll miss it.

q: 这句话是什么意思？
Zhè jù huà shì shénme yìsi?
What does this mean?
o: 如果早点儿出门，还来得及坐旅游大巴去长城。
Rúguǒ zǎo diǎnr chūmén, hái lái de jí zuò lǚyóu dàbā qù Chángchéng.
If you leave early, there's still time to take the coach.
不管几点出门，都来得及坐旅游大巴去长城。
Bùguǎn jǐ diǎn chūmén, dōu lái de jí zuò lǚyóu dàbā qù Chángchéng.
Whenever you leave, you'll make the coach.
如果早点儿出门，就有时间打的去长城。
Rúguǒ zǎo diǎnr chūmén, jiù yǒu shíjiān dǎdī qù Chángchéng.
If you leave early, there's time to take a taxi.
如果晚点儿离开家，也有时间坐旅游大巴去长城。
Rúguǒ wǎn diǎnr líkāi jiā, yě yǒu shíjiān zuò lǚyóu dàbā qù Chángchéng.
Even if you leave late, you'll make the coach.

lines: 今天老师留了这么多作业，我哪儿做得完呀？
Jīntiān lǎoshī liú le zhème duō zuòyè, wǒ nǎr zuò de wán ya?
The teacher set so much homework today. How am I supposed to finish it?

q: 这句话的意思是什么？
Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì shénme?
What does this mean?
o: Zuòyè bù duō, tā néng wánchéng.
Not much homework, and he can finish it.
Zuòyè bù duō, tā wán bu chéng.
Not much homework, but he can't finish it.
Zuòyè tài duō, tā wán bu chéng.
Too much homework, and he can't finish it.
Zuòyè hěn duō, tā néng wánchéng.
Lots of homework, but he can finish it.

lines: 我的眼睛最近有点儿问题，看书的时候离得远一点儿就看不清了。
Wǒ de yǎnjing zuìjìn yǒudiǎnr wèntí, kàn shū de shíhou lí de yuǎn yìdiǎnr jiù kàn bu qīng le.
Something's wrong with my eyes lately. When I read, I can't see clearly if the book's a bit far away.

q: 他的眼睛有什么问题？
Tā de yǎnjing yǒu shénme wèntí?
What's wrong with his eyes?
o: Kàn bu qīng bǐjiào jìn de zì.
He can't see nearby text clearly.
Kàn bu qīng yuǎn yìdiǎnr de zì.
He can't see text a bit further away.
Néng kànqīng hěn yuǎn de zì.
He can see text far away.
能看清很近的字和很远的字。
Néng kànqīng hěn jìn de zì hé hěn yuǎn de zì.
He can see both near and far text.

lines: 这件大衣太贵了，我怎么买得起呢？
Zhè jiàn dàyī tài guì le, wǒ zěnme mǎi de qǐ ne?
This coat is far too expensive. How could I afford it?

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: Tā bù xiǎng mǎi zhè jiàn dàyī.
Tā bù xǐhuan zhè jiàn dàyī.
他没有这么多钱买这件大衣。
Tā méiyǒu zhème duō qián mǎi zhè jiàn dàyī.

他这个月的钱已经花完了。
Tā zhège yuè de qián yǐjīng huāwán le.

lines: 这台电脑我现在用不着，如果你要用的话就先拿去用吧。
Zhè tái diànnǎo wǒ xiànzài yòng bu zháo, rúguǒ nǐ yào yòng de huà jiù xiān náqu yòng ba.
I don't need this computer right now. If you need it, take it and use it.

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: The listener can borrow the computer.

lines: 谢谢你帮我买到了飞机票，要不我就回不了国了。
Xièxie nǐ bāng wǒ mǎidào le fēijī piào, yàobù wǒ jiù huí bu liǎo guó le.
Thanks for getting me a plane ticket. Otherwise I couldn't have gone home.

q: 说话人怎么了？
Shuōhuàrén zěnme le?
What's the speaker's situation?
o: Mǎi bu dào fēijī piào, hěn zháojí.
He can't get a ticket and is worried.

lines: 你要是能肯定出不了问题，那我就听你的。
Nǐ yàoshi néng kěndìng chū bu liǎo wèntí, nà wǒ jiù tīng nǐ de.

q: 从对话中，我们可以知道什么？

o: 老周能肯定不会出问题。
Lǎo Zhōu néng kěndìng bú huì chū wèntí.

老周不能肯定不会出问题。

女的不听老周的话，老周很不高兴。

lines: 刚刚讲过的问题，有没有哪个同学听不懂？
Gānggāng jiǎng guo de wèntí, yǒu méiyǒu nǎ ge tóngxué tīng bu dǒng?

Wǒ juéde lǎoshī yǐjīng jiǎng de hěn míngbai le.

q: 女的是什么意思？
Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?

o: 女的觉得老师应该再讲一遍。
Nǚ de juéde lǎoshī yīnggāi zài jiǎng yí biàn.

女的觉得这个问题没有意思。

女的觉得老师讲得很明白。
Nǚ de juéde lǎoshī jiǎng de hěn míngbai.
She thinks the teacher explained it clearly.

lines: 小王，你七月穿的那件衣服在哪儿能买得着？
Xiǎo Wáng, nǐ qīyuè chuān de nà jiàn yīfu zài nǎr néng mǎi de zháo?
Xiao Wang, where can I buy that top you wore in July?

q: 小王说的话是什么意思？
Xiǎo Wáng shuō de huà shì shénme yìsi?

Xiànzài shì xiàtiān, hái mǎi de dào nà zhǒng yīfu.

Xiànzài shì dōngtiān, yě mǎi de dào nà zhǒng yīfu.
It's winter, but you can still buy it.
现在是冬天，买不到那种衣服了。
Xiànzài shì dōngtiān, mǎi bu dào nà zhǒng yīfu le.

现在不是冬天，买不到那种衣服。

lines: 你点了这么多菜，咱们两个人吃得完吗？

q: 男的是什么意思？

o: Tā bú è, chī bu wán zhèxiē cài.

他饿坏了，吃得完这么多菜。
Tā è huài le, chī de wán zhème duō cài.
He's starving and can finish it all.
他们是两个人，吃得完这些菜。
Tāmen shì liǎng ge rén, chī de wán zhèxiē cài.
There are two of them, so they can finish it.
他等小英的时候吃了这么多菜。
Tā děng Xiǎo Yīng de shíhou chī le zhème duō cài.

q: 男的这两天怎么了？
Nán de zhè liǎng tiān zěnme le?
What's up with the man these last few days?
o: 病了，吃不下饭也睡不好觉。
Bìng le, chī bu xià fàn yě shuì bu hǎo jiào.

身体不舒服，饭吃得不多，睡觉也不好。
Shēntǐ bù shūfu, fàn chī de bù duō, shuìjiào yě bù hǎo.
He feels unwell and isn't eating or sleeping well.
要参加网球比赛，很紧张。
Yào cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài, hěn jǐnzhāng.
He's playing in a tennis match and is nervous.
要看网球比赛了，心里很高兴。
Yào kàn wǎngqiú bǐsài le, xīnli hěn gāoxìng.

lines: 你看，那件蓝色的大衣怎么样？那件灰色的也不错。

Look, what about that blue coat? The grey one's nice too.
黄的也不难看。不过我看都比不上那件红的。
Huáng de yě bù nánkàn. Búguò wǒ kàn dōu bǐ bu shàng nà jiàn hóng de.
The yellow one isn't bad either. But I don't think any of them beats the red one.

q: 女的认为哪件最好？
Nǚ de rènwéi nǎ jiàn zuì hǎo?

lines: 老孙，这么重的东西你一个人能搬得动吗？还是找个人来和你一起搬吧。
Lǎo Sūn, zhème zhòng de dōngxi nǐ yí ge rén néng bān de dòng ma? Háishi zhǎo ge rén lái hé nǐ yìqǐ bān ba.

q: 老孙的意思是什么？
Lǎo Sūn de yìsi shì shénme?
What does Lao Sun mean?
o: 他可以一点儿一点儿地搬。
Tā kěyǐ yìdiǎnr yìdiǎnr de bān.
He can move it bit by bit.
最好找个人和他一起搬。
Zuìhǎo zhǎo ge rén hé tā yìqǐ bān.

lines: 我怕来不及了，要不咱们打辆车吧。
Wǒ pà lái bu jí le, yàobù zánmen dǎ liàng chē ba.
I'm worried we won't make it. Shall we get a taxi?
不用，两点上课，就算走二十五分钟，到了那儿还有十分钟呢。
Búyòng, liǎng diǎn shàngkè, jiùsuàn zǒu èrshíwǔ fēnzhōng, dàole nàr hái yǒu shí fēnzhōng ne.
No need. Class is at two. Even if it takes 25 minutes to walk, we'll still have ten minutes to spare.

q: 现在是几点？
Xiànzài shì jǐ diǎn?
What time is it now?

blocks.note: 2:00, minus 10 minutes to spare, minus 25 minutes' walk, makes 1:25.

lines: 我看我还是算了吧，汉语太难了，我是学不会了。
Wǒ kàn wǒ háishi suàn le ba, Hànyǔ tài nán le, wǒ shì xué bu huì le.
I think I'll give up. Chinese is too hard. I'll never learn it.
别这样，学一点儿是一点儿。
Bié zhèyàng, xué yìdiǎnr shì yìdiǎnr.
Don't be like that. Every little bit you learn counts.

q: 女的是什么意思？
Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
What does the woman mean?
o: 能学会一点儿就不错了。
Néng xuéhuì yìdiǎnr jiù búcuò le.
Learning a little is good enough.
大家都得一点儿一点儿地学。
Dàjiā dōu děi yìdiǎnr yìdiǎnr de xué.
Everyone has to learn bit by bit.

blocks.note: 学一点儿是一点儿 means “every bit counts”. A fits that best, but B is close, so check against your book.

lines: 你最近常出差吗？怎么办公室里老是看不到你？
Nǐ zuìjìn cháng chūchāi ma? Zěnme bàngōngshì li lǎoshì kàn bu dào nǐ?

是啊，东南西北的，跑得我累死了。
Shì a, dōng nán xī běi de, pǎo de wǒ lèi sǐ le.
Yes, all over the place. I'm worn out from rushing around.

q: 从对话中我们可以知道什么？
Cóng duìhuà zhōng wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from the dialogue?
o: Nǚ de pǎobù pǎo de hěn lèi.
Nǚ de nǎr yě méi qù.
女的天天跑着去办公室。
Nǚ de tiāntiān pǎo zhe qù bàngōngshì.
She runs to the office every day.

lines: 我得换一个闹钟了，早上我都听不见它响。
Wǒ děi huàn yí ge nàozhōng le, zǎoshang wǒ dōu tīng bu jiàn tā xiǎng.
I need a new alarm clock. I can't even hear it go off in the morning.
不想起床的话，换闹钟也没用。
Bù xiǎng qǐchuáng de huà, huàn nàozhōng yě méi yòng.
If you don't want to get up, a new alarm won't help.

q: 女的是什么意思？
Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
What does the woman mean?
o: He should get a new alarm.
Nán de bù xǐhuan zǎo qǐ.
The man doesn't like getting up early.

lines: 工作太多了，这件事情我怕到时候完不成。
Gōngzuò tài duō le, zhè jiàn shìqing wǒ pà dào shíhou wán bu chéng.
There's too much work. I'm afraid I won't finish this in time.
没关系，完不成的话，晚一两天也没什么。
Méi guānxi, wán bu chéng de huà, wǎn yì liǎng tiān yě méi shénme.
Don't worry. If you can't finish, a day or two late is fine.

q: 女的是什么意思？
Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
What does the woman mean?
o: It's OK to finish a few days late.
Kěyǐ bú zuò zhè jiàn shì.
He doesn't have to do it.
It can be finished any time.

grammar: V得/不 + 了 (liǎo)
can / can't (at all)
了 read liǎo after 得 or 不 asks whether something is possible at all: 回不了国 (can't get home), 肯定不了 (can't be sure).
要不我就回不了国了。
Yàobù wǒ jiù huí bu liǎo guó le.
Otherwise I couldn't have gone home.
今天我去不了了。
Jīntiān wǒ qù bu liǎo le.
I can't make it today.
V得起 / V不起
can / can't afford
起 here means having the means to do it.
我怎么买得起呢？
Wǒ zěnme mǎi de qǐ ne?
How could I afford it?
这么贵的饭馆我吃不起。
Zhème guì de fànguǎn wǒ chī bu qǐ.
I can't afford to eat at such an expensive restaurant.
哪儿 + V得 + result + 呀？
how could I possibly …?
This rhetorical 哪儿 means “no way”, not “where”.
我哪儿做得完呀？
Wǒ nǎr zuò de wán ya?
How am I supposed to finish it?
这么多东西，我哪儿拿得动？
Zhème duō dōngxi, wǒ nǎr ná de dòng?
How could I carry all this?
V得动 / V不动
can / can't move (heavy things)
动 shows whether you have the strength: 搬得动 (can carry it), 走不动 (can't walk any further).
这么重的东西你一个人能搬得动吗？
Zhème zhòng de dōngxi nǐ yí ge rén néng bān de dòng ma?
Can you move something this heavy on your own?
我累得走不动了。
Wǒ lèi de zǒu bu dòng le.
I'm too tired to walk any further.
就算……，也/还……
even if …
就算 concedes a condition, and the result still holds.
就算走二十五分钟，到了那儿还有十分钟呢。
Jiùsuàn zǒu èrshíwǔ fēnzhōng, dàole nàr hái yǒu shí fēnzhōng ne.
Even if it takes 25 minutes to walk, we'll still have ten minutes to spare.
就算下雨，我也要去。
Jiùsuàn xià yǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.
Even if it rains, I'm going.
V得 + 我 + 累死了
so much that I'm …
This is a causative degree complement: 跑得我累死了 means “all that running wore me out”.
跑得我累死了。
Pǎo de wǒ lèi sǐ le.
I'm worn out from rushing around.
这个问题想得我头疼。
Zhège wèntí xiǎng de wǒ tóuténg.
Thinking about this has given me a headache.
gaps: 这么重的东西你一个人能搬得
走二十五分钟，到了那儿还有十分钟呢。
say: The teacher set so much homework today. How am I supposed to finish it?
This coat is far too expensive. How could I afford it?
I'm worried we won't make it. Shall we get a taxi?
Don't be like that. Every little bit you learn counts.

057.title: Can he get tickets?
057.sub: Yu Fei queues all night for concert tickets, with six questions
057.transcriptNote: A short story, then six questions. The answers are my own wording. The story continues in part 058.

blocks.label: 故事
lines: 飞龙乐队要在北郊体育场开演唱会了。
Fēilóng Yuèduì yào zài běijiāo tǐyùchǎng kāi yǎnchànghuì le.
The band Feilong is going to play a concert at the stadium in the northern suburbs.
小青是飞龙乐队的粉丝，
Xiǎo Qīng shì Fēilóng Yuèduì de fěnsī,
Xiao Qing is a Feilong fan,
一直就非常希望能观看这个乐队的演唱会。
yìzhí jiù fēicháng xīwàng néng guānkàn zhège yuèduì de yǎnchànghuì.
and she's always longed to see them live.
她这个愿望是不是满足得了，那就得看她的男朋友于飞了。
Tā zhège yuànwàng shì bu shì mǎnzú de liǎo, nà jiù děi kàn tā de nánpéngyou Yú Fēi le.
Whether her wish comes true depends on her boyfriend, Yu Fei.
于飞要是买得到票，小青就会高兴，
Yú Fēi yàoshi mǎi de dào piào, Xiǎo Qīng jiù huì gāoxìng,
If Yu Fei can get tickets, Xiao Qing will be happy,
所以，于飞决定半夜就去排队买票。
suǒyǐ, Yú Fēi juédìng bànyè jiù qù páiduì mǎi piào.
so Yu Fei decided to start queuing for tickets in the middle of the night.
为了能让小青高兴，自己吃点儿苦没什么。
Wèile néng ràng Xiǎo Qīng gāoxìng, zìjǐ chī diǎnr kǔ méi shénme.
A bit of hardship is nothing if it makes Xiao Qing happy.
排了好几个小时的队，于飞终于买到了两张票。
Pái le hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí de duì, Yú Fēi zhōngyú mǎidào le liǎng zhāng piào.
After queuing for hours, Yu Fei finally got two tickets.
虽然座位不太好，可能根本看不清舞台上的演员，
Suīrán zuòwèi bú tài hǎo, kěnéng gēnběn kàn bu qīng wǔtái shang de yǎnyuán,
The seats weren't great, and they might not see the performers on stage at all,
可那也比买不到票好啊。
kě nà yě bǐ mǎi bu dào piào hǎo a.
but that's still better than no tickets.
要是真的买不到票，那于飞今天的日子可就过不好了。
Yàoshi zhēn de mǎi bu dào piào, nà Yú Fēi jīntiān de rìzi kě jiù guò bu hǎo le.
If he hadn't got any, Yu Fei would have had a very bad day.

blocks.label: 问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 飞龙乐队要在哪儿开演唱会？
Fēilóng Yuèduì yào zài nǎr kāi yǎnchànghuì?
Where is Feilong playing?
ans: 在北郊体育场。
Zài běijiāo tǐyùchǎng.
At the stadium in the northern suburbs.

q: 小青听说过这个乐队吗？
Xiǎo Qīng tīngshuō guo zhège yuèduì ma?
Has Xiao Qing heard of the band?
ans: 听说过，她是这个乐队的粉丝。
Tīngshuō guo, tā shì zhège yuèduì de fěnsī.
Yes, she's a fan.

q: 于飞买得到票或买不到票，小青会怎么样？
Yú Fēi mǎi de dào piào huò mǎi bu dào piào, Xiǎo Qīng huì zěnmeyàng?
How will Xiao Qing feel if Yu Fei does or doesn't get tickets?
ans: 买得到，她就会高兴；买不到，她就会不高兴。
Mǎi de dào, tā jiù huì gāoxìng; mǎi bu dào, tā jiù huì bù gāoxìng.
Happy if he gets them, unhappy if he doesn't.

q: 于飞为什么要半夜去排队？
Yú Fēi wèishénme yào bànyè qù páiduì?
Why does Yu Fei queue in the middle of the night?
ans: 为了能买到票，让小青高兴。
Wèile néng mǎidào piào, ràng Xiǎo Qīng gāoxìng.
To make sure he gets tickets and makes Xiao Qing happy.

q: 他最后买到票了吗？买到了什么样的票？
Tā zuìhòu mǎidào piào le ma? Mǎidào le shénmeyàng de piào?
Did he get tickets in the end? What kind?
ans: 买到了两张，可是座位不太好。
Mǎidào le liǎng zhāng, kěshì zuòwèi bú tài hǎo.
Yes, two, but the seats aren't very good.

q: 为什么说如果于飞没有买到票，他今天的日子会过不好？
Wèishénme shuō rúguǒ Yú Fēi méiyǒu mǎidào piào, tā jīntiān de rìzi huì guò bu hǎo?
Why would Yu Fei have had a bad day without tickets?
ans: 因为小青会很不高兴。
Yīnwèi Xiǎo Qīng huì hěn bù gāoxìng.
Because Xiao Qing would be very upset.

grammar: 那就得看……了
that depends on …
得看 means “it depends on”.
那就得看她的男朋友于飞了。
Nà jiù děi kàn tā de nánpéngyou Yú Fēi le.
That depends on her boyfriend, Yu Fei.
去不去，得看天气。
Qù bu qù, děi kàn tiānqì.
Whether we go depends on the weather.
in order to …
为了 gives the purpose, and the main clause gives the action taken.
为了能让小青高兴，自己吃点儿苦没什么。
Wèile néng ràng Xiǎo Qīng gāoxìng, zìjǐ chī diǎnr kǔ méi shénme.
A bit of hardship is nothing if it makes Xiao Qing happy.
为了学好汉语，他每天练习。
Wèile xuéhǎo Hànyǔ, tā měi tiān liànxí.
He practises every day to learn Chinese well.
排了……的队
to queue for …
With a separable verb, the duration goes in the middle: 排了好几个小时的队.
排了好几个小时的队，于飞终于买到了两张票。
Pái le hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí de duì, Yú Fēi zhōngyú mǎidào le liǎng zhāng piào.
After queuing for hours, Yu Fei finally got two tickets.
我睡了八个小时的觉。
Wǒ shuì le bā ge xiǎoshí de jiào.
I slept for eight hours.
……也比……好
still better than …
This admits something is bad, but not as bad as the alternative.
可那也比买不到票好啊。
Kě nà yě bǐ mǎi bu dào piào hǎo a.
But that's still better than no tickets.
慢一点儿也比不去好。
Màn yìdiǎnr yě bǐ bú qù hǎo.
Slow is still better than not going.
gaps: 可能根本看不清舞台上的
say: Xiao Qing is a Feilong fan.
If Yu Fei can get tickets, Xiao Qing will be happy.
After queuing for hours, Yu Fei finally got two tickets.
But that's still better than no tickets.

058.title: Can they get home tonight?
058.sub: After the concert: no bus, no taxi, no train
058.transcriptNote: A short narrated monologue that continues the story from part 057. It has no questions.

blocks.label: 独白
lines: Jīntiān huí de liǎo jiā ma
演唱会散场了，可是要坐公交车回家的人太多了，
Yǎnchànghuì sànchǎng le, kěshì yào zuò gōngjiāochē huí jiā de rén tài duō le,
The concert's over, but there are far too many people trying to get the bus home.
每辆车都挤得不得了，连于飞这样的小伙子都挤不上去，
Měi liàng chē dōu jǐ de bùdéliǎo, lián Yú Fēi zhèyàng de xiǎohuǒzi dōu jǐ bu shàngqu,
Every bus is packed. Even a young man like Yu Fei can't squeeze on,
小青这样的女孩子就更挤不上去了。
Xiǎo Qīng zhèyàng de nǚháizi jiù gèng jǐ bu shàngqu le.
so a girl like Xiao Qing has even less chance.
打的回家吧，可是要打的的人也很多，
Dǎdī huí jiā ba, kěshì yào dǎdī de rén yě hěn duō,
Take a taxi, then? But lots of people want taxis too,
出租车又少，不知道什么时候才能打得着。
chūzūchē yòu shǎo, bù zhīdào shénme shíhou cái néng dǎ de zháo.
and there are hardly any, so who knows when they'll get one.
坐地铁吧，体育场在郊区，离最近的地铁站至少得走半个多小时。
Zuò dìtiě ba, tǐyùchǎng zài jiāoqū, lí zuì jìn de dìtiězhàn zhìshǎo děi zǒu bàn ge duō xiǎoshí.
The subway, then? The stadium's in the suburbs, and the nearest station is at least half an hour's walk.
于飞还好，可小青已经累得走不动了。
Yú Fēi hái hǎo, kě Xiǎo Qīng yǐjīng lèi de zǒu bu dòng le.
Yu Fei is OK, but Xiao Qing is too tired to walk any further.
你说说，这该怎么办？今天还回得了家吗？
Nǐ shuōshuo, zhè gāi zěnme bàn? Jīntiān hái huí de liǎo jiā ma?
So what are they supposed to do? Will they get home tonight?

grammar: even … can't, let alone …
This compares an easier case with a harder one.
连于飞这样的小伙子都挤不上去，小青这样的女孩子就更挤不上去了。
Lián Yú Fēi zhèyàng de xiǎohuǒzi dōu jǐ bu shàngqu, Xiǎo Qīng zhèyàng de nǚháizi jiù gèng jǐ bu shàngqu le.
Even Yu Fei can't squeeze on, so Xiao Qing has even less chance.
连老师都不知道，我就更不知道了。
Lián lǎoshī dōu bù zhīdào, wǒ jiù gèng bù zhīdào le.
Even the teacher doesn't know, so I certainly don't.
what about …? but …
The speaker suggests an option with 吧, then rules it out with 可是.
打的回家吧，可是要打的的人也很多。
Dǎdī huí jiā ba, kěshì yào dǎdī de rén yě hěn duō.
Take a taxi, then? But lots of people want taxis too.
去看电影吧，可是今天没时间。
Qù kàn diànyǐng ba, kěshì jīntiān méi shíjiān.
Go to the cinema, then? But there's no time today.
A 离 B 至少得……
A is at least … from B
离 gives the distance, and 至少 sets the minimum.
离最近的地铁站至少得走半个多小时。
Lí zuì jìn de dìtiězhàn zhìshǎo děi zǒu bàn ge duō xiǎoshí.
The nearest station is at least half an hour's walk.
这儿离机场至少一个小时。
Zhèr lí jīchǎng zhìshǎo yí ge xiǎoshí.
It's at least an hour to the airport from here.
累得 + V不动
too tired to …
A degree complement describing the effect of tiredness.
小青已经累得走不动了。
Xiǎo Qīng yǐjīng lèi de zǒu bu dòng le.
Xiao Qing is too tired to walk any further.
我累得说不出话来了。
Wǒ lèi de shuō bu chū huà lai le.
I'm too tired to speak.
gaps: 不知道什么时候才能打得
say: Take a taxi, then? But lots of people want taxis too.
Yu Fei is OK, but Xiao Qing is too tired to walk any further.
So what are they supposed to do? Will they get home tonight?

059.title: “I can't walk any more”
059.sub: Walking home after the concert, with four multiple-choice items
059.transcriptNote: 甲 is Xiao Qing and 乙 is Yu Fei. Speakers were assigned by voice pitch. The answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 于飞，还有多远啊？我走不动了。
Yú Fēi, hái yǒu duō yuǎn a? Wǒ zǒu bu dòng le.
Yu Fei, how much further? I can't walk any more.
我也累得走不动了。要不，咱们还是打的吧。
Wǒ yě lèi de zǒu bu dòng le. Yàobù, zánmen háishi dǎdī ba.
I'm worn out too. Maybe we should just get a taxi.
可是，咱们走了这么长时间，一辆空车也看不见呀。
Kěshì, zánmen zǒu le zhème cháng shíjiān, yí liàng kòng chē yě kàn bu jiàn ya.
But we've been walking all this time and haven't seen a single free taxi.
是啊，现在这么多人要回家，公交车和出租车又少，看得见空车那才奇怪呢。
Shì a, xiànzài zhème duō rén yào huí jiā, gōngjiāochē hé chūzūchē yòu shǎo, kàn de jiàn kòng chē nà cái qíguài ne.
True. With so many people going home and so few buses and taxis, it'd be a miracle to see a free one.
那怎么办？要不你背着我走吧。
Nà zěnme bàn? Yàobù nǐ bēi zhe wǒ zǒu ba.
So what do we do? How about you carry me?
要是平常，我一定会背你走。可是现在连我自己都走不动了，怎么能背得动你呢？
Yàoshi píngcháng, wǒ yídìng huì bēi nǐ zǒu. Kěshì xiànzài lián wǒ zìjǐ dōu zǒu bu dòng le, zěnme néng bēi de dòng nǐ ne?
Normally I'd carry you, of course. But I can barely walk myself. How could I carry you?
你再坚持一下吧，你看，前面就是地铁站了。
Nǐ zài jiānchí yíxià ba, nǐ kàn, qiánmiàn jiù shì dìtiězhàn le.
Hang in there a bit longer. Look, the subway station's just ahead.
在哪儿呢？我怎么看不见呀？
Zài nǎr ne? Wǒ zěnme kàn bu jiàn ya?
Where? Why can't I see it?

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 小青为什么走不动了？
Xiǎo Qīng wèishénme zǒu bu dòng le?
Why can't Xiao Qing walk any more?
o: Tā xiǎng ràng Yú Fēi bēi zhe tā.
She wants Yu Fei to carry her.
她累极了，再也不想走了。
Tā lèi jí le, zài yě bù xiǎng zǒu le.
She's exhausted and doesn't want to walk any more.
因为于飞累了，走不动了。
Yīnwèi Yú Fēi lèi le, zǒu bu dòng le.
Because Yu Fei is too tired.
Tā méiyǒu chī wǎnfàn, è le.
She skipped dinner and is hungry.

q: 为什么路上没有空出租车？
Wèishénme lù shang méiyǒu kòng chūzūchē?
Why are there no free taxis?
o: 时间太晚，出租车司机都下班了。
Shíjiān tài wǎn, chūzūchē sījī dōu xiàbān le.
It's too late, and the drivers have gone home.
打的的人多，出租车也多。
Dǎdī de rén duō, chūzūchē yě duō.
Lots of people want taxis, and there are lots of taxis.
时间太早，出租车司机还没上班。
Shíjiān tài zǎo, chūzūchē sījī hái méi shàngbān.
It's too early, and the drivers haven't started.
要坐车的人太多，出租车太少。
Yào zuò chē de rén tài duō, chūzūchē tài shǎo.
Too many people want rides, and there are too few taxis.

q: 于飞什么时候会很高兴地背着小青走路？
Yú Fēi shénme shíhou huì hěn gāoxìng de bēi zhe Xiǎo Qīng zǒulù?
When would Yu Fei happily carry Xiao Qing?
o: píngcháng méi chī fàn de shíhou

q: 你说，他们最后是怎么回家的？
Nǐ shuō, tāmen zuìhòu shì zěnme huí jiā de?
How do you think they got home in the end?
o: Yú Fēi bēi zhe Xiǎo Qīng zǒu huí jiā.
Yu Fei carried Xiao Qing home.
一直走到地铁站，坐地铁回家。
Yìzhí zǒudào dìtiězhàn, zuò dìtiě huí jiā.
They walked to the station and took the subway.

grammar: 要不……吧
how about …
要不 offers an alternative suggestion.
要不，咱们还是打的吧。
Yàobù, zánmen háishi dǎdī ba.
Maybe we should just get a taxi.
要不我们明天再去吧。
Yàobù wǒmen míngtiān zài qù ba.
How about we go tomorrow instead?
一 + MW + 也 + 看不见
not even one
一辆空车也看不见 means “not one free taxi in sight”.
一辆空车也看不见呀。
Yí liàng kòng chē yě kàn bu jiàn ya.
Not a single free taxi in sight.
教室里一个人也没有。
Jiàoshì li yí ge rén yě méiyǒu.
There's nobody in the classroom.
……那才奇怪呢
now that would be strange
才 stresses that the opposite situation would be the surprising one.
看得见空车那才奇怪呢。
Kàn de jiàn kòng chē nà cái qíguài ne.
It'd be a miracle to see a free one.
他不迟到那才奇怪呢。
Tā bù chídào nà cái qíguài ne.
It'd be strange if he weren't late.
要是平常，……可是现在……
normally …, but now …
This contrasts usual behaviour with the present situation.
要是平常，我一定会背你走。可是现在连我自己都走不动了。
Yàoshi píngcháng, wǒ yídìng huì bēi nǐ zǒu. Kěshì xiànzài lián wǒ zìjǐ dōu zǒu bu dòng le.
Normally I'd carry you, but I can barely walk myself.
要是平常，我会去。可是今天太忙了。
Yàoshi píngcháng, wǒ huì qù. Kěshì jīntiān tài máng le.
Normally I'd go, but today I'm too busy.
gaps: 于飞，还有多远啊？我走不
say: Yu Fei, how much further? I can't walk any more.
I'm worn out too. Maybe we should just get a taxi.
Hang in there a bit longer. Look, the subway station's just ahead.

060.title: Vocabulary list
060.transcriptNote: The words in the order they're read: verbs, adjectives and adverbs, measure words, nouns, then names. Single words were matched to how parts 061–063 use them.

blocks.note: Matched to the texts: 挥 (heard as 硅 or 灰; part 062 has 挥着胳膊), 渴 (part 063 has 又渴又饿), 排 and 场 (heard as 还 and 厂), 腿 (heard as 鬼) and 城市 (heard as 尝试). 轻骑 (heard as 清骑) is my best guess and fits 你的轻骑怎么坏了呢 in part 063.

061.title: How the new words are used
061.transcriptNote: Each group takes one word from the vocabulary in part 060 and uses it in short phrases. Some group numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: playing wind and string instruments and singing

blocks.h: 演 yǎn · to perform, to act
停 tíng · to stop; to park

lines: huā le wǒ liǎng bǎi kuài
zhǐ huā le hěn shǎo de qián
huā le yì zhěng tiān de shíjiān
huā le hěn dà de lìqi

to lead him by the hand
