062.title: After the concert
062.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. It retells parts 057–059 in more detail and continues in part 063. The recording has no title line, so the title here is mine.

lines: 听完了演唱会以后，于飞一整天都兴奋得坐不住。
Tīngwán le yǎnchànghuì yǐhòu, Yú Fēi yì zhěng tiān dōu xīngfèn de zuò bu zhù.
On the day of the concert, Yu Fei was too excited to sit still all day.
老师讲课，他连一句也听不进，
Lǎoshī jiǎngkè, tā lián yí jù yě tīng bu jìn,
He didn't take in a single word of the lectures.
脑子里就想着一件事——今天晚上的那场演唱会。
nǎozi li jiù xiǎng zhe yí jiàn shì — jīntiān wǎnshang de nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì.
All he could think about was that night's concert.
他和他女朋友小青都是飞龙乐队的歌迷。
Tā hé tā nǚpéngyou Xiǎo Qīng dōu shì Fēilóng Yuèduì de gēmí.
He and his girlfriend Xiao Qing are both Feilong fans.
一个月以前，于飞怕买不着票，半夜就去排队，好不容易才买到两张。
Yí ge yuè yǐqián, Yú Fēi pà mǎi bu zháo piào, bànyè jiù qù páiduì, hǎobù róngyì cái mǎidào liǎng zhāng.
A month earlier, worried he wouldn't get tickets, Yu Fei had queued in the middle of the night and finally got two.
虽然座位是最后一排的，但他还是觉得很幸运。
Suīrán zuòwèi shì zuìhòu yì pái de, dàn tā háishi juéde hěn xìngyùn.
Even though the seats were in the back row, he still felt very lucky.
演唱会在北郊体育场举行。
The concert was at the stadium in the northern suburbs.
于飞和小青从市中心先坐六号地铁到终点站，然后换三八四路公交车，又坐了三站才到。
Yú Fēi hé Xiǎo Qīng cóng shì zhōngxīn xiān zuò liù hào dìtiě dào zhōngdiǎnzhàn, ránhòu huàn sān bā sì lù gōngjiāochē, yòu zuò le sān zhàn cái dào.
From the city centre they took Line 6 to the last stop, changed to the 384 bus, and rode three more stops.
Bā diǎn zhěng, yǎnchànghuì kāishǐ le.
At eight o'clock sharp, the concert began.
他们俩根本看不清楚舞台上的歌手，
Tāmen liǎ gēnběn kàn bu qīngchu wǔtái shang de gēshǒu,
They couldn't see the singers on stage at all,
也和其他的观众们一样，不停地向他们挥着胳膊，激动得又叫又跳。
yě hé qítā de guānzhòngmen yíyàng, bù tíng de xiàng tāmen huī zhe gēbo, jīdòng de yòu jiào yòu tiào.
but like the rest of the crowd they kept waving their arms, shouting and jumping with excitement.
他们一边小声地唱着刚才听到的歌曲，一边跟着人群往公交车站走。
tāmen yìbiān xiǎoshēng de chàng zhe gāngcái tīngdào de gēqǔ, yìbiān gēn zhe rénqún wǎng gōngjiāochē zhàn zǒu.
Quietly singing the songs they'd just heard, they followed the crowd to the bus stop.
可是，车站周围站着一大群人，最后只来了一辆，还是末班车。
Kěshì, chēzhàn zhōuwéi zhàn zhe yí dà qún rén, zuìhòu zhǐ lái le yí liàng, hái shì mòbānchē.
But there was a huge crowd at the stop, and only one more bus came, and that was the last one.
他们俩用力挤了半天也没挤上去。
Tāmen liǎ yònglì jǐ le bàntiān yě méi jǐ shangqu.
They pushed and squeezed for ages but couldn't get on.
那，多花些钱打的吧，或者跟别人拼车也行。
Nà, duō huā xiē qián dǎdī ba, huòzhě gēn biérén pīnchē yě xíng.
Spend a bit more and take a taxi, then, or share one with someone.
可是，连出租车也打不着。
Kěshì, lián chūzūchē yě dǎ bu zháo.
But they couldn't even get a taxi.
不是方向不对，就是人已经太多了，司机说坐不下。
Bú shì fāngxiàng bú duì, jiù shì rén yǐjīng tài duō le, sījī shuō zuò bu xià.
Either they were going the wrong way, or they were already too full and the driver said there was no room.
没有别的办法，只剩下两条腿了。
Méiyǒu biéde bànfǎ, zhǐ shèngxia liǎng tiáo tuǐ le.
There was nothing for it but to walk.
最后一班地铁是十二点五分，于飞看了看手表，算了一下时间，也许还来得及。
Zuìhòu yì bān dìtiě shì shí'èr diǎn wǔ fēn, Yú Fēi kàn le kàn shǒubiǎo, suàn le yíxià shíjiān, yěxǔ hái lái de jí.
The last train was at 12:05. Yu Fei looked at his watch and worked out that they might still make it.

grammar: adj + 得 + V不住
so … one can't …
兴奋得坐不住 means “too excited to sit still”. 不住 means unable to hold steady.
于飞一整天都兴奋得坐不住。
Yú Fēi yì zhěng tiān dōu xīngfèn de zuò bu zhù.
Yu Fei was too excited to sit still all day.
他高兴得睡不着。
Tā gāoxìng de shuì bu zháo.
He was too happy to sleep.
V不进 / V不着
can't take in / can't get
Potential complements with other result words: 听不进 (can't take in), 买不着 (can't get hold of), 打不着 (can't get a taxi).
老师讲课，他连一句也听不进。
Lǎoshī jiǎngkè, tā lián yí jù yě tīng bu jìn.
He didn't take in a single word.
这么早，买不着早饭。
Zhème zǎo, mǎi bu zháo zǎofàn.
You can't get breakfast this early.
先……到……，然后换……
first … to …, then change to …
This describes a journey with a change of transport.
先坐六号地铁到终点站，然后换三八四路公交车。
Xiān zuò liù hào dìtiě dào zhōngdiǎnzhàn, ránhòu huàn sān bā sì lù gōngjiāochē.
Take Line 6 to the last stop, then change to the 384 bus.
你先坐地铁，然后换公交车。
Nǐ xiān zuò dìtiě, ránhòu huàn gōngjiāochē.
Take the subway first, then change to a bus.
V了半天也没 V上去
tried for ages but couldn't …
半天 means “ages”, and 也没 shows it still didn't work.
他们俩用力挤了半天也没挤上去。
Tāmen liǎ yònglì jǐ le bàntiān yě méi jǐ shangqu.
They pushed for ages but couldn't get on.
我找了半天也没找到。
Wǒ zhǎo le bàntiān yě méi zhǎodào.
I looked for ages but couldn't find it.
只剩下两条腿了
nothing for it but to walk
Literally “only our two legs are left”, a humorous way of saying “we'll have to walk”.
没有别的办法，只剩下两条腿了。
Méiyǒu biéde bànfǎ, zhǐ shèngxia liǎng tiáo tuǐ le.
There was nothing for it but to walk.
钱都花完了，只剩下十块了。
Qián dōu huāwán le, zhǐ shèngxia shí kuài le.
I've spent everything. Only ten yuan left.
gaps: 他和他女朋友小青都是飞龙乐队的
他们俩根本看不清楚舞台上的
没有别的办法，只剩下两条
say: He and his girlfriend Xiao Qing are both Feilong fans.
At eight o'clock sharp, the concert began.
They pushed and squeezed for ages but couldn't get on.
The last train was at 12:05.

063.title: Made it at last
063.sub: Yu Fei and Xiao Qing walk to the subway
063.transcriptNote: 甲 is Xiao Qing and 乙 is Yu Fei. Speakers were assigned by voice pitch. It continues from part 062.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 于飞和小青手拉着手，一边走一边说话。
Yú Fēi hé Xiǎo Qīng shǒu lā zhe shǒu, yìbiān zǒu yìbiān shuōhuà.
Yu Fei and Xiao Qing walk hand in hand, chatting.
哎，你说，你的轻骑怎么坏了呢？
Āi, nǐ shuō, nǐ de qīngqí zěnme huài le ne?
Hey, how come your moped broke down?
Jiù shì tài bù qiǎo le.
我听说国外有些大城市，路边有自助式出租的自行车，
Wǒ tīngshuō guówài yǒuxiē dà chéngshì, lùbiān yǒu zìzhùshì chūzū de zìxíngchē,
I've heard some big cities abroad have self-service rental bikes by the roadside,
骑车出门的人越来越多。
qí chē chūmén de rén yuèláiyuè duō.
and more and more people go out by bike.
咱们这儿也有啊，你看见过吧？
Zánmen zhèr yě yǒu a, nǐ kànjiàn guo ba?
We have them here too. Haven't you seen them?
有的报亭旁边停放着一些红黄两色的车，可是很少有人用。
Yǒude bàotíng pángbiān tíngfàng zhe yìxiē hóng huáng liǎng sè de chē, kěshì hěn shǎo yǒu rén yòng.
There are red and yellow ones parked next to some newsstands, but hardly anyone uses them.
以前，外国人都说中国是自行车王国，
Yǐqián, wàiguórén dōu shuō Zhōngguó shì zìxíngchē wángguó,
Foreigners used to call China the kingdom of bicycles.
现在呢，到处都是汽车，还经常堵车，城市交通成了大问题。
xiànzài ne, dàochù dōu shì qìchē, hái jīngcháng dǔchē, chéngshì jiāotōng chéng le dà wèntí.
Now there are cars everywhere, traffic jams all the time, and city traffic has become a big problem.
于飞，我又渴又饿，实在走不动了。
Yú Fēi, wǒ yòu kě yòu è, shízài zǒu bu dòng le.
Yu Fei, I'm thirsty and hungry, and I really can't walk any more.
这双鞋也不合适，脚疼得厉害。
Zhè shuāng xié yě bù héshì, jiǎo téng de lìhai.
These shoes don't fit either. My feet are killing me.
哎，你看，前面那个路口一拐过去就是地铁站。
Āi, nǐ kàn, qiánmiàn nàge lùkǒu yì guǎi guoqu jiù shì dìtiězhàn.
Hey, look! Turn at that junction ahead, and it's the subway station.
现在十二点整，咱们肯定能赶得上末班车。
Xiànzài shí'èr diǎn zhěng, zánmen kěndìng néng gǎn de shàng mòbānchē.
It's exactly twelve. We'll definitely catch the last train.
太好了！终于到了，快跑吧！
Tài hǎo le! Zhōngyú dào le, kuài pǎo ba!
Great! We made it. Let's run!
用不着跑，你不是脚疼吗？
Yòng bu zháo pǎo, nǐ bú shì jiǎo téng ma?
No need to run. Didn't you say your feet hurt?
No problem, they don't hurt any more!

grammar: 就是太……了
it's just too …
就是 here means “simply, just”: it was nothing more than bad luck.
就是太不巧了。
Jiù shì tài bù qiǎo le.
Just bad luck.
这件衣服挺好的，就是太贵了。
Zhè jiàn yīfu tǐng hǎo de, jiù shì tài guì le.
This top is nice, it's just too expensive.
以前……，现在呢，……
before …, but now …
呢 after 现在 marks the contrast with the past.
以前，外国人都说中国是自行车王国，现在呢，到处都是汽车。
Yǐqián, wàiguórén dōu shuō Zhōngguó shì zìxíngchē wángguó, xiànzài ne, dàochù dōu shì qìchē.
Foreigners used to call China the kingdom of bicycles. Now there are cars everywhere.
以前这儿很安静，现在呢，到处都是人。
Yǐqián zhèr hěn ānjìng, xiànzài ne, dàochù dōu shì rén.
It used to be quiet here. Now there are people everywhere.
both … and …
This joins two adjectives describing the same state.
我又渴又饿，实在走不动了。
Wǒ yòu kě yòu è, shízài zǒu bu dòng le.
I'm thirsty and hungry, and I really can't walk any more.
这个菜又便宜又好吃。
Zhège cài yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
This dish is cheap and tasty.
V得厉害
terribly …
厉害 after 得 means an extreme degree, usually of something unpleasant.
脚疼得厉害。
Jiǎo téng de lìhai.
My feet are killing me.
外面风刮得厉害。
Wàimiàn fēng guā de lìhai.
The wind is blowing hard outside.
一 V 过去就是……
as soon as you …, there's …
一 + V + 就 shows something comes right after you do the first action.
前面那个路口一拐过去就是地铁站。
Qiánmiàn nàge lùkǒu yì guǎi guoqu jiù shì dìtiězhàn.
Turn at that junction ahead, and it's the subway station.
一出门就是公园。
Yì chūmén jiù shì gōngyuán.
The park's right outside the door.
gaps: 现在呢，到处都是汽车，还经常
这双鞋也不合适，脚疼得
say: Just bad luck.
I'm thirsty and hungry, and I really can't walk any more.
It's exactly twelve. We'll definitely catch the last train.
No problem, they don't hurt any more!

064.title: Vocabulary list
064.transcriptNote: The words in the order they're read. The English introduction isn't transcribed. Single words were matched to how parts 065–070 use them.

lines: Unclear word, so check your book
blocks.note: Matched to the texts: 搬 (heard as 班; part 070 has a 搬 group), 幅 (heard as 福; part 065 has 一幅山水画), 不时地 (heard as 不实的) and 村子 (heard as 墩子). The word at 0:50, heard as 古, 鼓 or 骨, is unclear. 古 (as in 古树, old trees in part 067) is my best guess.

065.title: Ten sentences
065.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences. Several use doubled adjectives (安安静静, 热热闹闹, 绿油油). Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 因为城里空气不好，爸爸把家搬到了乡下。
Yīnwèi chéng li kōngqì bù hǎo, bàba bǎ jiā bāndào le xiāngxia.
The air in the city was bad, so Dad moved the family to the countryside.
图书馆里安安静静的，很适合复习功课。
Túshūguǎn li ān'ānjìngjìng de, hěn shìhé fùxí gōngkè.
The library is lovely and quiet, perfect for revising.
拐了个弯儿，眼前突然出现了一条热热闹闹的大街。
Guǎi le ge wānr, yǎnqián tūrán chūxiàn le yì tiáo rèrènāonāo de dàjiē.
We turned a corner, and suddenly a bustling street appeared in front of us.
小王刚从公园跑步回来，满身都是汗。
Xiǎo Wáng gāng cóng gōngyuán pǎobù huílai, mǎn shēn dōu shì hàn.
Xiao Wang has just come back from a run in the park, dripping with sweat.
儿子饿坏了，一连吃了三碗饭。
Érzi è huài le, yìlián chī le sān wǎn fàn.
Our son was starving and ate three bowls of rice in a row.
在画家的笔下，很快就出现了一幅美丽的山水画。
Zài huàjiā de bǐ xià, hěn kuài jiù chūxiàn le yì fú měilì de shānshuǐ huà.
Under the painter's brush, a beautiful landscape painting soon appeared.
他想起了三年前的事儿，一切都好像就发生在眼前。
Tā xiǎngqǐ le sān nián qián de shìr, yíqiè dōu hǎoxiàng jiù fāshēng zài yǎnqián.
He remembered what happened three years ago, as if it were all happening before his eyes.
你只要往外面看一下，就可以看到春天已经到来了。
Nǐ zhǐyào wǎng wàimiàn kàn yíxià, jiù kěyǐ kàndào chūntiān yǐjīng dàolái le.
Just look outside and you'll see that spring has arrived.
小猫躺在窗前，不时地睁开眼看看我。
Xiǎo māo tǎng zài chuāng qián, bùshí de zhēngkāi yǎn kànkan wǒ.
The kitten lies by the window, opening its eyes now and then to look at me.
春天来了，树上长出了一片片绿油油的叶子。
Chūntiān lái le, shù shang zhǎngchū le yí piànpiàn lǜyóuyóu de yèzi.
Spring has come, and the trees are covered in lush green leaves.

grammar: AABB adjectives
very …, nice and …
Doubling a two-syllable adjective as AABB makes it vivid, and 的 usually follows: 安安静静的, 热热闹闹的.
图书馆里安安静静的。
Túshūguǎn li ān'ānjìngjìng de.
The library is lovely and quiet.
房间打扫得干干净净的。
Fángjiān dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng de.
The room has been cleaned spotless.
place + 出现了 + something
something appeared
Appearance verbs put the place first and the new thing after the verb.
眼前突然出现了一条热热闹闹的大街。
Yǎnqián tūrán chūxiàn le yì tiáo rèrènāonāo de dàjiē.
Suddenly a bustling street appeared in front of us.
门口来了一个人。
Ménkǒu lái le yí ge rén.
Someone has come to the door.
满 + noun + 都是
covered in …
满身都是汗 means “sweat all over”. 满 means the whole of something.
满身都是汗。
Mǎn shēn dōu shì hàn.
Dripping with sweat.
满地都是水。
Mǎn dì dōu shì shuǐ.
There's water all over the floor.
一连 + V + number
… in a row
一连 shows the action repeated without a break.
一连吃了三碗饭。
Yìlián chī le sān wǎn fàn.
Ate three bowls of rice in a row.
一连下了三天雨。
Yìlián xià le sān tiān yǔ.
It rained for three days straight.
ABB adjectives
vividly …
绿油油 is an adjective plus a doubled ending, and it's very descriptive.
树上长出了一片片绿油油的叶子。
Shù shang zhǎngchū le yí piànpiàn lǜyóuyóu de yèzi.
The trees are covered in lush green leaves.
她的头发黑亮亮的。
Tā de tóufa hēiliàngliàng de.
Her hair is glossy black.
gaps: 图书馆里安安静静的，很
出现了一条热热闹闹的大街。
小王刚从公园跑步回来，
往外面看一下，就可以看到春天已经到来了。
say: The library is lovely and quiet, perfect for revising.
Our son was starving and ate three bowls of rice in a row.
Just look outside and you'll see that spring has arrived.
Spring has come, and the trees are covered in lush green leaves.

066.title: Seven multiple-choice items
066.sub: Quiet rooms, odd clothes, and how a couple met
066.transcriptNote: Items 1–5 are short exchanges, and items 6–7 share one longer passage. The answer key is my own reading. 他 and 她 sound the same, and I chose by context.

lines: 教室里安安静静的，有人翻一下书都能听得清清楚楚。
Jiàoshì li ān'ānjìngjìng de, yǒu rén fān yíxià shū dōu néng tīng de qīngqīngchǔchǔ.
The classroom is so quiet you can clearly hear someone turning a page.

q: 说话人想说什么？
Shuōhuàrén xiǎng shuō shénme?
What is the speaker saying?
o: Jiàoshì li yǒu rén fān shū.
教室里只有翻书的声音。
Jiàoshì li zhǐ yǒu fān shū de shēngyīn.
The only sound is pages turning.
Jiàoshì li méiyǒu rén zài kàn shū.

lines: 明天就该交作业了，可是我现在还没写完，怎么办呢？
Míngtiān jiù gāi jiāo zuòyè le, kěshì wǒ xiànzài hái méi xiěwán, zěnme bàn ne?
The homework's due tomorrow and I still haven't finished. What do I do?
我早就说有事情要快点儿做，可你总是这样。
Wǒ zǎo jiù shuō yǒu shìqing yào kuài diǎnr zuò, kě nǐ zǒngshì zhèyàng.
I've always told you to get things done quickly, but you're always like this.

q: 女的为什么对男的这样说？
Nǚ de wèishénme duì nán de zhèyàng shuō?
Why does the woman say this?
o: 男的做事很快，他很生气。
Nán de zuò shì hěn kuài, tā hěn shēngqì.
He works fast and is angry.
男的做事很慢，他很高兴。
Nán de zuò shì hěn màn, tā hěn gāoxìng.
He works slowly and is happy.
男的没写完作业，他很不高兴。
Nán de méi xiěwán zuòyè, tā hěn bù gāoxìng.
He hasn't finished his homework and is upset.
男的写完了作业，明天可以交了。
Nán de xiěwán le zuòyè, míngtiān kěyǐ jiāo le.
He's finished and can hand it in tomorrow.

lines: 王小山的嗓子真是不错，可他总是穿一些奇奇怪怪的衣服，让人看了觉得不舒服。
Wáng Xiǎoshān de sǎngzi zhēn shì búcuò, kě tā zǒngshì chuān yìxiē qíqíguàiguài de yīfu, ràng rén kàn le juéde bù shūfu.
Wang Xiaoshan has a great voice, but he always wears such strange clothes that it's uncomfortable to look at.

q: 女的对王小山的看法是什么？
Nǚ de duì Wáng Xiǎoshān de kànfǎ shì shénme?
What does the woman think of Wang Xiaoshan?

blocks.note: C is also true (she praises his voice). B is her main criticism, so check your book for which one it wants.

lines: 你觉得这件衣服怎么样？
Nǐ juéde zhè jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng?
What do you think of this top?
有人说它很漂亮，可我觉得也没什么好看的。
Yǒu rén shuō tā hěn piàoliang, kě wǒ juéde yě méi shénme hǎokàn de.
Some people say it's pretty, but I don't think it's anything special.

q: 男的认为这件衣服怎么样？
Nán de rènwéi zhè jiàn yīfu zěnmeyàng?
What does the man think of it?
o: bǐ rénmen shuō de hái yào piàoliang

lines: 最近生意不太好，我的饭馆老是冷冷清清的，你那儿怎么样啊？
Zuìjìn shēngyi bú tài hǎo, wǒ de fànguǎn lǎoshì lěnglěngqīngqīng de, nǐ nàr zěnmeyàng a?
Business hasn't been good lately. My restaurant is always empty. How about yours?
也是一会儿好一会儿坏的。
Yě shì yíhuìr hǎo yíhuìr huài de.
Same here. Sometimes good, sometimes bad.

q: 男的那儿的生意怎么样？
Nán de nàr de shēngyi zěnmeyàng?
How is the man's business?

lines: 那是三十年前，我才二十多岁，
Nà shì sānshí nián qián, wǒ cái èrshí duō suì,
That was thirty years ago. I was only in my twenties.
每天上完课，做完作业，就去书店看书。
měi tiān shàngwán kè, zuòwán zuòyè, jiù qù shūdiàn kàn shū.
Every day after class and homework, I'd go to the bookshop to read.
第一次见到她就是在书店。
Dì yī cì jiàndào tā jiù shì zài shūdiàn.
That's where I first saw her.
那天，她穿着白白的衬衣、红红的裙子，头发长长的，眼睛大大的。
Nà tiān, tā chuān zhe báibái de chènyī, hónghóng de qúnzi, tóufa chángcháng de, yǎnjing dàdà de.
That day she wore a white blouse and a red skirt. She had long hair and big eyes.
她跟我一样，也喜欢看小说。
Tā gēn wǒ yíyàng, yě xǐhuan kàn xiǎoshuō.
Like me, she loved reading novels.
后来我们就认识了。她就是你们的妈妈。
Hòulái wǒmen jiù rènshi le. Tā jiù shì nǐmen de māma.
Then we got to know each other. She's your mother.

q: 男的多大了？
Nán de duō dà le?
How old is the man?
男的在说什么？
Nán de zài shuō shénme?
What is the man talking about?
o: tā niánqīng shí jīngcháng zuò de shì
what he did when he was young

blocks.note: Question 6: he was in his twenties thirty years ago, so he's in his fifties now.

grammar: ……都能 + V得清清楚楚
even … can be clearly …
都 here means “even”, and the doubled 清清楚楚 makes it vivid.
有人翻一下书都能听得清清楚楚。
Yǒu rén fān yíxià shū dōu néng tīng de qīngqīngchǔchǔ.
You can clearly hear someone turning a page.
他说的每个字我都听得清清楚楚。
Tā shuō de měi ge zì wǒ dōu tīng de qīngqīngchǔchǔ.
I heard every word he said perfectly clearly.
让人 + V了觉得……
makes people feel …
让人 means it affects anyone who sees or hears it.
让人看了觉得不舒服。
Ràng rén kàn le juéde bù shūfu.
It's uncomfortable to look at.
这个消息让人听了很高兴。
Zhège xiāoxi ràng rén tīng le hěn gāoxìng.
This news makes people happy.
没什么 + adj + 的
nothing … about it
This plays something down.
可我觉得也没什么好看的。
Kě wǒ juéde yě méi shénme hǎokàn de.
But I don't think it's anything special.
这个电影没什么意思。
Zhège diànyǐng méi shénme yìsi.
This film isn't very interesting.
一会儿……一会儿……
one moment …, the next …
This describes something that keeps changing.
也是一会儿好一会儿坏的。
Yě shì yíhuìr hǎo yíhuìr huài de.
Sometimes good, sometimes bad.
天气一会儿冷一会儿热。
Tiānqì yíhuìr lěng yíhuìr rè.
The weather keeps switching between hot and cold.
AA的 adjectives
nice and …
One-syllable adjectives doubled with 的 make descriptions vivid: 白白的, 红红的, 长长的, 大大的.
她穿着白白的衬衣、红红的裙子，头发长长的，眼睛大大的。
Tā chuān zhe báibái de chènyī, hónghóng de qúnzi, tóufa chángcháng de, yǎnjing dàdà de.
White blouse, red skirt, long hair, big eyes.
小孩的脸圆圆的。
Xiǎohái de liǎn yuányuán de.
The child has a nice round face.
gaps: 她穿着白白的衬衣、红红的
say: The classroom is so quiet you can clearly hear someone turning a page.
Business hasn't been good lately. My restaurant is always empty.
Same here. Sometimes good, sometimes bad.
That's where I first saw her.

067.title: Seeing the Yangtze
067.sub: A childhood climb up the mountain, with five multiple-choice items
067.transcriptNote: One speaker remembers climbing the mountain as a child, then five questions follow. The answer key is my own reading.

lines: 在我小的时候，我家住在乡下，
Zài wǒ xiǎo de shíhou, wǒ jiā zhù zài xiāngxia,
When I was little, my family lived in the countryside,
离长江不太远，而且就在一座大山的脚下。
lí Chángjiāng bú tài yuǎn, érqiě jiù zài yí zuò dà shān de jiǎo xià.
not far from the Yangtze, right at the foot of a big mountain.
村子周围是一片片的茶园，绿油油的，非常好看。
Cūnzi zhōuwéi shì yí piànpiàn de cháyuán, lǜyóuyóu de, fēicháng hǎokàn.
Around the village were tea plantations, lush and green and very pretty.
我总想让爸爸带我去山上看看，可爸爸总说没有时间。
Wǒ zǒng xiǎng ràng bàba dài wǒ qù shān shang kànkan, kě bàba zǒng shuō méiyǒu shíjiān.
I always wanted Dad to take me up the mountain, but he always said he had no time.
终于有一天，爸爸要上山，说要带我一起去。
Zhōngyú yǒu yì tiān, bàba yào shàng shān, shuō yào dài wǒ yìqǐ qù.
Finally, one day, Dad was going up the mountain and said he'd take me.
刚开始上山的时候，我们的四周都是高高的大树，看不到什么风景。
Gāng kāishǐ shàng shān de shíhou, wǒmen de sìzhōu dōu shì gāogāo de dà shù, kàn bu dào shénme fēngjǐng.
At first we were surrounded by tall trees and couldn't see much of the view.
再往上走了一会儿以后，大树慢慢地少了，景色变得越来越好看了。
Zài wǎng shàng zǒu le yíhuìr yǐhòu, dà shù mànmàn de shǎo le, jǐngsè biàn de yuèláiyuè hǎokàn le.
After climbing a bit higher, the trees thinned out and the view got better and better.
眼前是山石和古树，远处是大大小小的山头，更远的地方是平原。
Yǎnqián shì shānshí hé gǔ shù, yuǎnchù shì dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shāntóu, gèng yuǎn de dìfang shì píngyuán.
In front of us were rocks and ancient trees. In the distance were hilltops of all sizes, and further still, the plain.
一条长长的银色丝带在阳光下闪着光，那就是长江。
Yì tiáo chángcháng de yínsè sīdài zài yángguāng xià shǎn zhe guāng, nà jiù shì Chángjiāng.
A long silver ribbon glittered in the sunlight. That was the Yangtze.
它静静地流着，带着一条条小船，流到很远很远的地方。
Tā jìngjìng de liú zhe, dài zhe yì tiáotiáo xiǎo chuán, liúdào hěn yuǎn hěn yuǎn de dìfang.
It flowed quietly, carrying little boats far, far away.

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 他小时候住在什么地方？
Tā xiǎo shíhou zhù zài shénme dìfang?
Where did he live as a child?
村子周围的茶园是什么颜色的？
Cūnzi zhōuwéi de cháyuán shì shénme yánsè de?
What colour were the tea plantations?
他一直想做什么？
Tā yìzhí xiǎng zuò shénme?
What had he always wanted to do?
刚上山的时候，风景怎么样？
Gāng shàng shān de shíhou, fēngjǐng zěnmeyàng?
What was the view like at the start of the climb?
短文里没有说到什么？
Duǎnwén li méiyǒu shuōdào shénme?
What is NOT mentioned in the passage?
o: shān li gāogāo de dà shù

blocks.note: Question 5: the passage says the village is at the foot of a mountain, but never where the mountain is. Item 4's options were re-transcribed as one span, because the first pass cut them up.

grammar: 一片片 / 一条条
piece after piece, one after another
Doubling the measure word means “many of them”.
村子周围是一片片的茶园。
Cūnzi zhōuwéi shì yí piànpiàn de cháyuán.
Around the village were tea plantations.
天上飘着一朵朵白云。
Tiān shang piāo zhe yì duǒduǒ bái yún.
White clouds were drifting across the sky.
总想……，可……总说……
always wanted …, but … always said …
The repeated 总 shows a long-running pattern.
我总想让爸爸带我去山上看看，可爸爸总说没有时间。
Wǒ zǒng xiǎng ràng bàba dài wǒ qù shān shang kànkan, kě bàba zǒng shuō méiyǒu shíjiān.
I always wanted Dad to take me, but he always said he had no time.
我总想去中国，可总没有钱。
Wǒ zǒng xiǎng qù Zhōngguó, kě zǒng méiyǒu qián.
I always wanted to go to China, but never had the money.
变得越来越……
to become more and more …
变得 introduces the new state, and 越来越 shows the gradual change.
景色变得越来越好看了。
Jǐngsè biàn de yuèláiyuè hǎokàn le.
The view got better and better.
她变得越来越漂亮了。
Tā biàn de yuèláiyuè piàoliang le.
She's getting prettier and prettier.
眼前是……，远处是……，更远的地方是……
near …, far …, further still …
This describes a view layer by layer.
眼前是山石和古树，远处是大大小小的山头，更远的地方是平原。
Yǎnqián shì shānshí hé gǔ shù, yuǎnchù shì dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shāntóu, gèng yuǎn de dìfang shì píngyuán.
Rocks and trees nearby, hilltops in the distance, and further still, the plain.
近处是花园，远处是大海。
Jìnchù shì huāyuán, yuǎnchù shì dàhǎi.
Nearby is a garden, and in the distance the sea.
静静地 + V着
quietly …ing
Doubled adverb + 地 + verb + 着 describes a calm, ongoing action.
它静静地流着。
Tā jìngjìng de liú zhe.
It flowed quietly.
她静静地坐着。
Tā jìngjìng de zuò zhe.
She sat quietly.
gaps: 离长江不太远，而且就在一座大山的
一条长长的银色丝带在阳光下
say: When I was little, my family lived in the countryside.
Finally, one day, Dad was going up the mountain and said he'd take me.
The view got better and better.
A long silver ribbon glittered in the sunlight. That was the Yangtze.

068.title: Who's really rich?
068.sub: A rich father shows his son how the poor live, with three questions
068.transcriptNote: A story told by a narrator, then three multiple-choice items. The answer key is my own reading. The title is mine, since the recording doesn't announce one.

blocks.label: 故事
lines: 一天，一个有钱人带着儿子从城里到了乡下。
Yì tiān, yí ge yǒuqiánrén dài zhe érzi cóng chéng li dào le xiāngxia.
One day a rich man took his son from the city to the countryside.
他想让儿子看看穷人是怎样生活的。
Tā xiǎng ràng érzi kànkan qióngrén shì zěnyàng shēnghuó de.
He wanted his son to see how poor people live.
他们到了一个村子，在村里一户最穷的人家住了一天一夜。
Tāmen dào le yí ge cūnzi, zài cūn li yí hù zuì qióng de rénjiā zhù le yì tiān yí yè.
They went to a village and stayed a day and a night with the poorest family there.
旅行以后，父亲问儿子：“感觉怎么样？”
Lǚxíng yǐhòu, fùqin wèn érzi: “Gǎnjué zěnmeyàng?”
After the trip, the father asked his son, “How was it?”
“现在你该知道穷人是什么样的了吧？”
“Xiànzài nǐ gāi zhīdào qióngrén shì shénmeyàng de le ba?”
“So now you know what it's like to be poor?”
儿子回答：“是的，我知道了。”
Érzi huídá: “Shì de, wǒ zhīdào le.”
“你能说一下有钱人和穷人有什么不一样吗？”
“Nǐ néng shuō yíxià yǒuqiánrén hé qióngrén yǒu shénme bù yíyàng ma?”
“Can you tell me how the rich and the poor are different?”
The son thought for a moment and said,
“我们家里只有一只狗，可是他们家里有四只狗。
“Wǒmen jiā li zhǐ yǒu yì zhī gǒu, kěshì tāmen jiā li yǒu sì zhī gǒu.
“We've only got one dog, but they've got four.
我们家里只有一个不太大的游泳池，可他们有一条很长的河。
Wǒmen jiā li zhǐ yǒu yí ge bú tài dà de yóuyǒngchí, kě tāmen yǒu yì tiáo hěn cháng de hé.
We've only got a smallish swimming pool, but they've got a long river.
我们家里的花园里只有几棵树，可他们的花园里树多得数不清。”
Wǒmen jiā li de huāyuán li zhǐ yǒu jǐ kē shù, kě tāmen de huāyuán li shù duō de shǔ bu qīng.”
Our garden has only a few trees, but theirs has more trees than you can count.”
父亲一点儿也没想到儿子会说这样的话。
Fùqin yìdiǎnr yě méi xiǎngdào érzi huì shuō zhèyàng de huà.
The father never expected his son to say this.
接着，儿子又说：“等我长大了，一定要过上和他们一样的生活。”
Jiēzhe, érzi yòu shuō: “Děng wǒ zhǎngdà le, yídìng yào guòshang hé tāmen yíyàng de shēnghuó.”
Then the son added, “When I grow up, I'm going to live just like them.”

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 父亲带儿子到乡下是想让他——
Fùqin dài érzi dào xiāngxia shì xiǎng ràng tā —
The father took his son to the countryside so that he would …
他们在穷人家住了多长时间？
Tāmen zài qióngrén jiā zhù le duō cháng shíjiān?
How long did they stay with the poor family?
儿子觉得穷人的生活——
Érzi juéde qióngrén de shēnghuó —
The son thinks poor people's lives are …

blocks.note: Question 2: 一天一夜 is a day and a night, so 24 hours.

grammar: ……是怎样 + V的
how … (does something)
怎样 is a more formal 怎么样, and 是……的 frames the question about manner.
他想让儿子看看穷人是怎样生活的。
Tā xiǎng ràng érzi kànkan qióngrén shì zěnyàng shēnghuó de.
He wanted his son to see how poor people live.
你是怎样学会游泳的？
Nǐ shì zěnyàng xuéhuì yóuyǒng de?
How did you learn to swim?
surely … by now?
该 + 了吧 expresses an expectation that something should be true now.
现在你该知道穷人是什么样的了吧？
Xiànzài nǐ gāi zhīdào qióngrén shì shénmeyàng de le ba?
So now you know what it's like to be poor?
都十点了，他该到了吧？
Dōu shí diǎn le, tā gāi dào le ba?
It's ten already. He must be there by now?
adj + 得 + V不清
so … you can't …
多得数不清 means “more than you can count”.
可他们的花园里树多得数不清。
Kě tāmen de huāyuán li shù duō de shǔ bu qīng.
Theirs has more trees than you can count.
天上的星星多得数不清。
Tiān shang de xīngxing duō de shǔ bu qīng.
There are countless stars in the sky.
一点儿也没想到
never expected
This is a strong way to say something came as a total surprise.
父亲一点儿也没想到儿子会说这样的话。
Fùqin yìdiǎnr yě méi xiǎngdào érzi huì shuō zhèyàng de huà.
The father never expected his son to say this.
我一点儿也没想到他会来。
Wǒ yìdiǎnr yě méi xiǎngdào tā huì lái.
I never expected him to come.
过上……的生活
to come to live a … life
过上 means reaching a certain way of life.
一定要过上和他们一样的生活。
Yídìng yào guòshang hé tāmen yíyàng de shēnghuó.
I'm going to live just like them.
他们终于过上了好日子。
Tāmen zhōngyú guòshang le hǎo rìzi.
They finally have a good life.
gaps: 带着儿子从城里到了乡下。
最穷的人家住了一天一夜。
我们家里只有一个不太大的
我们家里的花园里只有几
可他们的花园里树多得数不
say: He wanted his son to see how poor people live.
Can you tell me how the rich and the poor are different?
We've only got one dog, but they've got four.
When I grow up, I'm going to live just like them.

071.title: Climbing Mount Lu
071.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. It tells the story from part 067 in more detail. 它 (the river) sounds the same as 他, and I used 它.

lines: 我小时候，父亲身体不太好，不适合住在城里，就把我们全家搬到了乡下。
Wǒ xiǎo shíhou, fùqin shēntǐ bú tài hǎo, bú shìhé zhù zài chéng li, jiù bǎ wǒmen quánjiā bāndào le xiāngxia.
When I was small, my father's health wasn't good and city life didn't suit him, so he moved the whole family to the countryside.
我们那个村子不大，就在著名的庐山脚下，离长江只有十几公里，
Wǒmen nàge cūnzi bú dà, jiù zài zhùmíng de Lúshān jiǎo xià, lí Chángjiāng zhǐ yǒu shí jǐ gōnglǐ,
Our village was small, right at the foot of famous Mount Lu, only a dozen or so kilometres from the Yangtze,
fùjìn hái yǒu yí ge dà hú.
and there was a big lake nearby.
村子周围的小山上种满了绿油油的茶树。
Cūnzi zhōuwéi de xiǎo shān shang zhòngmǎn le lǜyóuyóu de cháshù.
The hills around the village were covered in lush green tea bushes.
当我长到七八岁的时候，父亲有时会带着我翻过几座小山到镇上去买东西，
Dāng wǒ zhǎngdào qī bā suì de shíhou, fùqin yǒushí huì dài zhe wǒ fānguò jǐ zuò xiǎo shān dào zhèn shang qù mǎi dōngxi,
When I was seven or eight, my father sometimes took me over the hills to the town to go shopping,
可是我从来没有登上过庐山。
kěshì wǒ cónglái méiyǒu dēngshang guo Lúshān.
but I had never climbed Mount Lu.
Zhè yì tiān zhōngyú láidào le.
一路上，父亲不时地要停下来采草药，
Yí lù shang, fùqin bùshí de yào tíng xialai cǎi cǎoyào,
All the way up, my father kept stopping to gather herbs,
结果，当我们爬到山顶的时候，已经快到傍晚了。
jiéguǒ, dāng wǒmen pádào shāndǐng de shíhou, yǐjīng kuài dào bàngwǎn le.
so by the time we reached the top it was nearly dusk.
刚开始，四周都是高大的树木，我们什么都看不见。
Gāng kāishǐ, sìzhōu dōu shì gāodà de shùmù, wǒmen shénme dōu kàn bu jiàn.
At first there were tall trees all around and we couldn't see anything.
可是只要再往上走一步，眼前就突然亮起来，
Kěshì zhǐyào zài wǎng shàng zǒu yí bù, yǎnqián jiù tūrán liàng qilai,
But with just one more step up, everything suddenly brightened,
出现了一幅壮丽的景色。
chūxiàn le yì fú zhuànglì de jǐngsè.
近处都是奇形怪状的山石和古树，
Jìnchù dōu shì qí xíng guài zhuàng de shānshí hé gǔ shù,
Close by were strangely shaped rocks and ancient trees.
远处是一片大大小小的山头，像大海的波浪一样，向低处流去。
yuǎnchù shì yí piàn dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shāntóu, xiàng dàhǎi de bōlàng yíyàng, xiàng dīchù liúqu.
In the distance, hilltops of all sizes rolled downward like waves of the sea.
更远的地方是平原，那边刚刚下过一场大雨，太阳又从云彩里出来了。
Gèng yuǎn de dìfang shì píngyuán, nàbiān gānggāng xià guo yì chǎng dà yǔ, tàiyáng yòu cóng yúncai li chūlai le.
Further still was the plain. It had just rained heavily there, and the sun had come out from behind the clouds again.
就在这时，我看到一条长长的银白色的丝带在夕阳下闪闪发光。
Jiù zài zhè shí, wǒ kàndào yì tiáo chángcháng de yínbáisè de sīdài zài xīyáng xià shǎnshǎn fāguāng.
Just then I saw a long silvery ribbon glittering in the setting sun.
The Yangtze! The Yangtze! The Yangtze!
我兴奋地一连喊了三声，
Wǒ xīngfèn de yìlián hǎn le sān shēng,
I shouted three times in a row with excitement,
好像这样就可以使自己相信这一切都是真的。
hǎoxiàng zhèyàng jiù kěyǐ shǐ zìjǐ xiāngxìn zhè yíqiè dōu shì zhēn de.
as if that would make me believe it was all real.
这条大江，我听大人们说过好多次，可是没想到这么快就亲眼看到了。
Zhè tiáo dà jiāng, wǒ tīng dàrénmen shuō guo hǎo duō cì, kěshì méi xiǎngdào zhème kuài jiù qīnyǎn kàndào le.
I'd heard grown-ups talk about this great river many times, but never thought I'd see it with my own eyes so soon.
它就在那里，静静地流着，把一条条小船带到很远很远的地方去。
Tā jiù zài nàlǐ, jìngjìng de liú zhe, bǎ yì tiáotiáo xiǎo chuán dàidào hěn yuǎn hěn yuǎn de dìfang qù.
There it was, flowing quietly, carrying little boats far, far away.
当我睁大眼睛，盯着那些小船的时候，
Dāng wǒ zhēngdà yǎnjing, dīng zhe nàxiē xiǎo chuán de shíhou,
As I stared wide-eyed at the boats,
一只无形的大手把一条美丽的彩虹摆在了大江上面的蓝天里。
yì zhī wúxíng de dà shǒu bǎ yì tiáo měilì de cǎihóng bǎi zài le dà jiāng shàngmiàn de lán tiān li.
an invisible hand placed a beautiful rainbow in the blue sky above the river.

grammar: V满了
filled with …
满 as a result means “full” or “covering everywhere”: 种满了 (planted all over), 坐满了 (full of people).
村子周围的小山上种满了绿油油的茶树。
Cūnzi zhōuwéi de xiǎo shān shang zhòngmǎn le lǜyóuyóu de cháshù.
The hills were covered in tea bushes.
教室里坐满了学生。
Jiàoshì li zuòmǎn le xuésheng.
The classroom was full of students.
从来没有 + V过
have never …
This is a strong negative about past experience. 登上过 means “ever climbed to the top”.
可是我从来没有登上过庐山。
Kěshì wǒ cónglái méiyǒu dēngshang guo Lúshān.
But I had never climbed Mount Lu.
我从来没有吃过这种菜。
Wǒ cónglái méiyǒu chī guo zhè zhǒng cài.
I've never eaten this dish.
…, so in the end …
结果 introduces the outcome, often an unplanned one.
结果，当我们爬到山顶的时候，已经快到傍晚了。
Jiéguǒ, dāng wǒmen pádào shāndǐng de shíhou, yǐjīng kuài dào bàngwǎn le.
So by the time we reached the top it was nearly dusk.
他没带伞，结果全身都湿了。
Tā méi dài sǎn, jiéguǒ quánshēn dōu shī le.
He didn't bring an umbrella and got soaked.
as long as …, then …
只要 gives the one condition needed for the result.
只要再往上走一步，眼前就突然亮起来。
Zhǐyào zài wǎng shàng zǒu yí bù, yǎnqián jiù tūrán liàng qilai.
With just one more step up, everything suddenly brightened.
只要你努力，就一定能学好。
Zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì, jiù yídìng néng xuéhǎo.
As long as you work hard, you'll learn it well.
使 + person + V
to make someone …
使 is a more formal 让.
好像这样就可以使自己相信这一切都是真的。
Hǎoxiàng zhèyàng jiù kěyǐ shǐ zìjǐ xiāngxìn zhè yíqiè dōu shì zhēn de.
As if that would make me believe it was all real.
这个消息使大家很高兴。
Zhège xiāoxi shǐ dàjiā hěn gāoxìng.
The news made everyone happy.
没想到这么快就……
didn't expect so soon …
没想到 shows surprise, and 这么快就 stresses how quickly it happened.
可是没想到这么快就亲眼看到了。
Kěshì méi xiǎngdào zhème kuài jiù qīnyǎn kàndào le.
But I never thought I'd see it with my own eyes so soon.
没想到他这么快就回来了。
Méi xiǎngdào tā zhème kuài jiù huílai le.
I didn't expect him back so soon.
gaps: 的时候，已经快到傍晚了。
say: Our village was small, right at the foot of famous Mount Lu.
At last the day came.
At first there were tall trees all around and we couldn't see anything.
I shouted three times in a row with excitement.

072.title: Vocabulary list
072.transcriptNote: The words in the order they're read. The English introduction isn't transcribed. Single words were matched to how parts 073–077 use them.

lines: to pay a New Year call
for …, as far as … is concerned
blocks.note: Matched to the texts: 贴 (heard as 爹; part 074 has 把福字贴倒了), 亲热 (heard as 清热; 亲亲热热地吃一顿年夜饭) and 非 (heard as 飞; 非回家过年不可).

073.title: Ten sentences
073.sub: Spring Festival, travel and good luck
073.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences using the new words from part 072. Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 过年以前，一定要把房子打扫干净。
Guònián yǐqián, yídìng yào bǎ fángzi dǎsǎo gānjìng.
Before New Year, you must clean the house thoroughly.
拜年，就是在新年来到的时候，互相说祝福的话。
Bàinián, jiù shì zài xīnnián láidào de shíhou, hùxiāng shuō zhùfú de huà.
拜年 means exchanging good wishes when the New Year arrives.
很多人利用假期到外地去旅游。
Hěn duō rén lìyòng jiàqī dào wàidì qù lǚyóu.
Lots of people use the holidays to travel.
昨天地铁出了一点儿事儿，幸好我出来得早，要不然就迟到了。
Zuótiān dìtiě chū le yìdiǎnr shìr, xìnghǎo wǒ chūlai de zǎo, yàobùrán jiù chídào le.
There was a problem on the subway yesterday. Luckily I left early, or I'd have been late.
据说那个地方非常冷，我绝不让你去。
Jùshuō nàge dìfang fēicháng lěng, wǒ jué bú ràng nǐ qù.
They say it's freezing there. I'm absolutely not letting you go.
新年来到的时候，成千上万的人走上大街表示庆祝。
Xīnnián láidào de shíhou, chéng qiān shàng wàn de rén zǒushang dàjiē biǎoshì qìngzhù.
When the New Year arrives, thousands upon thousands of people take to the streets to celebrate.
你能不能联系一下益达公司的林经理？我想请他吃饭。
Nǐ néng bu néng liánxì yíxià Yìdá Gōngsī de Lín jīnglǐ? Wǒ xiǎng qǐng tā chī fàn.
Could you get in touch with Manager Lin at Yida Company? I'd like to take him to dinner.
安达改变了学习方法，考试得到了很好的成绩。
Āndá gǎibiàn le xuéxí fāngfǎ, kǎoshì dédào le hěn hǎo de chéngjì.
Anda changed the way he studied and got very good exam results.
对中国人来说，春节是最重要的节日。
Duì Zhōngguórén lái shuō, Chūnjié shì zuì zhòngyào de jiérì.
For Chinese people, Spring Festival is the most important holiday.
快到春节的时候，很多在外地的中国人非回家过年不可。
Kuài dào Chūnjié de shíhou, hěn duō zài wàidì de Zhōngguórén fēi huí jiā guònián bù kě.
As Spring Festival approaches, many Chinese people living away from home simply have to go home for New Year.

vocab: to pay a New Year call
for …, as far as … is concerned
grammar: … means …
就是 introduces a definition or explanation.
拜年，就是在新年来到的时候，互相说祝福的话。
Bàinián, jiù shì zài xīnnián láidào de shíhou, hùxiāng shuō zhùfú de huà.
拜年 means exchanging good wishes when the New Year arrives.
“老外”，就是外国人。
“Lǎowài”, jiù shì wàiguórén.
“Laowai” means a foreigner.
幸好……，要不然……
luckily …, otherwise …
幸好 gives the lucky circumstance, and 要不然 the bad outcome that was avoided.
幸好我出来得早，要不然就迟到了。
Xìnghǎo wǒ chūlai de zǎo, yàobùrán jiù chídào le.
Luckily I left early, or I'd have been late.
幸好你提醒我，要不然我就忘了。
Xìnghǎo nǐ tíxǐng wǒ, yàobùrán wǒ jiù wàng le.
Luckily you reminded me, or I'd have forgotten.
据说……
it's said that …
据说 introduces hearsay without naming the source.
据说那个地方非常冷。
Jùshuō nàge dìfang fēicháng lěng.
They say it's freezing there.
据说明天要下雪。
Jùshuō míngtiān yào xià xuě.
Apparently it's going to snow tomorrow.
对……来说
for …, as far as … is concerned
This frames a statement from someone's point of view.
对中国人来说，春节是最重要的节日。
Duì Zhōngguórén lái shuō, Chūnjié shì zuì zhòngyào de jiérì.
For Chinese people, Spring Festival is the most important holiday.
对我来说，汉字最难。
Duì wǒ lái shuō, Hànzì zuì nán.
For me, characters are the hardest part.
非……不可
simply must …
A double negative that means “absolutely have to”.
很多在外地的中国人非回家过年不可。
Hěn duō zài wàidì de Zhōngguórén fēi huí jiā guònián bù kě.
Many Chinese people living away from home simply have to go home for New Year.
这个电影我非看不可。
Zhège diànyǐng wǒ fēi kàn bù kě.
I absolutely have to see this film.
gaps: 过年以前，一定要把房子
我出来得早，要不然就迟到了。
的人走上大街表示庆祝。
一下益达公司的林经理？
say: Before New Year, you must clean the house thoroughly.
Luckily I left early, or I'd have been late.
For Chinese people, Spring Festival is the most important holiday.
Many Chinese people living away from home simply have to go home for New Year.

074.title: Twelve multiple-choice items
074.sub: Spring Festival customs and getting home for New Year
074.transcriptNote: Each item has a sentence or short exchange, a question and four options. The answer key is my own reading. Some item numbers aren't read aloud.

lines: 你知道吗？中国人从阴历十二月起就开始准备过春节了。
Nǐ zhīdào ma? Zhōngguórén cóng yīnlì shí'èr yuè qǐ jiù kāishǐ zhǔnbèi guò Chūnjié le.
Did you know? Chinese people start preparing for Spring Festival in the twelfth lunar month.
我当然知道，春节是中国人最重要的节日，所以很早就开始做准备了。
Wǒ dāngrán zhīdào, Chūnjié shì Zhōngguórén zuì zhòngyào de jiérì, suǒyǐ hěn zǎo jiù kāishǐ zuò zhǔnbèi le.
Of course I know. It's the most important Chinese festival, so preparations start early.

q: 中国人为什么很早就开始准备过春节？
Zhōngguórén wèishénme hěn zǎo jiù kāishǐ zhǔnbèi guò Chūnjié?
Why do Chinese people start preparing so early?
o: 因为过春节的人太多，所以得早准备。
Yīnwèi guò Chūnjié de rén tài duō, suǒyǐ děi zǎo zhǔnbèi.
So many people celebrate that you have to prepare early.
因为春节是最重要的节日，应该早点儿准备。
Yīnwèi Chūnjié shì zuì zhòngyào de jiérì, yīnggāi zǎo diǎnr zhǔnbèi.
It's the most important festival, so you should prepare early.
因为春节前工作不忙，可以早点儿准备。
Yīnwèi Chūnjié qián gōngzuò bù máng, kěyǐ zǎo diǎnr zhǔnbèi.
Work isn't busy before the festival, so there's time.
因为准备得越早越可以早点儿过年。
Yīnwèi zhǔnbèi de yuè zǎo yuè kěyǐ zǎo diǎnr guònián.
The earlier you prepare, the earlier New Year comes.

lines: 爸爸，你怎么把福字贴倒了？
Bàba, nǐ zěnme bǎ fú zì tiē dào le?
Dad, why have you stuck the 福 character on upside down?
对呀，这样贴，福就到咱家了嘛。
Duì ya, zhèyàng tiē, fú jiù dào zán jiā le ma.
That's right. Stuck like this, good fortune “arrives” at our house.

q: 爸爸为什么把福字贴倒了？
Bàba wèishénme bǎ fú zì tiē dào le?
Why did Dad stick 福 on upside down?
o: Tā xīwàng quánjiā rén yǒu fú.
He hopes the family will have good fortune.
Fú zhège zì dào le tā de jiā.
The character 福 arrived at his house.

blocks.note: The pun is that 倒 (dào, upside down) sounds like 到 (dào, arrive), so an upside-down 福 means good fortune has arrived. D is the literal pun, C is what it means.

lines: 除夕晚上，全家人要在一起亲亲热热地吃一顿年夜饭。
Chúxī wǎnshang, quánjiā rén yào zài yìqǐ qīnqīnrèrè de chī yí dùn niányèfàn.
On New Year's Eve the whole family gets together for a warm, cosy reunion dinner.

q: 这句话没有告诉我们什么？
Zhè jù huà méiyǒu gàosu wǒmen shénme?
What does this sentence NOT tell us?
o: 全家人是从什么地方回家的
quánjiā rén shì cóng shénme dìfang huí jiā de
where the family comes home from
quánjiā rén zài yìqǐ zuò shénme
how the family eats the dinner

lines: 过年的时候，北方人习惯吃饺子，因为饺子的样子像元宝；
Guònián de shíhou, běifāngrén xíguàn chī jiǎozi, yīnwèi jiǎozi de yàngzi xiàng yuánbǎo;
At New Year, northerners usually eat dumplings, because they look like gold ingots.
南方人喜欢做年糕，表示一年比一年高的意思。
nánfāngrén xǐhuan zuò niángāo, biǎoshì yì nián bǐ yì nián gāo de yìsi.
Southerners like to make rice cake, which stands for getting higher every year.

q: 南方人过年的时候为什么吃年糕？
Nánfāngrén guònián de shíhou wèishénme chī niángāo?
Why do southerners eat rice cake at New Year?
o: 因为年糕表示一年比一年高。
Yīnwèi niángāo biǎoshì yì nián bǐ yì nián gāo.
It stands for rising higher each year.
因为年糕的样子像元宝。
Yīnwèi niángāo de yàngzi xiàng yuánbǎo.
因为南方人不喜欢吃饺子。
Yīnwèi nánfāngrén bù xǐhuan chī jiǎozi.

blocks.note: 年糕 (niángāo) sounds like 年高 (nián gāo, “higher each year”).

lines: 以前拜年得去亲友家，现在简单了，大家都互相用手机发几条祝福的短信就行了。
Yǐqián bàinián děi qù qīnyǒu jiā, xiànzài jiǎndān le, dàjiā dōu hùxiāng yòng shǒujī fā jǐ tiáo zhùfú de duǎnxìn jiù xíng le.
You used to have to visit friends and family for New Year greetings. Now it's easy: everyone just sends a few text messages.

q: 根据这句话，下面哪种说法是不对的？
Gēnjù zhè jù huà, xiàmiàn nǎ zhǒng shuōfǎ shì bú duì de?
Which statement is NOT correct?
o: 以前过年见面的时候互相拜年。
Yǐqián guònián jiànmiàn de shíhou hùxiāng bàinián.
People used to greet each other in person.
现在可以用手机发短信拜年。
Xiànzài kěyǐ yòng shǒujī fā duǎnxìn bàinián.
Now you can send greetings by text.
以前也用手机发短信拜年。
Yǐqián yě yòng shǒujī fā duǎnxìn bàinián.
People used to text their greetings too.

lines: 火车站怎么这么多人呀？
Huǒchēzhàn zěnme zhème duō rén ya?
Why is the station so crowded?
快过年了嘛，按照中国人的习惯，过年的时候，出门在外的人都要赶回家去过年。
Kuài guònián le ma, ànzhào Zhōngguórén de xíguàn, guònián de shíhou, chūmén zài wài de rén dōu yào gǎn huí jiā qù guònián.
It's nearly New Year. By Chinese custom, everyone away from home rushes back for it.

q: 这段对话发生在什么时候？
Zhè duàn duìhuà fāshēng zài shénme shíhou?
When does this conversation take place?

lines: 老王，回家的火车票买到了吗？
Lǎo Wáng, huí jiā de huǒchē piào mǎidào le ma?
Lao Wang, did you get a train ticket home?
别提了，昨天我在火车站排了一天的队也没买到，最后只好从黄牛手里买了一张，比平时的票贵了好多呢。
Bié tí le, zuótiān wǒ zài huǒchēzhàn pái le yì tiān de duì yě méi mǎidào, zuìhòu zhǐhǎo cóng huángniú shǒu li mǎi le yì zhāng, bǐ píngshí de piào guì le hǎo duō ne.
Don't ask. I queued at the station all day yesterday and didn't get one. In the end I had to buy one from a tout, and it cost way more than usual.

q: 老王是怎么买到火车票的？
Lǎo Wáng shì zěnme mǎidào huǒchē piào de?
How did Lao Wang get his ticket?

lines: 我是湖北来的民工，我和妻子在广东一家公司打工已经有七八年了，我们年年都要回家过年。
Wǒ shì Húběi lái de míngōng, wǒ hé qīzi zài Guǎngdōng yì jiā gōngsī dǎgōng yǐjīng yǒu qī bā nián le, wǒmen niánnián dōu yào huí jiā guònián.
I'm a migrant worker from Hubei. My wife and I have worked at a company in Guangdong for seven or eight years, and we go home every New Year.

q: 根据这段话，我们可以知道什么？
Gēnjù zhè duàn huà, wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from this?
o: Tāmen de lǎojiā bú zài Guǎngdōng.
他们在广东开了一家公司。
Tāmen zài Guǎngdōng kāi le yì jiā gōngsī.
They started a company in Guangdong.
他们在老家过年，也在打工的地方过年。
Tāmen zài lǎojiā guònián, yě zài dǎgōng de dìfang guònián.
They celebrate at home and at work.

lines: 我们工厂安排得很好，有免费的年夜饭，还可以免费去公园，可是孩子和父母都在老家，不回去看看不行。
Wǒmen gōngchǎng ānpái de hěn hǎo, yǒu miǎnfèi de niányèfàn, hái kěyǐ miǎnfèi qù gōngyuán, kěshì háizi hé fùmǔ dōu zài lǎojiā, bù huíqu kànkan bù xíng.
Our factory organises things well: a free New Year's Eve dinner and free entry to the park. But my children and parents are back home, so I have to go and see them.

q: 下面哪句话不对？
Xiàmiàn nǎ jù huà bú duì?
Which statement is NOT correct?
o: 在工厂过年可以吃免费的年夜饭。
Zài gōngchǎng guònián kěyǐ chī miǎnfèi de niányèfàn.
At the factory you get a free dinner.
孩子和父母也可以来工厂过年。
Háizi hé fùmǔ yě kěyǐ lái gōngchǎng guònián.
Children and parents can come to the factory too.
父母和孩子现在在老家。
Fùmǔ hé háizi xiànzài zài lǎojiā.
Parents and children are back home.
我一定要回老家去看孩子和父母。
Wǒ yídìng yào huí lǎojiā qù kàn háizi hé fùmǔ.
I have to go home to see them.

lines: 小丽，你爸爸怎么没跟你们一起过年呀？
Xiǎo Lì, nǐ bàba zěnme méi gēn nǐmen yìqǐ guònián ya?
Xiao Li, why didn't your dad celebrate New Year with you?
工厂里的工人们都回家过春节去了，只有我爸爸留在那儿。
Gōngchǎng li de gōngrénmen dōu huí jiā guò Chūnjié qù le, zhǐ yǒu wǒ bàba liú zài nàr.
All the factory workers went home for the festival. Only my dad stayed there.

q: 小丽的爸爸过年的时候在哪儿？
Xiǎo Lì de bàba guònián de shíhou zài nǎr?
Where was Xiao Li's dad at New Year?

lines: Nǐ shōudào wǒ de xìn le ma?
过了年才收到，我搬了家，是别人给我带来的。
Guò le nián cái shōudào, wǒ bān le jiā, shì biérén gěi wǒ dàilai de.
Only after New Year. I'd moved, so someone else brought it to me.

q: 信为什么很晚才收到？
Xìn wèishénme hěn wǎn cái shōudào?
Why did the letter arrive late?
o: dì yī ge rén méiyǒu jì chuqu
the first person didn't post it
dì èr ge rén huàn le dìzhǐ

lines: 哟，老太太，怎么一个人来买菜啦？
Yō, lǎotàitai, zěnme yí ge rén lái mǎi cài la?
Oh, ma'am, shopping on your own?
孩子们都到外地旅游去了，要过了年才回来。
Háizimen dōu dào wàidì lǚyóu qù le, yào guò le nián cái huílai.
The children have all gone travelling and won't be back until after New Year.

q: 对话发生在什么时候？
Duìhuà fāshēng zài shénme shíhou?
When does this take place?

grammar: 从……起
starting from …
This marks the starting point in time.
中国人从阴历十二月起就开始准备过春节了。
Zhōngguórén cóng yīnlì shí'èr yuè qǐ jiù kāishǐ zhǔnbèi guò Chūnjié le.
Chinese people start preparing in the twelfth lunar month.
从明天起，我每天跑步。
Cóng míngtiān qǐ, wǒ měi tiān pǎobù.
Starting tomorrow, I'll run every day.
V得越……越……
the more …, the more …
越……越 links two increasing qualities.
因为准备得越早越可以早点儿过年。
Yīnwèi zhǔnbèi de yuè zǎo yuè kěyǐ zǎo diǎnr guònián.
The earlier you prepare, the earlier New Year comes.
汉语越学越有意思。
Hànyǔ yuè xué yuè yǒu yìsi.
The more you learn Chinese, the more interesting it gets.
一年比一年 + adj
more … every year
This shows steady progress over time.
表示一年比一年高的意思。
Biǎoshì yì nián bǐ yì nián gāo de yìsi.
It stands for getting higher every year.
他的汉语一天比一天好。
Tā de Hànyǔ yì tiān bǐ yì tiān hǎo.
His Chinese gets better every day.
不 V 不行
have to …
A double negative meaning “can't not do it”.
孩子和父母都在老家，不回去看看不行。
Háizi hé fùmǔ dōu zài lǎojiā, bù huíqu kànkan bù xíng.
My children and parents are back home, so I have to go and see them.
明天考试，不复习不行。
Míngtiān kǎoshì, bú fùxí bù xíng.
There's an exam tomorrow. I have to revise.
过了……才……
not until after …
才 shows the action happened later than expected.
过了年才收到。
Guò le nián cái shōudào.
I only got it after New Year.
他过了十二点才睡觉。
Tā guò le shí'èr diǎn cái shuìjiào.
He didn't go to bed until after midnight.
gaps: 十二月起就开始准备过春节了。
晚上，全家人要在一起亲亲热热地吃一顿年夜饭。
大家都互相用手机发几条祝福的
我们工厂安排得很好，有
say: Dad, why have you stuck the 福 character on upside down?
On New Year's Eve the whole family gets together for a warm, cosy reunion dinner.
It's nearly New Year. By Chinese custom, everyone away from home rushes back for it.
Did you get my letter?

075.title: At the post office
075.sub: David and Xiao Wang before Spring Festival, with four multiple-choice items
075.transcriptNote: 甲 is David and 乙 is Xiao Wang. Speakers are assigned from context. The answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: Dàwèi hé Xiǎo Wáng zài yóujú.
David and Xiao Wang are at the post office.
邮局里怎么有这么多人啊？
Yóujú li zěnme yǒu zhème duō rén a?
Why is the post office so busy?
快到春节了，很多在外地工作的人都给家里寄东西。
Kuài dào Chūnjié le, hěn duō zài wàidì gōngzuò de rén dōu gěi jiā li jì dōngxi.
Spring Festival is coming, and lots of people who work away from home are sending things to their families.
可是那些人没拿着要寄的东西啊。
Kěshì nàxiē rén méi ná zhe yào jì de dōngxi a.
But those people aren't carrying anything to post.
哦，你是说那边排队的人呀？我想他们是来寄钱的。
Ò, nǐ shì shuō nàbiān páiduì de rén ya? Wǒ xiǎng tāmen shì lái jì qián de.
Oh, you mean the people in that queue? I think they're here to send money.
Wèishénme zhème duō rén jì qián?
Why are so many people sending money?
春节的时候，人们一般都回家跟父母一起过节，
Chūnjié de shíhou, rénmen yìbān dōu huí jiā gēn fùmǔ yìqǐ guòjié,
At Spring Festival people usually go home to celebrate with their parents.
在外地不能回去的人，常常给家里寄一些钱。
zài wàidì bù néng huíqu de rén, chángcháng gěi jiā li jì yìxiē qián.
Those who can't go home often send some money instead.

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 什么地方的人很多？
Shénme dìfang de rén hěn duō?
Where is it crowded?
这段对话大约是在什么时候？
Zhè duàn duìhuà dàyuē shì zài shénme shíhou?
Roughly when does this take place?
给家里寄东西的都是什么人？
Gěi jiā li jì dōngxi de dōu shì shénme rén?
Who is sending things home?
寄钱的人为什么很多？
Jì qián de rén wèishénme hěn duō?
Why are so many people sending money?
o: 因为他们不能回家跟父母一起过春节
yīnwèi tāmen bù néng huí jiā gēn fùmǔ yìqǐ guò Chūnjié
they can't go home to celebrate with their parents
因为他们要去外地过春节
yīnwèi tāmen yào qù wàidì guò Chūnjié
因为很多人的家里需要钱
yīnwèi hěn duō rén de jiā li xūyào qián
yīnwèi yǒu qián cái néng guò Chūnjié

grammar: 快到……了
… is nearly here
快 + 到 + time + 了 means something is approaching.
快到春节了。
Kuài dào Chūnjié le.
Spring Festival is coming.
快到十二点了，睡吧。
Kuài dào shí'èr diǎn le, shuì ba.
It's nearly midnight. Go to bed.
给 + person/place + 寄 + thing
to send something to …
给 marks the receiver before the verb.
很多在外地工作的人都给家里寄东西。
Hěn duō zài wàidì gōngzuò de rén dōu gěi jiā li jì dōngxi.
Many people working away from home send things to their families.
我每个月给妈妈寄一封信。
Wǒ měi ge yuè gěi māma jì yì fēng xìn.
I send Mum a letter every month.
你是说……呀？
you mean …?
This checks what the other person is referring to.
你是说那边排队的人呀？
Nǐ shì shuō nàbiān páiduì de rén ya?
You mean the people in that queue?
你是说明天吗？
Nǐ shì shuō míngtiān ma?
You mean tomorrow?
是来 + V + 的
have come to …
是……的 stresses the purpose of coming.
我想他们是来寄钱的。
Wǒ xiǎng tāmen shì lái jì qián de.
I think they're here to send money.
我是来找老师的。
Wǒ shì lái zhǎo lǎoshī de.
I've come to see the teacher.
gaps: 很多在外地工作的人都给家里
都回家跟父母一起过节。
say: Why is the post office so busy?
Spring Festival is coming, and lots of people who work away from home are sending things to their families.
Oh, you mean the people in that queue? I think they're here to send money.

076.title: New Year in Hainan
076.sub: Lao Wang is off on holiday, with five multiple-choice items
076.transcriptNote: 甲 is Lao Li and 乙 is Lao Wang. Speakers are assigned from context. The answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 你们夫妻俩这是去哪儿啊？去拜年吗？怎么还带着行李？
Nǐmen fūqī liǎ zhè shì qù nǎr a? Qù bàinián ma? Zěnme hái dài zhe xíngli?
Where are you two off to? Visiting people for New Year? Why the luggage?
我们利用春节放假去海南岛玩。
Wǒmen lìyòng Chūnjié fàngjià qù Hǎinán Dǎo wán.
We're using the Spring Festival holiday to go to Hainan.
对呀，现在海南岛那边天气又好又暖和，还可以在大海里游泳。
Duì ya, xiànzài Hǎinán Dǎo nàbiān tiānqì yòu hǎo yòu nuǎnhuo, hái kěyǐ zài dàhǎi li yóuyǒng.
Yes! The weather in Hainan is lovely and warm right now, and you can swim in the sea.
我不是说去海南岛不好，我是说现在是春节，坐火车的人太多了，火车票不好买吧？
Wǒ bú shì shuō qù Hǎinán Dǎo bù hǎo, wǒ shì shuō xiànzài shì Chūnjié, zuò huǒchē de rén tài duō le, huǒchē piào bù hǎo mǎi ba?
I'm not saying Hainan's a bad idea. I mean it's Spring Festival, and so many people are on the trains. Isn't it hard to get tickets?
买票难那是除夕以前，到了春节就不那么难了。再说我们也不坐火车呀。
Mǎi piào nán nà shì chúxī yǐqián, dàole Chūnjié jiù bú nàme nán le. Zàishuō wǒmen yě bú zuò huǒchē ya.
It's hard before New Year's Eve, but once the festival starts it's not so bad. Besides, we're not taking the train.
现在交通这么方便，汽车、飞机也可以嘛，很多人还自己开车呢。
Xiànzài jiāotōng zhème fāngbiàn, qìchē, fēijī yě kěyǐ ma, hěn duō rén hái zìjǐ kāichē ne.
Transport is so convenient now. You can go by coach or plane, and lots of people even drive themselves.
你说得对。那你们是怎么去海南岛呢？
Nǐ shuō de duì. Nà nǐmen shì zěnme qù Hǎinán Dǎo ne?
True. So how are you getting there?
我们呀，飞机票早就买好了，来回用不了多长时间，可以在那儿多玩几天。
Wǒmen ya, fēijī piào zǎo jiù mǎihǎo le, láihuí yòng bu liǎo duō cháng shíjiān, kěyǐ zài nàr duō wán jǐ tiān.
We bought plane tickets ages ago. The journey doesn't take long, so we get a few more days there.
真不错，那我祝你们旅游愉快！
Zhēn búcuò, nà wǒ zhù nǐmen lǚyóu yúkuài!

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 对话发生在什么时候？
Duìhuà fāshēng zài shénme shíhou?
When does this take place?
老李和老王见面的时候为什么互相说“春节快乐”？
Lǎo Lǐ hé Lǎo Wáng jiànmiàn de shíhou wèishénme hùxiāng shuō “Chūnjié kuàilè”?
Why do they say “Happy Spring Festival” to each other?
o: 中国人见面的时候都这样说。
Zhōngguórén jiànmiàn de shíhou dōu zhèyàng shuō.
Chinese people always say this when they meet.
这是人们互相拜年时说的话。
Zhè shì rénmen hùxiāng bàinián shí shuō de huà.
It's what people say as New Year greetings.
新年的时候大家都这样说。
Xīnnián de shíhou dàjiā dōu zhèyàng shuō.
Everyone says it at (Western) New Year.
快要过春节了，他们互相祝福。
Kuài yào guò Chūnjié le, tāmen hùxiāng zhùfú.

q: 老王为什么出门？
Lǎo Wáng wèishénme chūmén?
Why is Lao Wang going out?
o: Tā hé tàitai yào qù lǚyóu.
He and his wife are going on holiday.
Tā yào qù biérén jiā bàinián.
He's visiting people for New Year.
他和太太要回老家过年。
Tā hé tàitai yào huí lǎojiā guònián.
He and his wife are going back to their hometown.

q: 老王怎么去旅游？
Lǎo Wáng zěnme qù lǚyóu?
How is Lao Wang travelling?
这段对话里没有说什么？
Zhè duàn duìhuà li méiyǒu shuō shénme?
What is NOT mentioned in the dialogue?
o: 春节的时候，买火车票比较困难
Chūnjié de shíhou, mǎi huǒchē piào bǐjiào kùnnan
it's hard to get train tickets at Spring Festival
春节以前，坐火车的人很多
Chūnjié yǐqián, zuò huǒchē de rén hěn duō
lots of people take trains before the festival
现在人们可以用很多种方法旅行
xiànzài rénmen kěyǐ yòng hěn duō zhǒng fāngfǎ lǚxíng
people can travel in many ways now
Chūnjié qījiān fēijī piào hěn guì
plane tickets are expensive at Spring Festival

blocks.note: Question 5: plane ticket prices are never mentioned. Train tickets are discussed, so A is mentioned even though Lao Wang says it isn't too hard.

grammar: 利用……去……
to use … to …
利用 means making use of time or resources for a purpose.
我们利用春节放假去海南岛玩。
Wǒmen lìyòng Chūnjié fàngjià qù Hǎinán Dǎo wán.
We're using the holiday to go to Hainan.
他利用周末学汉语。
Tā lìyòng zhōumò xué Hànyǔ.
He uses weekends to study Chinese.
我不是说……，我是说……
I'm not saying …, I mean …
This clarifies a misunderstanding.
我不是说去海南岛不好，我是说现在是春节。
Wǒ bú shì shuō qù Hǎinán Dǎo bù hǎo, wǒ shì shuō xiànzài shì Chūnjié.
I'm not saying Hainan's a bad idea. I mean it's Spring Festival.
我不是说你错了，我是说我们再想想。
Wǒ bú shì shuō nǐ cuò le, wǒ shì shuō wǒmen zài xiǎngxiang.
I'm not saying you're wrong. I'm saying let's think again.
再说……
besides …, what's more …
再说 adds another reason.
再说我们也不坐火车呀。
Zàishuō wǒmen yě bú zuò huǒchē ya.
Besides, we're not taking the train.
太晚了，再说我也累了。
Tài wǎn le, zàishuō wǒ yě lèi le.
It's too late, and besides, I'm tired.
V不了多长时间
won't take long
不了 (liǎo) after the verb means it isn't possible to need that much.
来回用不了多长时间。
Láihuí yòng bu liǎo duō cháng shíjiān.
The journey doesn't take long.
这点儿作业用不了一个小时。
Zhè diǎnr zuòyè yòng bu liǎo yí ge xiǎoshí.
This homework won't take an hour.
祝你们 + wish
I wish you …
祝 introduces a good wish.
那我祝你们旅游愉快！
Nà wǒ zhù nǐmen lǚyóu yúkuài!
Have a great trip!
祝你生日快乐！
Zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!
Happy birthday!
gaps: 海南岛那边天气又好又
say: Happy Spring Festival, Lao Wang!
We're using the Spring Festival holiday to go to Hainan.
Transport is so convenient now.
Lovely. Have a great trip!

077.title: Home for New Year, whatever it takes
077.sub: A stranded traveller at the station, with four multiple-choice items
077.transcriptNote: 甲 asks the questions, like a reporter, and 乙 is Shi Baoting. The name was heard as 石宝婷 and 石宝亭, and I used 石宝亭. The answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 请问您贵姓？这是要到什么地方去？
Qǐngwèn nín guìxìng? Zhè shì yào dào shénme dìfang qù?
Excuse me, may I ask your name? Where are you heading?
我叫石宝亭，我要回湖北老家。
Wǒ jiào Shí Bǎotíng, wǒ yào huí Húběi lǎojiā.
I'm Shi Baoting. I'm going home to Hubei.
今年的雪这么大，火车都停开了，您还一定要回家过年吗？
Jīnnián de xuě zhème dà, huǒchē dōu tíngkāi le, nín hái yídìng yào huí jiā guònián ma?
There's so much snow this year that the trains have stopped. Do you still have to go home for New Year?
不回去怎么行？父母、妻子和孩子都在老家，过年当然得回去。
Bù huíqu zěnme xíng? Fùmǔ, qīzi hé háizi dōu zài lǎojiā, guònián dāngrán děi huíqu.
How could I not? My parents, wife and kids are all back home. Of course I have to go back for New Year.
那您是怎么买到车票的？
Nà nín shì zěnme mǎidào chēpiào de?
How did you get a ticket?
我买的是黄牛票，比原价票贵好多呢。
Wǒ mǎi de shì huángniú piào, bǐ yuánjià piào guì hǎo duō ne.
I bought it from a tout. It cost way more than the normal price.
现在没有车，您打算怎么办呢？
Xiànzài méiyǒu chē, nín dǎsuan zěnme bàn ne?
There are no trains now. What are you going to do?
那我也要等。过年了嘛，火车会有的。
Nà wǒ yě yào děng. Guònián le ma, huǒchē huì yǒu de.
Then I'll wait. It's New Year. The trains will run.

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 他们可能在什么地方说话？
Tāmen kěnéng zài shénme dìfang shuōhuà?
Where are they probably talking?
火车停开了，可是石宝亭是怎么想的？
Huǒchē tíngkāi le, kěshì Shí Bǎotíng shì zěnme xiǎng de?
The trains have stopped. What does Shi Baoting think?
o: 没有火车就不回老家了。
Méiyǒu huǒchē jiù bù huí lǎojiā le.
With no trains, he won't go home.
没有火车可以坐飞机回老家。
Méiyǒu huǒchē kěyǐ zuò fēijī huí lǎojiā.
继续等，他相信火车一定会开的，因为要过年了。
Jìxù děng, tā xiāngxìn huǒchē yídìng huì kāi de, yīnwèi yào guònián le.
Keep waiting. He's sure the trains will run because it's New Year.
没有火车可以坐汽车回家。
Méiyǒu huǒchē kěyǐ zuò qìchē huí jiā.
Without trains, he can take a coach.

q: 石宝亭为什么一定要回家过年？
Shí Bǎotíng wèishénme yídìng yào huí jiā guònián?
Why does he have to go home?
o: Tā de jiārén dōu zài lǎojiā.

q: 石宝亭买的火车票是——
Shí Bǎotíng mǎi de huǒchē piào shì —
The ticket he bought was …
o: bǐ yuánjià gāo hěn duō de piào

blocks.note: In question 3, D plays on 黄牛 (a ticket tout, but literally “yellow ox”).

grammar: 您贵姓？
what's your surname? (polite)
This is the polite way to ask someone's name.
请问您贵姓？
Qǐngwèn nín guìxìng?
May I ask your name?
您贵姓？——我姓王。
Nín guìxìng? — Wǒ xìng Wáng.
May I ask your name? — My surname is Wang.
不 V 怎么行？
how could I not …?
This rhetorical question means “I have to”.
不回去怎么行？
Bù huíqu zěnme xíng?
How could I not go back?
不吃饭怎么行？
Bù chī fàn zěnme xíng?
You can't not eat!
比……贵好多
much more expensive than …
好多 after the adjective means “a lot”.
比原价票贵好多呢。
Bǐ yuánjià piào guì hǎo duō ne.
It cost way more than the normal price.
今天比昨天冷好多。
Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān lěng hǎo duō.
Today is much colder than yesterday.
it's …, so … will …
嘛 makes the reason sound obvious, and 会……的 expresses confidence.
过年了嘛，火车会有的。
Guònián le ma, huǒchē huì yǒu de.
It's New Year. The trains will run.
别担心，他会来的。
Bié dānxīn, tā huì lái de.
Don't worry. He'll come.
say: Excuse me, may I ask your name? Where are you heading?
How could I not? My parents, wife and kids are all back home.
I bought it from a tout. It cost way more than the normal price.
Then I'll wait. It's New Year. The trains will run.

078.title: The colour red
078.sub: A short talk, with a speaking prompt
078.transcriptNote: One speaker explains why red is a lucky colour in China, then asks you to answer out loud. The sample answer is my own.

blocks.label: 独白
lines: 红色是中国人很喜欢的颜色。
Hóngsè shì Zhōngguórén hěn xǐhuan de yánsè.
Red is a colour Chinese people love.
比如在婚礼上，新娘应该穿红色的衣服；
Bǐrú zài hūnlǐ shang, xīnniáng yīnggāi chuān hóngsè de yīfu;
For example, at a wedding the bride should wear red;
节日的时候，很多地方都挂上红色的灯笼；
jiérì de shíhou, hěn duō dìfang dōu guàshang hóngsè de dēnglong;
at festivals, red lanterns are hung up everywhere;
给孩子钱的时候，用红纸包着，叫红包，等等。
gěi háizi qián de shíhou, yòng hóng zhǐ bāo zhe, jiào hóngbāo, děngděng.
and money given to children is wrapped in red paper, called a 红包, and so on.
这是因为中国人觉得红色是喜庆的颜色，
Zhè shì yīnwèi Zhōngguórén juéde hóngsè shì xǐqìng de yánsè,
That's because Chinese people see red as a festive colour.
它表示幸福快乐的意思。
tā biǎoshì xìngfú kuàilè de yìsi.
It stands for happiness and joy.

blocks.label: 说说
blocks.h: 听后请说一说 · Your turn to speak

q: 听后请说一说：中国人在什么时候喜欢使用红颜色？为什么？
Tīng hòu qǐng shuō yi shuō: Zhōngguórén zài shénme shíhou xǐhuan shǐyòng hóng yánsè? Wèishénme?
Now say it yourself: when do Chinese people like to use red, and why?
ans: 在婚礼上、节日的时候和给孩子红包的时候，因为红色表示喜庆、幸福和快乐。
Zài hūnlǐ shang, jiérì de shíhou hé gěi háizi hóngbāo de shíhou, yīnwèi hóngsè biǎoshì xǐqìng, xìngfú hé kuàilè.
At weddings, at festivals and when giving children red envelopes, because red stands for celebration, happiness and joy.

grammar: 比如……，……，等等
for example …, …, and so on
比如 introduces a list of examples, and 等等 closes it.
比如在婚礼上……用红纸包着，叫红包，等等。
Bǐrú zài hūnlǐ shang … yòng hóng zhǐ bāo zhe, jiào hóngbāo, děngděng.
For example at weddings … red envelopes, and so on.
我喜欢很多水果，比如苹果、香蕉等等。
Wǒ xǐhuan hěn duō shuǐguǒ, bǐrú píngguǒ, xiāngjiāo děngděng.
I like lots of fruit, for example apples, bananas and so on.
V上 (attaching)
to put up, to put on
上 shows something being attached: 挂上 (hang up), 贴上 (stick on), 穿上 (put on).
很多地方都挂上红色的灯笼。
Hěn duō dìfang dōu guàshang hóngsè de dēnglong.
Red lanterns are hung up everywhere.
他在门上贴上了一个福字。
Tā zài mén shang tiēshang le yí ge fú zì.
He stuck a 福 on the door.
…, which is called …
叫 names the thing just described.
用红纸包着，叫红包。
Yòng hóng zhǐ bāo zhe, jiào hóngbāo.
Wrapped in red paper, called a 红包.
这种菜叫饺子。
Zhè zhǒng cài jiào jiǎozi.
This dish is called jiaozi.
这是因为……
this is because …
This explains the reason behind what was just said.
这是因为中国人觉得红色是喜庆的颜色。
Zhè shì yīnwèi Zhōngguórén juéde hóngsè shì xǐqìng de yánsè.
That's because Chinese people see red as festive.
他没来，这是因为他病了。
Tā méi lái, zhè shì yīnwèi tā bìng le.
He didn't come because he was ill.
gaps: 红色是中国人很喜欢的
在婚礼上，新娘应该穿红色的衣服。
很多地方都挂上红色的
say: Red is a colour Chinese people love.
For example, at a wedding the bride should wear red.
That's because Chinese people see red as a festive colour.
