081.title: Chinese New Year
081.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. It gathers the customs from parts 073–078 into one account.

lines: 中国阴历的新年叫做春节，
Zhōngguó yīnlì de xīnnián jiàozuò Chūnjié,
The Chinese lunar New Year is called Spring Festival.
和西方的圣诞节一样，是中国人一年中最重要、最热闹的节日，
hé xīfāng de Shèngdàn Jié yíyàng, shì Zhōngguórén yì nián zhōng zuì zhòngyào, zuì rènao de jiérì,
Like Christmas in the West, it's the most important and liveliest festival of the year for Chinese people,
也是全家人团圆的日子。
yě shì quánjiā rén tuányuán de rìzi.
and it's when the whole family gets together.
所以，出门在外的人必须在年前赶回家来，
Suǒyǐ, chūmén zài wài de rén bìxū zài nián qián gǎn huí jiā lai,
So people away from home must rush back before New Year,
大中小学也都在这个时候开始放寒假。
dà zhōng xiǎoxué yě dōu zài zhège shíhou kāishǐ fàng hánjià.
and universities and schools all start their winter holidays then.
从阴历十二月初开始，人们就要准备过年了。
Cóng yīnlì shí'èr yuè chū kāishǐ, rénmen jiù yào zhǔnbèi guònián le.
From the start of the twelfth lunar month, people begin getting ready for New Year.
先得把屋子打扫得干干净净，
Xiān děi bǎ wūzi dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng,
First the house has to be cleaned from top to bottom,
然后在门口贴上一副红色的对联和一个倒着的福字，表示福到了。
ránhòu zài ménkǒu tiēshang yí fù hóngsè de duìlián hé yí ge dào zhe de fú zì, biǎoshì fú dào le.
then a pair of red couplets and an upside-down 福 are stuck by the door, meaning good fortune has arrived.
大年三十晚上，全家人坐在一起，亲亲热热地吃一顿年夜饭。
Dànián sānshí wǎnshang, quánjiā rén zuò zài yìqǐ, qīnqīnrèrè de chī yí dùn niányèfàn.
On New Year's Eve, the whole family sits down together for a warm reunion dinner.
北方人习惯吃饺子，因为它的样子像元宝；
Běifāngrén xíguàn chī jiǎozi, yīnwèi tā de yàngzi xiàng yuánbǎo;
Northerners usually eat dumplings, because they look like gold ingots.
南方人喜欢做年糕，意思是一年比一年高。
nánfāngrén xǐhuan zuò niángāo, yìsi shì yì nián bǐ yì nián gāo.
Southerners like to make rice cake, meaning higher every year.
夜里十二点，看完了电视里春晚的节目，大人和孩子都跑到外边去放鞭炮。
Yèli shí'èr diǎn, kànwán le diànshì li Chūnwǎn de jiémù, dàrén hé háizi dōu pǎodào wàibian qù fàng biānpào.
At midnight, after the Spring Festival Gala on TV, adults and children run outside to set off firecrackers.
据说，这是为了把一个名字叫“夕”的怪物吓跑，使全家人一年平安，
Jùshuō, zhè shì wèile bǎ yí ge míngzi jiào “Xī” de guàiwu xià pǎo, shǐ quánjiā rén yì nián píng'ān,
It's said this is to scare off a monster called Xi and keep the family safe all year,
suǒyǐ zhè yì tiān yě jiào chúxī.
which is why the day is also called 除夕 (“chasing out Xi”).
正月初一，人们穿上新衣服，带着水果或点心去亲友家拜年，
Zhēngyuè chūyī, rénmen chuānshang xīn yīfu, dài zhe shuǐguǒ huò diǎnxin qù qīnyǒu jiā bàinián,
On the first day of the New Year, people put on new clothes and take fruit or pastries to visit friends and family,
互相说一些祝福的话，比如“身体健康”“恭喜发财”“万事如意”等等。
hùxiāng shuō yìxiē zhùfú de huà, bǐrú “shēntǐ jiànkāng” “gōngxǐ fācái” “wànshì rúyì” děngděng.
exchanging good wishes like “good health”, “prosperity” and “may all go well”.
孩子们还可以从大人那里得到装着钱的小红包。
Háizimen hái kěyǐ cóng dàrén nàlǐ dédào zhuāng zhe qián de xiǎo hóngbāo.
Children also get little red envelopes with money from the adults.
最近这些年，大城市里的人不再把春节看得那么重要了。
Zuìjìn zhèxiē nián, dà chéngshì li de rén bú zài bǎ Chūnjié kàn de nàme zhòngyào le.
In recent years, people in big cities no longer see Spring Festival as quite so important.
有些人觉得在家做饭太麻烦，就把年夜饭搬到餐馆里去吃，
Yǒuxiē rén juéde zài jiā zuò fàn tài máfan, jiù bǎ niányèfàn bāndào cānguǎn li qù chī,
Some find cooking at home too much trouble and have the reunion dinner at a restaurant instead.
也有人利用这个假期去旅行。
yě yǒu rén lìyòng zhège jiàqī qù lǚxíng.
Some use the holiday to travel.
就连拜年也变得简单了，只要用手机发几条短信就行了。
Jiù lián bàinián yě biàn de jiǎndān le, zhǐyào yòng shǒujī fā jǐ tiáo duǎnxìn jiù xíng le.
Even New Year greetings have got simpler. A few text messages are enough.
但是，对农村人来说，老传统还是绝不能改变的。
Dànshì, duì nóngcūnrén lái shuō, lǎo chuántǒng háishi jué bù néng gǎibiàn de.
But for people in the countryside, the old traditions absolutely must not change.

grammar: 和……一样，是……
like …, it is …
This compares something new to a familiar thing.
和西方的圣诞节一样，是中国人一年中最重要、最热闹的节日。
Hé xīfāng de Shèngdàn Jié yíyàng, shì Zhōngguórén yì nián zhōng zuì zhòngyào, zuì rènao de jiérì.
Like Christmas in the West, it's the most important festival of the year.
和北京一样，上海也是大城市。
Hé Běijīng yíyàng, Shànghǎi yě shì dà chéngshì.
Like Beijing, Shanghai is a big city.
把 + object + V得 + AABB
to … until it's …
Using 把 with a doubled adjective emphasises the result: 打扫得干干净净.
先得把屋子打扫得干干净净。
Xiān děi bǎ wūzi dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng.
First the house has to be cleaned from top to bottom.
她把房间收拾得整整齐齐。
Tā bǎ fángjiān shōushi de zhěngzhěngqíqí.
She tidied the room until it was spick and span.
这是为了……
this is in order to …
This states the purpose of a custom.
据说，这是为了把一个名字叫“夕”的怪物吓跑。
Jùshuō, zhè shì wèile bǎ yí ge míngzi jiào “Xī” de guàiwu xià pǎo.
It's said this is to scare off a monster called Xi.
这是为了让大家都能听清楚。
Zhè shì wèile ràng dàjiā dōu néng tīng qīngchu.
This is so that everyone can hear clearly.
不再……了
no longer …
不再 shows that a former situation has stopped.
大城市里的人不再把春节看得那么重要了。
Dà chéngshì li de rén bú zài bǎ Chūnjié kàn de nàme zhòngyào le.
City people no longer see Spring Festival as so important.
他不再抽烟了。
Tā bú zài chōuyān le.
He doesn't smoke any more.
就连……也……
even …
就连 is an emphatic form of 连……也.
就连拜年也变得简单了。
Jiù lián bàinián yě biàn de jiǎndān le.
Even New Year greetings have got simpler.
就连小孩子也知道这件事。
Jiù lián xiǎo háizi yě zhīdào zhè jiàn shì.
Even small children know about it.
gaps: 然后在门口贴上一副红色的
大人和孩子都跑到外边去放
把春节看得那么重要了。
say: The Chinese lunar New Year is called Spring Festival.
On New Year's Eve, the whole family sits down together for a warm reunion dinner.
Children also get little red envelopes with money from the adults.
Even New Year greetings have got simpler. A few text messages are enough.

082.zh: 过年了，火车一定会开的
082.title: “It's New Year, the trains will run”
082.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. It's the full story behind the interview in part 077.

lines: 过年了，火车一定会开的
Guònián le, huǒchē yídìng huì kāi de
It's New Year, the trains will run
二〇〇八年春节前，中国南方突然下了一场非常寒冷的暴风雪。
Èr líng líng bā nián Chūnjié qián, Zhōngguó nánfāng tūrán xià le yì chǎng fēicháng hánlěng de bàofēngxuě.
Just before Spring Festival in 2008, a bitterly cold snowstorm suddenly hit southern China.
飞机不能起飞，火车和汽车都停开了，电话联系也断了。
Fēijī bù néng qǐfēi, huǒchē hé qìchē dōu tíngkāi le, diànhuà liánxì yě duàn le.
Planes couldn't take off, trains and coaches stopped running, and even phone lines went down.
记者在火车站看到，大厅里挤满了成千上万的旅客，
Jìzhě zài huǒchēzhàn kàndào, dàtīng li jǐmǎn le chéng qiān shàng wàn de lǚkè,
At the station, a reporter saw the hall packed with thousands of passengers.
有的连坐的地方都没有，有的还抱着孩子。
yǒude lián zuò de dìfang dōu méiyǒu, yǒude hái bào zhe háizi.
Some didn't even have anywhere to sit, and some were holding children.
谁也不清楚什么时候会有车。
Shéi yě bù qīngchu shénme shíhou huì yǒu chē.
Nobody knew when there'd be a train.
人们又冷又累，十分辛苦，心里只有一个目的和愿望：回家过年。
Rénmen yòu lěng yòu lèi, shífēn xīnkǔ, xīnli zhǐ yǒu yí ge mùdì hé yuànwàng: huí jiā guònián.
People were cold, tired and miserable, with only one aim and wish: to get home for New Year.
Shí Bǎotíng shì ge Húběi míngōng,
Shi Baoting is a migrant worker from Hubei.
他的行李是两个装得满满的大袋子，都是给家人带回去的礼物。
tā de xíngli shì liǎng ge zhuāng de mǎnmǎn de dà dàizi, dōu shì gěi jiārén dài huiqu de lǐwù.
His luggage was two big, bulging bags, all presents for his family.
他告诉记者，他们夫妻俩在广东一家鞋厂打工，已经有七八年了，
Tā gàosu jìzhě, tāmen fūqī liǎ zài Guǎngdōng yì jiā xiéchǎng dǎgōng, yǐjīng yǒu qī bā nián le,
He told the reporter that he and his wife had worked in a shoe factory in Guangdong for seven or eight years.
年年都要回家，可是年年买票都很困难。
niánnián dōu yào huí jiā, kěshì niánnián mǎi piào dōu hěn kùnnan.
They go home every year, and every year getting tickets is hard.
幸好他的妻子已经提前半个月回去了。
Xìnghǎo tā de qīzi yǐjīng tíqián bàn ge yuè huíqu le.
Luckily his wife had already gone back two weeks early.
“Nà nǐ de piào shì zěnme mǎidào de?”
“So how did you get your ticket?”
石宝亭吸了一口烟，然后挥了一下手：
Shí Bǎotíng xī le yì kǒu yān, ránhòu huī le yíxià shǒu:
Shi Baoting took a drag on his cigarette and waved his hand.
“唉，别提了！为了买票，我白白排了好几个小时的队，最后连站票都没买着。
“Āi, bié tí le! Wèile mǎi piào, wǒ báibái pái le hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí de duì, zuìhòu lián zhànpiào dōu méi mǎizháo.
“Don't ask! I queued for hours for nothing, and couldn't even get a standing ticket in the end.
没办法，只好从黄牛那里买了这张高价票。”
Méi bànfǎ, zhǐhǎo cóng huángniú nàlǐ mǎi le zhè zhāng gāojià piào.”
I had no choice but to buy this overpriced one from a tout.”
“买票这么难，花费这么大，你就没想过留下来过年吗？”
“Mǎi piào zhème nán, huāfèi zhème dà, nǐ jiù méi xiǎng guo liú xialai guònián ma?”
“With tickets so hard to get and so expensive, didn't you think of staying for New Year?”
“说实话，不是没想过。过年的时候，我们工厂安排得很好，有免费的年夜饭，还可以免费逛公园，
“Shuō shíhuà, bú shì méi xiǎng guo. Guònián de shíhou, wǒmen gōngchǎng ānpái de hěn hǎo, yǒu miǎnfèi de niányèfàn, hái kěyǐ miǎnfèi guàng gōngyuán,
“To be honest, I did think about it. At New Year our factory organises things well: a free reunion dinner and free entry to the parks.
可是，孩子和父母都在老家，不回去看看不行。”
kěshì, háizi hé fùmǔ dōu zài lǎojiā, bù huíqu kànkan bù xíng.”
But my children and parents are back home. I have to go and see them.”
“Zhēn dǎoméi, pèngshang le zhège huài tiānqì.
“What bad luck, running into weather like this.
可是万一火车开不了，回不去了怎么办？”
Kěshì wànyī huǒchē kāi bu liǎo, huí bu qù le zěnme bàn?”
But what if the trains can't run and you can't get home?”
石宝亭把烟头扔在地上，口气非常肯定：
Shí Bǎotíng bǎ yāntóu rēng zài dì shang, kǒuqì fēicháng kěndìng:
Shi Baoting threw his cigarette end on the ground and said firmly,
“非回去不可！过年了嘛，火车一定会开的！”
“Fēi huíqu bù kě! Guònián le ma, huǒchē yídìng huì kāi de!”
“I'm going back, no matter what! It's New Year. The trains will run!”

grammar: 有的……，有的……
some …, others …
有的 divides a group into different cases.
有的连坐的地方都没有，有的还抱着孩子。
Yǒude lián zuò de dìfang dōu méiyǒu, yǒude hái bào zhe háizi.
Some didn't even have anywhere to sit, and some were holding children.
学生们有的看书，有的写字。
Xuéshengmen yǒude kàn shū, yǒude xiě zì.
Some students were reading, others writing.
谁也不……
nobody …
A question word + 也 + negative means “no one at all”.
谁也不清楚什么时候会有车。
Shéi yě bù qīngchu shénme shíhou huì yǒu chē.
Nobody knew when there'd be a train.
这件事谁也不知道。
Zhè jiàn shì shéi yě bù zhīdào.
Nobody knows about this.
白白 + V了……
to … for nothing
白白 means effort that was wasted.
我白白排了好几个小时的队。
Wǒ báibái pái le hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí de duì.
I queued for hours for nothing.
我白白等了一个下午。
Wǒ báibái děng le yí ge xiàwǔ.
I waited all afternoon for nothing.
不是没想过
it's not that I didn't think of it
A double negative that admits something.
说实话，不是没想过。
Shuō shíhuà, bú shì méi xiǎng guo.
To be honest, I did think about it.
我不是不想去，是没有时间。
Wǒ bú shì bù xiǎng qù, shì méiyǒu shíjiān.
It's not that I don't want to go. I don't have time.
万一……怎么办？
what if …?
万一 raises an unlikely but worrying possibility.
可是万一火车开不了，回不去了怎么办？
Kěshì wànyī huǒchē kāi bu liǎo, huí bu qù le zěnme bàn?
But what if the trains can't run?
万一下雨怎么办？
Wànyī xià yǔ zěnme bàn?
What if it rains?
gaps: 中国南方突然下了一场非常寒冷的
大厅里挤满了成千上万的
火车开不了，回不去了怎么办？
say: Planes couldn't take off, trains and coaches stopped running, and even phone lines went down.
Luckily his wife had already gone back two weeks early.
I queued for hours for nothing.
I'm going back, no matter what! It's New Year. The trains will run!

083.title: Vocabulary list
083.sub: Geography and numbers: words for parts 084–087
083.transcriptNote: The words in the order they're read. The English introduction isn't transcribed. Single words were matched to how parts 084–086 use them.

blocks.note: Matched to the texts: 却 (heard as 雀), 亿 (part 085 has 十三亿), 穷 and 富 (heard as 熊 and 付; part 085 has 东部富，西部穷), 秒 (part 086 has 五分四十五秒) and 书费 (heard as 收费; part 086 has 一百五十元书费).

084.title: Ten sentences
084.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences using the new words from part 083. Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 超市卖的鱼不如那家小店的新鲜。
Chāoshì mài de yú bùrú nà jiā xiǎo diàn de xīnxiān.
The fish at the supermarket isn't as fresh as at that little shop.
谁都知道，夏天来这里旅游的人非常多。
Shéi dōu zhīdào, xiàtiān lái zhèlǐ lǚyóu de rén fēicháng duō.
Everyone knows loads of tourists come here in summer.
这一带有六个工厂，其中最大的是一家鞋厂。
Zhè yídài yǒu liù ge gōngchǎng, qízhōng zuì dà de shì yì jiā xiéchǎng.
There are six factories around here, and the biggest of them is a shoe factory.
他的这些知识都是通过看书学到的。
Tā de zhèxiē zhīshi dōu shì tōngguò kàn shū xuédào de.
He learned all this from reading books.
blocks.note: One model heard 不都是 (not all), which would mean he did NOT learn it all from books.

lines: 海洋大约占地球表面的四分之三。
Hǎiyáng dàyuē zhàn dìqiú biǎomiàn de sì fēn zhī sān.
The oceans cover about three-quarters of the earth's surface.
南方的冬天不太冷，而夏天有时会非常热。
Nánfāng de dōngtiān bú tài lěng, ér xiàtiān yǒushí huì fēicháng rè.
Winters in the south aren't very cold, while summers can be extremely hot.
Qīzi de huà bù duō, què hěn duì.
My wife doesn't say much, but what she says is right.
北京的夏天比较热，尤其是七月。
Běijīng de xiàtiān bǐjiào rè, yóuqí shì qīyuè.
Beijing summers are pretty hot, especially July.
飞龙乐队的演唱会把歌迷们全都集中到一起了。
Fēilóng Yuèduì de yǎnchànghuì bǎ gēmímen quán dōu jízhōng dào yìqǐ le.
The Feilong concert brought all the fans together.
你们是朋友，更应该互相帮助。
Nǐmen shì péngyou, gèng yīnggāi hùxiāng bāngzhù.
You're friends, so you should help each other all the more.

vocab: to make up, to take up
grammar: A 不如 B + adj
A isn't as … as B
不如 compares and says A falls short.
超市卖的鱼不如那家小店的新鲜。
Chāoshì mài de yú bùrú nà jiā xiǎo diàn de xīnxiān.
The supermarket fish isn't as fresh as at that little shop.
坐公交车不如坐地铁快。
Zuò gōngjiāochē bùrú zuò dìtiě kuài.
The bus isn't as fast as the subway.
…, of which …
其中 picks one out of a group just mentioned.
这一带有六个工厂，其中最大的是一家鞋厂。
Zhè yídài yǒu liù ge gōngchǎng, qízhōng zuì dà de shì yì jiā xiéchǎng.
There are six factories, and the biggest is a shoe factory.
我们班有二十个学生，其中五个是男生。
Wǒmen bān yǒu èrshí ge xuésheng, qízhōng wǔ ge shì nánshēng.
Our class has twenty students, five of them boys.
通过……
through, by means of
通过 gives the method used to get a result.
他的这些知识都是通过看书学到的。
Tā de zhèxiē zhīshi dōu shì tōngguò kàn shū xuédào de.
He learned all this from reading books.
我是通过朋友认识他的。
Wǒ shì tōngguò péngyou rènshi tā de.
I met him through a friend.
A 占 B 的 X分之Y
A makes up Y/X of B
占 gives a proportion. Fractions are said bottom first: 四分之三 (three-quarters).
海洋大约占地球表面的四分之三。
Hǎiyáng dàyuē zhàn dìqiú biǎomiàn de sì fēn zhī sān.
The oceans cover about three-quarters of the earth's surface.
女生占全班的一半。
Nǚshēng zhàn quán bān de yíbàn.
Girls make up half the class.
…, while … / …, but …
而 contrasts two facts and is a bit formal. 却 marks a surprising contrast and goes before the verb.
妻子的话不多，却很对。
Qīzi de huà bù duō, què hěn duì.
My wife doesn't say much, but what she says is right.
他很聪明，却不努力。
Tā hěn cōngming, què bù nǔlì.
He's clever, but he doesn't work hard.
…, especially …
尤其是 singles out the strongest example.
北京的夏天比较热，尤其是七月。
Běijīng de xiàtiān bǐjiào rè, yóuqí shì qīyuè.
Beijing summers are hot, especially July.
我喜欢水果，尤其是苹果。
Wǒ xǐhuan shuǐguǒ, yóuqí shì píngguǒ.
I like fruit, especially apples.
say: The fish at the supermarket isn't as fresh as at that little shop.
He learned all this from reading books.
Beijing summers are pretty hot, especially July.
You're friends, so you should help each other all the more.

085.title: Eight multiple-choice items
085.transcriptNote: Each item has a sentence, a question and four options. The answer key is my own reading. Some item numbers aren't read aloud.

lines: 中国的人口是世界上最多的，差不多是世界总人口的百分之二十二。
Zhōngguó de rénkǒu shì shìjiè shang zuì duō de, chàbuduō shì shìjiè zǒng rénkǒu de bǎi fēn zhī èrshí'èr.
China has the world's largest population, about 22% of the world total.

q: 这句话告诉我们什么？
Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen shénme?
What does this tell us?
o: 中国是人口比较多的国家之一。
Zhōngguó shì rénkǒu bǐjiào duō de guójiā zhī yī.
China is one of the more populous countries.
中国是二十二个人口较多的国家之一。
Zhōngguó shì èrshí'èr ge rénkǒu jiào duō de guójiā zhī yī.
China is one of 22 populous countries.
中国是世界上人口最多的国家。
Zhōngguó shì shìjiè shang rénkǒu zuì duō de guójiā.
China is the world's most populous country.
全世界有很多人口很多的国家。
Quán shìjiè yǒu hěn duō rénkǒu hěn duō de guójiā.

lines: 二〇〇五年一月六日是中国的十三亿人口日，也就是说，在那一天，中国的人口达到了十三亿。
Èr líng líng wǔ nián yī yuè liù rì shì Zhōngguó de shísān yì rénkǒu rì, yě jiù shì shuō, zài nà yì tiān, Zhōngguó de rénkǒu dádào le shísān yì.
6 January 2005 was China's 1.3 billion population day. In other words, on that day China's population reached 1.3 billion.

q: 中国的人口是哪年达到十三亿的？
Zhōngguó de rénkǒu shì nǎ nián dádào shísān yì de?
In which year did China's population reach 1.3 billion?

lines: 中国的人口中，百分之九十以上是汉族人，另外五十五个少数民族的人口不到百分之十。
Zhōngguó de rénkǒu zhōng, bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí yǐshàng shì Hànzú rén, lìngwài wǔshíwǔ ge shǎoshù mínzú de rénkǒu bú dào bǎi fēn zhī shí.
Over 90% of China's population is Han. The other 55 ethnic minorities make up less than 10%.

q: 这句话告诉我们什么？
Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen shénme?
What does this tell us?
o: The Han population is fairly large.
The Han are the largest group.
少数民族的总人口很多。
Shǎoshù mínzú de zǒng rénkǒu hěn duō.
The minorities' total population is very large.
中国有五十五个少数民族。
Zhōngguó yǒu wǔshíwǔ ge shǎoshù mínzú.

blocks.note: D is also true. B fits the main point (over 90% Han), so check your book.

lines: 中国的陆地面积在世界上是第三位，排在俄罗斯和加拿大的后边，在美国的前边。
Zhōngguó de lùdì miànjī zài shìjiè shang shì dì sān wèi, pái zài Éluósī hé Jiānádà de hòubian, zài Měiguó de qiánbian.
China's land area is third in the world, behind Russia and Canada and ahead of the US.

q: 世界上陆地面积第二大的国家是哪个？
Shìjiè shang lùdì miànjī dì èr dà de guójiā shì nǎ ge?
Which country has the second-largest land area?

lines: 中国西部有很多高山，平原差不多都在东部。
Zhōngguó xībù yǒu hěn duō gāo shān, píngyuán chàbuduō dōu zài dōngbù.
Western China has lots of high mountains, and the plains are almost all in the east.

q: 中国的高山大部分在什么地方？
Zhōngguó de gāo shān dà bùfen zài shénme dìfang?
Where are most of China's high mountains?

lines: 中国人口大部分集中在东部，而且东部的经济也最发达，但西部的经济比较差，人口也少。
Zhōngguó rénkǒu dà bùfen jízhōng zài dōngbù, érqiě dōngbù de jīngjì yě zuì fādá, dàn xībù de jīngjì bǐjiào chà, rénkǒu yě shǎo.
Most of China's population is in the east, which is also the most developed. The west's economy is weaker, and fewer people live there.

q: 中国东部和西部有什么差别？
Zhōngguó dōngbù hé xībù yǒu shénme chābié?
How do the east and west differ?
o: 东部穷，人口多；西部富，人口少。
Dōngbù qióng, rénkǒu duō; xībù fù, rénkǒu shǎo.
The east is poor and crowded, the west rich and empty.
东部穷，人口少；西部富，人口多。
Dōngbù qióng, rénkǒu shǎo; xībù fù, rénkǒu duō.
The east is poor and empty, the west rich and crowded.
西部穷，人口少；东部富，人口多。
Xībù qióng, rénkǒu shǎo; dōngbù fù, rénkǒu duō.
The west is poor and empty, the east rich and crowded.
西部穷，人口不少；东部富，人口不多。
Xībù qióng, rénkǒu bù shǎo; dōngbù fù, rénkǒu bù duō.
The west is poor but populous, the east rich but sparse.

lines: 中国西部和北方冬天和夏天的温度差别很大，夏天很热，冬天冷得不得了；
Zhōngguó xībù hé běifāng dōngtiān hé xiàtiān de wēndù chābié hěn dà, xiàtiān hěn rè, dōngtiān lěng de bùdéliǎo;
In the west and north, the difference between summer and winter is huge: summers are hot and winters bitterly cold.
南方比较温和，冬天也不那么冷。
nánfāng bǐjiào wēnhé, dōngtiān yě bú nàme lěng.
The south is milder, and winters there aren't so cold.

q: 中国南方和北方的气候有什么不一样？
Zhōngguó nánfāng hé běifāng de qìhòu yǒu shénme bù yíyàng?
How do the climates of north and south differ?
o: Běifāng dōngtiān lěng, xiàtiān bú rè.
The north: cold winters, mild summers.
南方冬天不冷，夏天不太热。
Nánfāng dōngtiān bù lěng, xiàtiān bú tài rè.
The south: mild winters, not very hot summers.
南方冬天很冷，夏天很热。
Nánfāng dōngtiān hěn lěng, xiàtiān hěn rè.
The south: very cold winters, very hot summers.
北方冬天很冷，夏天也很热。
Běifāng dōngtiān hěn lěng, xiàtiān yě hěn rè.
The north: very cold winters and very hot summers.

blocks.note: D matches the passage most closely. B (a mild south) also fits, so check your book.

lines: 中国人的祖先生活在黄河中下游地区，所以中国人还把黄河叫做母亲河。
Zhōngguórén de zǔxiān shēnghuó zài Huáng Hé zhōng-xiàyóu dìqū, suǒyǐ Zhōngguórén hái bǎ Huáng Hé jiàozuò mǔqīn hé.
The ancestors of the Chinese lived along the middle and lower Yellow River, so it's also called the Mother River.

q: 中国人为什么把黄河叫做母亲河？
Zhōngguórén wèishénme bǎ Huáng Hé jiàozuò mǔqīn hé?
Why is the Yellow River called the Mother River?
o: 因为黄河中下游地区是中国人的祖先生活的地方。
Yīnwèi Huáng Hé zhōng-xiàyóu dìqū shì Zhōngguórén de zǔxiān shēnghuó de dìfang.
The ancestors lived along its middle and lower reaches.
因为黄河有中下游地区。
Yīnwèi Huáng Hé yǒu zhōng-xiàyóu dìqū.
It has middle and lower reaches.
因为黄河是中国人的祖先。
Yīnwèi Huáng Hé shì Zhōngguórén de zǔxiān.
因为中国人的祖先生活在黄河上游地区。
Yīnwèi Zhōngguórén de zǔxiān shēnghuó zài Huáng Hé shàngyóu dìqū.
The ancestors lived on its upper reaches.

grammar: 百分之 + number
… per cent
Percentages are said as “of a hundred, X”: 百分之二十二 is 22%.
差不多是世界总人口的百分之二十二。
Chàbuduō shì shìjiè zǒng rénkǒu de bǎi fēn zhī èrshí'èr.
About 22% of the world total.
百分之八十的学生通过了考试。
Bǎi fēn zhī bāshí de xuésheng tōngguò le kǎoshì.
80% of students passed the exam.
也就是说
in other words
This rephrases or sums up what was just said.
也就是说，在那一天，中国的人口达到了十三亿。
Yě jiù shì shuō, zài nà yì tiān, Zhōngguó de rénkǒu dádào le shísān yì.
In other words, on that day the population reached 1.3 billion.
他明天走，也就是说，今天是最后一天。
Tā míngtiān zǒu, yě jiù shì shuō, jīntiān shì zuìhòu yì tiān.
He leaves tomorrow, so today's the last day.
排在……的后边 / 前边
ranked behind / ahead of
This places something in a ranking.
排在俄罗斯和加拿大的后边，在美国的前边。
Pái zài Éluósī hé Jiānádà de hòubian, zài Měiguó de qiánbian.
Behind Russia and Canada, ahead of the US.
他的成绩排在全班第三。
Tā de chéngjì pái zài quán bān dì sān.
He's third in the class.
大部分 + 集中在……
mostly concentrated in …
大部分 means the majority.
中国人口大部分集中在东部。
Zhōngguó rénkǒu dà bùfen jízhōng zài dōngbù.
Most of China's population is in the east.
大部分学生住在学校里。
Dà bùfen xuésheng zhù zài xuéxiào li.
Most students live on campus.
把 A 叫做 B
to call A B
叫做 gives a name or title.
所以中国人还把黄河叫做母亲河。
Suǒyǐ Zhōngguórén hái bǎ Huáng Hé jiàozuò mǔqīn hé.
So the Yellow River is also called the Mother River.
大家把他叫做“老外”。
Dàjiā bǎ tā jiàozuò “lǎowài”.
Everyone calls him “laowai”.
gaps: 差不多是世界总人口的
生活在黄河中下游地区。
say: China has the world's largest population, about 22% of the world total.
Western China has lots of high mountains, and the plains are almost all in the east.
The south is milder, and winters there aren't so cold.
The ancestors of the Chinese lived along the middle and lower Yellow River, so it's also called the Mother River.

086.title: Nine number puzzles
086.sub: Multiple choice with a little arithmetic
086.transcriptNote: Each item has a sentence or short exchange with numbers, a question and four options. The answer key is my own working. Some item numbers aren't read aloud.

lines: 昨天来上课的有十个人，今天来的是昨天的三倍。
Zuótiān lái shàngkè de yǒu shí ge rén, jīntiān lái de shì zuótiān de sān bèi.
Ten people came to class yesterday. Today three times as many came.

q: 今天有多少人来上课？
Jīntiān yǒu duōshao rén lái shàngkè?
How many came today?

lines: 中国人口有十三亿，其中百分之九十是汉族。
Zhōngguó rénkǒu yǒu shísān yì, qízhōng bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí shì Hànzú.
China has 1.3 billion people, 90% of whom are Han.

q: 中国汉族人口大约有多少？
Zhōngguó Hànzú rénkǒu dàyuē yǒu duōshao?
Roughly how many Han Chinese are there?

blocks.note: 1.3 billion × 90% ≈ 1.17 billion. The options were re-transcribed as one span, because the first pass merged two of them.

lines: 我去年通过小赵的朋友马新平认识了张大海的老师。
Wǒ qùnián tōngguò Xiǎo Zhào de péngyou Mǎ Xīnpíng rènshi le Zhāng Dàhǎi de lǎoshī.
Last year, through Xiao Zhao's friend Ma Xinping, I met Zhang Dahai's teacher.

q: 我去年认识了谁？
Wǒ qùnián rènshi le shéi?
Who did I meet last year?

lines: 老张今年四十五岁了，他的太太比他大三岁。
Lǎo Zhāng jīnnián sìshíwǔ suì le, tā de tàitai bǐ tā dà sān suì.
Lao Zhang is 45 this year, and his wife is three years older.

q: 老张的太太今年多大岁数了？
Lǎo Zhāng de tàitai jīnnián duō dà suìshu le?
How old is his wife?

lines: 小王这次游泳成绩怎么样？
Xiǎo Wáng zhè cì yóuyǒng chéngjì zěnmeyàng?
How did Xiao Wang do in the swimming this time?
五分四十五秒，比第二名快了十五秒。
Wǔ fēn sìshíwǔ miǎo, bǐ dì èr míng kuài le shíwǔ miǎo.
5:45, fifteen seconds faster than second place.

q: 第二名的成绩是多少？
Dì èr míng de chéngjì shì duōshao?
What was second place's time?

lines: 现在上学要花不少钱，我和姐姐每人要交三千元学费，每人还要交一百五十元书费呢。
Xiànzài shàngxué yào huā bù shǎo qián, wǒ hé jiějie měi rén yào jiāo sānqiān yuán xuéfèi, měi rén hái yào jiāo yìbǎi wǔshí yuán shūfèi ne.
School costs a lot these days. My sister and I each pay 3,000 yuan in fees, plus 150 yuan each for books.

q: 他们姐弟俩一共要交多少钱？
Tāmen jiědì liǎ yígòng yào jiāo duōshao qián?
How much do the two of them pay in total?

lines: 听说小李的考试成绩不太好。
Tīngshuō Xiǎo Lǐ de kǎoshì chéngjì bú tài hǎo.
I hear Xiao Li didn't do well in the exam.
Nà Xiǎo Wáng de chéngjì zěnmeyàng?
小王的成绩也不比小李的好多少。
Xiǎo Wáng de chéngjì yě bù bǐ Xiǎo Lǐ de hǎo duōshao.
Xiao Wang didn't do much better than Xiao Li.

q: 小王的成绩怎么样？
Xiǎo Wáng de chéngjì zěnmeyàng?
How did Xiao Wang do?
o: bǐ Xiǎo Lǐ de chéngjì hǎo de duō
gēn Xiǎo Lǐ de chéngjì chàbuduō
about the same as Xiao Li
bǐ Xiǎo Lǐ de chéngjì chà de duō
bǐ Xiǎo Lǐ de chéngjì hǎo

lines: 小张能参加最后的比赛吗？
Xiǎo Zhāng néng cānjiā zuìhòu de bǐsài ma?
Can Xiao Zhang get into the final?
哪有那么容易，两百个人里，能参加最后比赛的大概只有十分之一。
Nǎ yǒu nàme róngyì, liǎng bǎi ge rén li, néng cānjiā zuìhòu bǐsài de dàgài zhǐ yǒu shí fēn zhī yī.
It's not that easy. Out of 200 people, only about a tenth make the final.

q: 有多少人可以参加最后的比赛？
Yǒu duōshao rén kěyǐ cānjiā zuìhòu de bǐsài?
How many people can enter the final?

lines: 今天的晚会大家都能来吗？
Jīntiān de wǎnhuì dàjiā dōu néng lái ma?
Can everyone make it to tonight's party?
有几个人不能来，其中有小王。
Yǒu jǐ ge rén bù néng lái, qízhōng yǒu Xiǎo Wáng.
A few people can't come, including Xiao Wang.

q: 从对话里，我们可以知道什么？
Cóng duìhuà li, wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell from the dialogue?
o: Lái cānjiā wǎnhuì de rén hěn shǎo.
小王一个人来参加晚会。
Xiǎo Wáng yí ge rén lái cānjiā wǎnhuì.
Xiǎo Wáng bù néng lái cānjiā wǎnhuì.

grammar: ……是……的 X 倍
is X times …
倍 gives a multiple. 三倍 means three times as many.
今天来的是昨天的三倍。
Jīntiān lái de shì zuótiān de sān bèi.
Three times as many came today as yesterday.
这个房间是那个的两倍大。
Zhège fángjiān shì nàge de liǎng bèi dà.
This room is twice as big as that one.
A 比 B 大/快 + amount
A is … more than B
The difference goes after the adjective: 大三岁 (three years older), 快了十五秒 (fifteen seconds faster).
他的太太比他大三岁。
Tā de tàitai bǐ tā dà sān suì.
His wife is three years older than him.
我比他高五厘米。
Wǒ bǐ tā gāo wǔ límǐ.
I'm five centimetres taller than him.
A 不比 B + adj + 多少
A is hardly any … than B
不比 denies a real difference, so 不比……好多少 means “not much better”.
小王的成绩也不比小李的好多少。
Xiǎo Wáng de chéngjì yě bù bǐ Xiǎo Lǐ de hǎo duōshao.
Xiao Wang didn't do much better.
这家店不比那家便宜多少。
Zhè jiā diàn bù bǐ nà jiā piányi duōshao.
This shop isn't much cheaper than that one.
哪有那么容易
it's not that easy
This rhetorical question means “of course not”.
哪有那么容易。
Nǎ yǒu nàme róngyì.
It's not that easy.
学好汉语哪有那么容易？
Xuéhǎo Hànyǔ nǎ yǒu nàme róngyì?
Learning Chinese well isn't that easy!
gaps: 小赵的朋友马新平认识了张大海的老师。
我和姐姐每人要交三千元
能参加最后比赛的大概只有十分之
say: Ten people came to class yesterday. Today three times as many came.
Lao Zhang is 45 this year, and his wife is three years older.
It's not that easy. Out of 200 people, only about a tenth make the final.
A few people can't come, including Xiao Wang.

087.title: What's Hong Kong like?
087.sub: Lao Liu describes Hong Kong, with six multiple-choice items
087.transcriptNote: 甲 asks the questions and 乙 is Lao Liu. Speakers are assigned from context. The answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: 老刘，你觉得香港怎么样？
Lǎo Liú, nǐ juéde Xiānggǎng zěnmeyàng?
Lao Liu, what did you think of Hong Kong?
不错，城市很干净，房子也很漂亮。
Búcuò, chéngshì hěn gānjìng, fángzi yě hěn piàoliang.
Not bad. The city's clean and the buildings are lovely.
香港的东西是不是比较贵？
Xiānggǎng de dōngxi shì bu shì bǐjiào guì?
Tài guì le, bǐ Běijīng guì de duō.
Chī, chuān, yòng dōu bǐ Běijīng guì ma?
Food, clothes, everyday things, all dearer than Beijing?
都比北京贵，比如穿的方面，比北京差不多贵一倍。
Dōu bǐ Běijīng guì, bǐrú chuān de fāngmiàn, bǐ Běijīng chàbuduō guì yí bèi.
All of it. Clothes, for example, cost about twice as much as in Beijing.
不过，最贵的是租房子和买房子。
Búguò, zuì guì de shì zū fángzi hé mǎi fángzi.
But the most expensive thing is renting or buying a home.
香港的人口比北京多吗？
Xiānggǎng de rénkǒu bǐ Běijīng duō ma?
Does Hong Kong have more people than Beijing?
不比北京多，是北京的二分之一。不过香港地方小，到处都很挤。
Bù bǐ Běijīng duō, shì Běijīng de èr fēn zhī yī. Búguò Xiānggǎng dìfang xiǎo, dàochù dōu hěn jǐ.
No, about half as many. But Hong Kong is small, so it's crowded everywhere.
香港人吃饭的习惯是不是跟广东人一样？
Xiānggǎngrén chī fàn de xíguàn shì bu shì gēn Guǎngdōngrén yíyàng?
Do Hong Kong people eat the same way as people in Guangdong?
是的，差不多。你去香港一定要吃早茶，很好吃。
Shì de, chàbuduō. Nǐ qù Xiānggǎng yídìng yào chī zǎochá, hěn hǎochī.
Yes, pretty much. If you go, you must have dim sum, it's delicious.
Zǎochá? Bú shì hē de ma?
Morning tea? Isn't tea something you drink?
吃早茶跟吃饭差不多，吃的东西很多。
Chī zǎochá gēn chī fàn chàbuduō, chī de dōngxi hěn duō.
Having 早茶 is like having a meal. There's lots to eat.
对了，香港人是不是说广东话？很难懂吧？
Duì le, Xiānggǎngrén shì bu shì shuō Guǎngdōnghuà? Hěn nán dǒng ba?
By the way, do people in Hong Kong speak Cantonese? It must be hard to understand.
百分之九十以上的香港人都说广东话，不过，现在越来越多的人会说普通话了。
Bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí yǐshàng de Xiānggǎngrén dōu shuō Guǎngdōnghuà, búguò, xiànzài yuèláiyuè duō de rén huì shuō pǔtōnghuà le.
Over 90% of Hong Kong people speak Cantonese, but more and more can speak Mandarin now.

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 香港的什么比北京贵？
Xiānggǎng de shénme bǐ Běijīng guì?
What is dearer in Hong Kong than Beijing?
香港最贵的东西是什么？
Xiānggǎng zuì guì de dōngxi shì shénme?
What's most expensive in Hong Kong?
香港的人口比北京多吗？
Xiānggǎng de rénkǒu bǐ Běijīng duō ma?
Does Hong Kong have more people than Beijing?
在香港买衣服的钱是北京的多少倍？
Zài Xiānggǎng mǎi yīfu de qián shì Běijīng de duōshao bèi?
How many times the Beijing price are clothes in Hong Kong?
早茶是什么？
Zǎochá shì shénme?
What is 早茶?

chī fàn de shíhou hē de chá

q: 有多少香港人不说广东话？
Yǒu duōshao Xiānggǎngrén bù shuō Guǎngdōnghuà?
How many Hong Kong people don't speak Cantonese?
o: dàyuē bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí de rén
dàyuē bǎi fēn zhī shíjiǔ de rén
dàyuē bǎi fēn zhī shí de rén
dàyuē bǎi fēn zhī sì de rén

blocks.note: Question 4 is a trap: 贵一倍 means “one time more”, which makes it twice the price, so 两倍 (B).

grammar: 是不是……？
isn't it …?
This checks an assumption, like a tag question.
香港的东西是不是比较贵？
Xiānggǎng de dōngxi shì bu shì bǐjiào guì?
Isn't everything quite expensive there?
你是不是累了？
Nǐ shì bu shì lèi le?
Are you tired?
比……贵一倍
twice as expensive as …
贵一倍 means “dearer by one times”, so twice the price. Watch out for the 倍 trap.
比北京差不多贵一倍。
Bǐ Běijīng chàbuduō guì yí bèi.
About twice as expensive as Beijing.
今年的学生比去年多一倍。
Jīnnián de xuésheng bǐ qùnián duō yí bèi.
There are twice as many students as last year.
不比……多，是……的二分之一
no more than …, it's half …
This is an exact comparison using a fraction.
不比北京多，是北京的二分之一。
Bù bǐ Běijīng duō, shì Běijīng de èr fēn zhī yī.
No more than Beijing, about half as many.
我的工资是他的三分之一。
Wǒ de gōngzī shì tā de sān fēn zhī yī.
My salary is a third of his.
A 跟 B 差不多
A is much the same as B
差不多 here means “roughly the same”.
吃早茶跟吃饭差不多。
Chī zǎochá gēn chī fàn chàbuduō.
Having 早茶 is like having a meal.
他的汉语跟我差不多。
Tā de Hànyǔ gēn wǒ chàbuduō.
His Chinese is about the same as mine.
gaps: 不过香港地方小，到处都很
现在越来越多的人会说
say: Lao Liu, what did you think of Hong Kong?
All of it. Clothes, for example, cost about twice as much as in Beijing.
No, about half as many. But Hong Kong is small, so it's crowded everywhere.
Over 90% of Hong Kong people speak Cantonese, but more and more can speak Mandarin now.

090.zh: 中国的人口、地理和方言
090.title: China's population, geography and dialects
090.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. The recording stops after the paragraph about the name 华夏, before the section on dialects that the title promises, so the rest probably comes in the next file.

lines: 中国的人口、地理和方言
Zhōngguó de rénkǒu, dìlǐ hé fāngyán
当代中国的全名是中华人民共和国，
Dāngdài Zhōngguó de quánmíng shì Zhōnghuá Rénmín Gònghéguó,
Modern China's full name is the People's Republic of China.
是一九四九年十月一日成立的，首都在北京。
shì yī jiǔ sì jiǔ nián shí yuè yī rì chénglì de, shǒudū zài Běijīng.
It was founded on 1 October 1949, and its capital is Beijing.
谁都知道，中国是世界上人口最多的国家。
Shéi dōu zhīdào, Zhōngguó shì shìjiè shang rénkǒu zuì duō de guójiā.
Everyone knows China is the most populous country in the world.
二〇一四年末，全国人口总数达到了十三亿六千七百多万，
Èr líng yī sì nián mò, quánguó rénkǒu zǒngshù dádào le shísān yì liùqiān qībǎi duō wàn,
At the end of 2014, the total population reached over 1.367 billion,
其中汉族百分之九十以上，另外还有五十多个少数民族。
qízhōng Hànzú bǎi fēn zhī jiǔshí yǐshàng, lìngwài hái yǒu wǔshí duō ge shǎoshù mínzú.
over 90% of them Han, plus more than fifty ethnic minorities.
中国的陆地面积大约有九百六十万平方公里，是法国的十七倍。
Zhōngguó de lùdì miànjī dàyuē yǒu jiǔbǎi liùshí wàn píngfāng gōnglǐ, shì Fǎguó de shíqī bèi.
China's land area is about 9.6 million square kilometres, seventeen times the size of France.
从地图上看，好像一只头向东、尾巴向西的大公鸡。
Cóng dìtú shang kàn, hǎoxiàng yì zhī tóu xiàng dōng, wěiba xiàng xī de dà gōngjī.
On the map it looks like a big rooster with its head to the east and its tail to the west.
西部是高原和大山，能源丰富，但是人很少。
Xībù shì gāoyuán hé dà shān, néngyuán fēngfù, dànshì rén hěn shǎo.
The west is plateaus and mountains, rich in energy resources but thinly populated.
大部分人口都集中在中部和东部，
Dà bùfen rénkǒu dōu jízhōng zài zhōngbù hé dōngbù,
Most people live in the centre and east,
那里的经济比其他地区发达得多，尤其是东南沿海的几个省。
nàlǐ de jīngjì bǐ qítā dìqū fādá de duō, yóuqí shì dōngnán yánhǎi de jǐ ge shěng.
where the economy is far more developed than elsewhere, especially in the south-eastern coastal provinces.
西部和北方是大陆性气候，比较干，冬天和夏天温度的差别很大；
Xībù hé běifāng shì dàlùxìng qìhòu, bǐjiào gān, dōngtiān hé xiàtiān wēndù de chābié hěn dà;
The west and north have a continental climate: fairly dry, with big differences between summer and winter.
而南方的气候是海洋性的，比较温和，雨水多，很少出现寒冷的天气。
ér nánfāng de qìhòu shì hǎiyángxìng de, bǐjiào wēnhé, yǔshuǐ duō, hěn shǎo chūxiàn hánlěng de tiānqì.
The south has a maritime climate: mild and rainy, and it rarely gets very cold.
中国的两条最长的河流，一条在南方，叫长江，全长六千三百多公里；
Zhōngguó de liǎng tiáo zuì cháng de héliú, yì tiáo zài nánfāng, jiào Chángjiāng, quán cháng liùqiān sānbǎi duō gōnglǐ;
Of China's two longest rivers, one is in the south: the Yangtze, over 6,300 km long.
另一条在北方，有五千四百多公里长，
lìng yì tiáo zài běifāng, yǒu wǔqiān sìbǎi duō gōnglǐ cháng,
The other, in the north, is over 5,400 km long.
穿过黄土高原，使河水变黄了，所以叫黄河。
chuānguò huángtǔ gāoyuán, shǐ héshuǐ biàn huáng le, suǒyǐ jiào Huáng Hé.
It flows through the loess plateau, which turns the water yellow, so it's called the Yellow River.
三千多年以前，中国人的祖先就开始生活在黄河中下游的平原上。
Sānqiān duō nián yǐqián, Zhōngguórén de zǔxiān jiù kāishǐ shēnghuó zài Huáng Hé zhōng-xiàyóu de píngyuán shang.
Over three thousand years ago, the ancestors of the Chinese began living on the plains of the middle and lower Yellow River.
古代中国的名字叫华夏，意思是很大也很美的国家。
Gǔdài Zhōngguó de míngzi jiào Huáxià, yìsi shì hěn dà yě hěn měi de guójiā.
Ancient China was called Huaxia, meaning a great and beautiful country.
一直到今天，海外的中国人都把自己叫做华人。
Yìzhí dào jīntiān, hǎiwài de Zhōngguórén dōu bǎ zìjǐ jiàozuò Huárén.
To this day, Chinese people overseas call themselves 华人.

grammar: 是……成立的
was founded on …
是……的 stresses the time of a past event.
是一九四九年十月一日成立的。
Shì yī jiǔ sì jiǔ nián shí yuè yī rì chénglì de.
It was founded on 1 October 1949.
这个学校是一九八零年成立的。
Zhège xuéxiào shì yī jiǔ bā líng nián chénglì de.
This school was founded in 1980.
从……上看，好像……
seen from …, it looks like …
This gives an impression from a particular angle.
从地图上看，好像一只头向东、尾巴向西的大公鸡。
Cóng dìtú shang kàn, hǎoxiàng yì zhī tóu xiàng dōng, wěiba xiàng xī de dà gōngjī.
On the map it looks like a big rooster.
从外面看，这个房子很小。
Cóng wàimiàn kàn, zhège fángzi hěn xiǎo.
From outside, the house looks small.
比其他……发达得多，尤其是……
far more … than others, especially …
This combines a 比 comparison with 尤其是, which picks out the extreme case.
那里的经济比其他地区发达得多，尤其是东南沿海的几个省。
Nàlǐ de jīngjì bǐ qítā dìqū fādá de duō, yóuqí shì dōngnán yánhǎi de jǐ ge shěng.
Far more developed than elsewhere, especially the south-east coast.
这家店比其他的贵得多，尤其是水果。
Zhè jiā diàn bǐ qítā de guì de duō, yóuqí shì shuǐguǒ.
This shop is far dearer than others, especially the fruit.
-type, -like (suffix)
性 turns a noun into a quality: 大陆性 (continental), 海洋性 (maritime).
而南方的气候是海洋性的。
Ér nánfāng de qìhòu shì hǎiyángxìng de.
The south has a maritime climate.
这是一个国际性的会议。
Zhè shì yí ge guójìxìng de huìyì.
This is an international conference.
to make … become …
使 is causative and 变 shows the change.
穿过黄土高原，使河水变黄了。
Chuānguò huángtǔ gāoyuán, shǐ héshuǐ biàn huáng le.
It flows through the loess plateau, turning the water yellow.
这件事使他变得很高兴。
Zhè jiàn shì shǐ tā biàn de hěn gāoxìng.
This made him very happy.
gaps: 当代中国的全名是中华人民
是一九四九年十月一日
达到了十三亿六千七百多万。
中国的陆地面积大约有九百六十万平方
西部是高原和大山，能源
西部和北方是大陆性气候，比较
海外的中国人都把自己叫做
say: Modern China's full name is the People's Republic of China.
On the map it looks like a big rooster with its head to the east and its tail to the west.
The south has a maritime climate: mild and rainy, and it rarely gets very cold.
To this day, Chinese people overseas call themselves 华人.

091.title: China's dialects
091.sub: The lesson text, part 2: Yu Lian and Teacher Huang
091.transcriptNote: 甲 is Teacher Huang and 乙 is Yu Lian, a student back from China. It finishes the lesson text begun in part 090. Speakers are assigned from context.

lines: 于莲，今年暑假你到哪儿度假去了？
Yú Lián, jīnnián shǔjià nǐ dào nǎr dùjià qù le?
Yu Lian, where did you go this summer holiday?
我和几个同学去了一趟中国，还利用旅游的机会练习了口语。
Wǒ hé jǐ ge tóngxué qù le yí tàng Zhōngguó, hái lìyòng lǚyóu de jīhuì liànxí le kǒuyǔ.
I went to China with some classmates, and used the trip to practise speaking.
对了，黄老师，我正想问问您呢。
Duì le, Huáng lǎoshī, wǒ zhèng xiǎng wènwen nín ne.
Oh, Teacher Huang, there's something I wanted to ask you.
我们从南到北，走了不少地方，发现各地口音的差别太大了。
Wǒmen cóng nán dào běi, zǒu le bù shǎo dìfang, fāxiàn gè dì kǒuyīn de chābié tài dà le.
We travelled from south to north and found the accents differ enormously from place to place.
是啊，不过这不光是口音的问题。
Shì a, búguò zhè bù guāng shì kǒuyīn de wèntí.
Yes, but it's not just a question of accent.
语言学家把汉语分成十个方言区。
Yǔyánxuéjiā bǎ Hànyǔ fēnchéng shí ge fāngyán qū.
Linguists divide Chinese into ten dialect areas.
东北、华北和西南地区的人讲北方话，
Dōngběi, Huáběi hé xīnán dìqū de rén jiǎng běifānghuà,
People in the northeast, north and southwest speak northern dialects,
虽然也有口音，但一般能互相交流。
suīrán yě yǒu kǒuyīn, dàn yìbān néng hùxiāng jiāoliú.
and although their accents differ, they can usually understand each other.
而东南部呢，人口比讲北方话的人少得多，
Ér dōngnánbù ne, rénkǒu bǐ jiǎng běifānghuà de rén shǎo de duō,
The southeast, though, has far fewer people than the northern-dialect areas,
面积也只占汉语区的四分之一左右，可是那里却集中了六七种方言。
miànjī yě zhǐ zhàn Hànyǔ qū de sì fēn zhī yī zuǒyòu, kěshì nàlǐ què jízhōng le liù qī zhǒng fāngyán.
and only about a quarter of the area, yet six or seven dialects are concentrated there.
比如，一个广东人碰到一个上海人，如果他们只会讲自己的家乡话，
Bǐrú, yí ge Guǎngdōngrén pèngdào yí ge Shànghǎirén, rúguǒ tāmen zhǐ huì jiǎng zìjǐ de jiāxiānghuà,
For example, if someone from Guangdong meets someone from Shanghai and they only speak their own dialects,
那就需要找个人当翻译，或者通过写字来交流。
nà jiù xūyào zhǎo ge rén dāng fānyì, huòzhě tōngguò xiě zì lái jiāoliú.
they'd need someone to interpret, or they'd have to communicate in writing.
就是啊，我们在广州的时候，听当地人说话，看当地的电视，连一句都听不懂。
Jiù shì a, wǒmen zài Guǎngzhōu de shíhou, tīng dāngdìrén shuōhuà, kàn dāngdì de diànshì, lián yí jù dōu tīng bu dǒng.
Exactly! In Guangzhou we couldn't understand a single sentence of the locals or the local TV.
当时我们想，学了好几年中文，怎么没有用呢？
Dāngshí wǒmen xiǎng, xué le hǎo jǐ nián Zhōngwén, zěnme méiyǒu yòng ne?
We thought, we've studied Chinese for years, so why is it no use?
幸好也有不少人能说普通话。
Xìnghǎo yě yǒu bù shǎo rén néng shuō pǔtōnghuà.
Luckily, plenty of people could speak Mandarin.
对，特别是年轻一代，还有那些离开家乡到外地打工的人。
Duì, tèbié shì niánqīng yí dài, hái yǒu nàxiē líkāi jiāxiāng dào wàidì dǎgōng de rén.
Yes, especially the young, and people who've left home to work elsewhere.
不过，根据二〇〇四年的统计，中国国内有百分之四十六点九四，
Búguò, gēnjù èr líng líng sì nián de tǒngjì, Zhōngguó guónèi yǒu bǎi fēn zhī sìshíliù diǎn jiǔ sì,
But according to 2004 statistics, 46.94% of people in China,
也就是说，大约一半的人不会说普通话。
yě jiù shì shuō, dàyuē yíbàn de rén bú huì shuō pǔtōnghuà.
in other words about half, can't speak Mandarin.
是吗？那他们还不如我们这些外国人呢！哈哈……
Shì ma? Nà tāmen hái bùrú wǒmen zhèxiē wàiguórén ne! Hāhā …
Really? Then they're worse at it than us foreigners! Ha ha …

grammar: 不光是……
not only …
不光 is a spoken form of 不只 or 不仅.
这不光是口音的问题。
Zhè bù guāng shì kǒuyīn de wèntí.
It's not just a question of accent.
他不光会说英语，还会说法语。
Tā bù guāng huì shuō Yīngyǔ, hái huì shuō Fǎyǔ.
He speaks not only English but French too.
把 A 分成 B
to divide A into B
分成 gives the parts something is divided into.
语言学家把汉语分成十个方言区。
Yǔyánxuéjiā bǎ Hànyǔ fēnchéng shí ge fāngyán qū.
Linguists divide Chinese into ten dialect areas.
老师把我们分成三个组。
Lǎoshī bǎ wǒmen fēnchéng sān ge zǔ.
The teacher split us into three groups.
number + 左右
about …
左右 after a number means “roughly”.
面积也只占汉语区的四分之一左右。
Miànjī yě zhǐ zhàn Hànyǔ qū de sì fēn zhī yī zuǒyòu.
Only about a quarter of the area.
他三十岁左右。
Tā sānshí suì zuǒyòu.
He's about thirty.
通过……来 + V
to … by means of …
来 links the method to the purpose.
或者通过写字来交流。
Huòzhě tōngguò xiě zì lái jiāoliú.
Or communicate in writing.
我们通过电话来联系。
Wǒmen tōngguò diànhuà lái liánxì.
We keep in touch by phone.
当 + role
to act as …
当 means to serve in a role: 当翻译, 当老师.
那就需要找个人当翻译。
Nà jiù xūyào zhǎo ge rén dāng fānyì.
They'd need someone to interpret.
他想当医生。
Tā xiǎng dāng yīshēng.
He wants to be a doctor.
gaps: 面积也只占汉语区的四分之一
也有不少人能说普通话。
say: I went to China with some classmates, and used the trip to practise speaking.
Yes, but it's not just a question of accent.
Luckily, plenty of people could speak Mandarin.
Really? Then they're worse at it than us foreigners!

092.title: Vocabulary: health and Chinese medicine

blocks.label: 生词

093.title: Ten sentences
093.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences using the new words from part 092. Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 既然没有火车了，那咱们就别回老家了。
Jìrán méiyǒu huǒchē le, nà zánmen jiù bié huí lǎojiā le.

我们的身体里有各种各样的细菌，是很自然的。

法国的小学生功课少，假期多，比中国小学生轻松得多。

lines: 没有人非要让你做这件事儿不可。
Méiyǒu rén fēi yào ràng nǐ zuò zhè jiàn shìr bù kě.

grammar: since …, then …
既然 accepts a fact as given and draws a conclusion from it.
既然没有火车了，那咱们就别回老家了。
Jìrán méiyǒu huǒchē le, nà zánmen jiù bié huí lǎojiā le.
Since there are no trains, let's not go home.
既然你累了，就早点儿睡吧。
Jìrán nǐ lèi le, jiù zǎo diǎnr shuì ba.
Since you're tired, go to bed early.
both … and …
This joins two qualities and is more formal than 又……又…….
他买的衣服既便宜又好看。
Tā mǎi de yīfu jì piányi yòu hǎokàn.
The clothes are both cheap and nice.
这个工作既轻松又有意思。
Zhège gōngzuò jì qīngsōng yòu yǒu yìsi.
This job is both easy and interesting.
被看成是……
to be seen as …
被 is the passive marker, and 看成 means to regard as.
雅克被看成是全校最聪明的学生。
Yǎkè bèi kànchéng shì quán xiào zuì cōngming de xuésheng.
Jacques is seen as the cleverest student in the school.
他被看成是最好的老师。
Tā bèi kànchéng shì zuì hǎo de lǎoshī.
He's considered the best teacher.
并不 / 并没有
not at all, actually not
并 before a negative contradicts an assumption.
他虽然是法国人，但并不喜欢吃奶酪。

比……轻松得多
much easier than …
得多 after the adjective in a 比 sentence means “much more”.
比中国小学生轻松得多。
Bǐ Zhōngguó xiǎoxuéshēng qīngsōng de duō.
Much easier than for Chinese pupils.
今天比昨天暖和得多。
Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān nuǎnhuo de duō.
Today is much warmer than yesterday.
gaps: 没有火车了，那咱们就别回老家了。
我们的身体里有各种各样的

094.title: Listening: doctors and Chinese medicine
094.sub: Eight items with four options each
094.transcriptNote: Each item has a statement or short exchange, a question and four options. Some item numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order. Speakers are assigned from context, and the answer key is my own reading.

lines: 当你身体不舒服的时候，比方说感冒、发烧或者牙疼、拉肚子什么的，就会去医院，让医生看看是什么细菌或者病毒使你生病的。
Dāng nǐ shēntǐ bù shūfu de shíhou, bǐfang shuō gǎnmào, fāshāo huòzhě yá téng, lā dùzi shénme de, jiù huì qù yīyuàn, ràng yīshēng kànkan shì shénme xìjūn huòzhě bìngdú shǐ nǐ shēngbìng de.
When you're unwell, say with a cold, fever, toothache or diarrhoea, you go to hospital so the doctor can see which bacteria or virus made you ill.

q: 人们为什么去医院？
Rénmen wèishénme qù yīyuàn?
Why do people go to hospital?
o: 去医院买感冒发烧的药
qù yīyuàn mǎi gǎnmào fāshāo de yào
to buy cold and fever medicine
to find out the cause of the illness
yīyuàn li yǒu rènshi de rén
they know someone at the hospital

lines: 按照中医的说法，如果一个人身体的阴阳平衡被破坏了，他就会生病。
Ànzhào zhōngyī de shuōfǎ, rúguǒ yí ge rén shēntǐ de yīnyáng pínghéng bèi pòhuài le, tā jiù huì shēngbìng.
According to Chinese medicine, if the balance of yin and yang in the body is upset, you fall ill.

q: 按照中医的说法，人为什么会生病？
Ànzhào zhōngyī de shuōfǎ, rén wèishénme huì shēngbìng?
According to Chinese medicine, why do people get ill?
o: réntǐ de yīnyáng bù pínghéng le
the body's yin and yang are out of balance
there are bacteria in the body
there's a virus in the body

lines: 中医治病，就是要找出生病的原因，然后用中草药或者针灸来调节阴阳平衡。
Zhōngyī zhì bìng, jiù shì yào zhǎochū shēngbìng de yuányīn, ránhòu yòng zhōngcǎoyào huòzhě zhēnjiǔ lái tiáojié yīnyáng pínghéng.
Chinese medicine treats illness by finding its cause, then restoring the yin–yang balance with herbs or acupuncture.

q: 中医治病不用什么方法？
Zhōngyī zhì bìng bú yòng shénme fāngfǎ?
Which method does Chinese medicine not use?

lines: 我最近睡觉不太好，通过朋友介绍，上个星期我去看了个中医，他给我开了个药方，很有效。
Wǒ zuìjìn shuìjiào bú tài hǎo, tōngguò péngyou jièshào, shàng ge xīngqī wǒ qù kàn le ge zhōngyī, tā gěi wǒ kāi le ge yàofāng, hěn yǒuxiào.
I haven't been sleeping well lately. A friend recommended a TCM doctor, I saw him last week, and the prescription he gave me works very well.

q: 他为什么去看中医？
Tā wèishénme qù kàn zhōngyī?
Why did he see a TCM doctor?
o: nàge zhōngyī shì tā de péngyou
他要给中医介绍一个朋友
tā yào gěi zhōngyī jièshào yí ge péngyou
he wants to introduce a friend to the doctor
那个中医开的药方比较好
nàge zhōngyī kāi de yàofāng bǐjiào hǎo

lines: 自然界里有细菌和病毒，那是有原因的，人一定要杀死它们，自然界就有可能不平衡了。
Zìránjiè li yǒu xìjūn hé bìngdú, nà shì yǒu yuányīn de, rén yídìng yào shāsǐ tāmen, zìránjiè jiù yǒu kěnéng bù pínghéng le.
There's a reason bacteria and viruses exist in nature. If people insist on killing them, nature may fall out of balance.

q: 下面哪句话的意思和这句话不一样？
Xiàmiàn nǎ jù huà de yìsi hé zhè jù huà bù yíyàng?
Which sentence does NOT match this meaning?
o: 为了自然界的平衡，不一定要杀死细菌和病毒
wèile zìránjiè de pínghéng, bù yídìng yào shāsǐ xìjūn hé bìngdú
for nature's balance, we needn't kill bacteria and viruses
自然界里不应该有细菌和病毒
zìránjiè li bù yīnggāi yǒu xìjūn hé bìngdú
there shouldn't be bacteria and viruses in nature
人和细菌、病毒可以共同生活在自然界里
rén hé xìjūn, bìngdú kěyǐ gòngtóng shēnghuó zài zìránjiè li
people, bacteria and viruses can live together in nature
如果杀死细菌和病毒，对自然界可能不好
rúguǒ shāsǐ xìjūn hé bìngdú, duì zìránjiè kěnéng bù hǎo
killing them may be bad for nature

blocks.note: The third clause reads as a condition: “if people insist on killing them”.

lines: 李大夫，您给我看病，为什么还问我吃饭睡觉什么的问题呀？
Lǐ dàifu, nín gěi wǒ kànbìng, wèishénme hái wèn wǒ chīfàn shuìjiào shénme de wèntí ya?
Dr Li, you're treating me, so why do you ask about my eating and sleeping?
一个医生如果不花很多时间来了解病人，那他就不是一个好医生。
Yí ge yīshēng rúguǒ bù huā hěn duō shíjiān lái liǎojiě bìngrén, nà tā jiù bú shì yí ge hǎo yīshēng.
A doctor who doesn't spend time getting to know the patient isn't a good doctor.

q: 男的是什么意思？
Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
What does the man mean?
o: 好医生应该了解病人的情况
hǎo yīshēng yīnggāi liǎojiě bìngrén de qíngkuàng
a good doctor should understand the patient's situation
好医生就应该问病人吃饭睡觉的情况
hǎo yīshēng jiù yīnggāi wèn bìngrén chīfàn shuìjiào de qíngkuàng
a good doctor must ask about eating and sleeping
好医生问不问病人的情况不重要
hǎo yīshēng wèn bu wèn bìngrén de qíngkuàng bú zhòngyào
it doesn't matter whether a good doctor asks
好医生应该先治病，再问病人的情况
hǎo yīshēng yīnggāi xiān zhì bìng, zài wèn bìngrén de qíngkuàng
a good doctor treats first and asks later

blocks.note: B is too narrow: eating and sleeping are only examples of the patient's situation.

lines: 老王，我最近不太想吃东西，晚上睡觉也有问题，你有什么好办法？
Lǎo Wáng, wǒ zuìjìn bú tài xiǎng chī dōngxi, wǎnshang shuìjiào yě yǒu wèntí, nǐ yǒu shénme hǎo bànfǎ?
Lao Wang, I haven't felt like eating lately, and I'm sleeping badly too. Any ideas?
这样吧，我给你介绍一个好中医，开点药，好好调节一下。
Zhèyàng ba, wǒ gěi nǐ jièshào yí ge hǎo zhōngyī, kāi diǎn yào, hǎohāo tiáojié yíxià.
Tell you what, I'll introduce you to a good TCM doctor who can give you something to get you back in balance.

q: 他的身体有什么问题？
Tā de shēntǐ yǒu shénme wèntí?
What's wrong with his health?
o: chī de hǎo, shuì bu hǎo
shuì de hǎo, chī bu hǎo
chī bu hǎo, shuì bu hǎo
shuì de hǎo, yě chī de hǎo

blocks.note: The first word of the question is unclear (one model heard 你的). It asks about the first speaker.

lines: 请问，您在法国可以用中医给人治病吗？
Qǐngwèn, nín zài Fǎguó kěyǐ yòng zhōngyī gěi rén zhì bìng ma?
Can you practise Chinese medicine in France?
不行，因为我不是在法国毕业的医生。
Bù xíng, yīnwèi wǒ bú shì zài Fǎguó bìyè de yīshēng.
No, because I didn't qualify as a doctor in France.
那什么人可以在法国用中医治病呢？
Nà shénme rén kěyǐ zài Fǎguó yòng zhōngyī zhì bìng ne?
So who can practise it in France?
从法国大学毕业的医生，到中国去学习中医，回到法国就可以用中医治病了。
Cóng Fǎguó dàxué bìyè de yīshēng, dào Zhōngguó qù xuéxí zhōngyī, huídào Fǎguó jiù kěyǐ yòng zhōngyī zhì bìng le.
Doctors who graduated from a French university can study it in China and then practise it back in France.

q: 如果想在法国用中医治病，应该怎么办？
Rúguǒ xiǎng zài Fǎguó yòng zhōngyī zhì bìng, yīnggāi zěnme bàn?
What should you do to practise TCM in France?
o: study TCM at a Chinese university
在法国大学学西医，然后去中国学中医
zài Fǎguó dàxué xué xīyī, ránhòu qù Zhōngguó xué zhōngyī
study Western medicine in France, then TCM in China
study TCM at a French university
在法国大学学西医和中医
zài Fǎguó dàxué xué xīyī hé zhōngyī

vocab: to understand, to get to know
grammar: 比方说……什么的
for example … and so on
比方说 introduces examples, and 什么的 closes the list.
比方说感冒、发烧或者牙疼、拉肚子什么的。
Bǐfang shuō gǎnmào, fāshāo huòzhě yá téng, lā dùzi shénme de.
For example a cold, fever, toothache or diarrhoea.
我喜欢运动，比方说游泳、跑步什么的。
Wǒ xǐhuan yùndòng, bǐfang shuō yóuyǒng, pǎobù shénme de.
I like sport, like swimming, running and so on.
使 + person + V
to make someone …
使 is a formal causative, like 让.
是什么细菌或者病毒使你生病的。
Shì shénme xìjūn huòzhě bìngdú shǐ nǐ shēngbìng de.
Which bacteria or virus made you ill.
这件事使我很难过。
Zhè jiàn shì shǐ wǒ hěn nánguò.
This made me very sad.
按照……的说法
according to …
按照 gives the authority or standard you're following.
按照中医的说法，……他就会生病。
Ànzhào zhōngyī de shuōfǎ, … tā jiù huì shēngbìng.
According to Chinese medicine, … he'll fall ill.
按照老师的说法，这个字不对。
Ànzhào lǎoshī de shuōfǎ, zhège zì bú duì.
According to the teacher, this character is wrong.
被 + V + 了
passive: has been …
被 marks the passive and is often used for something bad happening.
如果一个人身体的阴阳平衡被破坏了。
Rúguǒ yí ge rén shēntǐ de yīnyáng pínghéng bèi pòhuài le.
If the body's yin–yang balance is upset.
我的自行车被偷了。
Wǒ de zìxíngchē bèi tōu le.
My bike has been stolen.
用……来 + V
to … by means of …
来 links the method to the purpose.
然后用中草药或者针灸来调节阴阳平衡。
Ránhòu yòng zhōngcǎoyào huòzhě zhēnjiǔ lái tiáojié yīnyáng pínghéng.
Then balance yin and yang with herbs or acupuncture.
我用手机来学汉语。
Wǒ yòng shǒujī lái xué Hànyǔ.
I study Chinese on my phone.
gaps: 比方说感冒、发烧或者牙疼、
让医生看看是什么细菌或者
如果一个人身体的阴阳
我给你介绍一个好中医，开点药，好好
say: Lao Wang, I haven't felt like eating lately, and I'm sleeping badly too. Any ideas?
I haven't been sleeping well lately.
Can you practise Chinese medicine in France?

095.title: Listening: illness and seeing the doctor
095.sub: Eleven items with four options each
095.transcriptNote: Each item has a statement or short exchange, a question and four options. Some item numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order. Speakers are assigned from context, and the answer key is my own reading.

lines: 我看呀，小孙减肥不是怕有病，是怕芳芳不喜欢他。

Xiǎo Sūn pà shuōhuàrén bù xǐhuan tā
he's afraid the speaker won't like him

Xiǎo Sūn zìjǐ juéde tài pàng le bù hǎo
he thinks being fat is bad

Xiǎo Sūn pà zìjǐ tài pàng le, nǚpéngyou bù xǐhuan
he's afraid his girlfriend won't like him fat

lines: 最近天气很干，生病的人很多，这场雪下得太好了。
Zuìjìn tiānqì hěn gān, shēngbìng de rén hěn duō, zhè cháng xuě xià de tài hǎo le.

q: 下雪以后会怎么样？

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 人的身体上什么样的细菌、病毒都有，
Rén de shēntǐ shang shénmeyàng de xìjūn, bìngdú dōu yǒu,
The human body carries all sorts of bacteria and viruses,
可是为什么有的人会生病，有的人就很健康呢？
kěshì wèishénme yǒu de rén huì shēngbìng, yǒu de rén jiù hěn jiànkāng ne?
so why do some people get ill while others stay healthy?
按照中医的说法，那就是因为人的身体自己就可以调节。
Ànzhào zhōngyī de shuōfǎ, nà jiù shì yīnwèi rén de shēntǐ zìjǐ jiù kěyǐ tiáojié.
According to Chinese medicine, it's because the body can regulate itself.
在身体很好的时候，那些细菌和病毒就会平平安安地和你一起生活。
Zài shēntǐ hěn hǎo de shíhou, nàxiē xìjūn hé bìngdú jiù huì píngpíng'ān'ān de hé nǐ yìqǐ shēnghuó.
When you're in good health, those bacteria and viruses live peacefully alongside you.
但是当身体出现不平衡了，细菌和病毒就多了，人就会生病了。
Dànshì dāng shēntǐ chūxiàn bù pínghéng le, xìjūn hé bìngdú jiù duō le, rén jiù huì shēngbìng le.
But when the body falls out of balance, the bacteria and viruses multiply and you get ill.

Wèishénme xìjūn hé bìngdú huì hé wǒmen píng'ān de yìqǐ shēnghuó?

Question word + 都 means “every …, any …”.

some …, others …
This contrasts two groups.

Wèishénme yǒu de rén huì shēngbìng, yǒu de rén jiù hěn jiànkāng ne?

097.title: Your body loves you most
097.sub: A short passage with four multiple-choice questions
097.transcriptNote: A short passage, then four questions with four options each. The answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 如果世界上还有最爱的话，那么最爱你的就是你的身体。
Rúguǒ shìjiè shang hái yǒu zuì ài dehuà, nàme zuì ài nǐ de jiù shì nǐ de shēntǐ.
If there's such a thing as the greatest love in the world, then what loves you most is your body.
我们每天都在用着我们的身体，可是身体却为我们不停地、辛辛苦苦地工作。
Wǒmen měi tiān dōu zài yòng zhe wǒmen de shēntǐ, kěshì shēntǐ què wèi wǒmen bù tíng de, xīnxīnkǔkǔ de gōngzuò.
We use our bodies every day, and they work hard for us without stopping.
它在我们吃的食物中找到那些有用的东西，为我们补充营养。
Tā zài wǒmen chī de shíwù zhōng zhǎodào nàxiē yǒuyòng de dōngxi, wèi wǒmen bǔchōng yíngyǎng.
It finds what's useful in the food we eat and gives us nourishment.
在我们睡觉的时候，它为我们生产血液，清除不干净的东西。
Zài wǒmen shuìjiào de shíhou, tā wèi wǒmen shēngchǎn xuèyè, qīngchú bù gānjìng de dōngxi.
While we sleep, it makes blood for us and clears out what's dirty.
它为我们服务，希望我们第二天醒来的时候能够健康。
Tā wèi wǒmen fúwù, xīwàng wǒmen dì èr tiān xǐnglái de shíhou nénggòu jiànkāng.
It serves us, hoping we'll wake up healthy the next day.
可是，如果我们不注意我们吃的东西，也不注意休息，身体就会受不了了，我们就会生病了。
Kěshì, rúguǒ wǒmen bú zhùyì wǒmen chī de dōngxi, yě bú zhùyì xiūxi, shēntǐ jiù huì shòu bu liǎo le, wǒmen jiù huì shēngbìng le.
But if we don't watch what we eat or get enough rest, the body can't cope and we fall ill.

grammar: 如果……的话，那么……
if …, then …
的话 closes the condition, and 那么 opens the result.
如果世界上还有最爱的话，那么最爱你的就是你的身体。
Rúguǒ shìjiè shang hái yǒu zuì ài dehuà, nàme zuì ài nǐ de jiù shì nǐ de shēntǐ.
If there's a greatest love, it's your body's love for you.
如果明天下雨的话，那么我们就不去了。
Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ dehuà, nàme wǒmen jiù bú qù le.
If it rains tomorrow, we won't go.
却
but, yet
却 goes after the subject and marks a contrast.
可是身体却为我们不停地、辛辛苦苦地工作。
Kěshì shēntǐ què wèi wǒmen bù tíng de, xīnxīnkǔkǔ de gōngzuò.
Yet the body works hard for us non-stop.
他很累，却不想休息。
Tā hěn lèi, què bù xiǎng xiūxi.
He's tired but doesn't want to rest.
为 + someone + V
to do … for someone
为 marks who benefits.
为我们补充营养。
Wèi wǒmen bǔchōng yíngyǎng.
It gives us nourishment.
妈妈为我们做饭。
Māma wèi wǒmen zuò fàn.
Mum cooks for us.
在……中
in, among …
在……中 is the written form of 在……里.
它在我们吃的食物中找到那些有用的东西。
Tā zài wǒmen chī de shíwù zhōng zhǎodào nàxiē yǒuyòng de dōngxi.
It finds what's useful in the food we eat.
在这些书中，我最喜欢这本。
Zài zhèxiē shū zhōng, wǒ zuì xǐhuan zhè běn.
Of these books, I like this one best.
gaps: 那么最爱你的就是你的
say: We use our bodies every day, and they work hard for us without stopping.
While we sleep, it makes blood for us and clears out what's dirty.
If we don't watch what we eat or get enough rest, the body can't cope and we fall ill.

100.title: Words from an old TCM doctor
100.transcriptNote: The lesson text, a monologue split into paragraphs.

lines: Yí ge lǎo zhōngyī de huà
Words from an old TCM doctor
当你身体不舒服的时候，比如感冒、发烧、牙疼、拉肚子，或者什么地方长了个包，就会去医院看病。
Dāng nǐ shēntǐ bù shūfu de shíhou, bǐrú gǎnmào, fāshāo, yá téng, lā dùzi, huòzhě shénme dìfang zhǎng le ge bāo, jiù huì qù yīyuàn kànbìng.
When you're unwell, with a cold, fever, toothache, diarrhoea or a lump somewhere, you go to hospital.
检查一下，医生会给你开个药方，在有些情况下，还可能会直接动手术。
Jiǎnchá yíxià, yīshēng huì gěi nǐ kāi ge yàofāng, zài yǒuxiē qíngkuàng xià, hái kěnéng huì zhíjiē dòng shǒushù.
After an examination the doctor writes a prescription, and in some cases may operate straight away.
那些使你生病的细菌和病毒都被药物杀死了，有病的那一部分也被切掉了，不就治好了吗？
Nàxiē shǐ nǐ shēngbìng de xìjūn hé bìngdú dōu bèi yàowù shāsǐ le, yǒu bìng de nà yí bùfen yě bèi qiēdiào le, bú jiù zhìhǎo le ma?
The bacteria and viruses that made you ill are killed by drugs, the diseased part is cut out, so you're cured, aren't you?
Zhè shì xiàndài yīxué de zuòfǎ.
That's the way of modern medicine.
In fact, the problem hasn't been solved.
这些干坏事的细菌、病毒，既然能生活在自然界里，就有它们存在的理由。
Zhèxiē gàn huàishì de xìjūn, bìngdú, jìrán néng shēnghuó zài zìránjiè li, jiù yǒu tāmen cúnzài de lǐyóu.
Since these troublemaking bacteria and viruses can live in nature, there's a reason for them to exist.
人一定要杀它们，它们也要千方百计地活下去。
Rén yídìng yào shā tāmen, tāmen yě yào qiān fāng bǎi jì de huó xiaqu.
People are determined to kill them, and they're just as determined to survive.
Yǒu shíhou wǒ kāi wánxiào shuō,
十九世纪以前，中国的细菌、病毒比外国的轻松得多，
shíjiǔ shìjì yǐqián, Zhōngguó de xìjūn, bìngdú bǐ wàiguó de qīngsōng de duō,
before the 19th century, Chinese bacteria and viruses had a much easier time than foreign ones,
因为没有人非要把它们弄死不可，它们也用不着急着变异。
yīnwèi méiyǒu rén fēi yào bǎ tāmen nòngsǐ bù kě, tāmen yě yòng bu zháo jí zhe biànyì.
because nobody was set on killing them, so they had no need to rush to mutate.
人的身体从头到脚，从里到外，大概什么样的细菌、病毒都有，这是很自然的，
Rén de shēntǐ cóng tóu dào jiǎo, cóng lǐ dào wài, dàgài shénmeyàng de xìjūn, bìngdú dōu yǒu, zhè shì hěn zìrán de,
From head to toe, inside and out, the body probably carries every kind of bacteria and virus. That's perfectly natural,
因为我们呼吸的空气、喝的水、吃的食物，都是从自然界里来的。
yīnwèi wǒmen hūxī de kōngqì, hē de shuǐ, chī de shíwù, dōu shì cóng zìránjiè li lái de.
because the air we breathe, the water we drink and the food we eat all come from nature.
那么，为什么有些人还是很健康，很少生病呢？
Nàme, wèishénme yǒuxiē rén háishi hěn jiànkāng, hěn shǎo shēngbìng ne?
So why are some people still healthy and rarely ill?
按照中医的说法，在正常的情况下，我们完全可以和这些看不见、摸不着的敌人平平安安地一起生活。
Ànzhào zhōngyī de shuōfǎ, zài zhèngcháng de qíngkuàng xià, wǒmen wánquán kěyǐ hé zhèxiē kàn bu jiàn, mō bu zháo de dírén píngpíng'ān'ān de yìqǐ shēnghuó.
According to Chinese medicine, normally we can live quite peacefully with these invisible, intangible enemies.
但是，如果你在身体上或精神上受了刺激，阴阳的平衡被破坏了，
Dànshì, rúguǒ nǐ zài shēntǐ shang huò jīngshén shang shòu le cìjī, yīnyáng de pínghéng bèi pòhuài le,
But if you suffer a physical or mental shock and your yin–yang balance is upset,
细菌、病毒就会越生越多，从十个变成一百个，从一百个变成一千个，变得太多了，就会很危险。
xìjūn, bìngdú jiù huì yuè shēng yuè duō, cóng shí ge biànchéng yìbǎi ge, cóng yìbǎi ge biànchéng yìqiān ge, biàn de tài duō le, jiù huì hěn wēixiǎn.
the bacteria and viruses multiply, from ten to a hundred, from a hundred to a thousand, and once there are too many it becomes dangerous.
中医治病就是要找出生病的原因，看看是什么条件使阴阳的平衡发生了变化，
Zhōngyī zhì bìng jiù shì yào zhǎochū shēngbìng de yuányīn, kànkan shì shénme tiáojiàn shǐ yīnyáng de pínghéng fāshēng le biànhuà,
Chinese medicine treats illness by finding its cause, seeing which conditions changed the yin–yang balance,
然后用中草药或者针灸来改变这个条件。
ránhòu yòng zhōngcǎoyào huòzhě zhēnjiǔ lái gǎibiàn zhège tiáojiàn.
and then changing those conditions with herbs or acupuncture.
所以有人说，中医和西医最主要的区别是：西医治病，中医治人。
Suǒyǐ yǒu rén shuō, zhōngyī hé xīyī zuì zhǔyào de qūbié shì: xīyī zhì bìng, zhōngyī zhì rén.
So some say the main difference is that Western medicine treats the illness and Chinese medicine treats the person.
也有人说，西医是一门科学，而中医是一门哲学。
Yě yǒu rén shuō, xīyī shì yì mén kēxué, ér zhōngyī shì yì mén zhéxué.
Others say Western medicine is a science, while Chinese medicine is a philosophy.

grammar: 不就……了吗？
isn't that … then?
A rhetorical question that means “surely …”.
有病的那一部分也被切掉了，不就治好了吗？
Yǒu bìng de nà yí bùfen yě bèi qiēdiào le, bú jiù zhìhǎo le ma?
The diseased part is cut out, so you're cured, aren't you?
你给他打个电话，不就知道了吗？
Nǐ gěi tā dǎ ge diànhuà, bú jiù zhīdào le ma?
Just call him and you'll know, won't you?
since …, then …
既然 accepts a fact and draws the conclusion.
既然能生活在自然界里，就有它们存在的理由。
Jìrán néng shēnghuó zài zìránjiè li, jiù yǒu tāmen cúnzài de lǐyóu.
Since they can live in nature, there's a reason for them to exist.
既然你来了，就多住几天吧。
Jìrán nǐ lái le, jiù duō zhù jǐ tiān ba.
Since you're here, stay a few more days.
非要……不可
to insist on …
This double negative means someone absolutely must or wants to.
因为没有人非要把它们弄死不可。
Yīnwèi méiyǒu rén fēi yào bǎ tāmen nòngsǐ bù kě.
Because nobody was set on killing them.
他非要今天去不可。
Tā fēi yào jīntiān qù bù kě.
He insists on going today.
from … to …
Paired ranges cover everything.
人的身体从头到脚，从里到外……
Rén de shēntǐ cóng tóu dào jiǎo, cóng lǐ dào wài …
From head to toe, inside and out …
他从早到晚，从周一到周五都在工作。
Tā cóng zǎo dào wǎn, cóng zhōuyī dào zhōuwǔ dōu zài gōngzuò.
He works morning to night, Monday to Friday.
the more …, the more …
越 + V + 越 + adj shows a growing degree.
细菌、病毒就会越生越多。
Xìjūn, bìngdú jiù huì yuè shēng yuè duō.
The bacteria and viruses multiply more and more.
雨越下越大。
Yǔ yuè xià yuè dà.
The rain is getting heavier.
A 是……，而 B 是……
A is …, whereas B is …
而 contrasts two parallel statements in formal style.
西医是一门科学，而中医是一门哲学。
Xīyī shì yì mén kēxué, ér zhōngyī shì yì mén zhéxué.
Western medicine is a science, while Chinese medicine is a philosophy.
哥哥很高，而弟弟很矮。
Gēge hěn gāo, ér dìdi hěn ǎi.
The older brother is tall, whereas the younger is short.
gaps: 的空气、喝的水、吃的食物，
say: In fact, the problem hasn't been solved.
So why are some people still healthy and rarely ill?
Western medicine treats the illness and Chinese medicine treats the person.
Western medicine is a science, while Chinese medicine is a philosophy.

101.title: What makes a good TCM doctor
101.sub: The lesson text, part 2: an interview with Mr Ash
101.transcriptNote: An introduction, then an interview. 甲 asks the questions and 乙 is 阿什先生 (Mr Ash). Speakers are assigned from context, and the name is spelled as heard.

lines: 阿什先生是从中国的中医大学毕业的。
Āshí xiānsheng shì cóng Zhōngguó de zhōngyī dàxué bìyè de.
Mr Ash graduated from a university of Chinese medicine in China.
他很希望能在法国用中医治病，并且让更多的法国人了解中国的传统医学。
Tā hěn xīwàng néng zài Fǎguó yòng zhōngyī zhì bìng, bìngqiě ràng gèng duō de Fǎguórén liǎojiě Zhōngguó de chuántǒng yīxué.
He very much hopes to practise Chinese medicine in France and help more French people understand traditional Chinese medicine.
法国有很多懂中医的专家吗？比方说，像您这样的人。
Fǎguó yǒu hěn duō dǒng zhōngyī de zhuānjiā ma? Bǐfang shuō, xiàng nín zhèyàng de rén.
Are there many TCM experts in France? People like you, for example?
Zhège ma, wǒ bú tài qīngchu.
根据法律，我不可以用中医给人看病，因为我没有在法国念过医学院。
Gēnjù fǎlǜ, wǒ bù kěyǐ yòng zhōngyī gěi rén kànbìng, yīnwèi wǒ méiyǒu zài Fǎguó niàn guo yīxuéyuàn.
By law I can't treat people with Chinese medicine, because I didn't go to medical school in France.
可是一个从法国大学毕业的医生，只要去中国实习一个月，回来以后就可以使用中医。
Kěshì yí ge cóng Fǎguó dàxué bìyè de yīshēng, zhǐyào qù Zhōngguó shíxí yí ge yuè, huílai yǐhòu jiù kěyǐ shǐyòng zhōngyī.
But a doctor who graduated from a French university only has to train in China for a month, and can use Chinese medicine when he gets back.
什么人可以被看作好中医呢？
Shénme rén kěyǐ bèi kànzuò hǎo zhōngyī ne?
Who can be regarded as a good TCM doctor?
中医看病的时候，先要仔细地问病人很多问题，
Zhōngyī kànbìng de shíhou, xiān yào zǐxì de wèn bìngrén hěn duō wèntí,
When a TCM doctor sees a patient, he first has to ask lots of careful questions,
既要知道他什么地方难受，也要了解他平时的身体情况和生活习惯。
jì yào zhīdào tā shénme dìfang nánshòu, yě yào liǎojiě tā píngshí de shēntǐ qíngkuàng hé shēnghuó xíguàn.
finding out both where it hurts and what the patient's usual health and habits are like.
Nín néng jǔ jǐ ge lìzi ma?
Could you give a few examples?
例如，胃口怎么样，睡得好不好，怕不怕冷，出不出汗，等等。
Lìrú, wèikǒu zěnmeyàng, shuì de hǎo bu hǎo, pà bu pà lěng, chū bu chū hàn, děngděng.
For instance, how their appetite is, whether they sleep well, feel the cold, sweat, and so on.
我想，有些西医可能也会这样做吧。
Wǒ xiǎng, yǒuxiē xīyī kěnéng yě huì zhèyàng zuò ba.
I suppose some Western doctors might do that too.
但是中医还特别注意看病人的舌头和脸色，听他说话的声音，闻他发出的气味。
Dànshì zhōngyī hái tèbié zhùyì kàn bìngrén de shétou hé liǎnsè, tīng tā shuōhuà de shēngyīn, wén tā fāchū de qìwèi.
But a TCM doctor also pays special attention to the tongue and complexion, the sound of the voice and the patient's smell.
当然了，更重要的是给他摸脉。
Dāngrán le, gèng zhòngyào de shì gěi tā mō mài.
And of course, even more important is taking the pulse.
Nà zhēnjiǔshī yě shì zhèyàng ma?
Is it the same for acupuncturists?
当然了，针灸师也不能一见到病人就开始扎针。
Dāngrán le, zhēnjiǔshī yě bù néng yí jiàndào bìngrén jiù kāishǐ zhāzhēn.
Of course. An acupuncturist can't start putting in needles the moment he sees a patient either.
一句话，如果一个医生不花费很多时间来了解病人的话，那他就不能被认为是真正的中医。
Yí jù huà, rúguǒ yí ge yīshēng bù huāfèi hěn duō shíjiān lái liǎojiě bìngrén dehuà, nà tā jiù bù néng bèi rènwéi shì zhēnzhèng de zhōngyī.
In a word, a doctor who doesn't spend a lot of time getting to know the patient can't be considered a real TCM doctor.

grammar: 只要……就……
as long as …, then …
只要 gives a sufficient condition.
只要去中国实习一个月，回来以后就可以使用中医。
Zhǐyào qù Zhōngguó shíxí yí ge yuè, huílai yǐhòu jiù kěyǐ shǐyòng zhōngyī.
As long as he trains in China for a month, he can use TCM when he's back.
只要你努力，就一定能学好。
Zhǐyào nǐ nǔlì, jiù yídìng néng xuéhǎo.
As long as you work hard, you'll learn it well.
被看作 / 被认为是
to be regarded as
These passives give a general judgement.
什么人可以被看作好中医呢？
Shénme rén kěyǐ bèi kànzuò hǎo zhōngyī ne?
Who can be regarded as a good TCM doctor?
他被认为是最好的老师。
Tā bèi rènwéi shì zuì hǎo de lǎoshī.
He's considered the best teacher.
既要……，也要……
must both … and …
This joins two requirements.
既要知道他什么地方难受，也要了解他平时的身体情况和生活习惯。
Jì yào zhīdào tā shénme dìfang nánshòu, yě yào liǎojiě tā píngshí de shēntǐ qíngkuàng hé shēnghuó xíguàn.
He must find out both where it hurts and the patient's usual health and habits.
学汉语既要多听，也要多说。
Xué Hànyǔ jì yào duō tīng, yě yào duō shuō.
To learn Chinese you must listen a lot and speak a lot.
A 不 A questions in a list
whether or not …
Positive–negative pairs list the questions asked.
胃口怎么样，睡得好不好，怕不怕冷，出不出汗，等等。
Wèikǒu zěnmeyàng, shuì de hǎo bu hǎo, pà bu pà lěng, chū bu chū hàn, děngděng.
Appetite, sleep, feeling the cold, sweating, and so on.
你问问他去不去。
Nǐ wènwen tā qù bu qù.
Ask him whether he's going.
as soon as …
This means one thing immediately follows another.
针灸师也不能一见到病人就开始扎针。
Zhēnjiǔshī yě bù néng yí jiàndào bìngrén jiù kāishǐ zhāzhēn.
An acupuncturist can't start needling as soon as he sees a patient.
他一回家就睡觉了。
Tā yì huí jiā jiù shuìjiào le.
He went to bed as soon as he got home.
gaps: 阿什先生是从中国的中医大学
让更多的法国人了解中国的
也要了解他平时的身体情况和生活
但是中医还特别注意看病人的舌头和

rp.title: What makes a good TCM doctor

say: Well, I'm not really sure.
Could you give a few examples?
Is it the same for acupuncturists?
And of course, even more important is taking the pulse.

102.title: Vocabulary: family life
102.sub: New words for the lesson on family
