103.title: Ten sentences
103.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences using the new words from part 102. Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 自从结了婚，小王就再也没去过酒馆。
Zìcóng jié le hūn, Xiǎo Wáng jiù zài yě méi qù guo jiǔguǎn.
Since he got married, Xiao Wang has never been to a bar again.
在老年人看来，电脑是年轻人用的东西。
Zài lǎoniánrén kànlái, diànnǎo shì niánqīngrén yòng de dōngxi.
In older people's view, computers are for the young.
再过一个月，他的儿子就满十六岁了。
Zài guò yí ge yuè, tā de érzi jiù mǎn shíliù suì le.
In another month his son will turn sixteen.
这件事儿不能说出去，你的嘴得严一点儿。
Zhè jiàn shìr bù néng shuō chuqu, nǐ de zuǐ děi yán yìdiǎnr.
This mustn't get out. Keep your mouth shut.
妈妈身体不好，你要好好照顾她。
Māma shēntǐ bù hǎo, nǐ yào hǎohāo zhàogù tā.
Mum isn't well. Look after her properly.
你看，等公交车的人太多了，要不然咱们还是去坐地铁吧。
Nǐ kàn, děng gōngjiāochē de rén tài duō le, yàobùrán zánmen háishi qù zuò dìtiě ba.
Look, too many people are waiting for the bus. Why don't we take the subway instead?
你一个人在外边，要注意身体，别让父母担心。
Nǐ yí ge rén zài wàibian, yào zhùyì shēntǐ, bié ràng fùmǔ dānxīn.
You're away on your own, so look after yourself and don't make your parents worry.
两口子过日子，不可能每件事儿都很顺利。
Liǎngkǒuzi guò rìzi, bù kěnéng měi jiàn shìr dōu hěn shùnlì.
When a couple live together, not everything can go smoothly.
有些事情应该让孩子独自去做。
Yǒuxiē shìqing yīnggāi ràng háizi dúzì qù zuò.
Some things children should be left to do by themselves.
男人不能只想着在外面挣钱，还应该多关心家庭。
Nánrén bù néng zhǐ xiǎng zhe zài wàimiàn zhèngqián, hái yīnggāi duō guānxīn jiātíng.
Men shouldn't think only about earning money outside; they should care more about their families too.

grammar: 自从……，就再也没……
since …, never again …
自从 marks the starting point; 再也没 means never again.
自从结了婚，小王就再也没去过酒馆。
Zìcóng jié le hūn, Xiǎo Wáng jiù zài yě méi qù guo jiǔguǎn.
Since marrying, Xiao Wang has never been to a bar again.
自从搬家以后，我再也没见过他。
Zìcóng bānjiā yǐhòu, wǒ zài yě méi jiàn guo tā.
I haven't seen him since I moved.
在……看来
in …'s view
This gives someone's opinion.
在老年人看来，电脑是年轻人用的东西。
Zài lǎoniánrén kànlái, diànnǎo shì niánqīngrén yòng de dōngxi.
In older people's view, computers are for the young.
在我看来，这个办法不错。
Zài wǒ kànlái, zhège bànfǎ búcuò.
In my view this is a good idea.
再过 + time，就……了
in another …
This counts forward to a coming point.
再过一个月，他的儿子就满十六岁了。
Zài guò yí ge yuè, tā de érzi jiù mǎn shíliù suì le.
In another month his son turns sixteen.
再过两天就放假了。
Zài guò liǎng tiān jiù fàngjià le.
The holidays start in two days.
要不然
otherwise; or else (suggestion)
要不然 can introduce an alternative suggestion.
要不然咱们还是去坐地铁吧。
Yàobùrán zánmen háishi qù zuò dìtiě ba.
Why don't we take the subway instead?
快走吧，要不然就晚了。
Kuài zǒu ba, yàobùrán jiù wǎn le.
Hurry, or we'll be late.
别让 + person + V
don't make someone …
让 is causative, and 别 makes it a warning.
别让父母担心。
Bié ràng fùmǔ dānxīn.
Don't make your parents worry.
别让孩子等太久。
Bié ràng háizi děng tài jiǔ.
Don't keep the child waiting too long.
say: Since he got married, Xiao Wang has never been to a bar again.
Look after yourself and don't make your parents worry.
Why don't we take the subway instead?

104.title: Listening: children, parents and grandparents
104.transcriptNote: Items 1–10 each have a sentence or short exchange with one question. Items 11–12 and 13–14 share a passage. Some item numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order. Speakers are assigned from context, and the answer key is my own reading.

lines: 想要生孩子，先得准备很多钱，要不然怎么能把孩子养大呢？
Xiǎng yào shēng háizi, xiān děi zhǔnbèi hěn duō qián, yàobùrán zěnme néng bǎ háizi yǎngdà ne?
If you want a baby, you need to save a lot of money first, or how will you bring it up?

q: 这句话告诉我们，生孩子以前要……
Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen, shēng háizi yǐqián yào …
This tells us that before having a baby you should …
o: save quite a lot of money
get a home ready for the child

lines: 你还跟我们算钱！我们把你养这么大，你算算我们花了多少精力和钱。
Nǐ hái gēn wǒmen suàn qián! Wǒmen bǎ nǐ yǎng zhème dà, nǐ suànsuan wǒmen huā le duōshao jīnglì hé qián.
You're keeping accounts with us? We raised you. Work out how much energy and money that cost us!

q: 说话的人可能是什么人？
Shuōhuà de rén kěnéng shì shénme rén?
Who is probably speaking?

lines: 要孩子干什么？小两口自己轻轻松松地过日子多好。
Yào háizi gàn shénme? Xiǎo liǎngkǒu zìjǐ qīngqīngsōngsōng de guò rìzi duō hǎo.
Why have kids? It's so much nicer for a young couple to live a carefree life on their own.

q: 这句话的意思是什么？
Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì shénme?
What does this mean?
o: 有孩子的话，生活就不会轻松
yǒu háizi dehuà, shēnghuó jiù bú huì qīngsōng
with kids, life won't be easy
有孩子也可以轻松地生活
yǒu háizi yě kěyǐ qīngsōng de shēnghuó
you can live easily with kids too
没有孩子生活不太轻松
méiyǒu háizi shēnghuó bú tài qīngsōng

lines: 自从有了孩子，我再也不能像以前那样自由了。
Zìcóng yǒu le háizi, wǒ zài yě bù néng xiàng yǐqián nàyàng zìyóu le.
Since having a child, I've never been as free as before.

q: 这句话告诉我们什么？
Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen shénme?
What does this tell us?
o: 有了孩子以后，他可以想做什么就做什么
yǒu le háizi yǐhòu, tā kěyǐ xiǎng zuò shénme jiù zuò shénme
with a child, he can do whatever he likes
没有孩子的时候，他不太自由
méiyǒu háizi de shíhou, tā bú tài zìyóu
without a child, he wasn't very free
有了孩子以后，他也很自由
yǒu le háizi yǐhòu, tā yě hěn zìyóu
with a child, he's still free
没有孩子的时候，他可以想做什么就做什么
méiyǒu háizi de shíhou, tā kěyǐ xiǎng zuò shénme jiù zuò shénme
without a child, he could do whatever he liked

lines: 虽然孩子有他姥姥在照顾生活，可他姥姥不识字，我怕孩子在学习方面跟不上。
Suīrán háizi yǒu tā lǎolao zài zhàogù shēnghuó, kě tā lǎolao bù shí zì, wǒ pà háizi zài xuéxí fāngmiàn gēn bu shàng.
Grandma looks after the child day to day, but she can't read, so I'm afraid the child will fall behind at school.

q: 说话人担心什么？
Shuōhuàrén dānxīn shénme?
What is the speaker worried about?
o: the child won't learn to read
孩子在学习方面会有困难
háizi zài xuéxí fāngmiàn huì yǒu kùnnan
the child will struggle with schoolwork
lǎolao guǎn háizi guǎn de tài yán

lines: 不是我们不想跟父母住在一起，而是他们不想和我们住在一起，他们都说喜欢安静。
Bú shì wǒmen bù xiǎng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yìqǐ, ér shì tāmen bù xiǎng hé wǒmen zhù zài yìqǐ, tāmen dōu shuō xǐhuan ānjìng.
It's not that we don't want to live with our parents. They don't want to live with us. They say they like peace and quiet.

q: 他们为什么和父母分开住？
Tāmen wèishénme hé fùmǔ fēnkāi zhù?
Why do they live apart from their parents?
o: 父母和他们住在一起安静不了
fùmǔ hé tāmen zhù zài yìqǐ ānjìng bu liǎo
the parents couldn't have peace living with them
父母和他们住在一起比较安静
fùmǔ hé tāmen zhù zài yìqǐ bǐjiào ānjìng
it's quieter for the parents living with them
他们不喜欢和父母住在一起
tāmen bù xǐhuan hé fùmǔ zhù zài yìqǐ
they don't like living with their parents

lines: 老年人常常不喜欢年轻人做的事，这也不奇怪，两代人嘛，想法怎么能一样？
Lǎoniánrén chángcháng bù xǐhuan niánqīngrén zuò de shì, zhè yě bù qíguài, liǎng dài rén ma, xiǎngfǎ zěnme néng yíyàng?
Older people often dislike what young people do. That's no surprise: they're two generations, so how could they think alike?

q: 说话人认为老年人不喜欢年轻人做的事儿的原因是……
Shuōhuàrén rènwéi lǎoniánrén bù xǐhuan niánqīngrén zuò de shìr de yuányīn shì …
The speaker thinks older people dislike what the young do because …
o: 年轻人和老年人的想法一样
niánqīngrén hé lǎoniánrén de xiǎngfǎ yíyàng
年轻人认为老年人的想法很奇怪
niánqīngrén rènwéi lǎoniánrén de xiǎngfǎ hěn qíguài
the young find the old strange
老年人和年轻人对事情的想法不一样
lǎoniánrén hé niánqīngrén duì shìqing de xiǎngfǎ bù yíyàng
老年人认为年轻人的习惯很好
lǎoniánrén rènwéi niánqīngrén de xíguàn hěn hǎo
the old like the young's habits

lines: 这是谁家的小宝宝？怎么旁边没有大人？不会是走丢了吧？
Zhè shì shéi jiā de xiǎo bǎobao? Zěnme pángbiān méiyǒu dàrén? Bú huì shì zǒudiū le ba?
Whose little baby is this? Why is there no adult around? Surely it hasn't got lost?

q: 他们发现了什么？
Tāmen fāxiàn le shénme?
What have they found?
o: yì zhǒng hěn guì de dōngxi

lines: 老李，您现在退休了，可以好好休息休息了。
Lǎo Lǐ, nín xiànzài tuìxiū le, kěyǐ hǎohāo xiūxi xiūxi le.
Lao Li, now you're retired you can have a good rest.
休息什么呀，别提了，每天得给儿子女儿看孩子，还不如上班舒服呢。
Xiūxi shénme ya, bié tí le, měi tiān děi gěi érzi nǚ'ér kān háizi, hái bùrú shàngbān shūfu ne.
Rest? Don't talk about it. I have to mind my son's and daughter's kids every day. Work was easier!

q: 老李退休以后生活怎么样？
Lǎo Lǐ tuìxiū yǐhòu shēnghuó zěnmeyàng?
How is Lao Li's life after retiring?

lines: 现在的年轻夫妇可真挺累的。
Xiànzài de niánqīng fūfù kě zhēn tǐng lèi de.
Young couples these days really have it tough.
可不是嘛，又得养孩子，又得照顾双方的老人，还得上班，太不容易了。
Kě bú shì ma, yòu děi yǎng háizi, yòu děi zhàogù shuāngfāng de lǎorén, hái děi shàngbān, tài bù róngyì le.
Too right. They have to raise kids, look after both sets of parents and go to work. It's not easy.

q: 现在的年轻夫妇为什么很累？
Xiànzài de niánqīng fūfù wèishénme hěn lèi?
Why are young couples so tired?
o: 孩子小，大人得费很多心
háizi xiǎo, dàrén děi fèi hěn duō xīn
small children take a lot of effort

lines: 串门就是到朋友、同事家去玩一玩，聊聊天儿。
Chuànmén jiù shì dào péngyou, tóngshì jiā qù wán yi wán, liáoliao tiānr.
串门 means dropping in at a friend's or colleague's home for a chat.
可是现在城市里的家庭都是三口之家，女主人不管是上班还是在家里都非常忙，还得帮助孩子学习，哪儿还有时间去串门呢？
Kěshì xiànzài chéngshì li de jiātíng dōu shì sān kǒu zhī jiā, nǚzhǔrén bùguǎn shì shàngbān háishi zài jiā li dōu fēicháng máng, hái děi bāngzhù háizi xuéxí, nǎr hái yǒu shíjiān qù chuànmén ne?
But city families now are all three-person households. The woman of the house is busy at work and at home, and has to help the child study too. Where would she find time to visit?

q: 现在城里人的家庭一般是几口人？
Xiànzài chénglǐrén de jiātíng yìbān shì jǐ kǒu rén?
How many people are usually in a city family now?
现在的妇女为什么不怎么去串门？
Xiànzài de fùnǚ wèishénme bù zěnme qù chuànmén?
Why don't women visit friends much now?
o: 下班以后回家有很多事要做
xiàbān yǐhòu huí jiā yǒu hěn duō shì yào zuò
lots to do at home after work
在家里要帮助孩子学习
zài jiā li yào bāngzhù háizi xuéxí
must help the child study at home

lines: 现在中国的家庭一般都是独生子女，所以教育孩子已经成了一个很大的社会问题。
Xiànzài Zhōngguó de jiātíng yìbān dōu shì dúshēng zǐnǚ, suǒyǐ jiàoyù háizi yǐjīng chéng le yí ge hěn dà de shèhuì wèntí.
Chinese families now generally have only one child, so bringing children up has become a big social issue.
有的家庭，孩子成了家里的小皇帝，大人什么都听孩子的；
Yǒu de jiātíng, háizi chéng le jiā li de xiǎo huángdì, dàrén shénme dōu tīng háizi de;
In some families the child has become a little emperor, and the adults do whatever the child says;
还有的家长知道这样对孩子不好，所以就一点儿也不尊重孩子的愿望。
hái yǒu de jiāzhǎng zhīdào zhèyàng duì háizi bù hǎo, suǒyǐ jiù yìdiǎnr yě bù zūnzhòng háizi de yuànwàng.
other parents know that's bad for the child, so they don't respect the child's wishes at all.
其实，在专家看来，这两种教育方式都不好。
Qíshí, zài zhuānjiā kànlái, zhè liǎng zhǒng jiàoyù fāngshì dōu bù hǎo.
In fact, experts think both approaches are bad.

q: 有的孩子为什么成了家里的小皇帝？
Yǒu de háizi wèishénme chéng le jiā li de xiǎo huángdì?
Why have some children become little emperors?
o: the parents give in to the child too much
孩子的父母和皇帝有关系
háizi de fùmǔ hé huángdì yǒu guānxi
the parents are related to an emperor
孩子长大以后要当皇帝
háizi zhǎngdà yǐhòu yào dāng huángdì
the child will be emperor one day

q: 根据短文，下面哪种说法不对？
Gēnjù duǎnwén, xiàmiàn nǎ zhǒng shuōfǎ bú duì?
According to the passage, which is NOT right?
o: 中国的家庭都是独生子女
Zhōngguó de jiātíng dōu shì dúshēng zǐnǚ
all Chinese families have one child
有的大人什么都听孩子的
yǒu de dàrén shénme dōu tīng háizi de
some adults do whatever the child says
有的大人不尊重孩子的愿望
yǒu de dàrén bù zūnzhòng háizi de yuànwàng
some adults don't respect the child's wishes
这两种教育方式都不合适
zhè liǎng zhǒng jiàoyù fāngshì dōu bù héshì

blocks.note: The passage says 一般都是 (generally), so A, which says all families, is the statement that isn't right.

grammar: 要不然怎么能……呢？
otherwise how could …?
要不然 + a rhetorical question stresses that the first step is necessary.
先得准备很多钱，要不然怎么能把孩子养大呢？
Xiān děi zhǔnbèi hěn duō qián, yàobùrán zěnme néng bǎ háizi yǎngdà ne?
You need money first, or how could you raise a child?
得多练，要不然怎么能说好呢？
Děi duō liàn, yàobùrán zěnme néng shuōhǎo ne?
You must practise, or how will you speak well?
do whatever you like
Repeating a question word, as in 想做什么就做什么, means “whatever you want”.
他可以想做什么就做什么。
Tā kěyǐ xiǎng zuò shénme jiù zuò shénme.
He could do whatever he liked.
你想吃什么就吃什么。
Nǐ xiǎng chī shénme jiù chī shénme.
Eat whatever you like.
不是……，而是……
it's not …, it's …
This corrects a mistaken assumption.
不是我们不想跟父母住在一起，而是他们不想和我们住在一起。
Bú shì wǒmen bù xiǎng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yìqǐ, ér shì tāmen bù xiǎng hé wǒmen zhù zài yìqǐ.
It's not that we don't want to live with them; they don't want to live with us.
不是我不想去，而是没时间。
Bú shì wǒ bù xiǎng qù, ér shì méi shíjiān.
It's not that I don't want to go; I don't have time.
还不如……呢
would even be better to …
不如 means “not as good as”, and 还……呢 adds feeling.
还不如上班舒服呢。
Hái bùrú shàngbān shūfu ne.
Work was easier!
坐车还不如走路快呢。
Zuò chē hái bùrú zǒulù kuài ne.
Walking is even quicker than driving.
又得……，又得……，还得……
have to … and … and …
This piles up obligations.
又得养孩子，又得照顾双方的老人，还得上班。
Yòu děi yǎng háizi, yòu děi zhàogù shuāngfāng de lǎorén, hái děi shàngbān.
Raise kids, look after both sets of parents and work.
我又得上课，又得打工。
Wǒ yòu děi shàngkè, yòu děi dǎgōng.
I have to go to class and work part-time.
不管……还是……都……
whether … or …
不管 introduces alternatives that don't change the result.
女主人不管是上班还是在家里都非常忙。
Nǚzhǔrén bùguǎn shì shàngbān háishi zài jiā li dōu fēicháng máng.
Whether at work or at home, she's very busy.
不管下雨还是下雪，他都去跑步。
Bùguǎn xià yǔ háishi xià xuě, tā dōu qù pǎobù.
Rain or snow, he goes running.
gaps: 小两口自己轻轻松松地过
可是现在城市里的家庭都是三口之
say: Since having a child, I've never been as free as before.
It's not that we don't want to live with our parents. They don't want to live with us.
Rest? Don't talk about it. I have to mind my son's and daughter's kids every day. Work was easier!

105.title: 4-2-1 families
105.sub: A short passage with four open questions
105.transcriptNote: A short passage about two young couples, then four questions to answer in your own words. Some question numbers aren't read aloud. The model answers are my own, and the names are spelled as heard.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 路易华和她的丈夫都是独生子女，他们很早就结了婚，生了孩子。
Lù Yìhuá hé tā de zhàngfu dōu shì dúshēng zǐnǚ, tāmen hěn zǎo jiù jié le hūn, shēng le háizi.
Lu Yihua and her husband are both only children. They married and had a child early.
路易华说：“现在父母身体还很好，生了孩子，还可以让他们照顾。
Lù Yìhuá shuō: “Xiànzài fùmǔ shēntǐ hái hěn hǎo, shēng le háizi, hái kěyǐ ràng tāmen zhàogù.
Lu Yihua says: “Our parents are still healthy now, so if we have a child they can look after it.
要是过三年五年以后生孩子，那时候父母的身体可能就不会这么好了。
Yàoshi guò sān nián wǔ nián yǐhòu shēng háizi, nà shíhou fùmǔ de shēntǐ kěnéng jiù bú huì zhème hǎo le.
If we waited three or five years, our parents might not be so healthy.
那时既得照顾父母，又得照顾孩子，就麻烦了。”
Nà shí jì děi zhàogù fùmǔ, yòu děi zhàogù háizi, jiù máfan le.”
Then we'd have to look after both our parents and a child, which would be hard.”
现在“四二一”家庭中的“二”差不多都这么想。
Xiànzài “sì èr yī” jiātíng zhōng de “èr” chàbuduō dōu zhème xiǎng.
Nowadays the “2” in “4-2-1” families nearly all think this way.
金剑和妻子的工作都很忙，所以金剑每周一到周四把孩子放在自己家里，让自己的父母照顾，
Jīn Jiàn hé qīzi de gōngzuò dōu hěn máng, suǒyǐ Jīn Jiàn měi zhōuyī dào zhōusì bǎ háizi fàng zài zìjǐ jiā li, ràng zìjǐ de fùmǔ zhàogù,
Jin Jian and his wife both have busy jobs, so from Monday to Thursday Jin Jian leaves their child at his own parents' home,
每周五到周日，就把孩子带到岳父岳母家。
měi zhōuwǔ dào zhōurì, jiù bǎ háizi dàidào yuèfù yuèmǔ jiā.
and from Friday to Sunday takes the child to his wife's parents.
“如果不这样安排，老人们会不满意呢。
“Rúguǒ bú zhèyàng ānpái, lǎorénmen huì bù mǎnyì ne.
“If we didn't arrange it like this, the grandparents would be unhappy.
要是我们两个年轻人能自己照顾小孩就好了，
Yàoshi wǒmen liǎng ge niánqīngrén néng zìjǐ zhàogù xiǎoháir jiù hǎo le,
It would be nice if the two of us could look after our child ourselves,
可是我们得挣钱呀，要不哪有那么多钱养小孩呢？”
kěshì wǒmen děi zhèngqián ya, yàobù nǎr yǒu nàme duō qián yǎng xiǎoháir ne?”
but we have to earn money. Otherwise where would we get the money to raise a child?”

blocks.label: 回答问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: “四二一”家庭的“四二一”指什么？
“Sì èr yī” jiātíng de “sì èr yī” zhǐ shénme?
What does 4-2-1 refer to?
ans: 四个老人（爷爷、奶奶、姥姥、姥爷），两个父母，一个孩子。
Sì ge lǎorén (yéye, nǎinai, lǎolao, lǎoye), liǎng ge fùmǔ, yí ge háizi.
Four grandparents, two parents and one child.

q: 路易华为什么很早就结婚生了孩子？
Lù Yìhuá wèishénme hěn zǎo jiù jiéhūn shēng le háizi?
Why did Lu Yihua marry and have a child early?
ans: 因为现在父母身体还很好，可以帮他们照顾孩子。
Yīnwèi xiànzài fùmǔ shēntǐ hái hěn hǎo, kěyǐ bāng tāmen zhàogù háizi.
Because their parents are healthy now and can help look after the child.

q: 金剑的父母哪些天照顾孩子？
Jīn Jiàn de fùmǔ nǎxiē tiān zhàogù háizi?
Which days do Jin Jian's parents look after the child?
ans: 每周一到周四。
Měi zhōuyī dào zhōusì.
Monday to Thursday.

q: 金剑和妻子为什么不自己照顾孩子？
Jīn Jiàn hé qīzi wèishénme bú zìjǐ zhàogù háizi?
Why don't Jin Jian and his wife look after the child themselves?
ans: 因为他们工作很忙，得挣钱养孩子。
Yīnwèi tāmen gōngzuò hěn máng, děi zhèngqián yǎng háizi.
They're busy at work and have to earn money to raise the child.

grammar: 要是……就……
if … then …
要是 is a spoken word for “if”.
要是过三年五年以后生孩子，那时候父母的身体可能就不会这么好了。
Yàoshi guò sān nián wǔ nián yǐhòu shēng háizi, nà shíhou fùmǔ de shēntǐ kěnéng jiù bú huì zhème hǎo le.
If we waited a few years, our parents might not be as healthy.
要是明天下雨，我就不去了。
Yàoshi míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒ jiù bú qù le.
If it rains tomorrow, I won't go.
既得……，又得……
have to both … and …
This adds two obligations at once.
那时既得照顾父母，又得照顾孩子，就麻烦了。
Nà shí jì děi zhàogù fùmǔ, yòu děi zhàogù háizi, jiù máfan le.
Then we'd have to look after both parents and child.
我既得上班，又得做饭。
Wǒ jì děi shàngbān, yòu děi zuò fàn.
I have to both work and cook.
要是……就好了
it would be nice if …
This expresses a wish.
要是我们两个年轻人能自己照顾小孩就好了。
Yàoshi wǒmen liǎng ge niánqīngrén néng zìjǐ zhàogù xiǎoháir jiù hǎo le.
It would be nice if we could look after our child ourselves.
要是我会说中文就好了。
Yàoshi wǒ huì shuō Zhōngwén jiù hǎo le.
If only I could speak Chinese.
要不哪有……呢？
otherwise where would … come from?
要不 + a rhetorical question shows why something is necessary.
要不哪有那么多钱养小孩呢？
Yàobù nǎr yǒu nàme duō qián yǎng xiǎoháir ne?
Otherwise where would we get the money?
快点儿学，要不哪有时间玩儿呢？
Kuài diǎnr xué, yàobù nǎr yǒu shíjiān wánr ne?
Study fast, or when will there be time to play?
gaps: 路易华和她的丈夫都是
生了孩子，还可以让他们
那时既得照顾父母，又得照顾孩子，就
say: Our parents are still healthy now, so if we have a child they can look after it.
It would be nice if the two of us could look after our child ourselves.
We have to earn money. Otherwise where would we get the money to raise a child?

106.title: Grandparents minding the children
106.sub: A short passage with nine true/false items
106.transcriptNote: A short passage, then nine statements to judge true or false. Some item numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order. The answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 在大部分独生子女看来，父母帮自己带孩子是好事情，
Zài dà bùfen dúshēng zǐnǚ kànlái, fùmǔ bāng zìjǐ dài háizi shì hǎo shìqing,
Most only children think it's a good thing for their parents to help mind their children,
但他们也担心，怕父母用老的教育方法会对孩子不好。
dàn tāmen yě dānxīn, pà fùmǔ yòng lǎo de jiàoyù fāngfǎ huì duì háizi bù hǎo.
but they also worry that their parents' old-fashioned methods will be bad for the child.
老人照顾小孩的时候，常常只管孩子的生活，别的差不多什么也帮不了。
Lǎorén zhàogù xiǎoháir de shíhou, chángcháng zhǐ guǎn háizi de shēnghuó, biéde chàbuduō shénme yě bāng bu liǎo.
When grandparents mind children, they often only take care of daily needs and can't help with much else.
比如孩子的妈妈买了给孩子听的音乐唱片回家，让老人平时给孩子听，
Bǐrú háizi de māma mǎi le gěi háizi tīng de yīnyuè chàngpiàn huí jiā, ràng lǎorén píngshí gěi háizi tīng,
For example, the mother brings home music CDs for the child and asks the grandparents to play them,
可是老人们不相信听音乐也会变聪明的说法，他们常常忘了这件事。
kěshì lǎorénmen bù xiāngxìn tīng yīnyuè yě huì biàn cōngming de shuōfǎ, tāmen chángcháng wàng le zhè jiàn shì.
but the grandparents don't believe music makes children cleverer, and they often forget.
另外，很多老人不会说普通话，对孩子的语言学习可能不会有什么帮助。
Lìngwài, hěn duō lǎorén bú huì shuō pǔtōnghuà, duì háizi de yǔyán xuéxí kěnéng bú huì yǒu shénme bāngzhù.
Also, many grandparents can't speak Mandarin, which may not help the child's language learning.
有的老人虽然有文化，可是两代人在很多方面有不同的看法。
Yǒu de lǎorén suīrán yǒu wénhuà, kěshì liǎng dài rén zài hěn duō fāngmiàn yǒu bùtóng de kànfǎ.
Some grandparents are educated, but the two generations see many things differently.
在年轻人看来，老一代人的一些看法早就过时了，
Zài niánqīngrén kànlái, lǎo yí dài rén de yìxiē kànfǎ zǎo jiù guòshí le,
Young people think some of the older generation's views are long out of date,
年轻人和老人们常常因为这些而不高兴。
niánqīngrén hé lǎorénmen chángcháng yīnwèi zhèxiē ér bù gāoxìng.
and the two often fall out over this.

blocks.label: 判断正误
blocks.h: 判断正误 · True or false

q: 独生子女夫妻都愿意让父母帮自己照顾孩子。
Dúshēng zǐnǚ fūqī dōu yuànyì ràng fùmǔ bāng zìjǐ zhàogù háizi.
All only-child couples want their parents to help mind the children.
qs.why: the passage says 大部分 (most), not 都 (all)

q: 年轻夫妻给老人买音乐唱片听。
Niánqīng fūqī gěi lǎorén mǎi yīnyuè chàngpiàn tīng.
Young couples buy music CDs for the grandparents.
qs.why: the CDs are for the child

q: 老人不相信听音乐可以让孩子变聪明。
Lǎorén bù xiāngxìn tīng yīnyuè kěyǐ ràng háizi biàn cōngming.
Grandparents don't believe music makes children cleverer.
老人们都懂普通话，但是不会说。
Lǎorénmen dōu dǒng pǔtōnghuà, dànshì bú huì shuō.
All grandparents understand Mandarin but can't speak it.
qs.why: the passage only says many can't speak it, nothing about all of them understanding it

q: 年轻夫妻怕孩子将来不会说普通话。
Niánqīng fūqī pà háizi jiānglái bú huì shuō pǔtōnghuà.
Young couples fear their child won't speak Mandarin in future.
qs.why: the passage only says it may not help the child's language learning; this one is debatable

q: 年轻人和老人在很多方面的看法不一样。
Niánqīngrén hé lǎorén zài hěn duō fāngmiàn de kànfǎ bù yíyàng.
The young and old differ in many views.
他们不怕老人们用老方法教育孩子。
Tāmen bú pà lǎorénmen yòng lǎo fāngfǎ jiàoyù háizi.
They don't mind the grandparents using old methods.
qs.why: they worry about exactly that

q: 年轻人认为旧的东西都不好。
Niánqīngrén rènwéi jiù de dōngxi dōu bù hǎo.
Young people think everything old is bad.
qs.why: only some views are seen as out of date

q: 年轻夫妻常常因为孩子的教育问题和老人们意见不合。
Niánqīng fūqī chángcháng yīnwèi háizi de jiàoyù wèntí hé lǎorénmen yìjiàn bù hé.
Young couples often disagree with the grandparents about bringing up the child.

grammar: 在……看来
in …'s view
This introduces whose opinion it is.
在大部分独生子女看来，父母帮自己带孩子是好事情。
Zài dà bùfen dúshēng zǐnǚ kànlái, fùmǔ bāng zìjǐ dài háizi shì hǎo shìqing.
Most only children think it's good for their parents to help.
在他看来，钱不重要。
Zài tā kànlái, qián bú zhòngyào.
In his view money isn't important.
什么也 + 不/没/V不了
nothing at all
A question word + 也 + negative means “nothing”.
别的差不多什么也帮不了。
Biéde chàbuduō shénme yě bāng bu liǎo.
They can hardly help with anything else.
我什么也没买。
Wǒ shénme yě méi mǎi.
I didn't buy anything.
虽然……，可是……
although …, …
This concedes a point and then contrasts.
有的老人虽然有文化，可是两代人在很多方面有不同的看法。
Yǒu de lǎorén suīrán yǒu wénhuà, kěshì liǎng dài rén zài hěn duō fāngmiàn yǒu bùtóng de kànfǎ.
Although some grandparents are educated, the generations differ on many things.
虽然很累，可是很高兴。
Suīrán hěn lèi, kěshì hěn gāoxìng.
Tired, but happy.
因为……而……
… because of …
而 links the cause to the result in formal style.
年轻人和老人们常常因为这些而不高兴。
Niánqīngrén hé lǎorénmen chángcháng yīnwèi zhèxiē ér bù gāoxìng.
They often fall out over this.
他因为生病而没来上课。
Tā yīnwèi shēngbìng ér méi lái shàngkè.
He missed class because he was ill.
gaps: 老一代人的一些看法早就
say: Most only children think it's a good thing for their parents to help mind their children.
Young people think some of the older generation's views are long out of date.

109.title: 4-2-1 families
109.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split into paragraphs. The names are spelled as heard.

lines: 你知道“四二一”是什么意思吗？
Nǐ zhīdào “sì èr yī” shì shénme yìsi ma?
这三个数字表示的是当代一部分中国人的家庭结构，
Zhè sān ge shùzì biǎoshì de shì dāngdài yí bùfen Zhōngguórén de jiātíng jiégòu,
These three numbers describe the family structure of some Chinese people today,
也就是说，四个长辈，他们夫妻俩和一个孩子。
yě jiù shì shuō, sì ge zhǎngbèi, tāmen fūqī liǎ hé yí ge háizi.
that is, four grandparents, the couple and one child.
他们都是一九七八年以后出生的独生子女，
Tāmen dōu shì yī jiǔ qī bā nián yǐhòu chūshēng de dúshēng zǐnǚ,
其中很多人已经结婚生孩子，成立了自己的小家庭，
qízhōng hěn duō rén yǐjīng jiéhūn shēng háizi, chénglì le zìjǐ de xiǎo jiātíng,
many of whom have married, had children and set up their own families,
而他们的孩子呢，也是独生子女。
ér tāmen de háizi ne, yě shì dúshēng zǐnǚ.
and their children are only children too.
社会学家认为，在不远的将来，一大批“四二一”家庭的出现，将会很快地改变传统的家庭关系。
Shèhuìxuéjiā rènwéi, zài bù yuǎn de jiānglái, yí dà pī “sì èr yī” jiātíng de chūxiàn, jiāng huì hěn kuài de gǎibiàn chuántǒng de jiātíng guānxi.
Sociologists believe that in the near future a wave of 4-2-1 families will quickly change traditional family relationships.
人们不再有姑姑、叔叔、伯伯、姨妈或舅舅，不再有表兄妹或堂兄妹，
Rénmen bú zài yǒu gūgu, shūshu, bóbo, yímā huò jiùjiu, bú zài yǒu biǎo xiōngmèi huò táng xiōngmèi,
People will no longer have aunts or uncles, or cousins of any kind,
而只有少数人才有兄弟姐妹。
ér zhǐyǒu shǎoshù rén cái yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi.
and only a few will have brothers and sisters.
以前那种四世同堂式的金字塔，现在倒过来了，上面大，下面小。
Yǐqián nà zhǒng sì shì tóng táng shì de jīnzìtǎ, xiànzài dào guolai le, shàngmiàn dà, xiàmiàn xiǎo.
The old pyramid of four generations under one roof has now turned upside down: big at the top, small at the bottom.
二十五岁的路易华去年生了一个可爱的女孩儿。
Èrshíwǔ suì de Lù Yìhuá qùnián shēng le yí ge kě'ài de nǚháir.
Twenty-five-year-old Lu Yihua had a lovely baby girl last year.
可是小宝宝刚满六个月，易华就回公司上班去了。
Kěshì xiǎo bǎobao gāng mǎn liù ge yuè, Yìhuá jiù huí gōngsī shàngbān qù le.
But when the baby was only six months old, Yihua went back to work.
她丈夫也经常出差去外地，她只好把孩子留在家里，让父母来帮着照顾。
Tā zhàngfu yě jīngcháng chūchāi qù wàidì, tā zhǐhǎo bǎ háizi liú zài jiā li, ràng fùmǔ lái bāng zhe zhàogù.
Her husband often travels for work too, so she had to leave the baby at home with her parents helping to look after it.
她遗憾地说：“我可能不是一个好妈妈，更不是一个好女儿。”
Tā yíhàn de shuō: “Wǒ kěnéng bú shì yí ge hǎo māma, gèng bú shì yí ge hǎo nǚ'ér.”
She says with regret: “I may not be a good mother, and I'm even less a good daughter.”
虽然在很多人看来，有父母的帮助是自己的福气，
Suīrán zài hěn duō rén kànlái, yǒu fùmǔ de bāngzhù shì zìjǐ de fúqi,
Although many people feel lucky to have their parents' help,
但是他们同时也担心爷爷奶奶或姥姥姥爷会用旧方法来教育后代，
dànshì tāmen tóngshí yě dānxīn yéye nǎinai huò lǎolao lǎoye huì yòng jiù fāngfǎ lái jiàoyù hòudài,
they also worry that the grandparents will bring the next generation up the old way,
这对孩子来说并不一定是好事。
zhè duì háizi lái shuō bìng bù yídìng shì hǎoshì.
which isn't necessarily good for the child.
易华说：“他们是五十年代长大的，我们这两代人的生活环境特别不一样。”
Yìhuá shuō: “Tāmen shì wǔshí niándài zhǎngdà de, wǒmen zhè liǎng dài rén de shēnghuó huánjìng tèbié bù yíyàng.”
Yihua says: “They grew up in the fifties. Our two generations grew up in very different worlds.”
自从有了孩子以后，他的生活发生了突然的变化，
Zìcóng yǒu le háizi yǐhòu, tā de shēnghuó fāshēng le tūrán de biànhuà,
Since having a child his life has changed suddenly,
一下子既要当老公，又要当爸爸，还要当一个好儿子。
yíxiàzi jì yào dāng lǎogōng, yòu yào dāng bàba, hái yào dāng yí ge hǎo érzi.
all at once he has to be a husband, a father and a good son.
“Wǒ kě bú xiàng yǐqián nàyàng zìyóu le.”
“I'm certainly not as free as I was.”
他每周一到周四让自己的父母来看他们的小孙子，周五到周日把孩子带到岳父母家去。
Tā měi zhōuyī dào zhōusì ràng zìjǐ de fùmǔ lái kān tāmen de xiǎo sūnzi, zhōuwǔ dào zhōurì bǎ háizi dàidào yuèfùmǔ jiā qù.
Monday to Thursday his own parents mind their grandson, and Friday to Sunday he takes the child to his wife's parents.
“只有这样，才能让双方的老人都满意。
“Zhǐyǒu zhèyàng, cái néng ràng shuāngfāng de lǎorén dōu mǎnyì.
“Only this way can we keep both sets of grandparents happy.
当然了，要是我们能独自照顾孩子就好了，
Dāngrán le, yàoshi wǒmen néng dúzì zhàogù háizi jiù hǎo le,
Of course, it would be nice if we could look after the child ourselves,
可是我们得工作挣钱呀，要不然怎么能养得起他呢？”
kěshì wǒmen děi gōngzuò zhèngqián ya, yàobùrán zěnme néng yǎng de qǐ tā ne?”
but we have to work and earn money, or how could we afford to raise him?”
一切为了孩子，这个“一”是全家人的中心。
Yíqiè wèile háizi, zhège “yī” shì quán jiā rén de zhōngxīn.
Everything is for the child: this “1” is the centre of the whole family.
在城里，把一个孩子养大要花费父母很多的金钱和精力。
Zài chéng li, bǎ yí ge háizi yǎngdà yào huāfèi fùmǔ hěn duō de jīnqián hé jīnglì.
In the city, bringing up a child costs parents a lot of money and energy.
因此，有些年轻人结了婚却不愿意要孩子，还不如两个人轻轻松松地过日子。
Yīncǐ, yǒuxiē niánqīngrén jié le hūn què bú yuànyì yào háizi, hái bùrú liǎng ge rén qīngqīngsōngsōng de guò rìzi.
So some young people marry but don't want children; they'd rather live an easy life as a couple.
现在，这种新式的“丁克”家庭在北京、上海、广州、深圳等大城市里越来越多。
Xiànzài, zhè zhǒng xīnshì de “dīngkè” jiātíng zài Běijīng, Shànghǎi, Guǎngzhōu, Shēnzhèn děng dà chéngshì li yuè lái yuè duō.
These new-style DINK families are becoming more and more common in big cities like Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou and Shenzhen.
人口学家们担心，这样下去，城市的老龄化问题将会变得十分严重。
Rénkǒuxuéjiāmen dānxīn, zhèyàng xiàqu, chéngshì de lǎolínghuà wèntí jiāng huì biàn de shífēn yánzhòng.
Demographers worry that if this continues, urban population ageing will become a very serious problem.

vocab: to go on a business trip
grammar: 也就是说
that is to say
This restates or explains what came before.
也就是说，四个长辈，他们夫妻俩和一个孩子。
Yě jiù shì shuō, sì ge zhǎngbèi, tāmen fūqī liǎ hé yí ge háizi.
That is, four grandparents, the couple and one child.
他是我妈妈的哥哥，也就是说，是我舅舅。
Tā shì wǒ māma de gēge, yě jiù shì shuō, shì wǒ jiùjiu.
He's my mum's brother, in other words my uncle.
只有……才……
only … can …
只有 gives the one condition; 才 marks the result.
而只有少数人才有兄弟姐妹。
Ér zhǐyǒu shǎoshù rén cái yǒu xiōngdì jiěmèi.
Only a few will have siblings.
只有多练习，才能说好。
Zhǐyǒu duō liànxí, cái néng shuōhǎo.
Only by practising can you speak well.
as soon as … / only just …, already …
This shows something happening very soon after.
小宝宝刚满六个月，易华就回公司上班去了。

113.title: Do you have a home?
113.sub: A short passage with five open questions
113.transcriptNote: A short passage on how housing used to be allocated, then five questions to answer in your own words. Some question numbers aren't read aloud. The model answers are my own.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 对中国城市居民来说，最大的问题是什么？人们肯定会说是房子。
Duì Zhōngguó chéngshì jūmín lái shuō, zuì dà de wèntí shì shénme? Rénmen kěndìng huì shuō shì fángzi.
What's the biggest problem for China's city dwellers? People will certainly say housing.
以前，结了婚才可以申请住房。
Yǐqián, jié le hūn cái kěyǐ shēnqǐng zhùfáng.
In the past you could only apply for housing once you were married.
虽然国家希望人们晚婚，可是晚结婚就晚分房子。
Suīrán guójiā xīwàng rénmen wǎnhūn, kěshì wǎn jiéhūn jiù wǎn fēn fángzi.
The state wanted people to marry late, but marrying late meant getting a flat late.
年轻人要想分到房子，首先要领到结婚证书，然后才能排队分房。
Niánqīngrén yào xiǎng fēndào fángzi, shǒuxiān yào lǐngdào jiéhūn zhèngshū, ránhòu cái néng páiduì fēn fáng.
To get a flat, young people first had to get a marriage certificate, and only then could they join the queue.
可谁也不知道要排多长时间的队。如果幸运的话，也许一两年；如果不幸运，也许一排就是六七年。
Kě shéi yě bù zhīdào yào pái duō cháng shíjiān de duì. Rúguǒ xìngyùn dehuà, yěxǔ yì liǎng nián; rúguǒ bú xìngyùn, yěxǔ yì pái jiù shì liù qī nián.
But nobody knew how long the wait would be. With luck a year or two; without it, maybe six or seven years.
新楼一座一座地都起来了，可是申请住房的人还是那么多。
Xīn lóu yí zuò yí zuò de dōu qǐlai le, kěshì shēnqǐng zhùfáng de rén háishi nàme duō.
New buildings went up one after another, but there were still just as many applicants.
过去在中国，分房真的是一件大事儿，也是一件让人头疼的事儿。
Guòqù zài Zhōngguó, fēn fáng zhēn de shì yí jiàn dà shìr, yě shì yí jiàn ràng rén tóuténg de shìr.
In China, getting a flat used to be a really big deal, and a real headache.
为什么呢？人多房子少，很难满足需要。
Wèishénme ne? Rén duō fángzi shǎo, hěn nán mǎnzú xūyào.
Why? Too many people and too few flats to meet the need.

q: 什么是分房子？
Shénme shì fēn fángzi?

ans: 就是单位或国家给职工分配住房。
Jiù shì dānwèi huò guójiā gěi zhígōng fēnpèi zhùfáng.

q: 怎样才能得到单位分的房子？

How could you get a flat from your work unit?
ans: 先结婚，领到结婚证书，然后排队申请。
Xiān jiéhūn, lǐngdào jiéhūn zhèngshū, ránhòu páiduì shēnqǐng.
Marry, get the certificate, then queue and apply.

q: 领了结婚证以后，为什么要排队分房子？
Lǐng le jiéhūnzhèng yǐhòu, wèishénme yào páiduì fēn fángzi?
Why queue after getting the certificate?
ans: 因为人多房子少，很难满足需要。
Yīnwèi rén duō fángzi shǎo, hěn nán mǎnzú xūyào.
Too many people and too few flats.

q: 排队分房子要排多长时间？
Páiduì fēn fángzi yào pái duō cháng shíjiān?
How long was the wait?
ans: 谁也不知道。幸运的话一两年，不幸运的话六七年。
Shéi yě bù zhīdào. Xìngyùn dehuà yì liǎng nián, bú xìngyùn dehuà liù qī nián.
Nobody knew: a year or two with luck, six or seven without.

q: 为什么说分房子是一件大事？
Wèishénme shuō fēn fángzi shì yí jiàn dà shì?
Why was getting a flat such a big deal?
ans: 因为人多房子少，等的时间很长，很让人头疼。
Yīnwèi rén duō fángzi shǎo, děng de shíjiān hěn cháng, hěn ràng rén tóuténg.
Few flats, many people, and a long, stressful wait.

grammar: 对……来说
for …
This gives the point of view.
对中国城市居民来说，最大的问题是什么？
Duì Zhōngguó chéngshì jūmín lái shuō, zuì dà de wèntí shì shénme?
What's the biggest problem for city dwellers?
对我来说，这很容易。
Duì wǒ lái shuō, zhè hěn róngyì.
For me it's easy.
only then
才 after a condition means “not until”.
以前，结了婚才可以申请住房。
Yǐqián, jié le hūn cái kěyǐ shēnqǐng zhùfáng.
You could only apply once married.
他十点才起床。
Tā shí diǎn cái qǐchuáng.
He didn't get up until ten.
首先……，然后……
first …, then …
This orders steps.
首先要领到结婚证书，然后才能排队分房。
Shǒuxiān yào lǐngdào jiéhūn zhèngshū, ránhòu cái néng páiduì fēn fáng.
First get the certificate, then queue.
首先洗手，然后吃饭。
Shǒuxiān xǐ shǒu, ránhòu chī fàn.
Wash your hands first, then eat.
一 + V + 就是 + amount
once …, it's a whole …
This stresses how much once something starts.
也许一排就是六七年。
Yěxǔ yì pái jiù shì liù qī nián.
Once in the queue, it could be six or seven years.
他一睡就是十个小时。
Tā yí shuì jiù shì shí ge xiǎoshí.
Once he's asleep, it's ten hours.
一 + MW + 一 + MW + 地
one after another
Repeating 一 + measure word shows things happening one by one.
新楼一座一座地都起来了。
Xīn lóu yí zuò yí zuò de dōu qǐlai le.
New buildings went up one after another.
学生一个一个地进来了。
Xuésheng yí ge yí ge de jìnlai le.
The students came in one by one.
say: In the past you could only apply for housing once you were married.
With luck a year or two; without it, maybe six or seven years.
Too many people and too few flats to meet the need.

114.title: Is this your new home?
114.sub: A dialogue about housing in Shanghai, with nine true/false items
114.transcriptNote: 甲 is a friend and 乙 is Xiaoying, who lives in Shanghai. Speakers are assigned from context, and the answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: Zhè shì nǐ jiā de xīn fángzi ba
小英，这是你家的新房子吧？
Xiǎo Yīng, zhè shì nǐ jiā de xīn fángzi ba?
Xiaoying, is this your family's new home?
是的。我家原来的平房拆了，那里要建地铁站。
Shì de. Wǒ jiā yuánlái de píngfáng chāi le, nàlǐ yào jiàn dìtiězhàn.
Yes. Our old single-storey house was pulled down; they're building a subway station there.
这几年上海大发展，很多旧房子都拆了。
Zhè jǐ nián Shànghǎi dà fāzhǎn, hěn duō jiù fángzi dōu chāi le.
Shanghai has developed a lot in recent years, and many old houses have been pulled down.
政府给我们家换了一套两室一厅的房子。
Zhèngfǔ gěi wǒmen jiā huàn le yí tào liǎng shì yì tīng de fángzi.
The government gave us a two-bedroom flat with a living room in exchange.
上海有一千多万人，要我看，解决住房问题真不容易。
Shànghǎi yǒu yìqiān duō wàn rén, yào wǒ kàn, jiějué zhùfáng wèntí zhēn bù róngyì.
Shanghai has over ten million people. If you ask me, solving the housing problem isn't easy.
谁说不是呢！以前我家只有一间房，老的老、小的小住在一起，挤得不行。
Shéi shuō bú shì ne! Yǐqián wǒ jiā zhǐ yǒu yì jiān fáng, lǎo de lǎo, xiǎo de xiǎo zhù zài yìqǐ, jǐ de bù xíng.
You can say that again! We used to have one room, old and young all living together. It was terribly cramped.
现在好了，我有了自己的房间，再也不用那么挤了。
Xiànzài hǎo le, wǒ yǒu le zìjǐ de fángjiān, zài yě búyòng nàme jǐ le.
It's better now. I have my own room and we don't have to squeeze in any more.
一般人的住房是买还是租？
Yìbān rén de zhùfáng shì mǎi háishi zū?
Do most people buy or rent?
都有。我们这座楼住了十八家人，有买的也有租的。
Dōu yǒu. Wǒmen zhè zuò lóu zhù le shíbā jiā rén, yǒu mǎi de yě yǒu zū de.
Both. Eighteen families live in our building; some bought and some rent.
现在买房子的人越来越多了，可是房价也越来越贵了，很多人还是买不起房子。
Xiànzài mǎi fángzi de rén yuè lái yuè duō le, kěshì fángjià yě yuè lái yuè guì le, hěn duō rén háishi mǎi bu qǐ fángzi.
More and more people are buying, but prices keep rising too, and many still can't afford it.
现在上海人最想要的是什么？
Xiànzài Shànghǎirén zuì xiǎng yào de shì shénme?
What do Shanghai people want most now?
没房子的人最想有自己的房子，有房子的人想要一辆汽车。
Méi fángzi de rén zuì xiǎng yǒu zìjǐ de fángzi, yǒu fángzi de rén xiǎng yào yí liàng qìchē.
People without a home most want one of their own; people with a home want a car.

blocks.label: 判断正误
blocks.h: 判断正误 · True or false

q: 小英家原来住的是平房，现在住的也是。
Xiǎo Yīng jiā yuánlái zhù de shì píngfáng, xiànzài zhù de yě shì.
Xiaoying's family lived in a single-storey house and still does.
qs.why: they now have a flat

q: 她家原来住在地铁站旁边。
Tā jiā yuánlái zhù zài dìtiězhàn pángbiān.
Her family used to live next to a subway station.
qs.why: the station is being built where their house was

q: 以前小英全家人住在一个房间里。
Yǐqián Xiǎo Yīng quán jiā rén zhù zài yí ge fángjiān li.
Xiaoying's whole family used to live in one room.
现在全家人住在两个房间里。
Xiànzài quán jiā rén zhù zài liǎng ge fángjiān li.
Now the family lives in two rooms.
qs.why: 两室一厅 means two bedrooms plus a living room, so this is arguable

q: 小英以前没有自己的房间。
Xiǎo Yīng yǐqián méiyǒu zìjǐ de fángjiān.
Xiaoying didn't have her own room before.
现在上海人都租房子住。
Xiànzài Shànghǎirén dōu zū fángzi zhù.
Shanghai people all rent now.
qs.why: some buy and some rent

q: 现在上海人都买房子住。
Xiànzài Shànghǎirén dōu mǎi fángzi zhù.
Shanghai people all buy now.
qs.why: some buy and some rent

q: 现在买不起房子的人还很多。
Xiànzài mǎi bu qǐ fángzi de rén hái hěn duō.
Many people still can't afford a home.
没有房子的人都先买一辆汽车。
Méiyǒu fángzi de rén dōu xiān mǎi yí liàng qìchē.
People without homes all buy a car first.
qs.why: it's people with homes who want a car

grammar: 要我看
if you ask me
This introduces a personal opinion.
要我看，解决住房问题真不容易。
Yào wǒ kàn, jiějué zhùfáng wèntí zhēn bù róngyì.
If you ask me, solving housing isn't easy.
要我看，明天会下雨。
Yào wǒ kàn, míngtiān huì xià yǔ.
If you ask me, it'll rain tomorrow.
谁说不是呢！
you can say that again!
A rhetorical question that strongly agrees.
谁说不是呢！
Shéi shuō bú shì ne!
You can say that again!
这天气真热。——谁说不是呢！
Zhè tiānqì zhēn rè. — Shéi shuō bú shì ne!
It's so hot. — Isn't it just!
adj + 得不行
extremely …
得不行 after an adjective means “unbearably”.
挤得不行。
Jǐ de bù xíng.
Terribly cramped.
我累得不行。
Wǒ lèi de bù xíng.
I'm absolutely exhausted.
有……的，也有……的
some …, some …
This splits a group into kinds.
有买的也有租的。
Yǒu mǎi de yě yǒu zū de.
Some bought and some rent.
有喝茶的，也有喝咖啡的。
Yǒu hē chá de, yě yǒu hē kāfēi de.
Some drink tea, some coffee.
gaps: 给我们家换了一套两室一厅的房子。
老的老、小的小住在一起，
say: Xiaoying, is this your family's new home?
You can say that again! We used to have one room, old and young all living together.
Do most people buy or rent?

115.zh: 我希望公司再搬一次家
115.title: I hope the company moves again
115.sub: A short monologue with three open questions
115.transcriptNote: A short monologue about moving house, then three questions to answer in your own words. The model answers are my own.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 我希望公司再搬一次家
Wǒ xīwàng gōngsī zài bān yí cì jiā
I hope the company moves again
来到这个城市的两年里，我已经搬过三次家了。
Láidào zhège chéngshì de liǎng nián li, wǒ yǐjīng bān guo sān cì jiā le.
In the two years since I came to this city, I've moved three times.
刚来的时候，我在公司附近租了一间房。
Gāng lái de shíhou, wǒ zài gōngsī fùjìn zū le yì jiān fáng.
When I first arrived I rented a room near the office.
房间不大，但是上班很方便，骑车十分钟就可以到公司。
Fángjiān bú dà, dànshì shàngbān hěn fāngbiàn, qí chē shí fēnzhōng jiù kěyǐ dào gōngsī.
It wasn't big, but getting to work was easy: ten minutes by bike.
今年，我们公司换了地方，所以我也只好搬家了。
Jīnnián, wǒmen gōngsī huàn le dìfang, suǒyǐ wǒ yě zhǐhǎo bānjiā le.
This year the company moved, so I had to move too.
可第二次租的那间房太小，我只住了半年，就搬到了现在这个地方。
Kě dì èr cì zū de nà jiān fáng tài xiǎo, wǒ zhǐ zhù le bàn nián, jiù bāndào le xiànzài zhège dìfang.
But the second room was too small. I stayed only six months before moving here.
房子是大了，离公司也不远，可就是太贵了。
Fángzi shì dà le, lí gōngsī yě bù yuǎn, kě jiù shì tài guì le.
It is bigger, and not far from work, but it's just too expensive.
没办法，我知道现在要找到非常合适的房子是很难的。
Méi bànfǎ, wǒ zhīdào xiànzài yào zhǎodào fēicháng héshì de fángzi shì hěn nán de.
There's nothing to be done. I know it's hard to find the perfect place these days.
我希望公司再搬一次家，也许租房会好点儿。
Wǒ xīwàng gōngsī zài bān yí cì jiā, yěxǔ zū fáng huì hǎo diǎnr.
I hope the company moves again. Maybe renting will be easier then.

blocks.label: 回答问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 我来这个城市多长时间了？
Wǒ lái zhège chéngshì duō cháng shíjiān le?
How long have I been in this city?
ans: 两年了。
Liǎng nián le.
Two years.

q: 我第一次租的房子怎么样？
Wǒ dì yī cì zū de fángzi zěnmeyàng?
What was my first rented room like?
ans: 房间不大，但是离公司很近，上班很方便。
Fángjiān bú dà, dànshì lí gōngsī hěn jìn, shàngbān hěn fāngbiàn.
Small, but close to work and convenient.

q: 我第三次租的房子怎么样？
Wǒ dì sān cì zū de fángzi zěnmeyàng?
What's my third place like?
ans: 房子大，离公司也不远，可是太贵了。
Fángzi dà, lí gōngsī yě bù yuǎn, kěshì tài guì le.
Big and not far from work, but too expensive.

grammar: V + 过 + number + 次
have done … times
过 marks experience, and the count follows it.
我已经搬过三次家了。
Wǒ yǐjīng bān guo sān cì jiā le.
I've already moved three times.
我去过两次北京。
Wǒ qù guo liǎng cì Běijīng.
I've been to Beijing twice.
只好
have no choice but to
只好 shows a forced decision.
所以我也只好搬家了。
Suǒyǐ wǒ yě zhǐhǎo bānjiā le.
So I had to move too.
没有车了，我们只好走路。
Méiyǒu chē le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo zǒulù.
No buses left, so we had to walk.
A 是 A，可就是……
it is …, but it's just …
Repeating the adjective with 是 concedes the point before the drawback.
房子是大了，……可就是太贵了。
Fángzi shì dà le, … kě jiù shì tài guì le.
It is bigger, but it's just too expensive.
这件衣服好看是好看，就是太贵。
Zhè jiàn yīfu hǎokàn shì hǎokàn, jiù shì tài guì.
It's nice all right, just too dear.
gaps: 我知道现在要找到非常
say: In the two years since I came to this city, I've moved three times.
It is bigger, and not far from work, but it's just too expensive.

116.title: Renting beats buying
116.sub: A short opinion piece on house prices
116.transcriptNote: A short monologue with no questions, split into paragraphs.

lines: 现在的房价真是和从前不能比了，每天都在涨，
Xiànzài de fángjià zhēn shì hé cóngqián bù néng bǐ le, měi tiān dōu zài zhǎng,
House prices today are nothing like they used to be. They go up every day,
一个普通人的工资怎么能赶得上这样的速度？
yí ge pǔtōngrén de gōngzī zěnme néng gǎn de shàng zhèyàng de sùdù?
so how can an ordinary person's wages keep up?
想想现在的小白领，就算一个月的工资一万元吧，
Xiǎngxiang xiànzài de xiǎo báilǐng, jiùsuàn yí ge yuè de gōngzī yí wàn yuán ba,
Think of today's young office workers. Say one earns 10,000 yuan a month,
但是房价一平米就得一万多元钱，
dànshì fángjià yì píngmǐ jiù děi yí wàn duō yuán qián,
but a square metre costs over 10,000 yuan,
买一套两室两厅的房子，九十个平米也要一百万左右，还不算别的花费。
mǎi yí tào liǎng shì liǎng tīng de fángzi, jiǔshí ge píngmǐ yě yào yìbǎi wàn zuǒyòu, hái bú suàn biéde huāfèi.
so a 90-square-metre flat with two bedrooms and two living areas costs about a million, not counting other costs.
即使买得起房子，以后的生活也会很紧张：
Jíshǐ mǎi de qǐ fángzi, yǐhòu de shēnghuó yě huì hěn jǐnzhāng:
Even if you can afford it, money will be tight afterwards:
吃不能吃好，穿不能穿好；
chī bù néng chīhǎo, chuān bù néng chuānhǎo;
you can't eat well or dress well;
人家去咖啡馆喝喝咖啡，你只能在家喝喝水；
rénjia qù kāfēiguǎn hēhe kāfēi, nǐ zhǐ néng zài jiā hēhe shuǐ;
others go to cafés for coffee while you drink water at home;
人家开车去郊外游玩，你只能在家看看电视。
rénjia kāi chē qù jiāowài yóuwán, nǐ zhǐ néng zài jiā kànkan diànshì.
others drive out to the countryside while you watch TV at home.
一天两天你可能觉得没什么，时间长了你试试！
Yì tiān liǎng tiān nǐ kěnéng juéde méi shénme, shíjiān cháng le nǐ shìshi!
For a day or two it may seem fine, but try it for a long time!
所以，如果没有能力买房的话，还不如去租。
Suǒyǐ, rúguǒ méiyǒu nénglì mǎi fáng dehuà, hái bùrú qù zū.
So if you can't afford to buy, you're better off renting.
虽然房子不是自己的，但这样的日子比自己买房轻松得多，生活质量也会好得多。
Suīrán fángzi bú shì zìjǐ de, dàn zhèyàng de rìzi bǐ zìjǐ mǎi fáng qīngsōng de duō, shēnghuó zhìliàng yě huì hǎo de duō.
The home isn't yours, but life is much easier than buying, and your quality of life is much better.
只要能和自己爱的人在一起，不管在哪儿都是家。
Zhǐyào néng hé zìjǐ ài de rén zài yìqǐ, bùguǎn zài nǎr dōu shì jiā.
As long as you're with the people you love, anywhere is home.

grammar: A 不如 B
A isn't as good as B
不如 means B is the better choice.
买房不如租房。
Mǎi fáng bùrú zū fáng.
Renting beats buying.
坐车不如走路。
Zuò chē bùrú zǒulù.
Walking is better than taking the bus.
V 得上 / V 不上
can / can't keep up
得上 means managing to reach a standard.
怎么能赶得上这样的速度？
Zěnme néng gǎn de shàng zhèyàng de sùdù?
How can wages keep up with that?
他跑得太快，我追不上。
Tā pǎo de tài kuài, wǒ zhuī bu shàng.
He runs too fast for me to catch.
即使……也……
even if …
即使 introduces a hypothetical concession.
即使买得起房子，以后的生活也会很紧张。
Jíshǐ mǎi de qǐ fángzi, yǐhòu de shēnghuó yě huì hěn jǐnzhāng.
Even if you can afford it, money will be tight.
即使下雨，我也要去。
Jíshǐ xià yǔ, wǒ yě yào qù.
Even if it rains, I'll go.
还不如……
you'd be better off …
还不如 suggests a better alternative.
如果没有能力买房的话，还不如去租。
Rúguǒ méiyǒu nénglì mǎi fáng dehuà, hái bùrú qù zū.
If you can't afford to buy, you're better off renting.
这么贵，还不如自己做。
Zhème guì, hái bùrú zìjǐ zuò.
At that price you'd be better off making it yourself.
只要……，不管……都……
as long as …, no matter …
只要 gives the condition, and 不管……都 says the place doesn't matter.
只要能和自己爱的人在一起，不管在哪儿都是家。
Zhǐyào néng hé zìjǐ ài de rén zài yìqǐ, bùguǎn zài nǎr dōu shì jiā.
As long as you're with people you love, anywhere is home.
只要你喜欢，不管多贵我都买。
Zhǐyào nǐ xǐhuan, bùguǎn duō guì wǒ dōu mǎi.
If you like it, I'll buy it whatever it costs.
gaps: 怎么能赶得上这样的速度？
say: House prices go up every day, so how can an ordinary person's wages keep up?
Even if you can afford it, money will be tight afterwards.
As long as you're with the people you love, anywhere is home.

117.title: Supplementary vocabulary: housing
117.sub: Verbs, adjectives, adverbs, nouns, set phrases and names
117.transcriptNote: A longer word list, read roughly as verbs, adjectives, adverbs, nouns, set phrases and then names. 原来, 正好 and 单身 come up twice in different sections.

blocks.label: 补充生词
lines: to live and work in peace
to talk till you're blue in the face
blocks.note: Short syllables were checked with a second, wider pass: 刷, 吵, 领, 求, 哭, 欠, 曾, 笔 and 墙. 不得不, 靠 and 计划 were missed on the first pass. 119.title: Stories about homes
119.sub: The lesson text: housing in China, told through four people
119.transcriptNote: The lesson text, split by section. Each story is told in the first person. The names are spelled as heard.

lines: “安居乐业”是一句古话，但至今还是很多年轻人的梦想。
“Ānjū lèyè” shì yí jù gǔhuà, dàn zhìjīn háishi hěn duō niánqīngrén de mèngxiǎng.
“A settled home and a happy job” is an old saying, but it's still many young people's dream.
通过下面这几个例子，我们可以看到几十年来城市居民住房情况发生的变化。
Tōngguò xiàmiàn zhè jǐ ge lìzi, wǒmen kěyǐ kàndào jǐ shí nián lái chéngshì jūmín zhùfáng qíngkuàng fāshēng de biànhuà.
These examples show how city housing has changed over the decades.
八十年代以前，所有的住房都是由工作单位提供的。
Bāshí niándài yǐqián, suǒyǒu de zhùfáng dōu shì yóu gōngzuò dānwèi tígōng de.
Before the 1980s, all housing was provided by the work unit.
虽然人口不断地增加，但是住房却很少，满足不了人们的需要。
Suīrán rénkǒu búduàn de zēngjiā, dànshì zhùfáng què hěn shǎo, mǎnzú bu liǎo rénmen de xūyào.
The population kept growing, but there was little housing, not enough to meet people's needs.
汽车修理工吕易光的故事
Qìchē xiūlǐgōng Lǚ Yìguāng de gùshi
The story of Lü Yiguang, car mechanic
一九七三年秋天，我二十四岁，跟厂里的一个姑娘认识了两年以后，我们决定结婚。
Yī jiǔ qī sān nián qiūtiān, wǒ èrshísì suì, gēn chǎng li de yí ge gūniang rènshi le liǎng nián yǐhòu, wǒmen juédìng jiéhūn.
In autumn 1973, when I was 24, after knowing a girl from the factory for two years, we decided to marry.
工厂很快就同意分给我们一间房子。
Gōngchǎng hěn kuài jiù tóngyì fēn gěi wǒmen yì jiān fángzi.
The factory quickly agreed to give us a room.
其实，我们还住在原来的单身宿舍楼里。
Qíshí, wǒmen hái zhù zài yuánlái de dānshēn sùshè lóu li.
Actually, we were still in the same single workers' dormitory.
中间是一条又黑又长的楼道，两边是一个个完全相同的房间。
Zhōngjiān shì yì tiáo yòu hēi yòu cháng de lóudào, liǎngbiān shì yí gège wánquán xiāngtóng de fángjiān.
A long dark corridor ran down the middle, with identical rooms on both sides.
Qiáng shuā bái le, jiù chéng le xīnfáng.
Once the walls were painted white, it became our marital home.
我们家在三层，朝北，只有十二平米，放进去一张大床和几件家具以后，就没有空地方了。
Wǒmen jiā zài sān céng, cháo běi, zhǐ yǒu shí'èr píngmǐ, fàng jinqu yì zhāng dà chuáng hé jǐ jiàn jiājù yǐhòu, jiù méiyǒu kòng dìfang le.
It was on the third floor, facing north, only 12 square metres. With a big bed and a few pieces of furniture there was no space left.
更不方便的是，卫生间和厨房都是和邻居们共用的，
Gèng bù fāngbiàn de shì, wèishēngjiān hé chúfáng dōu shì hé línjūmen gòngyòng de,
Worse, the bathroom and kitchen were shared with the neighbours:
炒菜常常要排队，上厕所也会碰上客满。
chǎo cài chángcháng yào páiduì, shàng cèsuǒ yě huì pèngshang kè mǎn.
we often queued to cook, and the toilet was often occupied.
不过，我们当时觉得很满意，就这样开始了我们的夫妻生活，而且有了孩子。
Búguò, wǒmen dāngshí juéde hěn mǎnyì, jiù zhèyàng kāishǐ le wǒmen de fūqī shēnghuó, érqiě yǒu le háizi.
Still, we were happy at the time. That's how our married life began, and we had a child.
从八十年代起，一大批福利住房建成了。
Cóng bāshí niándài qǐ, yí dà pī fúlì zhùfáng jiànchéng le.
From the 1980s on, a large amount of welfare housing was built.
The story of Zhang Shinan, civil servant
一九八九年，我谈恋爱的时候，我们单位正好开始分房。
Yī jiǔ bā jiǔ nián, wǒ tán liàn'ài de shíhou, wǒmen dānwèi zhènghǎo kāishǐ fēn fáng.
In 1989, when I was courting, my work unit happened to start allocating flats.
我和未婚妻只要能领到结婚证书，就可以得到一套四十平米的小公寓。
Wǒ hé wèihūnqī zhǐyào néng lǐngdào jiéhūn zhèngshū, jiù kěyǐ dédào yí tào sìshí píngmǐ de xiǎo gōngyù.
If my fiancée and I could get a marriage certificate, we'd get a small 40-square-metre flat.
我们俩当时都很兴奋，可是没想到，她工作的那个学校不同意，理由是她还没到二十三岁的晚婚年龄。
Wǒmen liǎ dāngshí dōu hěn xīngfèn, kěshì méi xiǎngdào, tā gōngzuò de nàge xuéxiào bù tóngyì, lǐyóu shì tā hái méi dào èrshísān suì de wǎnhūn niánlíng.
We were both thrilled, but her school unexpectedly refused, because she hadn't reached the late-marriage age of 23.
我一听到这个消息就急坏了，立刻跑去见校长，说：
Wǒ yì tīngdào zhège xiāoxi jiù jíhuài le, lìkè pǎo qù jiàn xiàozhǎng, shuō:
I was frantic when I heard, and rushed straight to the head teacher:
“校长，我求求您！我们单位好不容易分一次房，要是这次机会错过了，下一次就不知道是什么时候了。
“Xiàozhǎng, wǒ qiúqiu nín! Wǒmen dānwèi hǎo bù róngyì fēn yí cì fáng, yàoshi zhè cì jīhuì cuòguò le, xià yí cì jiù bù zhīdào shì shénme shíhou le.
“Please, I beg you! My unit hardly ever allocates flats. If we miss this chance, who knows when the next one will be.
虽然她不是晚婚，可法定的结婚年龄已经过了呀！再说我自己都二十六了。”
Suīrán tā bú shì wǎnhūn, kě fǎdìng de jiéhūn niánlíng yǐjīng guò le ya! Zàishuō wǒ zìjǐ dōu èrshíliù le.”
She may not be marrying late, but she's past the legal age! Besides, I'm already 26.”
我把嘴皮都快说破了，还差点儿哭了起来，可校长就是不答应。
Wǒ bǎ zuǐpí dōu kuài shuōpò le, hái chàdiǎnr kū le qilai, kě xiàozhǎng jiù shì bù dāying.
I talked till I was blue in the face and nearly cried, but the head just wouldn't agree.
结果，两年以后，当我们结婚的时候，单位的房子已经全部分完了，我们只好跟父母挤在一起，挤了差不多十年。
Jiéguǒ, liǎng nián yǐhòu, dāng wǒmen jiéhūn de shíhou, dānwèi de fángzi yǐjīng quánbù fēnwán le, wǒmen zhǐhǎo gēn fùmǔ jǐ zài yìqǐ, jǐ le chàbuduō shí nián.
In the end, when we married two years later, all the flats were gone. We had to squeeze in with my parents for almost ten years.
上个世纪末，城市住房可以像商品一样自由买卖了，福利住房变成了历史。
Shàng ge shìjì mò, chéngshì zhùfáng kěyǐ xiàng shāngpǐn yíyàng zìyóu mǎimài le, fúlì zhùfáng biànchéng le lìshǐ.
At the end of the last century, city housing could be bought and sold freely like any goods, and welfare housing became history.
刚刚成年的八零后，如果没有父母的帮助，就不得不靠自己的经济能力来解决住房问题。
Gānggāng chéngnián de bā líng hòu, rúguǒ méiyǒu fùmǔ de bāngzhù, jiù bù dé bù kào zìjǐ de jīngjì nénglì lái jiějué zhùfáng wèntí.
Young people born in the 1980s, just grown up, have to solve housing with their own money unless their parents help.
他们的收入一般比较低，而可怕的是，房价却越涨越快。
Tāmen de shōurù yìbān bǐjiào dī, ér kěpà de shì, fángjià què yuè zhǎng yuè kuài.
Their incomes are generally low, and the frightening thing is that prices are rising faster and faster.
到底是买房好，还是租房好呢？
Dàodǐ shì mǎi fáng hǎo, háishi zū fáng hǎo ne?
So is it better to buy or to rent?
我犹豫了很久才决定买房，因为要是现在还不买的话，以后连郊区的房子都买不起了。
Wǒ yóuyù le hěn jiǔ cái juédìng mǎi fáng, yīnwèi yàoshi xiànzài hái bù mǎi dehuà, yǐhòu lián jiāoqū de fángzi dōu mǎi bu qǐ le.
I hesitated a long time before deciding to buy, because if I don't buy now, later I won't even afford the suburbs.
而且，租房没有安全感，随时都会被房主赶出去。
Érqiě, zū fáng méiyǒu ānquángǎn, suíshí dōu huì bèi fángzhǔ gǎn chuqu.
And renting feels insecure: the owner can throw you out at any time.
现在，我那套二手房已经快装修好了。至少从搬进去的第一天起，我就会觉得有自己的财产和个人空间了。
Xiànzài, wǒ nà tào èrshǒufáng yǐjīng kuài zhuāngxiū hǎo le. Zhìshǎo cóng bān jinqu de dì yī tiān qǐ, wǒ jiù huì juéde yǒu zìjǐ de cáichǎn hé gèrén kōngjiān le.
My second-hand flat is nearly done up. From the day I move in, at least, I'll feel I have my own property and space.
我想好了，绝不为房地产商和银行打工。
Wǒ xiǎnghǎo le, jué bú wèi fángdìchǎnshāng hé yínháng dǎgōng.
I've made up my mind: I'm never going to slave for developers and banks.
可是我也不愿意向父母要钱，他们将来退休以后，岁数大了，万一生病或有急需怎么办？
Kěshì wǒ yě bú yuànyì xiàng fùmǔ yào qián, tāmen jiānglái tuìxiū yǐhòu, suìshu dà le, wànyī shēngbìng huò yǒu jíxū zěnme bàn?
But I don't want to ask my parents for money either. When they retire and get older, what if they get ill or need money urgently?
我的一些朋友虽然住进了自己的房子，却欠了一大笔钱，所有的计划，比如购物啊、娱乐啊、旅行啊，全都取消了，
Wǒ de yìxiē péngyou suīrán zhùjìn le zìjǐ de fángzi, què qiàn le yí dà bǐ qián, suǒyǒu de jìhuà, bǐrú gòuwù a, yúlè a, lǚxíng a, quán dōu qǔxiāo le,
Some friends moved into their own homes but owe a fortune, and every plan—shopping, fun, travel—has been cancelled.
日子过得既紧张又辛苦。我们都还年轻，这样的生活有什么意义呢？
rìzi guò de jì jǐnzhāng yòu xīnkǔ. Wǒmen dōu hái niánqīng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó yǒu shénme yìyì ne?
Life is tight and hard. We're still young, so what's the point of living like that?

vocab: to live and work in peace
lips (把嘴皮说破: talk till you're blue in the face)
grammar: 由……提供
provided by …
由 marks the agent in formal passives.
所有的住房都是由工作单位提供的。
Suǒyǒu de zhùfáng dōu shì yóu gōngzuò dānwèi tígōng de.
All housing was provided by the work unit.
午饭由公司提供。
Wǔfàn yóu gōngsī tígōng.
Lunch is provided by the company.
V + 不了
can't …
不了 means it's impossible.
满足不了人们的需要。
Mǎnzú bu liǎo rénmen de xūyào.
Not enough to meet people's needs.
这么多菜我吃不了。
Zhème duō cài wǒ chī bu liǎo.
I can't finish all this.
只要……就……
as long as …
只要 gives the one condition needed.
只要能领到结婚证书，就可以得到一套四十平米的小公寓。
Zhǐyào néng lǐngdào jiéhūn zhèngshū, jiù kěyǐ dédào yí tào sìshí píngmǐ de xiǎo gōngyù.
As long as we got the certificate, we'd get a flat.
只要你来，我就高兴。
Zhǐyào nǐ lái, wǒ jiù gāoxìng.
As long as you come, I'm happy.
好不容易
with great difficulty
好不容易 and 好容易 both mean “only just managed”.
我们单位好不容易分一次房。
Wǒmen dānwèi hǎo bù róngyì fēn yí cì fáng.
My unit hardly ever allocates flats.
我好不容易才买到票。
Wǒ hǎo bù róngyì cái mǎidào piào.
I only just managed to get a ticket.
the more … the more …
越 + V + 越 + adj shows an increasing trend.
房价却越涨越快。
Fángjià què yuè zhǎng yuè kuài.
Prices are rising faster and faster.
他越说越高兴。
Tā yuè shuō yuè gāoxìng.
The more he talked, the happier he got.
even …
连 picks out an extreme case.
以后连郊区的房子都买不起了。
Yǐhòu lián jiāoqū de fángzi dōu mǎi bu qǐ le.
Later I won't even afford the suburbs.
他连饭都没吃。
Tā lián fàn dōu méi chī.
He didn't even eat.
万一
in case, what if
万一 introduces an unlikely but worrying possibility.
万一生病或有急需怎么办？
Wànyī shēngbìng huò yǒu jíxū zěnme bàn?
What if they get ill or need money urgently?
带把伞吧，万一下雨呢。
Dài bǎ sǎn ba, wànyī xià yǔ ne.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
gaps: 还是很多年轻人的梦想。
所有的住房都是由工作单位
卫生间和厨房都是和邻居们
say: Before the 1980s, all housing was provided by the work unit.
If we miss this chance, who knows when the next one will be.
So is it better to buy or to rent?
We're still young, so what's the point of living like that?

121.title: Ten sentences
121.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences using the new words from part 120. Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order.

lines: 这些作者们根本不在乎别人对他们的看法。
Zhèxiē zuòzhěmen gēnběn bú zàihu biérén duì tāmen de kànfǎ.
These authors don't care at all what others think of them.
关于这些问题，网上的讨论非常热烈。
Guānyú zhèxiē wèntí, wǎng shang de tǎolùn fēicháng rèliè.
Online discussion of these questions is very heated.
写书这种事不是任何人都做得到的。
Xiě shū zhè zhǒng shì bú shì rènhé rén dōu zuò de dào de.
Writing a book isn't something just anyone can do.
有些作者大概永远也不会被文学界接受。
Yǒuxiē zuòzhě dàgài yǒngyuǎn yě bú huì bèi wénxuéjiè jiēshòu.
Some authors will probably never be accepted by the literary world.
到现在为止，很多奇奇怪怪的说法只能用在网上。
Dào xiànzài wéizhǐ, hěn duō qíqíguàiguài de shuōfǎ zhǐ néng yòng zài wǎng shang.
So far, a lot of odd expressions can only be used online.
其实，大部分网民并不反对网络文学。
Qíshí, dà bùfen wǎngmín bìng bù fǎnduì wǎngluò wénxué.
In fact, most internet users aren't against online literature.
这位专家专门研究过网络文学，发表了不少文章。
Zhè wèi zhuānjiā zhuānmén yánjiū guo wǎngluò wénxué, fābiǎo le bù shǎo wénzhāng.
This expert has specialised in online literature and published many articles.
我要是有未成年的孩子，就禁止他上网看小说。
Wǒ yàoshi yǒu wèichéngnián de háizi, jiù jìnzhǐ tā shàngwǎng kàn xiǎoshuō.
If I had an underage child, I'd forbid him to read novels online.
现在很多文学网站已经商业化了。
Xiànzài hěn duō wénxué wǎngzhàn yǐjīng shāngyèhuà le.
Many literary websites have gone commercial.
无论专家们怎么说，网络文学已经发展起来了。
Wúlùn zhuānjiāmen zěnme shuō, wǎngluò wénxué yǐjīng fāzhǎn qilai le.
Whatever the experts say, online literature has taken off.

grammar: 根本不……
not … at all
根本 before a negative strengthens it.
这些作者们根本不在乎别人对他们的看法。
Zhèxiē zuòzhěmen gēnběn bú zàihu biérén duì tāmen de kànfǎ.
These authors don't care at all.
我根本不认识他。
Wǒ gēnběn bú rènshi tā.
I don't know him at all.
关于……
about …
关于 introduces the topic, usually at the start.
关于这些问题，网上的讨论非常热烈。
Guānyú zhèxiē wèntí, wǎng shang de tǎolùn fēicháng rèliè.
Online discussion of these questions is heated.
关于这件事，我不太清楚。
Guānyú zhè jiàn shì, wǒ bú tài qīngchu.
I'm not sure about this.
任何……都……
any …
任何 + noun + 都 covers every case.
写书这种事不是任何人都做得到的。
Xiě shū zhè zhǒng shì bú shì rènhé rén dōu zuò de dào de.
Not just anyone can write a book.
任何问题都可以问我。
Rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ wèn wǒ.
You can ask me anything.
到……为止
up to …
This marks an end point in time.
到现在为止，……
Dào xiànzài wéizhǐ, …
So far, …
到今天为止，我学了五百个汉字。
Dào jīntiān wéizhǐ, wǒ xué le wǔbǎi ge Hànzì.
So far I've learnt 500 characters.
无论……都……
no matter …
无论 + a question form says the result holds in every case.
无论专家们怎么说，网络文学已经发展起来了。
Wúlùn zhuānjiāmen zěnme shuō, wǎngluò wénxué yǐjīng fāzhǎn qilai le.
Whatever the experts say, it has taken off.
无论多忙，他都锻炼。
Wúlùn duō máng, tā dōu duànliàn.
However busy, he exercises.
gaps: 有些作者大概永远也不会被文学界
say: Writing a book isn't something just anyone can do.
In fact, most internet users aren't against online literature.
Whatever the experts say, online literature has taken off.

122.title: Listening: life online
122.sub: Eighteen items on the internet and online literature
122.transcriptNote: Items 1–15 each have a sentence or short exchange with one question; items 16–18 share a dialogue. Some item numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order. Speakers in the dialogues are checked by pitch, and the answer key is my own reading.

lines: 关于网络小说算不算文学，网上的讨论非常热烈。发表意见的人既有专家学者，也有普普通通的网民。
Guānyú wǎngluò xiǎoshuō suàn bu suàn wénxué, wǎng shang de tǎolùn fēicháng rèliè. Fābiǎo yìjiàn de rén jì yǒu zhuānjiā xuézhě, yě yǒu pǔpǔtōngtōng de wǎngmín.
Online debate about whether internet novels count as literature is heated. Those giving opinions include experts and scholars as well as ordinary internet users.

q: 什么人没有参加讨论？
Shénme rén méiyǒu cānjiā tǎolùn?
Who didn't take part?

lines: 我不同意。一部作品算不算文学，应该由谁来决定？是几个大专家、大学者说了算吗？
Wǒ bù tóngyì. Yí bù zuòpǐn suàn bu suàn wénxué, yīnggāi yóu shéi lái juédìng? Shì jǐ ge dà zhuānjiā, dà xuézhě shuō le suàn ma?
I disagree. Who should decide whether a work counts as literature? Do a few big experts and scholars get the final say?

q: 说话人是什么意思？
Shuōhuàrén shì shénme yìsi?
What does the speaker mean?
o: 专家学者可以决定一部作品是不是文学
zhuānjiā xuézhě kěyǐ juédìng yí bù zuòpǐn shì bu shì wénxué
专家学者不能决定一部作品是不是文学
zhuānjiā xuézhě bù néng juédìng yí bù zuòpǐn shì bu shì wénxué
作品是不是文学，什么人可以决定
zuòpǐn shì bu shì wénxué, shénme rén kěyǐ juédìng
他不同意一部作品可以算文学
tā bù tóngyì yí bù zuòpǐn kěyǐ suàn wénxué
he disagrees that the work is literature

lines: 有一批专业写手，完全是为了钱而写作，这样哪能写出好作品来呢？
Yǒu yì pī zhuānyè xiěshǒu, wánquán shì wèile qián ér xiězuò, zhèyàng nǎ néng xiěchū hǎo zuòpǐn lai ne?
Some professional writers write purely for money. How can they produce good work that way?

q: 说话人的意思是什么？
Shuōhuàrén de yìsi shì shénme?
What does the speaker mean?
o: 专业写手写不出好作品
zhuānyè xiěshǒu xiě bu chū hǎo zuòpǐn
专业写手写得出好作品
zhuānyè xiěshǒu xiě de chū hǎo zuòpǐn
专业写手写得出写不出好作品？
zhuānyè xiěshǒu xiě de chū xiě bu chū hǎo zuòpǐn?
专业写手为了挣钱可以写出好作品
zhuānyè xiěshǒu wèile zhèngqián kěyǐ xiěchū hǎo zuòpǐn
writing for money produces good work

lines: 在我看来，这些网络文学作品才是真正的大众写、大众看的文学。
Zài wǒ kànlái, zhèxiē wǎngluò wénxué zuòpǐn cái shì zhēnzhèng de dàzhòng xiě, dàzhòng kàn de wénxué.
In my view, these online works are the real literature written and read by ordinary people.

q: 说话人对网络文学是什么态度？
Shuōhuàrén duì wǎngluò wénxué shì shénme tàidu?
What's the speaker's attitude?
o: 认为这些作品不是真正的大众文学
rènwéi zhèxiē zuòpǐn bú shì zhēnzhèng de dàzhòng wénxué
认为这些作品算不上真正的大众文学
rènwéi zhèxiē zuòpǐn suàn bu shàng zhēnzhèng de dàzhòng wénxué
doesn't count as real popular literature
认为这些作品就是真正的大众文学
rènwéi zhèxiē zuòpǐn jiù shì zhēnzhèng de dàzhòng wénxué
认为这些作品可能是真正的大众文学
rènwéi zhèxiē zuòpǐn kěnéng shì zhēnzhèng de dàzhòng wénxué

lines: 总的来说，网络文学给我的感觉是水平太低，里面什么不健康的东西都有。
Zǒng de lái shuō, wǎngluò wénxué gěi wǒ de gǎnjué shì shuǐpíng tài dī, lǐmiàn shénme bú jiànkāng de dōngxi dōu yǒu.
Overall, my impression is that online literature is low quality and full of all sorts of unhealthy content.
我要是有未成年的孩子，就禁止他上网看小说。
Wǒ yàoshi yǒu wèichéngnián de háizi, jiù jìnzhǐ tā shàngwǎng kàn xiǎoshuō.
If I had an underage child, I'd forbid him to read novels online.

q: 他不让孩子上网看小说的原因是什么？
Tā bú ràng háizi shàngwǎng kàn xiǎoshuō de yuányīn shì shénme?
Why wouldn't he let his child read novels online?
o: 上网看小说影响孩子的身体健康
shàngwǎng kàn xiǎoshuō yǐngxiǎng háizi de shēntǐ jiànkāng
上网看小说会影响孩子的学习
shàngwǎng kàn xiǎoshuō huì yǐngxiǎng háizi de xuéxí
网上的小说写得不好，内容也有不健康的东西
wǎng shang de xiǎoshuō xiě de bù hǎo, nèiróng yě yǒu bú jiànkāng de dōngxi
they're badly written, with unhealthy content
网上的小说写得还可以，但有不健康的内容
wǎng shang de xiǎoshuō xiě de hái kěyǐ, dàn yǒu bú jiànkāng de nèiróng
they're OK but have unhealthy content

lines: 把自己写的东西放到网上让很多人看，有什么不好呢？
Bǎ zìjǐ xiě de dōngxi fàngdào wǎng shang ràng hěn duō rén kàn, yǒu shénme bù hǎo ne?
What's wrong with putting your writing online for lots of people to read?

q: 说话人觉得……
Shuōhuàrén juéde …
The speaker thinks …
o: 把自己写的东西放到网上让别人看，这样很好
bǎ zìjǐ xiě de dōngxi fàngdào wǎng shang ràng biérén kàn, zhèyàng hěn hǎo
把自己写的东西放到网上让别人看，这样很不好
把自己写的东西放到网上让别人看，这样不太好
不把自己写的东西放到网上让别人看，这样很好
bù bǎ zìjǐ xiě de dōngxi fàngdào wǎng shang …, zhèyàng hěn hǎo

lines: 到现在为止，很多奇奇怪怪的说法只能用在网上，对我们的生活并没有多大的影响。
Dào xiànzài wéizhǐ, hěn duō qíqíguàiguài de shuōfǎ zhǐ néng yòng zài wǎng shang, duì wǒmen de shēnghuó bìng méiyǒu duō dà de yǐngxiǎng.
So far, many odd expressions are only used online and haven't much affected our lives.

q: 下面哪句话的意思和这句话不一样？
Xiàmiàn nǎ jù huà de yìsi hé zhè jù huà bù yíyàng?
Which sentence does NOT match?
o: 只是在网上有那些奇怪的说法，没有影响到我们的生活
zhǐ shì zài wǎng shang yǒu nàxiē qíguài de shuōfǎ, méiyǒu yǐngxiǎng dào wǒmen de shēnghuó
they're only online and don't affect us
虽然网上有很多奇怪的说法，但影响不了网民的生活
suīrán wǎng shang yǒu hěn duō qíguài de shuōfǎ, dàn yǐngxiǎng bu liǎo wǎngmín de shēnghuó
虽然那些奇怪的说法只是出现在网上，但对我们的生活影响很大
suīrán nàxiē qíguài de shuōfǎ zhǐ shì chūxiàn zài wǎng shang, dàn duì wǒmen de shēnghuó yǐngxiǎng hěn dà
they're only online but affect us a lot
我们的生活没有受到那些奇怪的说法的影响
wǒmen de shēnghuó méiyǒu shòudào nàxiē qíguài de shuōfǎ de yǐngxiǎng

lines: 上网时间长了，我们慢慢发现，网上可以干的事儿多着呢。
Shàngwǎng shíjiān cháng le, wǒmen mànmàn fāxiàn, wǎng shang kěyǐ gàn de shìr duō zhe ne.
After a while online we gradually discovered there's loads you can do there.

q: 这句话的意思是……
Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì …
This means …
o: 上网的时间长了以后，可以干的事儿就多了
shàngwǎng de shíjiān cháng le yǐhòu, kěyǐ gàn de shìr jiù duō le
the longer you're online, the more there is to do
上网的时间太慢，很多事儿不能干
shàngwǎng de shíjiān tài màn, hěn duō shìr bù néng gàn
it's too slow to do much
对网络熟悉了以后，可以用网络干很多事儿
duì wǎngluò shúxī le yǐhòu, kěyǐ yòng wǎngluò gàn hěn duō shìr
once familiar, you can do a lot online
对网络熟悉了以后，很多事儿干起来很慢
duì wǎngluò shúxī le yǐhòu, hěn duō shìr gàn qilai hěn màn

blocks.note: A misreads the sentence: it's not that there's more to do, but that you discover how much there is once you're used to it.

lines: 我每天都上网，和各地的网友聊聊天儿，看看电影，听听音乐。
Wǒ měi tiān dōu shàngwǎng, hé gè dì de wǎngyǒu liáoliao tiānr, kànkan diànyǐng, tīngting yīnyuè.
I go online every day to chat with friends all over, watch films and listen to music.

q: 这句话里没有说到下面哪种活动？
Zhè jù huà li méiyǒu shuōdào xiàmiàn nǎ zhǒng huódòng?
Which activity isn't mentioned?

lines: 网络有什么新鲜的？我从上大学那天起，就一直和它打交道。
Wǎngluò yǒu shénme xīnxiān de? Wǒ cóng shàng dàxué nà tiān qǐ, jiù yìzhí hé tā dǎ jiāodao.
What's new about the internet? I've been using it ever since I started university.

q: 这句话告诉我们什么？
Zhè jù huà gàosu wǒmen shénme?
What does this tell us?
o: 说话人一上大学就开始使用网络
shuōhuàrén yí shàng dàxué jiù kāishǐ shǐyòng wǎngluò
说话人觉得网络很新鲜
说话人上大学以前不会上网
shuōhuàrén shàng dàxué yǐqián bú huì shàngwǎng
说话人一上大学就开始和别人打交道
shuōhuàrén yí shàng dàxué jiù kāishǐ hé biérén dǎ jiāodao
started dealing with people at university

lines: 上个月我在网上开了我的第一家网店，卖我老家生产的东西。
Shàng ge yuè wǒ zài wǎng shang kāi le wǒ de dì yī jiā wǎngdiàn, mài wǒ lǎojiā shēngchǎn de dōngxi.
Last month I opened my first online shop, selling things made in my home town.

q: 这句话里的“网店”的意思可能是……
Zhè jù huà li de “wǎngdiàn” de yìsi kěnéng shì …
网店 probably means …
o: 在网络上卖东西的商店
zài wǎngluò shang mài dōngxi de shāngdiàn

lines: 我新买了一台二手电脑，上网还挺快。
Wǒ xīn mǎi le yì tái èrshǒu diànnǎo, shàngwǎng hái tǐng kuài.
I've just bought a second-hand computer, and it's pretty fast online.

q: 下面哪句话不对？
Xiàmiàn nǎ jù huà bú duì?
Which is wrong?
o: wǒ mǎi le yì tái jiù diànnǎo
wǒ mǎi le yì tái xīn diànnǎo
I use it to go online
wǒ mǎi diànnǎo de shíjiān bù cháng

blocks.note: 新买 means “recently bought”; the computer itself is second-hand.

lines: 我们正在说上网的好处呢，可王老师却说上网会对学生的学习不好，还会对身体不好。
Wǒmen zhèngzài shuō shàngwǎng de hǎochu ne, kě Wáng lǎoshī què shuō shàngwǎng huì duì xuésheng de xuéxí bù hǎo, hái huì duì shēntǐ bù hǎo.
We were talking about the benefits of the internet, but Teacher Wang said it's bad for students' studies and health.
父母们也同意他的看法。看来，我们以后上网没那么容易了。
Fùmǔmen yě tóngyì tā de kànfǎ. Kànlái, wǒmen yǐhòu shàngwǎng méi nàme róngyì le.
The parents agree with him. Looks like going online won't be so easy for us now.

q: 说话人最有可能是下面哪一种人？
Shuōhuàrén zuì yǒu kěnéng shì xiàmiàn nǎ yì zhǒng rén?
Who is the speaker most likely to be?

lines: 这些东西都是你在网上买的吗？
Zhèxiē dōngxi dōu shì nǐ zài wǎng shang mǎi de ma?
Did you buy all this online?
还有外国的东西呢。这样买东西很方便，也很便宜。
Hái yǒu wàiguó de dōngxi ne. Zhèyàng mǎi dōngxi hěn fāngbiàn, yě hěn piányi.
Some of it's even from abroad. Shopping like this is convenient and cheap.

q: 男的是在哪儿买的东西？
Nán de shì zài nǎr mǎi de dōngxi?
Where did the man buy things?

lines: 我除了星期天以外，天天坐在电脑前面，因为好多家文学网站都等着我写的书呢。
Wǒ chúle xīngqītiān yǐwài, tiāntiān zuò zài diànnǎo qiánmiàn, yīnwèi hǎo duō jiā wénxué wǎngzhàn dōu děng zhe wǒ xiě de shū ne.
Apart from Sundays I'm at the computer every day, because lots of literary websites are waiting for my books.
Nà nǐ zhèng de qián yídìng bù shǎo.
Then you must earn a lot.

q: 男的最有可能是什么人？
Nán de zuì yǒu kěnéng shì shénme rén?
Who is the man most likely to be?
o: a worker at a literary website

lines: 我们家老王每天一回家就坐到电脑前面，连吃饭都得叫他好几次。他还说电脑就是他的情人。你说是不是让人生气？
Wǒmen jiā Lǎo Wáng měi tiān yì huí jiā jiù zuòdào diànnǎo qiánmiàn, lián chī fàn dōu děi jiào tā hǎo jǐ cì. Tā hái shuō diànnǎo jiù shì tā de qíngrén. Nǐ shuō shì bu shì ràng rén shēngqì?
My Lao Wang sits down at the computer the moment he gets home; I have to call him several times even for dinner. He even says the computer is his lover. Isn't that infuriating?
你别生气了，不管怎么说，他也没干什么坏事儿。
Nǐ bié shēngqì le, bùguǎn zěnme shuō, tā yě méi gàn shénme huài shìr.
Don't be cross. Whatever you say, he's not doing anything bad.
你说得对。人家有的喜欢看电影，有的喜欢跳舞，有的喜欢唱歌，我们那位都不喜欢，就是对着电脑乐。
Nǐ shuō de duì. Rénjia yǒu de xǐhuan kàn diànyǐng, yǒu de xǐhuan tiàowǔ, yǒu de xǐhuan chàng gē, wǒmen nà wèi dōu bù xǐhuan, jiù shì duì zhe diànnǎo lè.
You're right. Some people like films, some dancing, some singing. Mine likes none of that; he's just happy at the computer.
所以你也别不满意了，就算他迷上了电脑，也比他每天往外跑好得多呀。
Suǒyǐ nǐ yě bié bù mǎnyì le, jiùsuàn tā míshang le diànnǎo, yě bǐ tā měi tiān wǎng wài pǎo hǎo de duō ya.
So don't complain. Even if he's hooked on the computer, it's much better than him going out every day.
我本来还生他的气，看来我还是让他留着这点爱好吧，要不然谁知道他会迷上什么呢。
Wǒ běnlái hái shēng tā de qì, kànlái wǒ háishi ràng tā liú zhe zhè diǎn àihào ba, yàobùrán shéi zhīdào tā huì míshang shénme ne.
I was cross with him, but I'd better let him keep this hobby. Otherwise who knows what he'd get hooked on.

q: 下面哪个不是老王的情况？
Xiàmiàn nǎge bú shì Lǎo Wáng de qíngkuàng?
Which is NOT true of Lao Wang?
o: 吃饭的时候也不想离开电脑
chī fàn de shíhou yě bù xiǎng líkāi diànnǎo
won't leave it even to eat
除了电脑外，没有别的爱好
chúle diànnǎo wài, méiyǒu biéde àihào

q: 对话里男的对这件事儿是怎么想的？
Duìhuà li nán de duì zhè jiàn shìr shì zěnme xiǎng de?
What does the man think?
o: 老王应该去喜欢别的事情
Lǎo Wáng yīnggāi qù xǐhuan biéde shìqing
Lao Wang should take up something else
女的不应该生老王的气
nǚ de bù yīnggāi shēng Lǎo Wáng de qì
she shouldn't be cross with him
老王不应该这样迷电脑
Lǎo Wáng bù yīnggāi zhèyàng mí diànnǎo

q: 女的最后的话是什么意思？
Nǚ de zuìhòu de huà shì shénme yìsi?
What does the woman mean at the end?
o: 老王不应该这么迷电脑
Lǎo Wáng bù yīnggāi zhème mí diànnǎo
Lǎo Wáng yīnggāi yǒu biéde àihào
老王有这个爱好比有别的爱好好
Lǎo Wáng yǒu zhège àihào bǐ yǒu biéde àihào hǎo
this hobby is better than others he might have
Lǎo Wáng xūyào yǒu hěn duō àihào

grammar: 既有……，也有……
there are both … and …
This lists two kinds of people or things.
发表意见的人既有专家学者，也有普普通通的网民。
Fābiǎo yìjiàn de rén jì yǒu zhuānjiā xuézhě, yě yǒu pǔpǔtōngtōng de wǎngmín.
They include experts as well as ordinary users.
这儿既有中国菜，也有西餐。
Zhèr jì yǒu Zhōngguó cài, yě yǒu xīcān.
There's both Chinese and Western food here.
说了算
to have the final say
说了算 means one's word decides.
是几个大专家、大学者说了算吗？
Shì jǐ ge dà zhuānjiā, dà xuézhě shuō le suàn ma?
Do a few big experts get the final say?
在我家，妈妈说了算。
Zài wǒ jiā, māma shuō le suàn.
In my family Mum decides.
哪能……呢？
how could …?
A rhetorical question meaning “impossible”.
这样哪能写出好作品来呢？
Zhèyàng nǎ néng xiěchū hǎo zuòpǐn lai ne?
How can they produce good work that way?
这么晚了，哪能还有车呢？
Zhème wǎn le, nǎ néng hái yǒu chē ne?
This late, how could there still be buses?
adj + 着呢
really …
着呢 after an adjective adds emphasis in speech.
网上可以干的事儿多着呢。
Wǎng shang kěyǐ gàn de shìr duō zhe ne.
There's loads you can do online.
他高兴着呢。
Tā gāoxìng zhe ne.
He's really happy.
从……那天起，就一直……
ever since …
This marks a start point and continuing action.
我从上大学那天起，就一直和它打交道。
Wǒ cóng shàng dàxué nà tiān qǐ, jiù yìzhí hé tā dǎ jiāodao.
I've used it since I started university.
他从来中国那天起，就一直学中文。
Tā cóng lái Zhōngguó nà tiān qǐ, jiù yìzhí xué Zhōngwén.
He's studied Chinese ever since he arrived in China.
even if …
就算 is a spoken form of 即使.
就算他迷上了电脑，也比他每天往外跑好得多呀。
Jiùsuàn tā míshang le diànnǎo, yě bǐ tā měi tiān wǎng wài pǎo hǎo de duō ya.
Even if he's hooked, it's better than going out every day.
就算下雨，我也去。
Jiùsuàn xià yǔ, wǒ yě qù.
Even if it rains, I'll go.
