123.title: Online literature
123.sub: A short passage with three open questions
123.transcriptNote: A short passage, then three questions to answer in your own words. The model answers are my own.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: 虽然很多年轻人都喜欢看网络小说，可是一直到今天，网络文学还是不被那些专家学者们接受。
Suīrán hěn duō niánqīngrén dōu xǐhuan kàn wǎngluò xiǎoshuō, kěshì yìzhí dào jīntiān, wǎngluò wénxué háishi bú bèi nàxiē zhuānjiā xuézhěmen jiēshòu.
Although lots of young people love online novels, to this day online literature still isn't accepted by experts and scholars.
以前的文学青年们辛辛苦苦地写出一本书，可是没地方发表，也没有其他的办法给大家看。
Yǐqián de wénxué qīngniánmen xīnxīnkǔkǔ de xiěchū yì běn shū, kěshì méi dìfang fābiǎo, yě méiyǒu qítā de bànfǎ gěi dàjiā kàn.
Young writers used to labour over a book with nowhere to publish it and no other way to show it to people.
有了网络，他们就可以把自己的作品放到网上，让更多的人看到。
Yǒu le wǎngluò, tāmen jiù kěyǐ bǎ zìjǐ de zuòpǐn fàngdào wǎng shang, ràng gèng duō de rén kàndào.
With the internet they can put their work online for many more people to see.
一些写得很好的人，在有网络以前，不一定会当作家，因为他们成功的机会太少。但现在，成功的可能性大了很多。
Yìxiē xiě de hěn hǎo de rén, zài yǒu wǎngluò yǐqián, bù yídìng huì dāng zuòjiā, yīnwèi tāmen chénggōng de jīhuì tài shǎo. Dàn xiànzài, chénggōng de kěnéngxìng dà le hěn duō.
Before the internet, some good writers might never have become authors because they had so little chance of success. Now their chances are much greater.

blocks.label: 回答问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 从这段话来看，什么人最喜欢网络文学？什么人不喜欢？
Cóng zhè duàn huà lái kàn, shénme rén zuì xǐhuan wǎngluò wénxué? Shénme rén bù xǐhuan?
Who likes online literature most? Who doesn't?
ans: 年轻人最喜欢，专家学者不接受。
Niánqīngrén zuì xǐhuan, zhuānjiā xuézhě bù jiēshòu.
Young people like it most; experts and scholars don't accept it.

q: 以前文学青年想发表作品会有什么困难？现在呢？
Yǐqián wénxué qīngnián xiǎng fābiǎo zuòpǐn huì yǒu shénme kùnnan? Xiànzài ne?
What problems did young writers have publishing before? And now?
ans: 以前没地方发表，也没办法给大家看。现在可以放到网上，让更多的人看到。
Yǐqián méi dìfang fābiǎo, yě méi bànfǎ gěi dàjiā kàn. Xiànzài kěyǐ fàngdào wǎng shang, ràng gèng duō de rén kàndào.
Before there was nowhere to publish; now they can put work online for many readers.

q: 除了发表作品以外，现在和以前比，还有什么变化？
Chúle fābiǎo zuòpǐn yǐwài, xiànzài hé yǐqián bǐ, hái yǒu shénme biànhuà?
Besides publishing, what else has changed?
ans: 写得好的人成功的可能性大了很多，更有机会当作家。
Xiě de hǎo de rén chénggōng de kěnéngxìng dà le hěn duō, gèng yǒu jīhuì dāng zuòjiā.
Good writers have a much better chance of success and of becoming authors.

grammar: 不被……接受
not accepted by …
被 marks the passive; the negative goes before 被.
网络文学还是不被那些专家学者们接受。
Wǎngluò wénxué háishi bú bèi nàxiē zhuānjiā xuézhěmen jiēshòu.
Online literature still isn't accepted by experts.
他的意见不被大家接受。
Tā de yìjiàn bú bèi dàjiā jiēshòu.
His view isn't accepted by others.
now that there's …
有了 introduces a new condition that makes the result possible.
有了网络，他们就可以把自己的作品放到网上。
Yǒu le wǎngluò, tāmen jiù kěyǐ bǎ zìjǐ de zuòpǐn fàngdào wǎng shang.
With the internet they can put their work online.
有了手机，联系就方便多了。
Yǒu le shǒujī, liánxì jiù fāngbiàn duō le.
With mobiles, keeping in touch is much easier.
不一定
not necessarily
不一定 means it may not happen.
在有网络以前，不一定会当作家。
Zài yǒu wǎngluò yǐqián, bù yídìng huì dāng zuòjiā.
Before the internet, they might not have become authors.
贵的不一定好。
Guì de bù yídìng hǎo.
Expensive isn't necessarily good.
gaps: 网络文学还是不被那些专家学者们
say: Although lots of young people love online novels, online literature still isn't accepted by experts.
With the internet they can put their work online for many more people to see.

124.title: Shopping online
124.sub: Tianmei shows David how to shop online, with true/false and multiple-choice items
124.transcriptNote: 甲 is David and 乙 is Tianmei; the name is spelled as heard. Speakers are assigned from context, and the answer key is my own reading.

blocks.label: 对话
lines: Nǐ zhè jiàn yīfu zhēn hǎokàn!
谢谢，这是我在网上买的。
Xièxie, zhè shì wǒ zài wǎng shang mǎi de.
真的吗？我从来没试过，挺麻烦的吧？
Zhēn de ma? Wǒ cónglái méi shì guo, tǐng máfan de ba?
Really? I've never tried. Isn't it a hassle?
不麻烦，我给你讲一遍你就会了。
Bù máfan, wǒ gěi nǐ jiǎng yí biàn nǐ jiù huì le.
Not at all. I'll explain once and you'll get it.
你只要进入购物网，就可以买东西了。
Nǐ zhǐyào jìnrù gòuwùwǎng, jiù kěyǐ mǎi dōngxi le.
Just go to a shopping site and you can buy things.
看看有没有你喜欢的商品。比如你想买这本书，就把它放进下面的购物车里。
Kànkan yǒu méiyǒu nǐ xǐhuan de shāngpǐn. Bǐrú nǐ xiǎng mǎi zhè běn shū, jiù bǎ tā fàngjìn xiàmiàn de gòuwùchē li.
See if there's anything you like. Say you want this book, you put it in the shopping cart below.
如果你不打算再买别的东西了，你就进入结算中心，这时会出现你买的商品的数量和钱数。
Rúguǒ nǐ bù dǎsuàn zài mǎi biéde dōngxi le, nǐ jiù jìnrù jiésuàn zhōngxīn, zhè shí huì chūxiàn nǐ mǎi de shāngpǐn de shùliàng hé qiánshù.
If you don't want anything else, go to checkout, and it shows the quantity and the total.
你检查一下商品和钱数对不对，没错的话，你就可以把你的姓名、地址、电话、电子信箱什么的写上。
Nǐ jiǎnchá yíxià shāngpǐn hé qiánshù duì bu duì, méi cuò dehuà, nǐ jiù kěyǐ bǎ nǐ de xìngmíng, dìzhǐ, diànhuà, diànzǐ xìnxiāng shénme de xiěshang.
Check the items and total are right, and if so fill in your name, address, phone, email and so on.
你可以收到东西以后再付钱，或者在网上用信用卡付钱，还可以去邮局汇款。
Nǐ kěyǐ shōudào dōngxi yǐhòu zài fù qián, huòzhě zài wǎng shang yòng xìnyòngkǎ fù qián, hái kěyǐ qù yóujú huìkuǎn.
You can pay on delivery, pay online by credit card, or send money from the post office.
最后，你还得决定收东西的方式：或者通过邮局寄给你，或者你在家里等，网站让人给你送来。
Zuìhòu, nǐ hái děi juédìng shōu dōngxi de fāngshì: huòzhě tōngguò yóujú jì gěi nǐ, huòzhě nǐ zài jiā li děng, wǎngzhàn ràng rén gěi nǐ sònglai.
Finally, you choose how to receive it: by post, or wait at home for the site to send someone.
Zhēn shì yòu jiǎndān yòu fāngbiàn.
是啊，还便宜呢，很多商品都不贵。你试试吧！
Shì a, hái piányi ne, hěn duō shāngpǐn dōu bú guì. Nǐ shìshi ba!
Yes, and it's cheap too; lots of things aren't expensive. Give it a try!

blocks.label: 判断正误
blocks.h: 判断正误 · True or false

q: 甜美在商店买了一件衣服。
Tiánměi zài shāngdiàn mǎi le yí jiàn yīfu.
Tianmei bought a top in a shop.
qs.why: she bought it online

q: 大卫教甜美怎样在网上购物。
Dàwèi jiāo Tiánměi zěnyàng zài wǎng shang gòuwù.
David teaches Tianmei to shop online.
qs.why: it's the other way round

q: 网上购物的付款方式有四种。
Wǎng shang gòuwù de fùkuǎn fāngshì yǒu sì zhǒng.
There are four ways to pay.
qs.why: three are mentioned

q: 网上购物有很多好处。
Wǎng shang gòuwù yǒu hěn duō hǎochu.
Online shopping has many advantages.
大卫决定试试在网上购物。
Dàwèi juédìng shìshi zài wǎng shang gòuwù.
David decides to try shopping online.
qs.why: Tianmei tells him to try; he doesn't say he's decided

blocks.label: 选择
blocks.h: 选择正确答案 · Choose the right answer

q: 甜美是在什么网站上买的衣服？
Tiánměi shì zài shénme wǎngzhàn shang mǎi de yīfu?
What kind of site did Tianmei buy it on?
什么时候进入结算中心？
Shénme shíhou jìnrù jiésuàn zhōngxīn?
When do you go to checkout?
o: 选好自己喜欢的商品以后
xuǎnhǎo zìjǐ xǐhuan de shāngpǐn yǐhòu
bú zài mǎi biéde shāngpǐn yǐhòu
when you don't want anything else
检查完商品和钱数以后
jiǎnchá wán shāngpǐn hé qiánshù yǐhòu

q: 关于买东西的人，没说到……
Guānyú mǎi dōngxi de rén, méi shuōdào …
Which detail about the buyer isn't mentioned?
对话中没说到哪种付钱方式？
Duìhuà zhōng méi shuōdào nǎ zhǒng fù qián fāngshì?
Which way of paying isn't mentioned?
网上购物的好处没说到……
Wǎng shang gòuwù de hǎochu méi shuōdào …
Which advantage isn't mentioned?

grammar: 从来没 + V + 过
have never …
从来 strengthens the negative of experience.
我从来没试过。
Wǒ cónglái méi shì guo.
I've never tried.
我从来没去过上海。
Wǒ cónglái méi qù guo Shànghǎi.
I've never been to Shanghai.
只要……就……
as long as …
只要 gives the one condition needed.
你只要进入购物网，就可以买东西了。
Nǐ zhǐyào jìnrù gòuwùwǎng, jiù kěyǐ mǎi dōngxi le.
Just go to a shopping site and you can buy.
只要有时间，我就来。
Zhǐyào yǒu shíjiān, wǒ jiù lái.
As long as I have time, I'll come.
或者……，或者……
either … or …
Paired 或者 lists alternatives in a statement.
或者通过邮局寄给你，或者你在家里等。
Huòzhě tōngguò yóujú jì gěi nǐ, huòzhě nǐ zài jiā li děng.
Either by post, or you wait at home.
或者你来，或者我去。
Huòzhě nǐ lái, huòzhě wǒ qù.
Either you come or I go.
both … and …
This joins two qualities.
真是又简单又方便。
Zhēn shì yòu jiǎndān yòu fāngbiàn.
Simple and convenient.
这家店又便宜又好吃。
Zhè jiā diàn yòu piányi yòu hǎochī.
This place is cheap and tasty.
say: Really? I've never tried. Isn't it a hassle?
So how do you pay?
That's simple and convenient.

125.title: China's Netizens' Day
125.transcriptNote: A short passage with no questions.

lines: 二〇〇九年一月六日上午，中国互联网协会在第一次中国网民文化节上决定，每年九月十四日是中国网民节。
Èr líng líng jiǔ nián yī yuè liù rì shàngwǔ, Zhōngguó Hùliánwǎng Xiéhuì zài dì yī cì Zhōngguó wǎngmín wénhuàjié shang juédìng, měi nián jiǔ yuè shísì rì shì Zhōngguó Wǎngmín Jié.
On the morning of 6 January 2009, at the first Chinese Netizens' Culture Festival, the Internet Society of China decided that 14 September each year would be China's Netizens' Day.
据了解，这一日期是由大约五十万网友投票决定的。
Jù liǎojiě, zhè yí rìqī shì yóu dàyuē wǔshí wàn wǎngyǒu tóupiào juédìng de.
Reportedly, the date was chosen by a vote of about 500,000 internet users.
一九八七年九月十四日，中国的网民发出了第一封电子邮件，
Yī jiǔ bā qī nián jiǔ yuè shísì rì, Zhōngguó de wǎngmín fāchū le dì yī fēng diànzǐ yóujiàn,
On 14 September 1987, Chinese internet users sent their first email,
所以很多网民愿意把这一天作为中国四亿网民自己的节日。
suǒyǐ hěn duō wǎngmín yuànyì bǎ zhè yì tiān zuòwéi Zhōngguó sì yì wǎngmín zìjǐ de jiérì.
so many wanted to make that day the festival of China's 400 million internet users.
这也说明，网民节如同记者节、教师节一样，成了一个大众的节日。
Zhè yě shuōmíng, Wǎngmín Jié rútóng Jìzhě Jié, Jiàoshī Jié yíyàng, chéng le yí ge dàzhòng de jiérì.
This shows that Netizens' Day, like Journalists' Day and Teachers' Day, has become a public festival.

grammar: 据了解
reportedly
This introduces information from a source, in news style.
据了解，这一日期是由大约五十万网友投票决定的。
Jù liǎojiě, zhè yí rìqī shì yóu dàyuē wǔshí wàn wǎngyǒu tóupiào juédìng de.
Reportedly, the date was chosen by vote.
据了解，他已经回国了。
Jù liǎojiě, tā yǐjīng huí guó le.
Reportedly, he has gone home.
是由……决定的
was decided by …
由 marks the agent in this 是……的 sentence.
这一日期是由大约五十万网友投票决定的。
Zhè yí rìqī shì yóu dàyuē wǔshí wàn wǎngyǒu tóupiào juédìng de.
The date was chosen by internet users.
这件事是由校长决定的。
Zhè jiàn shì shì yóu xiàozhǎng juédìng de.
The head decided this.
把 A 作为 B
to treat A as B
作为 means “as”.
把这一天作为中国四亿网民自己的节日。
Bǎ zhè yì tiān zuòwéi Zhōngguó sì yì wǎngmín zìjǐ de jiérì.
To make this day the netizens' festival.
我把他作为我的老师。
Wǒ bǎ tā zuòwéi wǒ de lǎoshī.
I regard him as my teacher.
如同……一样
just like …
如同 is a written form of 像.
网民节如同记者节、教师节一样，成了一个大众的节日。
Wǎngmín Jié rútóng Jìzhě Jié, Jiàoshī Jié yíyàng, chéng le yí ge dàzhòng de jiérì.
Like Journalists' Day and Teachers' Day, it's become a public festival.
他如同我的哥哥一样。
Tā rútóng wǒ de gēge yíyàng.
He's like a brother to me.
gaps: 在第一次中国网民文化节上决定，
这一日期是由大约五十万网友
中国的网民发出了第一封电子
say: On 14 September 1987, Chinese internet users sent their first email.

126.title: Supplementary vocabulary: the internet
126.sub: Verbs, adjectives, adverbs, measure words and nouns
126.transcriptNote: A longer word list, read roughly as verbs, adjectives, adverbs, measure words, then nouns.

blocks.label: 补充生词
blocks.note: Four single syllables in a row (piān, bù, yè, zhāng) are written as the measure words 篇, 部, 页 and 张, which suit a lesson on writing. Four short nouns scattered through the list are 甲, 乙, 丙 and 丁, the labels for the speakers in the lesson text (part 128). 反对, 敢 and 大众 were missed on the first pass and found with a second listen.

127.title: How the new words are used
127.transcriptNote: Each group takes a word from the vocabulary and uses it in short phrases. Some group numbers and heading words aren't read clearly, so I numbered them by order.

blocks.h: 乱七八糟 · 听说读写
读 dú · to read; to study

lines: to put in a lot of energy

blocks.h: 受 shòu · to receive, to suffer

lines: dào wǔ yuè shí rì wéizhǐ
duì zhè jiàn shì de tàidu

blocks.note: One model heard 本知识 here; it is probably 基本知识 (basic knowledge).

blocks.h: 影响 yǐngxiǎng · influence; to affect

128.title: A debate about online literature
128.sub: The lesson text: two experts and four netizens
128.transcriptNote: The lesson text: an introduction, then views from 专家甲/乙 (experts A and B) and 网友甲/乙/丙/丁 (netizens A–D). The recording ends after netizen D's example.

blocks.label: 引言
lines: 自从一九九八年中国出现了第一部网络小说以来，网络文学发展的速度很快。
Zìcóng yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián Zhōngguó chūxiàn le dì yī bù wǎngluò xiǎoshuō yǐlái, wǎngluò wénxué fāzhǎn de sùdù hěn kuài.
Since China's first online novel appeared in 1998, online literature has grown fast.
据说，那些最看好的大网站，家家都有好几百万会员，每天能收到几千篇作品，其中有不少是长篇小说。
Jùshuō, nàxiē zuì kànhǎo de dà wǎngzhàn, jiājiā dōu yǒu hǎo jǐ bǎi wàn huìyuán, měi tiān néng shōudào jǐ qiān piān zuòpǐn, qízhōng yǒu bù shǎo shì chángpiān xiǎoshuō.
Reportedly the most popular big sites each have several million members and receive thousands of works a day, many of them novels.
有些作品在网上发表以后，读者的点击数一天就能达到七八十万次。
Yǒuxiē zuòpǐn zài wǎng shang fābiǎo yǐhòu, dúzhě de diǎnjīshù yì tiān jiù néng dádào qī bā shí wàn cì.
Some works get 700,000–800,000 clicks a day once published.
为什么文学网站这么受欢迎？通过网络来写作或者阅读，到底是好事还是坏事？这些作品能不能算是文学？
Wèishénme wénxué wǎngzhàn zhème shòu huānyíng? Tōngguò wǎngluò lái xiězuò huòzhě yuèdú, dàodǐ shì hǎoshì háishi huàishì? Zhèxiē zuòpǐn néng bu néng suàn shì wénxué?
Why are literary sites so popular? Is writing or reading online good or bad? Do these works count as literature?
关于这些问题，网上的讨论非常热烈，发表意见的人当中，既有专家学者，也有普普通通的网民。
Guānyú zhèxiē wèntí, wǎng shang de tǎolùn fēicháng rèliè, fābiǎo yìjiàn de rén dāngzhōng, jì yǒu zhuānjiā xuézhě, yě yǒu pǔpǔtōngtōng de wǎngmín.
Online debate is heated, with experts and scholars as well as ordinary users giving their views.

blocks.label: 专家
blocks.h: 两位专家 · The two experts
lines: 我认为只能说有网络写作，并不存在什么网络文学。
Wǒ rènwéi zhǐ néng shuō yǒu wǎngluò xiězuò, bìng bù cúnzài shénme wǎngluò wénxué.
I'd say there's only online writing; online literature doesn't really exist.
因为纯文学是非常严肃的，一个真正的作家为了文学可以付出一切。
Yīnwèi chún wénxué shì fēicháng yánsù de, yí ge zhēnzhèng de zuòjiā wèile wénxué kěyǐ fùchū yíqiè.
Pure literature is very serious; a real writer will give everything for it.
我不同意。什么是纯文学？一部作品是不是纯文学，应该由谁来决定？
Wǒ bù tóngyì. Shénme shì chún wénxué? Yí bù zuòpǐn shì bu shì chún wénxué, yīnggāi yóu shéi lái juédìng?
I disagree. What is pure literature? Who decides whether a work counts?
是几个大专家、大学者说了算吗？
Shì jǐ ge dà zhuānjiā, dà xuézhě shuō le suàn ma?
Do a few big experts get the final say?
事实上，很多受读者欢迎的作家都进不了文学史。
Shìshí shang, hěn duō shòu dúzhě huānyíng de zuòjiā dōu jìn bu liǎo wénxuéshǐ.
In fact, many writers readers love never make it into literary history.
可我说的也是事实啊。我在博客上发表过一篇文章，就是想说明这个问题。
Kě wǒ shuō de yě shì shìshí a. Wǒ zài bókè shang fābiǎo guo yì piān wénzhāng, jiù shì xiǎng shuōmíng zhège wèntí.
But what I say is fact too. I wrote a blog post to explain exactly this.
现在出现的付费阅读，读一页要付几分钱，已经是有些网站商业化了。
Xiànzài chūxiàn de fùfèi yuèdú, dú yí yè yào fù jǐ fēn qián, yǐjīng shì yǒuxiē wǎngzhàn shāngyèhuà le.
Pay-to-read has appeared, a few cents a page; some sites have gone commercial.
他们有一批专业写手，完全是为了钱而写作，每天必须交一章，
Tāmen yǒu yì pī zhuānyè xiěshǒu, wánquán shì wèile qián ér xiězuò, měi tiān bìxū jiāo yì zhāng,
They have professional writers writing purely for money, who must hand in a chapter every day.
这样哪能写出有文学性的好作品来呢？都是垃圾！
zhèyàng nǎ néng xiěchū yǒu wénxuéxìng de hǎo zuòpǐn lai ne? Dōu shì lājī!
How can that produce good literary work? It's all rubbish!
怎么可以这样讲呢？我专门研究过网络文学。
Zěnme kěyǐ zhèyàng jiǎng ne? Wǒ zhuānmén yánjiū guo wǎngluò wénxué.
How can you say that? I've specially researched online literature.
首先，能靠写作来挣钱的人只是少数；其次，大部分网站还是免费的。
Shǒuxiān, néng kào xiězuò lái zhèngqián de rén zhǐ shì shǎoshù; qícì, dà bùfen wǎngzhàn háishi miǎnfèi de.
First, only a few can earn a living by writing; second, most sites are still free.
在我看来，这些年轻的作者们根本不在乎文学界对他们的态度，大概也永远不会被专家学者们接受，
Zài wǒ kànlái, zhèxiē niánqīng de zuòzhěmen gēnběn bú zàihu wénxuéjiè duì tāmen de tàidu, dàgài yě yǒngyuǎn bú huì bèi zhuānjiā xuézhěmen jiēshòu,
As I see it, these young writers don't care what the literary world thinks of them, and probably will never be accepted by the experts,
但这才是真正的大众写、大众看的文学。
dàn zhè cái shì zhēnzhèng de dàzhòng xiě, dàzhòng kàn de wénxué.
but this is the real literature, written and read by ordinary people.

blocks.label: 网友
blocks.h: 四位网友 · The four netizens
lines: 总的来说，网络作品给我的印象是什么不健康的内容都有，水平太低。
Zǒng de lái shuō, wǎngluò zuòpǐn gěi wǒ de yìnxiàng shì shénme bú jiànkāng de nèiróng dōu yǒu, shuǐpíng tài dī.
Overall, my impression is online works have every kind of unhealthy content, and the standard is too low.
换句话说，就是文笔差，情节差，人物差，反正我看不下去。
Huàn jù huà shuō, jiù shì wénbǐ chà, qíngjié chà, rénwù chà, fǎnzhèng wǒ kàn bu xiàqu.
In other words, poor writing, poor plots, poor characters. I just can't read them.
我要是有未成年的孩子，就禁止他上网看小说。
Wǒ yàoshi yǒu wèichéngnián de háizi, jiù jìnzhǐ tā shàngwǎng kàn xiǎoshuō.
If I had an underage child, I'd forbid him to read novels online.
还有，网虫们总是使用一些乱七八糟的网络语言，让人根本看不懂。
Hái yǒu, wǎngchóngmen zǒngshì shǐyòng yìxiē luànqībāzāo de wǎngluò yǔyán, ràng rén gēnběn kàn bu dǒng.
And internet addicts always use messy internet slang nobody can understand.
我觉得不能把所有这些作品都看成垃圾，有的也表达了很深的思想和感情，文笔又新又美。
Wǒ juéde bù néng bǎ suǒyǒu zhèxiē zuòpǐn dōu kànchéng lājī, yǒu de yě biǎodá le hěn shēn de sīxiǎng hé gǎnqíng, wénbǐ yòu xīn yòu měi.
You can't call all these works rubbish. Some express deep thoughts and feelings in fresh, beautiful writing.
不过，现在的青少年既没有什么文化知识，也没有多少社会经验，分不清楚好坏，他们对名著又不感兴趣，这确实是个问题。
Búguò, xiànzài de qīngshàonián jì méiyǒu shénme wénhuà zhīshi, yě méiyǒu duōshao shèhuì jīngyàn, fēn bu qīngchu hǎohuài, tāmen duì míngzhù yòu bù gǎn xìngqù, zhè quèshí shì ge wèntí.
But teenagers today have little knowledge or experience, can't tell good from bad, and aren't interested in the classics. That is a real problem.
我看，问题是那些管理网站的人。他们让读者投票，得票最多的就是好作品，还说这叫民主。
Wǒ kàn, wèntí shì nàxiē guǎnlǐ wǎngzhàn de rén. Tāmen ràng dúzhě tóupiào, dé piào zuì duō de jiù shì hǎo zuòpǐn, hái shuō zhè jiào mínzhǔ.
As I see it, the problem is the site managers. They let readers vote, the most votes means a good work, and they call it democracy.
我不反对网络文学。写书这种事不是任何人都做得到的。
Wǒ bù fǎnduì wǎngluò wénxué. Xiě shū zhè zhǒng shì bú shì rènhé rén dōu zuò de dào de.
I'm not against online literature. Not just anyone can write a book.
敢把自己写的东西放在网上发表，让很多人看，有什么不好呢？
Gǎn bǎ zìjǐ xiě de dōngxi fàng zài wǎng shang fābiǎo, ràng hěn duō rén kàn, yǒu shénme bù hǎo ne?
What's wrong with daring to publish your writing online for lots of people?
至于网络语言嘛，谁也管不了，也用不着担心。
Zhìyú wǎngluò yǔyán ma, shéi yě guǎn bu liǎo, yě yòng bu zháo dānxīn.
As for internet slang, nobody can control it, and there's no need to worry.
说实话，到现在为止，那些奇奇怪怪的说法只能用在网上，对我们的生活并没有多大的影响。
Shuō shíhuà, dào xiànzài wéizhǐ, nàxiē qíqíguàiguài de shuōfǎ zhǐ néng yòng zài wǎng shang, duì wǒmen de shēnghuó bìng méiyǒu duō dà de yǐngxiǎng.
Honestly, so far those odd expressions are only used online and haven't much affected our lives.
举个例子来说吧，你跟人告别的时候，能说“八八”吗？
Jǔ ge lìzi lái shuō ba, nǐ gēn rén gàobié de shíhou, néng shuō “bā bā” ma?
For example, when you say goodbye to someone, can you say “88”?
blocks.note: “88” (bā bā) is internet slang for “bye-bye”. The recording ends here.

grammar: 自从……以来
since …
This marks a starting point up to now.
自从一九九八年中国出现了第一部网络小说以来，……
Zìcóng yī jiǔ jiǔ bā nián Zhōngguó chūxiàn le dì yī bù wǎngluò xiǎoshuō yǐlái, …
Since the first online novel appeared in 1998, …
自从来中国以来，他一直学中文。
Zìcóng lái Zhōngguó yǐlái, tā yìzhí xué Zhōngwén.
He's studied Chinese ever since he came to China.
家家都……
every family/company …
Doubling a measure word or noun means “every”.
家家都有好几百万会员。
Jiājiā dōu yǒu hǎo jǐ bǎi wàn huìyuán.
Each has several million members.
人人都喜欢他。
Rénrén dōu xǐhuan tā.
Everyone likes him.
为了……可以付出一切
to give everything for …
为了 gives the purpose.
一个真正的作家为了文学可以付出一切。
Yí ge zhēnzhèng de zuòjiā wèile wénxué kěyǐ fùchū yíqiè.
A real writer will give everything for literature.
为了孩子，父母可以付出一切。
Wèile háizi, fùmǔ kěyǐ fùchū yíqiè.
Parents will give everything for their children.
首先……，其次……
firstly …, secondly …
This lists arguments in order.
首先，能靠写作来挣钱的人只是少数；其次，大部分网站还是免费的。
Shǒuxiān, néng kào xiězuò lái zhèngqián de rén zhǐ shì shǎoshù; qícì, dà bùfen wǎngzhàn háishi miǎnfèi de.
First, few can live by writing; second, most sites are free.
首先要努力，其次要有方法。
Shǒuxiān yào nǔlì, qícì yào yǒu fāngfǎ.
First work hard, then have a method.
换句话说
in other words
This restates the point.
换句话说，就是文笔差，情节差，人物差。
Huàn jù huà shuō, jiù shì wénbǐ chà, qíngjié chà, rénwù chà.
In other words, poor writing, plots and characters.
他不来了，换句话说，我们得自己做。
Tā bù lái le, huàn jù huà shuō, wǒmen děi zìjǐ zuò.
He's not coming, so in other words we have to do it ourselves.
V + 不下去
can't go on …
下去 means continuing, and 不下去 means you can't continue.
反正我看不下去。
Fǎnzhèng wǒ kàn bu xiàqu.
I just can't keep reading.
这本书太无聊，我看不下去了。
Zhè běn shū tài wúliáo, wǒ kàn bu xiàqu le.
This book's too boring to keep reading.
把 A 看成 B
to regard A as B
把 moves the object forward; 看成 means to see as.
不能把所有这些作品都看成垃圾。
Bù néng bǎ suǒyǒu zhèxiē zuòpǐn dōu kànchéng lājī.
You can't call all these works rubbish.
别把我看成孩子。
Bié bǎ wǒ kànchéng háizi.
Don't treat me like a child.
至于……
as for …
至于 switches to a related topic.
至于网络语言嘛，谁也管不了。
Zhìyú wǎngluò yǔyán ma, shéi yě guǎn bu liǎo.
As for internet slang, nobody can control it.
我去，至于他，我不知道。
Wǒ qù, zhìyú tā, wǒ bù zhīdào.
I'm going; as for him, I don't know.
gaps: 数一天就能达到七八十万次。
很多受读者欢迎的作家都进不了文学
say: I disagree. What is pure literature?
First, only a few can earn a living by writing; second, most sites are still free.
What's wrong with daring to publish your writing online for lots of people?

130.title: Ten sentences
130.sub: Put on an act, still, share the good and bad
130.transcriptNote: Ten separate sentences using the new words from part 129. Some sentence numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order. The name 宋凡平 is spelled as heard.

lines: 宋凡平装模作样地把手伸进口袋。
Sòng Fánpíng zhuāng mú zuò yàng de bǎ shǒu shēnjìn kǒudai.
Song Fanping made a show of putting his hand in his pocket.
孩子们还从来没有吃过大白兔奶糖。
Háizimen hái cónglái méiyǒu chī guo Dàbáitù nǎitáng.
The children had never eaten White Rabbit sweets.
当孩子们看到宋凡平手里的奶糖时，乐得张开了嘴。
Dāng háizimen kàndào Sòng Fánpíng shǒu li de nǎitáng shí, lè de zhāngkāi le zuǐ.
When the children saw the sweets in Song Fanping's hand, their mouths fell open with delight.
两个孩子现在是一家人了，他们俩互相帮助。
Liǎng ge háizi xiànzài shì yì jiā rén le, tāmen liǎ hùxiāng bāngzhù.
The two children are one family now, and they help each other.
宋凡平把最后一个口袋也翻开了，可里面仍然是空的。
Sòng Fánpíng bǎ zuìhòu yí ge kǒudai yě fānkāi le, kě lǐmiàn réngrán shì kōng de.
Song Fanping turned out his last pocket too, but it was still empty.
你们现在是兄弟了，以后要有福同享，有难同当。
Nǐmen xiànzài shì xiōngdì le, yǐhòu yào yǒu fú tóng xiǎng, yǒu nàn tóng dāng.
You're brothers now, so from now on share the good times and the bad.
老李说完了话，转身离开了办公室。
Lǎo Lǐ shuōwán le huà, zhuǎnshēn líkāi le bàngōngshì.
When Lao Li finished speaking, he turned and left the office.
为了不影响女儿看书，妈妈轻手轻脚地走进她的房间。
Wèile bù yǐngxiǎng nǚ'ér kàn shū, māma qīng shǒu qīng jiǎo de zǒujìn tā de fángjiān.
So as not to disturb her daughter's reading, Mum tiptoed into her room.
再使一点劲儿，就能把这块石头搬开了。
Zài shǐ yìdiǎn jìnr, jiù néng bǎ zhè kuài shítou bānkāi le.
Push a bit harder and we can move this stone.
小王和小丽是在法国旅游的时候相遇的。
Xiǎo Wáng hé Xiǎo Lì shì zài Fǎguó lǚyóu de shíhou xiāngyù de.
Xiao Wang and Xiao Li met while travelling in France.

vocab: yǒu fú tóng xiǎng, yǒu nàn tóng dāng
share the good and the bad
grammar: 当……时
when …
当……时 is the written form of ……的时候.
当孩子们看到宋凡平手里的奶糖时，乐得张开了嘴。
Dāng háizimen kàndào Sòng Fánpíng shǒu li de nǎitáng shí, lè de zhāngkāi le zuǐ.
When the children saw the sweets, their mouths fell open.
当我回家时，他已经睡了。
Dāng wǒ huí jiā shí, tā yǐjīng shuì le.
When I got home he was asleep.
adj + 得 + result
so … that …
得 links a feeling to its visible result.
乐得张开了嘴。
Lè de zhāngkāi le zuǐ.
Mouths open with delight.
他累得睡着了。
Tā lèi de shuìzháo le.
He was so tired he fell asleep.
仍然
still
仍然 means a situation is unchanged; it's more formal than 还.
可里面仍然是空的。
Kě lǐmiàn réngrán shì kōng de.
But it was still empty.
他仍然住在那儿。
Tā réngrán zhù zài nàr.
He still lives there.
为了不……
so as not to …
为了 + a negative gives a purpose to avoid.
为了不影响女儿看书，妈妈轻手轻脚地走进她的房间。
Wèile bù yǐngxiǎng nǚ'ér kàn shū, māma qīng shǒu qīng jiǎo de zǒujìn tā de fángjiān.
So as not to disturb her daughter, Mum tiptoed in.
为了不迟到，他很早就出门了。
Wèile bù chídào, tā hěn zǎo jiù chūmén le.
So as not to be late, he left early.
just a bit more and …
再 + action + 就 means one more step brings the result.
再使一点劲儿，就能把这块石头搬开了。
Zài shǐ yìdiǎn jìnr, jiù néng bǎ zhè kuài shítou bānkāi le.
Push a bit harder and we can move it.
再走十分钟就到了。
Zài zǒu shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le.
Ten more minutes' walk and we're there.
gaps: 孩子们还从来没有吃过大白兔
以后要有福同享，有难同
say: The children had never eaten White Rabbit sweets.
You're brothers now, so share the good times and the bad.
Push a bit harder and we can move this stone.

131.title: Listening: White Rabbit and everyday scenes
131.sub: Sixteen items with four options each
131.transcriptNote: Each item has a sentence or short exchange, a question and four options. Some item numbers aren't read aloud, so I numbered them by order. Speakers in the exchanges are checked by pitch, and the answer key is my own reading.

lines: 一家四口在一起吃了一顿有鱼有肉的美餐，可是两个孩子一心想吃的却是另外的东西。
Yì jiā sì kǒu zài yìqǐ chī le yí dùn yǒu yú yǒu ròu de měicān, kěshì liǎng ge háizi yìxīn xiǎng chī de què shì lìngwài de dōngxi.
The family of four had a fine meal with fish and meat, but what the two children really wanted was something else.

q: 两个孩子一心想吃的是什么？
Liǎng ge háizi yìxīn xiǎng chī de shì shénme?
What did the children want to eat?

blocks.note: The sentence only says it was 另外的东西, something else, so from this sentence alone we can't tell.

lines: 孩子们从来没有听说过这个世界上还有一种糖的名字叫软糖。
Háizimen cónglái méiyǒu tīngshuō guo zhège shìjiè shang hái yǒu yì zhǒng táng de míngzi jiào ruǎntáng.
The children had never heard there was a kind of sweet in the world called a soft sweet.

q: 下面哪个不是这句话的意思？
Xiàmiàn nǎge bú shì zhè jù huà de yìsi?
Which is NOT what this means?
o: 孩子们不知道什么是软糖
háizimen bù zhīdào shénme shì ruǎntáng
they didn't know what a soft sweet was
孩子们以前不知道软糖
they didn't know soft sweets before
孩子们没听说过软糖，也没吃过
háizimen méi tīngshuō guo ruǎntáng, yě méi chī guo
they'd never heard of or eaten them

lines: 这是一种奶油味的软糖，包着它的糖纸上印着一只大白兔，所以人们叫它大白兔奶糖。
Zhè shì yì zhǒng nǎiyóu wèi de ruǎntáng, bāo zhe tā de tángzhǐ shang yìn zhe yì zhī dà bái tù, suǒyǐ rénmen jiào tā Dàbáitù nǎitáng.
It's a creamy soft sweet with a big white rabbit printed on the wrapper, so people call it White Rabbit toffee.

q: 大白兔奶糖的名字是怎么来的？
Dàbáitù nǎitáng de míngzi shì zěnme lái de?
Where does the name come from?
o: 因为这是一种奶油味的软糖
yīnwèi zhè shì yì zhǒng nǎiyóu wèi de ruǎntáng
因为软糖的形状像一只大白兔
yīnwèi ruǎntáng de xíngzhuàng xiàng yì zhī dà bái tù
因为糖纸的形状像大白兔
yīnwèi tángzhǐ de xíngzhuàng xiàng dà bái tù
因为糖纸上印着一只大白兔
yīnwèi tángzhǐ shang yìn zhe yì zhī dà bái tù
there's a rabbit printed on the wrapper

lines: 夜里，孩子们捧着大白兔的糖纸躺在床上，闻着糖纸上的奶香，准备去和梦中的大白兔奶糖相遇。
Yèli, háizimen pěng zhe Dàbáitù de tángzhǐ tǎng zài chuáng shang, wén zhe tángzhǐ shang de nǎi xiāng, zhǔnbèi qù hé mèng zhōng de Dàbáitù nǎitáng xiāngyù.
At night the children lay in bed holding the wrappers, smelling the milky scent, ready to meet White Rabbit sweets in their dreams.

q: 孩子们为什么捧着糖纸睡觉？
Háizimen wèishénme pěng zhe tángzhǐ shuìjiào?
Why did the children hold the wrappers in bed?
o: tāmen yào wén tángzhǐ de wèidao
他们想梦到大白兔奶糖
tāmen pà bǎ tángzhǐ nòngdiū le

lines: 我问小丽考试的成绩怎么样，她只对我摇了摇头，什么也没说就走了。
Wǒ wèn Xiǎo Lì kǎoshì de chéngjì zěnmeyàng, tā zhǐ duì wǒ yáo le yáo tóu, shénme yě méi shuō jiù zǒu le.
I asked Xiao Li how her exam went. She just shook her head and left without a word.

q: 从这句话我们可以知道什么？
Cóng zhè jù huà wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?
What can we tell?
o: Xiǎo Lì kǎo de hěn hǎo
小丽觉得自己的成绩没问题
Xiǎo Lì juéde zìjǐ de chéngjì méi wèntí
she thinks her result is fine

lines: 母亲等了好几个小时，看到儿子回来了才放下心来，长长地吐了一口气。
Mǔqīn děng le hǎo jǐ ge xiǎoshí, kàndào érzi huílai le cái fàngxià xīn lai, chángcháng de tǔ le yì kǒu qì.
The mother waited for hours; only when she saw her son come back did she relax, letting out a long breath.

q: 母亲为什么长长地吐了一口气？
Mǔqīn wèishénme chángcháng de tǔ le yì kǒu qì?
Why did she let out a long breath?
o: érzi huílai le, tā hěn shēngqì
她等了很长时间，所以很生气
tā děng le hěn cháng shíjiān, suǒyǐ hěn shēngqì
she'd waited long, so she was angry
érzi huílai le, tā fàngxīn le
儿子等了她很长时间，她不好意思了
érzi děng le tā hěn cháng shíjiān, tā bù hǎoyìsi le

lines: 小明忙得连招呼都没跟我打，转身就进了办公室。
Xiǎo Míng máng de lián zhāohu dōu méi gēn wǒ dǎ, zhuǎnshēn jiù jìn le bàngōngshì.
Xiao Ming was so busy he didn't even say hello; he turned and went straight into the office.

q: 小明为什么不跟我打招呼？
Xiǎo Míng wèishénme bù gēn wǒ dǎ zhāohu?

o: he doesn't want to know me

lines: 他一直低着头看书，我走进来他都没看到。
Tā yìzhí dī zhe tóu kàn shū, wǒ zǒu jinlai tā dōu méi kàndào.
He kept his head down reading and didn't even see me come in.

q: 这句话的意思是什么？
Zhè jù huà de yìsi shì shénme?

o: tā hěn xǐhuan dī zhe tóu kàn shū
tā kàn shū de shíhou wǒ zǒu le
他看书的时候低着头看见了我
tā kàn shū de shíhou dī zhe tóu kànjiàn le wǒ
他很认真地看书，没看见我进来
tā hěn rènzhēn de kàn shū, méi kànjiàn wǒ jìnlai
he was absorbed and didn't see me come in

lines: 王奶奶对小孙子喜爱得不得了，就想每天把他捧在手里。
Wáng nǎinai duì xiǎo sūnzi xǐ'ài de bùdéliǎo, jiù xiǎng měi tiān bǎ tā pěng zài shǒu li.

q: 下面哪句话和这句话的意思一样？

o: 王奶奶每天都想见到小孙子
Wáng nǎinai měi tiān dōu xiǎng jiàndào xiǎo sūnzi
she wants to see him every day
王奶奶喜欢小孙子，这很不好
Wáng nǎinai xǐhuan xiǎo sūnzi, zhè hěn bù hǎo
she loves him, which is bad
王奶奶喜欢小孙子，小孙子很不舒服
Wáng nǎinai xǐhuan xiǎo sūnzi, xiǎo sūnzi hěn bù shūfu
she loves him and he's uncomfortable
王奶奶喜欢小孙子，每天都摸着他
Wáng nǎinai xǐhuan xiǎo sūnzi, měi tiān dōu mō zhe tā

blocks.note: 捧在手里 is a figure of speech for cherishing someone, so D takes it too literally. A is the closest of the four.

lines: 上个星期不是刚给你一百块钱吗？怎么又跟我伸手？

Didn't I just give you 100 yuan last week? Why are you asking again?
现在的物价这么贵，一百块钱两天就花完了。
Xiànzài de wùjià zhème guì, yìbǎi kuài qián liǎng tiān jiù huāwán le.
Prices are so high now, 100 yuan goes in two days.

q: 男的现在在干什么？
Nán de xiànzài zài gàn shénme?

lines: 咱们是这么多年的老朋友了，我敬你一杯。
Zánmen shì zhème duō nián de lǎo péngyou le, wǒ jìng nǐ yì bēi.
We've been friends for so many years. A toast to you!
老朋友了，还不知道我从来不喝酒吗？
Lǎo péngyou le, hái bù zhīdào wǒ cónglái bù hē jiǔ ma?
Old friends, and you still don't know I never drink?

q: 女的是什么意思？
Nǚ de shì shénme yìsi?
What does the woman mean?
o: tā hé nán de bú shì lǎo péngyou
tā yě jìng nán de yì bēi jiǔ

lines: 饿了你就吃啊，别光舔嘴唇。
È le nǐ jiù chī a, bié guāng tiǎn zuǐchún.
If you're hungry, eat! Don't just lick your lips.
那我可就不客气了，今天真是有福气呀。
Nà wǒ kě jiù bú kèqi le, jīntiān zhēn shì yǒu fúqi ya.
Then I won't stand on ceremony. I'm in luck today!

q: 从谈话里，我们可以知道什么？
Cóng tánhuà li, wǒmen kěyǐ zhīdào shénme?

o: nán de bú huì chī fàn
nǚ de zuò de cài hěn hǎochī

blocks.note: Nothing says this outright, but licking his lips and feeling lucky suggest the food is good.

lines: 你看，这孩子多可爱，刚一个月就喜欢抓着钢笔不放。
Nǐ kàn, zhè háizi duō kě'ài, gāng yí ge yuè jiù xǐhuan zhuā zhe gāngbǐ bú fàng.
Look how sweet this baby is! Only a month old and already loves holding on to a pen.
是啊，长大了一定是个好学生。
Shì a, zhǎngdà le yídìng shì ge hǎo xuésheng.
Yes, he'll be a good student when he grows up.

q: 下面的什么他们没有说到？
Xiàmiàn de shénme tāmen méiyǒu shuōdào?

o: 孩子将来的学习一定很好
háizi jiānglái de xuéxí yídìng hěn hǎo

lines: 宝宝这是怎么了，抱了这么半天还不睡觉。
Bǎobao zhè shì zěnme le, bào le zhème bàntiān hái bú shuìjiào.
What's up with the baby? I've held him for ages and he still won't sleep.
你轻轻地拍拍他，再小声地唱唱歌，他一会儿就睡了。
Nǐ qīngqīng de pāipai tā, zài xiǎoshēng de chàngchang gē, tā yíhuìr jiù shuì le.
Pat him gently and sing softly, and he'll be asleep in no time.

q: 他们在说什么事儿？
Tāmen zài shuō shénme shìr?
What are they talking about?
o: how to get a baby to sleep

lines: 今天不做完作业，你就别想出去玩。
Jīntiān bú zuòwán zuòyè, nǐ jiù bié xiǎng chūqu wán.
If you don't finish your homework today, forget about going out to play.
这么多作业，我怎么也做不完呀。
Zhème duō zuòyè, wǒ zěnme yě zuò bu wán ya.
There's so much, there's no way I can finish it.

q: 第二个人的意思是……
Dì èr ge rén de yìsi shì …
The second person means …
o: wǒ hěn kuài jiù zuòwán le
wǒ bú huì zuò, zuò bu wán
I can't do it, I can't finish
there's no way I can finish

lines: 请问，益达公司的大楼在哪边？
Qǐngwèn, Yìdá Gōngsī de dàlóu zài nǎ biān?
Excuse me, which way is the Yida Company building?
益达公司？您转过身去，一抬头就能看见公司的大楼了。
Yìdá Gōngsī? Nín zhuǎn guo shēn qu, yì tái tóu jiù néng kànjiàn gōngsī de dàlóu le.
Yida? Turn round and you'll see the building as soon as you look up.

q: 益达公司的大楼在第一个人的……
Yìdá Gōngsī de dàlóu zài dì yī ge rén de …
The building is … the first person

grammar: 一心想……
to want only …
一心 means with all your heart.
两个孩子一心想吃的却是另外的东西。
Liǎng ge háizi yìxīn xiǎng chī de què shì lìngwài de dōngxi.
What the children really wanted was something else.
他一心想去中国。
Tā yìxīn xiǎng qù Zhōngguó.
He's set on going to China.
……才放下心来
only then relaxed
才 shows relief came late.
看到儿子回来了才放下心来。
Kàndào érzi huílai le cái fàngxià xīn lai.
Only when she saw her son did she relax.
听到消息，我才放下心来。
Tīngdào xiāoxi, wǒ cái fàngxià xīn lai.
Only after hearing the news did I relax.
adj + 得连……都……
so … that not even …
This combines a degree complement with 连……都.
小明忙得连招呼都没跟我打。
Xiǎo Míng máng de lián zhāohu dōu méi gēn wǒ dǎ.
Xiao Ming was so busy he didn't even say hello.
他累得连饭都不想吃。
Tā lèi de lián fàn dōu bù xiǎng chī.
He's too tired even to eat.
V + 得不得了
extremely …
不得了 after 得 means “to an extreme degree”.
王奶奶对小孙子喜爱得不得了。
Wáng nǎinai duì xiǎo sūnzi xǐ'ài de bùdéliǎo.
Granny Wang adores her grandson.
今天热得不得了。
Jīntiān rè de bùdéliǎo.
It's incredibly hot today.
别光……
don't just …
光 means “only”.
别光舔嘴唇。
Bié guāng tiǎn zuǐchún.
Don't just lick your lips.
别光说，快做吧。
Bié guāng shuō, kuài zuò ba.
Stop talking and do it.
as soon as …
This shows one thing follows immediately.
一抬头就能看见公司的大楼了。
Yì tái tóu jiù néng kànjiàn gōngsī de dàlóu le.
You'll see it as soon as you look up.
我一到家就给你打电话。
Wǒ yí dào jiā jiù gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
I'll call you as soon as I'm home.

着大白兔的糖纸躺在床上，
王奶奶对小孙子喜爱得
就能看见公司的大楼了。

132.title: Baldy Li and Song Gang
132.sub: A short passage with six open questions
132.transcriptNote: A short passage introducing the characters of Yu Hua's novel 《兄弟》 (Brothers), then six questions to answer in your own words. Some question numbers aren't read aloud. The model answers are my own.

blocks.label: 短文
lines: Lǐ Guāngtóu de zhēnmíng jiào Lǐ Guāng.
Baldy Li's real name is Li Guang.
每次理发时，他母亲总是让理发师把他的头发推光，所以人们都叫他李光头。
Měi cì lǐfà shí, tā mǔqīn zǒngshì ràng lǐfàshī bǎ tā de tóufa tuīguāng, suǒyǐ rénmen dōu jiào tā Lǐ Guāngtóu.
Every haircut, his mother had the barber shave his head, so people called him Baldy Li.
最后连他母亲都习惯了。
Zuìhòu lián tā mǔqīn dōu xíguàn le.
In the end even his mother got used to it.
李光头和宋刚是兄弟俩。有人可能会觉得奇怪：宋刚姓宋，李光头姓李，他们怎么是一家人呢？
Lǐ Guāngtóu hé Sòng Gāng shì xiōngdì liǎ. Yǒu rén kěnéng huì juéde qíguài: Sòng Gāng xìng Sòng, Lǐ Guāngtóu xìng Lǐ, tāmen zěnme shì yì jiā rén ne?
Baldy Li and Song Gang are brothers. You may wonder how, when one is called Song and the other Li.
原来，李光头还没出生的时候，他爸爸就死了，妈妈李兰一个人带着李光头生活。
Yuánlái, Lǐ Guāngtóu hái méi chūshēng de shíhou, tā bàba jiù sǐ le, māma Lǐ Lán yí ge rén dài zhe Lǐ Guāngtóu shēnghuó.
It turns out Baldy Li's father died before he was born, and his mother Li Lan brought him up alone.
而宋凡平的妻子，就是宋刚的妈妈，也因病去世了。
Ér Sòng Fánpíng de qīzi, jiù shì Sòng Gāng de māma, yě yīn bìng qùshì le.
And Song Fanping's wife, Song Gang's mother, had died of illness.
后来，李兰和宋凡平谈了恋爱，最后结了婚，这样，宋刚和李光头也就成了一家人。
Hòulái, Lǐ Lán hé Sòng Fánpíng tán le liàn'ài, zuìhòu jié le hūn, zhèyàng, Sòng Gāng hé Lǐ Guāngtóu yě jiù chéng le yì jiā rén.
Later Li Lan and Song Fanping fell in love and married, so Song Gang and Baldy Li became one family.
结婚那天晚上，宋凡平给孩子们吃了几颗大白兔奶糖，让他们尝到了从来没有过的好味道。
Jiéhūn nà tiān wǎnshang, Sòng Fánpíng gěi háizimen chī le jǐ kē Dàbáitù nǎitáng, ràng tāmen chángdào le cónglái méiyǒu guo de hǎo wèidao.
On the wedding night Song Fanping gave the children some White Rabbit sweets, a taste they'd never known.
你想知道这兄弟俩后来的故事吗？那你就看看余华的小说《兄弟》吧。
Nǐ xiǎng zhīdào zhè xiōngdì liǎ hòulái de gùshi ma? Nà nǐ jiù kànkan Yú Huá de xiǎoshuō 《Xiōngdì》 ba.
Want to know what happened to the brothers? Read Yu Hua's novel Brothers.

blocks.label: 回答问题
blocks.h: 回答问题 · Answer the questions

q: 李光头的名字是真的吗？
Lǐ Guāngtóu de míngzi shì zhēn de ma?
Is “Baldy Li” his real name?
ans: 不是。
Bú shì.
No.

q: 他原来叫什么？
Tā yuánlái jiào shénme?
What was his real name?
ans: 李光。
Lǐ Guāng.
Li Guang.

q: 为什么叫李光头了？
Wèishénme jiào Lǐ Guāngtóu le?
Why was he called Baldy Li?
ans: 因为每次理发，他母亲都让理发师把他的头发推光。
Yīnwèi měi cì lǐfà, tā mǔqīn dōu ràng lǐfàshī bǎ tā de tóufa tuīguāng.
His mother always had his head shaved.

q: 宋刚为什么和李光头成了一家人了？
Sòng Gāng wèishénme hé Lǐ Guāngtóu chéng le yì jiā rén le?
Why did Song Gang and Baldy Li become one family?
ans: 因为李光头的妈妈李兰和宋刚的爸爸宋凡平结婚了。
Yīnwèi Lǐ Guāngtóu de māma Lǐ Lán hé Sòng Gāng de bàba Sòng Fánpíng jiéhūn le.
Their widowed parents married.

q: 宋凡平和李兰结婚那天，孩子们吃到了什么？
Sòng Fánpíng hé Lǐ Lán jiéhūn nà tiān, háizimen chīdào le shénme?
What did the children eat on the wedding day?
ans: 大白兔奶糖。
Dàbáitù nǎitáng.
White Rabbit sweets.

q: 李光头和宋刚的故事是从哪儿来的？
Lǐ Guāngtóu hé Sòng Gāng de gùshi shì cóng nǎr lái de?
Where does their story come from?
ans: 余华的小说《兄弟》。
Yú Huá de xiǎoshuō 《Xiōngdì》.
Yu Hua's novel Brothers.

grammar: 让……把……V
to have someone do something to …
让 is causative and 把 moves the object forward.
他母亲总是让理发师把他的头发推光。
Tā mǔqīn zǒngshì ràng lǐfàshī bǎ tā de tóufa tuīguāng.
His mother had the barber shave his head.
老师让我们把书打开。
Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen bǎ shū dǎkāi.
The teacher had us open our books.
原来
so it turns out
原来 introduces the explanation for something puzzling.
原来，李光头还没出生的时候，他爸爸就死了。
Yuánlái, Lǐ Guāngtóu hái méi chūshēng de shíhou, tā bàba jiù sǐ le.
It turns out his father died before he was born.
原来是你！
Yuánlái shì nǐ!
Oh, it's you!
因病去世
to die of illness
因 is the written form of 因为.
也因病去世了。
Yě yīn bìng qùshì le.
Had died of illness.
比赛因雨取消了。
Bǐsài yīn yǔ qǔxiāo le.
The match was cancelled because of rain.
gaps: 到了从来没有过的好味道。
say: Baldy Li's real name is Li Guang.

133.title: Do you know White Rabbit sweets?
133.sub: A short passage about a famous sweet
133.transcriptNote: A short passage with no questions.

lines: Do you know White Rabbit sweets?
大白兔奶糖是白色的，每颗糖都先用可以吃的米纸包着，外面再用糖纸包好。
Dàbáitù nǎitáng shì báisè de, měi kē táng dōu xiān yòng kěyǐ chī de mǐzhǐ bāo zhe, wàimiàn zài yòng tángzhǐ bāohǎo.
White Rabbit sweets are white. Each one is first wrapped in edible rice paper, then in a sweet wrapper.
出生在六十年代的中国人，可能没有多少人不知道大白兔奶糖，因为它早在那个时候就很有名了。
Chūshēng zài liùshí niándài de Zhōngguórén, kěnéng méiyǒu duōshao rén bù zhīdào Dàbáitù nǎitáng, yīnwèi tā zǎo zài nàge shíhou jiù hěn yǒumíng le.
Few Chinese people born in the sixties won't know them, because they were famous even then.
广州有一位一百零二岁的老人，每天一定要吃几颗大白兔奶糖。
Guǎngzhōu yǒu yí wèi yìbǎi líng èr suì de lǎorén, měi tiān yídìng yào chī jǐ kē Dàbáitù nǎitáng.
A 102-year-old woman in Guangzhou has to eat a few White Rabbit sweets every day.
她的儿女们都认为，母亲就是因为吃大白兔奶糖才长寿的。
Tā de érnǚmen dōu rènwéi, mǔqīn jiù shì yīnwèi chī Dàbáitù nǎitáng cái chángshòu de.
Her children believe it's thanks to White Rabbit sweets that she's lived so long.
她的邻居们都叫她“兔奶奶”。
Tā de línjūmen dōu jiào tā “Tù nǎinai”.
北京也有一位“兔爷爷”，也九十多岁了，
Běijīng yě yǒu yí wèi “Tù yéye”, yě jiǔshí duō suì le,
Beijing has a “Grandpa Rabbit” too, over ninety,
他也是自从有了大白兔奶糖以来就一直在吃。
tā yě shì zìcóng yǒu le Dàbáitù nǎitáng yǐlái jiù yìzhí zài chī.
who has eaten them ever since they first appeared.
一天，他不小心被一辆车碰了一下，可到医院一检查，却一点儿问题也没有，当天就走着回家了。
Yì tiān, tā bù xiǎoxīn bèi yí liàng chē pèng le yíxià, kě dào yīyuàn yì jiǎnchá, què yìdiǎnr wèntí yě méiyǒu, dàngtiān jiù zǒu zhe huí jiā le.
One day he was knocked by a car, but the hospital found nothing wrong and he walked home the same day.
家里人都认为是大白兔增加了他身体里的钙。
Jiā li rén dōu rènwéi shì Dàbáitù zēngjiā le tā shēntǐ li de gài.
His family think White Rabbit boosted the calcium in his body.

grammar: first …, then …
This orders two steps.
每颗糖都先用可以吃的米纸包着，外面再用糖纸包好。
Měi kē táng dōu xiān yòng kěyǐ chī de mǐzhǐ bāo zhe, wàimiàn zài yòng tángzhǐ bāohǎo.
Each is first wrapped in rice paper, then in a wrapper.
先吃饭，再看电视。
Xiān chī fàn, zài kàn diànshì.
Eat first, then watch TV.
没有多少人不……
hardly anyone doesn't …
A double negative meaning “almost everyone”.
可能没有多少人不知道大白兔奶糖。
Kěnéng méiyǒu duōshao rén bù zhīdào Dàbáitù nǎitáng.
Few won't know White Rabbit sweets.
没有人不喜欢他。
Méiyǒu rén bù xǐhuan tā.
Everyone likes him.
是因为……才……的
it's because of … that …
This stresses the cause.
母亲就是因为吃大白兔奶糖才长寿的。
Mǔqīn jiù shì yīnwèi chī Dàbáitù nǎitáng cái chángshòu de.
It's because of the sweets that she's lived so long.
他是因为生病才没来的。
Tā shì yīnwèi shēngbìng cái méi lái de.
He didn't come because he was ill.
as soon as …, yet …
却 marks the unexpected result.
可到医院一检查，却一点儿问题也没有。
Kě dào yīyuàn yì jiǎnchá, què yìdiǎnr wèntí yě méiyǒu.
But the hospital found nothing wrong.
我一看，却不是他。
Wǒ yí kàn, què bú shì tā.
I looked, but it wasn't him.
gaps: 每颗糖都先用可以吃的
母亲就是因为吃大白兔奶糖才
家里人都认为是大白兔
say: A 102-year-old woman in Guangzhou has to eat a few White Rabbit sweets every day.
The hospital found nothing wrong and he walked home the same day.

136.title: White Rabbit toffee
136.sub: The lesson text, adapted from Yu Hua's novel 《兄弟》
136.transcriptNote: The lesson text, a story split into paragraphs. Names are spelled as in part 132.

lines: 这个故事发生在上个世纪六十年代初中国南方的一个小镇里。
Zhège gùshi fāshēng zài shàng ge shìjì liùshí niándài chū Zhōngguó nánfāng de yí ge xiǎo zhèn li.
This story takes place in the early 1960s, in a small town in southern China.
李兰的丈夫死了，她一个人带着孩子生活。
Lǐ Lán de zhàngfu sǐ le, tā yí ge rén dài zhe háizi shēnghuó.
Li Lan's husband had died, and she was bringing up her child alone.
宋凡平的妻子去世以后，也留下了一个孩子。
Sòng Fánpíng de qīzi qùshì yǐhòu, yě liúxià le yí ge háizi.
Song Fanping's wife had died too, leaving a child.
这一天，李兰和宋凡平结婚了。
Zhè yì tiān, Lǐ Lán hé Sòng Fánpíng jiéhūn le.
On this day, Li Lan and Song Fanping got married.
客人们走了以后，一家四口在一起吃了一顿有鱼有肉的美餐。
Kèrénmen zǒu le yǐhòu, yì jiā sì kǒu zài yìqǐ chī le yí dùn yǒu yú yǒu ròu de měicān.
After the guests left, the family of four shared a fine meal with fish and meat.
可是两个孩子一心想吃的却是另外的东西。
Kěshì liǎng ge háizi yìxīn xiǎng chī de què shì lìngwài de dōngxi.
But what the two children really wanted was something else.
宋凡平嘿嘿地笑着，问两个孩子想吃什么糖。
Sòng Fánpíng hēihēi de xiào zhe, wèn liǎng ge háizi xiǎng chī shénme táng.
Song Fanping chuckled and asked the boys what sweets they wanted.
李光头和宋刚同时拿起了放在桌子上的糖纸，说：“想吃这样的糖。”
Lǐ Guāngtóu hé Sòng Gāng tóngshí náqǐ le fàng zài zhuōzi shang de tángzhǐ, shuō: “Xiǎng chī zhèyàng de táng.”
Baldy Li and Song Gang both picked up the wrappers on the table: “We want sweets like this.”
宋凡平装模作样地把手伸进口袋，问他们：“你们想吃硬糖？”
Sòng Fánpíng zhuāng mú zuò yàng de bǎ shǒu shēnjìn kǒudai, wèn tāmen: “Nǐmen xiǎng chī yìngtáng?”
Song Fanping made a show of putting his hand in his pocket: “You want hard sweets?”
他们使劲地点着头，伸长了脖子，想看到他的口袋。
Tāmen shǐjìn de diǎn zhe tóu, shēncháng le bózi, xiǎng kàndào tā de kǒudai.
They nodded hard and craned their necks to see into his pocket.
可是宋凡平摇了摇头说：“没有了。”
Kěshì Sòng Fánpíng yáo le yáo tóu shuō: “Méiyǒu le.”
But Song Fanping shook his head: “All gone.”
两个孩子失望得差点儿哭出来。
Liǎng ge háizi shīwàng de chàdiǎnr kū chulai.
The boys were so disappointed they nearly cried.
宋凡平这时说：“没有了，硬糖都吃光了，只有软糖。”
Sòng Fánpíng zhè shí shuō: “Méiyǒu le, yìngtáng dōu chīguāng le, zhǐ yǒu ruǎntáng.”
Then Song Fanping said: “No more hard sweets, they've all been eaten. There are only soft ones.”
李光头和宋刚立刻瞪圆了眼睛，抬起头来盯着宋凡平。
Lǐ Guāngtóu hé Sòng Gāng lìkè dèngyuán le yǎnjing, tái qi tóu lai dīng zhe Sòng Fánpíng.
Baldy Li and Song Gang's eyes went wide, and they looked up and stared at him.
他们从来没有听说过这个世界上还有一种糖的名字叫软糖。
Tāmen cónglái méiyǒu tīngshuō guo zhège shìjiè shang hái yǒu yì zhǒng táng de míngzi jiào ruǎntáng.
They'd never heard there was a kind of sweet in the world called a soft sweet.
他们看到他站起来，摸遍了身上的口袋，像要把软糖摸出来似的，
Tāmen kàndào tā zhàn qilai, mōbiàn le shēn shang de kǒudai, xiàng yào bǎ ruǎntáng mō chulai shìde,
They watched him stand and feel through all his pockets, as if to find the soft sweets,
他们的小心脏砰砰地跳个不停。
tāmen de xiǎo xīnzàng pēngpēng de tiào ge bù tíng.
and their little hearts thumped away.
宋凡平把口袋一个一个地翻过来给他们看，嘴里说着：“软糖呢？软糖呢？”
Sòng Fánpíng bǎ kǒudai yí gège de fān guolai gěi tāmen kàn, zuǐ li shuō zhe: “Ruǎntáng ne? Ruǎntáng ne?”
Song Fanping turned out his pockets one by one, saying, “Where are the soft sweets? Where are they?”
当他把最后一个口袋翻过来，里面仍然是空的时候，李光头和宋刚哇地哭了出来。
Dāng tā bǎ zuìhòu yí ge kǒudai fān guolai, lǐmiàn réngrán shì kōng de shíhou, Lǐ Guāngtóu hé Sòng Gāng wā de kū le chulai.
When he turned out the last pocket and it was still empty, Baldy Li and Song Gang burst into tears.
宋凡平拍着自己的脑袋对他们说：“哦，我想起来了。”
Sòng Fánpíng pāi zhe zìjǐ de nǎodai duì tāmen shuō: “Ò, wǒ xiǎng qilai le.”
Song Fanping slapped his head: “Oh, now I remember.”
他转身轻手轻脚地走向里面的屋子，好像要抓什么小虫子一样。
Tā zhuǎnshēn qīng shǒu qīng jiǎo de zǒuxiàng lǐmiàn de wūzi, hǎoxiàng yào zhuā shénme xiǎo chóngzi yíyàng.
He turned and tiptoed into the inner room, as if trying to catch some little insect.
当他在门口重新出现时，李光头和宋刚看到他手里提着一袋奶糖。
Dāng tā zài ménkǒu chóngxīn chūxiàn shí, Lǐ Guāngtóu hé Sòng Gāng kàndào tā shǒu li tí zhe yí dài nǎitáng.
When he reappeared in the doorway, the boys saw he was carrying a bag of toffees.
两个孩子惊叫起来，然后他们第一次吃到了软糖，第一次吃到了奶油味儿的软糖。
Liǎng ge háizi jīngjiào qilai, ránhòu tāmen dì yī cì chīdào le ruǎntáng, dì yī cì chīdào le nǎiyóu wèir de ruǎntáng.
The boys shrieked, and then for the first time they tasted soft sweets, creamy soft sweets.
包着它的糖纸上印着一只大白兔，它的名字就叫大白兔。
Bāo zhe tā de tángzhǐ shang yìn zhe yì zhī dà bái tù, tā de míngzi jiù jiào Dàbáitù.
Its wrapper had a big white rabbit printed on it, and its name was White Rabbit.
宋凡平说，这是他在上海的姐姐邮寄过来的，是姐姐给他的结婚礼物。
Sòng Fánpíng shuō, zhè shì tā zài Shànghǎi de jiějie yóujì guolai de, shì jiějie gěi tā de jiéhūn lǐwù.
Song Fanping said his sister in Shanghai had posted them as a wedding present.
宋凡平让李兰尝一颗，他自己也尝了一颗，给了李光头和宋刚每个人五颗。
Sòng Fánpíng ràng Lǐ Lán cháng yì kē, tā zìjǐ yě cháng le yì kē, gěi le Lǐ Guāngtóu hé Sòng Gāng měi ge rén wǔ kē.
He had Li Lan try one, tried one himself, and gave the boys five each.
两个孩子把奶糖放在嘴里，慢慢地舔，慢慢地咬，慢慢地吞着口水。
Liǎng ge háizi bǎ nǎitáng fàng zài zuǐ li, mànmàn de tiǎn, mànmàn de yǎo, mànmàn de tūn zhe kǒushuǐ.
The boys put the toffees in their mouths, slowly licking, slowly biting, slowly swallowing.
他们的口水和糖一样甜，和奶油一样香。
Tāmen de kǒushuǐ hé táng yíyàng tián, hé nǎiyóu yíyàng xiāng.
Their saliva was as sweet as sugar and as fragrant as cream.
李光头把米饭放进嘴里，和奶糖一起嚼，宋刚也学着把米饭放进了嘴里。
Lǐ Guāngtóu bǎ mǐfàn fàngjìn zuǐ li, hé nǎitáng yìqǐ jiáo, Sòng Gāng yě xué zhe bǎ mǐfàn fàngjìn le zuǐ li.
Baldy Li put rice in his mouth and chewed it with the toffee, and Song Gang copied him.
孩子们嘴里的米饭也像糖一样甜起来了，他们嘴里米饭的名字也叫大白兔了。
Háizimen zuǐ li de mǐfàn yě xiàng táng yíyàng tián qilai le, tāmen zuǐ li mǐfàn de míngzi yě jiào Dàbáitù le.
The rice in their mouths turned sweet as sugar too, and its name became White Rabbit.
宋刚一边美美地吃着，一边亲热地叫着：“李光头，李光头。”
Sòng Gāng yìbiān měiměi de chī zhe, yìbiān qīnrè de jiào zhe: “Lǐ Guāngtóu, Lǐ Guāngtóu.”
Song Gang ate happily, calling affectionately: “Baldy Li, Baldy Li.”
李光头也一边吃一边叫着：“宋刚，宋刚。”
Lǐ Guāngtóu yě yìbiān chī yìbiān jiào zhe: “Sòng Gāng, Sòng Gāng.”
Baldy Li ate and called back: “Song Gang, Song Gang.”
宋凡平哈哈大笑起来，李兰也幸福地笑着。
Sòng Fánpíng hāhā dà xiào qilai, Lǐ Lán yě xìngfú de xiào zhe.
Song Fanping roared with laughter, and Li Lan smiled happily.
这时，宋凡平转向两个孩子，把大笑变成了微笑，对他们说：
Zhè shí, Sòng Fánpíng zhuǎnxiàng liǎng ge háizi, bǎ dà xiào biànchéng le wēixiào, duì tāmen shuō:
Then Song Fanping turned to the boys, his laugh softening into a smile:
“从今天起，你们就是兄弟，你们要亲如手足，你们要互相帮助，
“Cóng jīntiān qǐ, nǐmen jiù shì xiōngdì, nǐmen yào qīn rú shǒu zú, nǐmen yào hùxiāng bāngzhù,
“From today you are brothers. Be as close as brothers, help each other,
你们要有福同享，有难同当，你们要好好学习，天天向上。”
nǐmen yào yǒu fú tóng xiǎng, yǒu nàn tóng dāng, nǐmen yào hǎohāo xuéxí, tiāntiān xiàngshàng.”
share the good times and the bad, study hard and improve every day.”
就这样，宋凡平和李兰成了夫妻，宋刚和李光头成了兄弟，两个家庭变成了一个家庭。
Jiù zhèyàng, Sòng Fánpíng hé Lǐ Lán chéng le fūqī, Sòng Gāng hé Lǐ Guāngtóu chéng le xiōngdì, liǎng ge jiātíng biànchéng le yí ge jiātíng.
And so Song Fanping and Li Lan became husband and wife, the boys became brothers, and two families became one.
两个孩子睡在外屋，大人们睡在里屋。
Liǎng ge háizi shuì zài wàiwū, dàrénmen shuì zài lǐwū.
The children slept in the outer room and the adults in the inner one.
这一天的夜晚，李光头和宋刚捧着大白兔的糖纸躺到了床上，闻着糖纸上的奶香，准备去和梦中的大白兔奶糖相遇。
Zhè yì tiān de yèwǎn, Lǐ Guāngtóu hé Sòng Gāng pěng zhe Dàbáitù de tángzhǐ tǎngdào le chuáng shang, wén zhe tángzhǐ shang de nǎi xiāng, zhǔnbèi qù hé mèng zhōng de Dàbáitù nǎitáng xiāngyù.
That night Baldy Li and Song Gang lay in bed holding their White Rabbit wrappers, smelling the milky scent, ready to meet White Rabbit toffee in their dreams.

vocab: yǒu fú tóng xiǎng, yǒu nàn tóng dāng
share the good and the bad
grammar: 一家四口
a family of four
Number + 口 counts family members.
一家四口在一起吃了一顿有鱼有肉的美餐。
Yì jiā sì kǒu zài yìqǐ chī le yí dùn yǒu yú yǒu ròu de měicān.
The family of four shared a fine meal.
我家有五口人。
Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.
There are five in my family.
adj + 得差点儿……
so … that nearly …
得 links the feeling to what nearly happened.
两个孩子失望得差点儿哭出来。
Liǎng ge háizi shīwàng de chàdiǎnr kū chulai.
They were so disappointed they nearly cried.
我高兴得差点儿跳起来。
Wǒ gāoxìng de chàdiǎnr tiào qilai.
I was so happy I nearly jumped.
像……似的
as if …
像 + clause + 似的 compares with an imagined situation.
像要把软糖摸出来似的。
Xiàng yào bǎ ruǎntáng mō chulai shìde.
As if to find the soft sweets.
他像没听见似的。
Tā xiàng méi tīngjiàn shìde.
He acted as if he hadn't heard.
V + 个不停
to keep …-ing
个不停 after a verb means non-stop.
他们的小心脏砰砰地跳个不停。
Tāmen de xiǎo xīnzàng pēngpēng de tiào ge bù tíng.
Their little hearts kept thumping.
雨下个不停。
Yǔ xià ge bù tíng.
It kept raining.
好像……一样
just like …
好像 + clause + 一样 makes a comparison.
好像要抓什么小虫子一样。
Hǎoxiàng yào zhuā shénme xiǎo chóngzi yíyàng.
As if trying to catch an insect.
她好像我妈妈一样。
Tā hǎoxiàng wǒ māma yíyàng.
She's just like my mother.
慢慢地……，慢慢地……
slowly …, slowly …
Repeating the adverb gives rhythm to a series of actions.
慢慢地舔，慢慢地咬，慢慢地吞着口水。
Mànmàn de tiǎn, mànmàn de yǎo, mànmàn de tūn zhe kǒushuǐ.
Slowly licking, slowly biting, slowly swallowing.
他慢慢地走，慢慢地想。
Tā mànmàn de zǒu, mànmàn de xiǎng.
He walked slowly, thinking slowly.
一边……一边……
while …
This links two actions done at the same time.
宋刚一边美美地吃着，一边亲热地叫着。
Sòng Gāng yìbiān měiměi de chī zhe, yìbiān qīnrè de jiào zhe.
Song Gang ate happily while calling out affectionately.
他一边听音乐一边做作业。
Tā yìbiān tīng yīnyuè yìbiān zuò zuòyè.
He does homework while listening to music.
把 A 变成 B
to turn A into B
把 + 变成 shows a transformation.
把大笑变成了微笑。
Bǎ dà xiào biànchéng le wēixiào.
His laugh softened into a smile.
他把房间变成了书房。
Tā bǎ fángjiān biànchéng le shūfáng.
He turned the room into a study.
gaps: 李兰的丈夫死了，她一个人
一家四口在一起吃了一顿有鱼有肉的
着大白兔的糖纸躺到了床上，
say: Baldy Li and Song Gang's eyes went wide, and they looked up and stared at him.
The boys put the toffees in their mouths, slowly licking, slowly biting.
From today you are brothers. Be as close as brothers, help each other.
